## Source: app/api/cron/tick/route.ts

````text
import { flushNotifications } from '../../../../lib/reviews';
import { migrateTimetable } from '../../../../lib/unified-timetable';
/**
 * The sole scheduler driver. Authenticated by the X-Cron-Secret header only,
 * and a mismatch returns 404 rather than 401 so the endpoint does not advertise
 * that it exists.
 *
 * TWO PASSES, AND THE ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING:
 *
 *   1. SEND everything whose time has come.
 *   2. GENERATE for every slot whose review window has opened.
 *
 * Sending first because a generation takes 30-60 seconds of LLM work and can
 * fail slowly, and a post that was ready to go out at 09:00 must not sit behind
 * a cycle that is busy judging feeds. Publishing is cheap, bounded, and the
 * thing with a deadline; writing is neither.
 *
 * ACK-THEN-WORK: responds in ~1s and does the work in after(). Cron providers
 * typically time out client-side around 30 seconds, and a cycle takes longer —
 * but the work MUST go through after() with maxDuration set, because serverless
 * kills background work the moment the response returns.
 *
 * TICK FREQUENCY: every 5 minutes or better. The review window is defined as a
 * MINIMUM (see lib/slots.ts), so a late tick gives more warning rather than
 * less — but a tick slower than the shortest lead time means slots are noticed
 * after their moment and marked missed. GitHub Actions cannot hold this: it
 * floors at 5 minutes and routinely runs 15+ minutes late. Vercel's Hobby cron
 * permits once per day. cron-job.org runs every minute, free.
 *
 * Double triggers are harmless: generation is claimed per (slot, local day),
 * every cycle passes an advisory lock on its own slot, and every publish goes
 * through its own idempotency key.
 */
import { after, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { runCycleWithLock, runDueSlots } from "../../../../lib/cycle";
import { publishDuePosts } from "../../../../lib/distribute";
import { notify } from "../../../../lib/push";
import { sweepIfDue } from "../../../../lib/retention";
import { listDueSlots, MISSED_AFTER_MINUTES, recordTick } from "../../../../lib/slots";

/**
 * Tell the phone what just happened.
 *
 * Only things that HAPPENED, on the tick that made them happen. The standing
 * health properties — a stalled scheduler, an expiring token — are checked by
 * /api/watchdog instead, driven from a different machine, because a tick cannot
 * report that ticks have stopped.
 *
 * Failures here are swallowed by notify() itself. A send that succeeded must
 * not be recorded as failed because a notification could not be delivered.
 */
async function announce(results: { agentId: string; seq: number; outcome: string; detail?: string }[]) {
  for (const r of results) {
    if (r.outcome === "published") {
      await notify(r.agentId, { kind: "published", seq: r.seq });
    } else if (r.outcome === "failed") {
      await notify(r.agentId, { kind: "publish_failed", seq: r.seq, detail: r.detail ?? "unknown" });
    }
    // "missed" and "ambiguous" are deliberately silent here: both are already
    // shouted about in the queue, and neither is actionable at 3am.
  }
}

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 300;

function authorized(request: Request): boolean {
  const expected = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  if (!expected) return false;
  const provided = request.headers.get("x-cron-secret") ?? "";
  if (provided.length !== expected.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) diff |= provided.charCodeAt(i) ^ expected.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  if (!authorized(request)) return new NextResponse("Not Found", { status: 404 });

  // Before anything else, and regardless of what the passes then do. The
  // heartbeat records that the SCHEDULER IS ALIVE — a tick that legitimately
  // finds nothing due is still proof the cron is running, and that is exactly
  // the case the app could not previously distinguish from a dead one.
  await recordTick();

  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const forcedAgent = url.searchParams.get("agent");
  const force = url.searchParams.get("force") === "1";

  try {
    // A forced single-agent run is the manual escape hatch and keeps the old
    // whole-agent behaviour, bypassing slots entirely.
    if (forcedAgent) {
      after(async () => {
        const result = await runCycleWithLock(forcedAgent, force);
        console.log(`[tick] forced ${forcedAgent}: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
      });
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, forced: forcedAgent });
    }

    after(async () => {
      // ---- 1. SEND. Never let this wait behind generation.
      try {
        const sent = await publishDuePosts(MISSED_AFTER_MINUTES);
        for (const s of sent) {
          console.log(`[tick] send agent=${s.agentId} p${s.seq} ${s.outcome}${s.detail ? ` (${s.detail})` : ""}`);
        }
        await announce(sent);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[tick] send pass failed:", err);
      }

      try { await migrateTimetable(); await flushNotifications(); }
      catch(err) { console.error("[tick] daily review pass failed:",err); }
      // ---- 3. HOUSEKEEPING. Self-throttled to once a day, and last because
      // deleting old rejections must never delay a post that is due.
      try {
        await sweepIfDue();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[tick] sweep failed:", err);
      }

      // ---- 2. GENERATE. Serialized inside runDueSlots — cycles share a
      // per-model LLM rate limit, so concurrency here just produces 429s.
      try {
        const generated = await runDueSlots();
        // Drafts announce themselves from inside runCycle, so every trigger —
        // this tick, "Run a cycle now", a forced run — reports identically.
        for (const g of generated) {
          console.log(`[tick] slot agent=${g.agentId}: ${JSON.stringify(g)}`);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[tick] generate pass failed:", err);
      }
    });

    // Reported before the work runs, so this is what is DUE rather than what
    // happened — the logs above carry the outcomes.
    //
    // This used to report listDueAgents(), which counts the LEGACY per-agent
    // scheduler_state and has had nothing to do with slots since generation
    // moved to them. It sat at 0 forever while the scheduler worked perfectly,
    // which is worse than reporting nothing: it invites you to watch a number
    // that cannot move.
    const due = await listDueSlots();
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      slotsDue: due.length,
      slots: due.map((d) => ({
        at: d.slot.localTime,
        for: d.runDate,
        missed: d.missed,
      })),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[tick] failed:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: String((err as Error)?.message ?? err) });
  }
}

````

````text
/**
 * Run a cycle now, from the dashboard or the app.
 *
 * /api/cron/tick exists for schedulers and is authenticated by a shared secret
 * that no client should ever hold. This is the human equivalent: same work,
 * same advisory lock, but gated by the ordinary session cookie like every
 * other /api route.
 *
 * Forces past the due check on purpose — someone pressing "Run now" has
 * decided, and refusing because the clock says 09:30 is not yet due would make
 * the button look broken.
 *
 * ACK-THEN-WORK, matching the tick route: a cycle takes longer than any
 * sensible request timeout, so the response returns immediately and the work
 * continues in after().
 */
import { after, NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../../lib/request-agent";
import { runCycleWithLock } from "../../../../lib/cycle";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 300;

export async function POST() {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  if (agent.paused) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "agent_paused", detail: "Unpause the agent before running a cycle." },
      { status: 409 },
    );
  }

  after(async () => {
    const result = await runCycleWithLock(agent.agentId, true);
    console.log(`[run] ${agent.agentId}: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`);
  });

  // The advisory lock means a second press while one is running is harmless —
  // it will simply find the lock held and return without doing anything.
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, started: true });
}

````

````text
/**
 * Register this phone for push notifications, or unregister it.
 *
 * Behind the session gate like everything else, so only a signed-in app can
 * attach a device to the agent — otherwise anyone who guessed the URL could
 * subscribe themselves to a stranger's drafts.
 *
 * The app calls POST on every launch, not only the first. FCM rotates tokens
 * on its own schedule and never tells the server, so "register again each time
 * we start" is the only reliable way to keep the registry current; the insert
 * is an upsert precisely so that is cheap.
 */
import { query } from "../../../lib/db";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../lib/request-agent";
import { notify, pushConfigured, registerDevice } from "../../../lib/push";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  let body: { token?: string; platform?: string; action?: string };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_request" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if(body.action==='test') {
    const delivered=await notify(agent.agentId,{kind:'test'},body.token);
    return NextResponse.json(delivered?{ok:true,delivered}:{error:'No notification could be delivered. Enable notifications on this device first.'},{status:delivered?200:503});
  }
  const token = (body.token ?? "").trim();
  // FCM tokens are long opaque strings; anything short is a bug or a probe.
  if (token.length < 20 || token.length > 4096) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_token" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  await registerDevice(agent.agentId, token, body.platform ?? "android");
  // Reported back so the app can say "notifications are on but the server has
  // no Firebase credentials" rather than silently never receiving anything.
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, configured: pushConfigured() });
}

export async function DELETE(request: Request) {
  const agent=await getRequestAgent();
  if(!agent)return NextResponse.json({error:'unauthorized'},{status:401});
  let body: { token?: string };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {body={token:new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('token')??''};}
  const token = (body.token ?? "").trim();
  if (token) await query('DELETE FROM device_tokens WHERE token=$1 AND agent_id=$2',[token,agent.agentId]);
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}
````

````text
/**
 * Public database readiness probe. Return 503 when storage is unavailable so
 * monitoring can detect an outage. Never expose database error details.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getPool } from "../../../lib/db";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  let db: "unconfigured" | "ok" | "unavailable" = "unconfigured";
  try {
    const pool = getPool();
    if (pool) {
      const probe = { text: "SELECT 1", query_timeout: 5_000 };
      await pool.query(probe);
      db = "ok";
    }
  } catch {
    db = "unavailable";
  }
  const ok = db === "ok";
  return NextResponse.json({
    ok,
    db,
    commit: process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA?.slice(0, 7) ?? "local",
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
  }, { status: ok ? 200 : 503, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}
````

## Source: app/api/init/route.ts

````text
/**
 * One-time setup: name, categories, timezone and daily post time.
 *
 * Idempotent on a hash of the payload, so re-posting identical input returns
 * the same agent with its history intact. Answers fast (pure DB work) and
 * expands the persona plus runs the first cycle in after().
 */
import { after, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { ensureAgent, expandStoredPersona } from "../../../lib/agents";
import { requestIdentity, getRequestAgent } from "../../../lib/request-agent";
import { describeCategories, parseCategories, isCategoryId, MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES } from "../../../lib/categories";
import { runCycleWithLock } from "../../../lib/cycle";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 300;

export async function GET() {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  return NextResponse.json({ initialized: !!agent, agent });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  if (await requestIdentity()) return NextResponse.json({error:'Use ByLine onboarding to finish setup.'}, {status:409});
  let body: {
    name?: string;
    categories?: unknown;
    timezone?: string;
    postTimeLocal?: string;
  };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_request" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body) || typeof body.name !== 'string') return NextResponse.json({error:'Enter your name.'},{status:400});
  if (!Array.isArray(body.categories) || body.categories.length < 1 || body.categories.length > MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES || body.categories.some(id=>!isCategoryId(id))) return NextResponse.json({error:'Choose 1–12 subjects from the catalogue.'},{status:400});
  const name = (body.name ?? "").trim();
  if (name.length < 2) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "name_required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const categories = parseCategories(body.categories);
  if (categories.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "at_least_one_category_required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Derived, not typed. This used to be a free-text sentence, and because
  // nothing ever revised it, it outlived the categories it was written for: an
  // agent whose music categories had since been switched off still introduced
  // itself as writing about music, and still had a music-shaped persona built
  // from that sentence. Deriving it means setup and every later category edit
  // produce the same answer. The idempotency hash covers it either way.
  const domain = describeCategories(categories);

  try {
    const { agentId, created } = await ensureAgent(
      { name, domain, categories },
      { timezone: body.timezone, postTimeLocal: body.postTimeLocal },
    );

    if (created) {
      // The persona expansion is one LLM call and the first cycle is two more;
      // neither belongs in the response path.
      after(async () => {
        await expandStoredPersona(agentId);
        await runCycleWithLock(agentId, true);
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ agentId, created });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[init] failed:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "init_failed", detail: String((err as Error)?.message ?? err).slice(0, 200) },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

````

````text
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {getRequestAgent} from '../../../lib/request-agent';
import {query} from '../../../lib/db';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export async function GET() {
  const agent=await getRequestAgent();
  if(!agent)return NextResponse.json({error:'unauthorized'},{status:401});
  const [row]=await query<{topics:string[]}>('SELECT persona_json->\'identity\'->\'interests\' AS topics FROM agents WHERE id=$1',[agent.agentId]);
  return NextResponse.json({topics:row?.topics ?? []},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
}
export async function POST(request:Request) {
  const agent=await getRequestAgent();
  if(!agent)return NextResponse.json({error:'unauthorized'},{status:401});
  const body=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  const topics=body?.topics;
  if(!Array.isArray(topics)||topics.length<1||topics.length>12||topics.some(t=>typeof t!=='string'||t.trim().length<2||t.trim().length>80))
    return NextResponse.json({error:'Add 1–12 topics, each 2–80 characters.'},{status:400});
  const cleaned=topics.map(t=>t.trim());
  if(new Set(cleaned.map(t=>t.toLowerCase())).size!==cleaned.length)
    return NextResponse.json({error:'Each topic should be different.'},{status:400});
  // Keep source categories, voice, corpus and all other persona fields intact.
  // Managed interests are author-controlled and must not be regenerated by AI.
  await query(`UPDATE agents SET persona_json=COALESCE(persona_json,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object(
    'managed',true,'identity',COALESCE(persona_json->'identity','{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object('interests',$2::jsonb)) WHERE id=$1`,
    [agent.agentId,JSON.stringify(cleaned)]);
  return NextResponse.json({ok:true,topics:cleaned});
}
````

## Source: app/api/linkedin/callback/route.ts

````text
import { completeNativeAuth } from '../../../../lib/native-auth';
import { nativeCallbackPage } from '../../../../lib/native-callback';
/**
 * OAuth callback: verify state, exchange the code, resolve the person URN,
 * store the encrypted token.
 *
 * Every exit is a redirect back to the dashboard with an error code rather
 * than raw JSON — this URL is opened as a top-level browser navigation, so
 * whatever it returns is what the user reads.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { saveAccount } from "../../../../lib/accounts";
import { query } from "../../../../lib/db";
import { exchangeCode, getMemberIdentity } from "../../../../lib/linkedin";
import { redirectUriFor } from "../redirect-uri";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function back(request: Request, params: Record<string, string>): NextResponse {
  const url = new URL("/", request.url);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, v);
  return NextResponse.redirect(url);
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
  const state = url.searchParams.get("state");

  const flow = state ? await completeNativeAuth(state, code, url.searchParams.has('error')) : null;
  if (flow) return nativeCallbackPage(flow.ok, flow.returnUri);
  // Native callbacks must never fall through to the legacy web dashboard.
  if (state?.startsWith('native-')) return nativeCallbackPage(false);


  if (!state) return nativeCallbackPage(false);
  // Consume state even on cancellation and keep its native return destination.
  const claimed = await query<{ agent_id: string; native: boolean; return_uri: string | null }>(
    "DELETE FROM oauth_states WHERE state = $1 AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' RETURNING agent_id, native, return_uri",
    [state],
  );
  if (claimed.length === 0) return nativeCallbackPage(false);
  const finish = (ok: boolean, params: Record<string, string>) => claimed[0].native
    ? nativeCallbackPage(ok, claimed[0].return_uri) : back(request, params);
  if (url.searchParams.has('error')) return finish(false, { error: 'linkedin_denied' });
  if (!code) return finish(false, { error: 'missing_code_or_state' });
  const agentId = claimed[0].agent_id;

  const grant = await exchangeCode(code, redirectUriFor(request));
  if (!grant.ok) return finish(false, { error: "token_exchange_failed", detail: grant.reason });

  const identity = await getMemberIdentity(grant.data.accessToken);
  if (!identity.ok) return finish(false, { error: "identity_failed", detail: identity.reason });

  try {
    await saveAccount(agentId, grant.data, identity.data);
  } catch (err) {
    // Almost always a missing or malformed TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
    return finish(false, {
      error: "store_failed",
      detail: String((err as Error)?.message ?? err).slice(0, 160),
    });
  }

  console.log(
    `[linkedin] agent=${agentId} connected as ${identity.data.personUrn}` +
      `${grant.data.refreshToken ? " (with refresh token)" : " (no refresh token — 60-day re-auth)"}`,
  );
  return finish(true, { connected: "1" });
}

````

## Source: app/api/linkedin/connect/route.ts

````text
/**
 * Start the OAuth round trip. Mints a single-use state value, stores it, and
 * redirects to LinkedIn's consent screen.
 */
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../../lib/request-agent";
import { query } from "../../../../lib/db";
import { authorizeUrl } from "../../../../lib/linkedin";
import { redirectUriFor } from "../redirect-uri";
import { nativeReturnUri } from '../../../../lib/native-return';

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  // `?json=1` returns the consent URL instead of redirecting to it.
  //
  // The browser wants a 302 — it is mid-navigation. A phone cannot use one: the
  // Flutter client would have to follow the redirect itself, inside its own HTTP
  // stack, where LinkedIn's consent page is unusable and the session cookie it
  // needs afterwards would never reach the system browser. So the app asks for
  // the URL and hands it to the real browser instead.
  const wantsJson = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("json") === "1";

  const fail = (code: string) =>
    wantsJson
      ? NextResponse.json({ error: code }, { status: 400 })
      : NextResponse.redirect(new URL(`/?error=${code}`, request.url));

  if (!agent) return fail("not_initialized");

  const requestedReturn = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('returnUri');
  const returnUri = nativeReturnUri(requestedReturn);
  if (requestedReturn && !returnUri) return fail('invalid_return_uri');
  const state = `${wantsJson ? 'app-' : ''}${randomUUID()}`;
  await query("INSERT INTO oauth_states (state, agent_id, native, return_uri) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)", [state, agent.agentId, wantsJson, returnUri]);
  // Housekeeping: abandoned round trips would otherwise accumulate forever.
  await query("DELETE FROM oauth_states WHERE created_at < now() - interval '1 hour'");

  const url = authorizeUrl(state, redirectUriFor(request));
  if (!url) return fail("missing_client_id");
  return wantsJson ? NextResponse.json({ url }) : NextResponse.redirect(url);
}

````

````text
/**

 * posts it has no way to publish, then filling the queue with failures.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../../lib/request-agent";
````

````text
/**
 * The redirect URI must be byte-identical between the authorize call, the
 * token exchange, and the value registered in the LinkedIn app — a mismatch
 * is the single most common cause of a failed connection.
 *
 * So it is computed in exactly one place. LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI wins when set
 * (the only reliable option behind proxies and preview deployments); otherwise
 * it is derived from the incoming request for local development.
 */
export function redirectUriFor(request: Request): string {
  const configured = process.env.LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI;
  if (configured) return configured;
  return new URL("/api/linkedin/callback", request.url).toString();
}
````

## Source: app/api/media/route.ts

````text
/**
 * Image upload: register with LinkedIn, PUT the bytes, record the URN.
 *
 * The bytes go through this server rather than straight from the browser to
 * LinkedIn's signed upload URL, because that URL wants the member access token
 * — and that token can post as the user for 60 days. Sending it to the browser
 * to save one hop would be trading a real credential for a minor optimisation.
 *
 * The cost is Vercel's ~4.5MB request body cap, which the client covers by
 * downscaling images before upload (see app/page.tsx). A modern phone photo is
 * 3-8MB at full size and about 400KB once resized to 1920px, so the resize is
 * doing real work here, not just being polite.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getUsableToken } from "../../../lib/accounts";

import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../lib/request-agent";
import { query } from "../../../lib/db";
import { initializeImageUpload, uploadImageBytes } from "../../../lib/linkedin";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 120;

/** Server-side ceiling; the client aims well below this. */
const MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const ALLOWED = new Set(["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/gif"]);

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  const token = await getUsableToken(agent.agentId);
  if (!token.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `linkedin_${token.reason}`, needsReauth: true },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  let file: File | null = null;
  let altText = "";
  try {
    const form = await request.formData();
    const candidate = form.get("file");
    if (candidate instanceof File) file = candidate;
    altText = String(form.get("altText") ?? "").slice(0, 300);
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_form_data" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!file) return NextResponse.json({ error: "file_required" }, { status: 400 });
  if (!ALLOWED.has(file.type)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "unsupported_type", detail: `${file.type} — LinkedIn accepts JPG, PNG and GIF` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }
  if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "file_too_large", detail: `${Math.round(file.size / 1024)}KB, max ${MAX_BYTES / 1024}KB` },
      { status: 413 },
    );
  }

  const registered = await initializeImageUpload(token.token, token.memberUrn);
  if (!registered.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "initialize_failed", detail: registered.reason, needsReauth: registered.needsReauth },
      { status: 502 },
    );
  }

  // Recorded before the PUT so a failed upload leaves a visible trace rather
  // than an image URN that exists at LinkedIn and nowhere here.
  const stored = await query<{ id: string }>(
    `INSERT INTO media_assets (agent_id, linkedin_urn, upload_url, alt_text, filename, status)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'initialized') RETURNING id`,
    [agent.agentId, registered.data.imageUrn, registered.data.uploadUrl, altText || null, file.name],
  );

  const uploaded = await uploadImageBytes(
    token.token,
    registered.data.uploadUrl,
    await file.arrayBuffer(),
    file.type,
  );
  if (!uploaded.ok) {
    await query("UPDATE media_assets SET status = 'failed' WHERE id = $1", [stored[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "upload_failed", detail: uploaded.reason }, { status: 502 });
  }

  await query("UPDATE media_assets SET status = 'uploaded' WHERE id = $1", [stored[0].id]);
  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    id: stored[0].id,
    imageUrn: registered.data.imageUrn,
    altText,
  });
}
````

````text
import { completeNativeAuth } from '../../../../lib/native-auth';
import { nativeCallbackPage } from '../../../../lib/native-callback';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export async function GET(request:Request) {
  const p=new URL(request.url).searchParams;
````

````text
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { digest, issueSession, localTestMode, provisionUser } from '../../../lib/native-auth';
import { query } from '../../../lib/db';
import { authorizeUrl } from '../../../lib/linkedin';
import { nativeReturnUri } from '../../../lib/native-return';
import { checkLoginAllowed, recordLoginFailure, clientKey } from '../../../lib/ratelimit';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
const json = (v:unknown,status=200) => NextResponse.json(v,{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
export async function GET() {
  return json({google:!!(process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&&process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET),
    linkedin:!!(process.env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID&&process.env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET),localTest:localTestMode()});
}
export async function POST(request:Request) {
  const body = await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  if (!body || typeof body.verifier!=='string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43,128}$/.test(body.verifier)) return json({error:'invalid_request'},400);
  if (body.action==='poll') {
    const [flow] = await query<{user_id:string|null;error:string|null}>(
      `DELETE FROM native_auth WHERE id=$1 AND verifier_hash=$2 AND created_at>now()-interval '10 minutes'
       AND (user_id IS NOT NULL OR error IS NOT NULL) RETURNING user_id,error`,[body.id,digest(body.verifier)]);
    if (!flow) return json({pending:true});
    if (flow.error) return json({error:'sign_in_failed',detail:flow.error},400);
    return json({token:await issueSession(flow.user_id!)});
  }
  const key = clientKey(request);
  if (!(await checkLoginAllowed(key)).allowed) return json({error:'Please wait before trying again.'},429);
  await recordLoginFailure(key); // bound account/flow creation too, across instances
  if (body.provider==='local' && localTestMode()) {
    const id = await provisionUser('local',randomUUID(),'Sample author');
    return json({token:await issueSession(id),testMode:true});
  }
  const provider = body.provider;
  const returnUri = nativeReturnUri(body.returnUri);
  if (body.returnUri != null && !returnUri) return json({error:'invalid_return_uri'},400);
  const origin = process.env.BYLINE_PUBLIC_URL ?? new URL(request.url).origin;
  const redirect = provider==='linkedin' ? process.env.LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI ?? `${origin}/api/linkedin/callback` : process.env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI ?? `${origin}/api/native-auth/callback`;
  const id = `native-${randomUUID()}`;
  let url:string|null=null;
  if (provider==='linkedin') url=authorizeUrl(id,redirect);
  if (provider==='google' && process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID && process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET) {
    url=`https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?${new URLSearchParams({client_id:process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,redirect_uri:redirect,response_type:'code',scope:'openid profile email',state:id,prompt:'select_account'})}`;
  }
  if (!url) return json({error:'This sign-in option is not configured yet.'},503);
  await query(`DELETE FROM native_auth WHERE created_at<now()-interval '1 hour'`);
  await query('INSERT INTO native_auth(id,provider,verifier_hash,redirect_uri,return_uri) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)',[id,provider,digest(body.verifier),redirect,returnUri]);
  return json({id,url});
}
````

````text
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requestIdentity } from '../../../lib/request-agent';
import { query, getPool } from '../../../lib/db';
import { setupStatus, parseSetup, generateSetupSample, firstDelivery, setupStyle, setupPersona, setupCategories } from '../../../lib/onboarding';
import { describeCategories } from '../../../lib/categories';
import { localTestMode } from '../../../lib/native-auth';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=120;
export async function GET() {
  const u=await requestIdentity();
  if(!u) return NextResponse.json({error:'unauthorized'},{status:401});
  return NextResponse.json(await setupStatus(u.userId),{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
}
export async function POST(request:Request) {
  const u=await requestIdentity();
  if(!u) return NextResponse.json({error:'unauthorized'},{status:401});
  const b=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  if(!b) return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_request'},{status:400});
  try {
    const current=await setupStatus(u.userId);
    if(current.completed_at) return NextResponse.json(current);
    if(b.action==='save') {
      const config=parseSetup(b.config);
      const changed=await query(`UPDATE onboarding SET config=$2,revision=revision+1,preview=NULL,preview_revision=NULL,accepted_revision=NULL
        WHERE user_id=$1 AND revision=$3 AND completed_at IS NULL RETURNING user_id`,[u.userId,JSON.stringify(config),b.revision]);
      if(!changed.length) throw new Error('Setup changed on another device. Reload and try again.');
    } else if(b.action==='preview') {
      const config=parseSetup(current.config);
      const lease=await query(`UPDATE onboarding SET generating_until=now()+interval '3 minutes',
        preview_attempts=CASE WHEN attempts_day=CURRENT_DATE THEN preview_attempts+1 ELSE 1 END,attempts_day=CURRENT_DATE
        WHERE user_id=$1 AND revision=$2 AND completed_at IS NULL AND (generating_until IS NULL OR generating_until<now())
        AND (attempts_day<>CURRENT_DATE OR preview_attempts<10) RETURNING revision`,[u.userId,b.revision]);
      if(!lease.length) throw new Error('A sample is already running, settings changed, or today’s sample allowance was reached.');
      try {
        const preview=await generateSetupSample(config,u.name);
        await query(`UPDATE onboarding SET preview=$2,preview_revision=$3,accepted_revision=NULL WHERE user_id=$1 AND revision=$3 AND completed_at IS NULL`,[u.userId,JSON.stringify(preview),b.revision]);
      } finally {await query('UPDATE onboarding SET generating_until=NULL WHERE user_id=$1',[u.userId]);}
    } else if(b.action==='accept') {
      const accepted=await query(`UPDATE onboarding SET accepted_revision=revision WHERE user_id=$1 AND revision=$2 AND preview_revision=revision AND preview IS NOT NULL AND generating_until IS NULL RETURNING user_id`,[u.userId,b.revision]);
      if(!accepted.length) throw new Error('Generate and review a sample for your current voice first.');
    } else if(b.action==='finish') {
      const config=parseSetup({...current.config,time:b.time,timezone:b.timezone,notifications:b.notifications});
      if(!localTestMode()&&(!current.account.connected||current.account.needsReauth)) throw new Error('Connect LinkedIn before finishing setup.');
      const next=firstDelivery(config);
      const c=await getPool()!.connect();
      try {
        await c.query('BEGIN');
        const done=await c.query(`UPDATE onboarding SET completed_at=now(),next_delivery_at=$2,config=$3,timetable_migrated=true
          WHERE user_id=$1 AND revision=$4 AND accepted_revision=revision AND preview_revision=revision AND generating_until IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL RETURNING user_id`,[u.userId,next,JSON.stringify(config),b.revision]);
        if(!done.rowCount) throw new Error('Accept your latest sample before finishing.');
        const categories=setupCategories(config);
        await c.query(`UPDATE agents SET paused=false,domain=$2,categories_json=$3,style_json=$4,corpus_json=$5,persona_json=$6,timezone=$7,post_time_local=$8
          WHERE owner_id=$1`,[u.userId,describeCategories(categories),JSON.stringify(categories),JSON.stringify(setupStyle(config)),JSON.stringify(config.samples),JSON.stringify(setupPersona(config,u.name)),config.timezone,config.time]);
        await c.query(`INSERT INTO post_slots(agent_id,local_time,days_mask,lead_minutes,auto_publish,next_run_at)
          SELECT id,$2,127,15,false,$3 FROM agents WHERE owner_id=$1`,[u.userId,config.time,next]);
        await c.query('UPDATE onboarding SET next_delivery_at=NULL WHERE user_id=$1',[u.userId]);
        await c.query('COMMIT');
      } catch(e) {await c.query('ROLLBACK');throw e;} finally {c.release();}
    } else throw new Error('Unknown setup action.');
    return NextResponse.json(await setupStatus(u.userId));
  } catch(e) {return NextResponse.json({error:'setup_failed',detail:(e as Error).message},{status:400});}
}
````

## Source: app/api/posts/[seq]/route.ts

````text
import { ownsMedia } from '../../../../lib/media-ownership';
/**
 * Actions on a single post: edit, clear, publish, discard, hold, reschedule,
 * and resolving an ambiguous send.
 *
 * One route with an explicit `action` rather than nine near-identical routes —
 * every one of these needs the same agent lookup, the same seq validation and
 * the same "is this post still in a state where that makes sense" check.
 *
 * CLEAR AND PUBLISH ARE DIFFERENT THINGS, and the split is the whole point of
 * the scheduling work. `clear` means "I have read this, let it go out at its
 * scheduled time" — the normal action, and the one the primary button in the
 * app performs. `publish` means "send it right now, never mind the schedule" —
 * an override. Before slots existed there was only one action and approving a
 * draft sent it immediately, which is the wrong default the moment a post has a
 * time of its own.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getPersona, voiceReferencesFor } from "../../../../lib/agents";
import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../../lib/request-agent";
import { query } from "../../../../lib/db";
import { publishPost, resolveAmbiguousSend, type ReviewedPost } from "../../../../lib/distribute";
import { assemblePost, checkLength, MAX_BODY_CHARS } from "../../../../lib/format";
import { HOLD_MINUTES } from "../../../../lib/slots";
import { rewriteDraft, writeFollowUp } from "../../../../lib/writer";
import { MAX_HASHTAGS } from "../../../../lib/style";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
// Two model calls in the worst case, not one: rewrite and followup both go
// through repairIfNeeded, which spends a second call whenever the draft misses
// the author's word range or hashtag count — which, on a narrow range, is most
// of the time. Sixty seconds fitted one call comfortably and two only sometimes.
export const maxDuration = 120;

type Action =
  | "edit"
  | "followup"
  | "clear"
  | "unclear"
  | "publish"
  | "discard"
  | "resolve"
  | "rewrite"
  | "hold"
  | "release"
  | "reschedule";

export async function PATCH(
  request: Request,
  context: { params: Promise<{ seq: string }> },
) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  const seq = Number((await context.params).seq);
  if (!Number.isInteger(seq) || seq < 1) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_seq" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  let body: {
    action?: Action;
    text?: string;
    hashtags?: string[];
    mediaIds?: string[];
    didPublish?: boolean;
    variant?: number;
    scheduledFor?: string | null;
    reviewed?: ReviewedPost;
  };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'bad_request' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if(body.mediaIds!==undefined && (!Array.isArray(body.mediaIds) || !await ownsMedia(agent.agentId,body.mediaIds)))return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_media'},{status:400});
  if(body.reviewed && (typeof body.reviewed.text!=='string'||!Array.isArray(body.reviewed.hashtags)||!Array.isArray(body.reviewed.media)))return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_review'},{status:400});
  const rows = await query<{
    status: string;
    scheduled_for: Date | null;
    cleared_at: Date | null;
    sources_json: string[];
    media_json: string[];
  }>(
    "SELECT status, scheduled_for, cleared_at, sources_json, media_json FROM posts WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2",
    [agent.agentId, seq],
  );
  if (rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_found" }, { status: 404 });
  const { status, scheduled_for: scheduledFor } = rows[0];
  if (body.action !== 'resolve' && body.action !== 'release' && body.action !== 'publish') {
    const sending = await query(
      `SELECT 1 FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=$1 AND seq=$2 AND status IN ('in_flight','sent')`,
      [agent.agentId, seq],
    );
    if (status === 'unknown' || sending.length) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'This send has already started. Refresh My Posts and confirm its result before making changes.' }, { status: 409 });
    }
  }

  switch (body.action) {
    case "edit": {
      if (status === "published") {
        // The Posts API can patch commentary, but the edit would not match
        // what is stored here and LinkedIn shows an "edited" marker anyway.
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "cannot_edit_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      const text = (body.text ?? "").trim();
      if (text.length < 20 || text.length > MAX_BODY_CHARS) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_text_length" }, { status: 400 });
      }
      const hashtags = (body.hashtags ?? [])
        .filter((h) => typeof h === "string")
        .slice(0, MAX_HASHTAGS);
      const length = checkLength(
        assemblePost({ body: text, hashtags, maxHashtags: MAX_HASHTAGS,
          sourceUrl: (body.mediaIds ?? rows[0].media_json ?? []).length === 0 ? rows[0].sources_json?.[0] : undefined }),
      );
      if (!length.withinLimit) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "too_long_after_escaping", detail: `${length.escapedChars} escaped chars` },
          { status: 400 },
        );
      }
      // COALESCE, so original_text is written once and only once. Every edit
      // after the first is a human revising their own revision; overwriting it
      // each time would leave the column holding the previous human draft
      // rather than the machine's, and the pair would stop being evidence of
      // anything. This is the training signal the app used to delete daily.
      //
      // mediaIds is optional: an editor that only changes text must not silently
      // detach the images already on the post, so absent means "leave alone".
      if (Array.isArray(body.mediaIds)) {
        const mediaIds = body.mediaIds.filter((id) => typeof id === "string").slice(0, 20);
        await query(
          `UPDATE posts
              SET original_text = COALESCE(original_text, text),
                  text = $3, hashtags_json = $4, media_json = $5, status = 'draft', cleared_at = NULL
            WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2`,
          [agent.agentId, seq, text, JSON.stringify(hashtags), JSON.stringify(mediaIds)],
        );
      } else {
        await query(
          `UPDATE posts
              SET original_text = COALESCE(original_text, text),
                  text = $3, hashtags_json = $4, status = 'draft', cleared_at = NULL
            WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2`,
          [agent.agentId, seq, text, JSON.stringify(hashtags)],
        );
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    case "clear": {
      if (status === "published") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "already_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      if (!scheduledFor) {
        // Clearing an unscheduled post would mark it ready and then nothing
        // would ever collect it. Say so rather than leaving it silently stuck.
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: "not_scheduled",
            detail: "This post has no send time. Give it one with `reschedule`, or use `publish` to send it now.",
          },
          { status: 409 },
        );
      }
      // Releases any stale edit hold in the same breath: saying "this is ready"
      // is unambiguously the end of editing it.
      const cleared=await query(
        `UPDATE posts SET cleared_at = now(), hold_until = NULL, status = 'approved'
          WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR
          (status IN ('draft','approved','failed','missed') AND text=$3 AND COALESCE(hashtags_json,'[]'::jsonb)=$4::jsonb AND COALESCE(media_json,'[]'::jsonb)=$5::jsonb)) RETURNING seq`,
        [agent.agentId,seq,body.reviewed?.text??null,JSON.stringify(body.reviewed?.hashtags??[]),JSON.stringify(body.reviewed?.media??[])],
      );
      if(!cleared.length)return NextResponse.json({error:'This post changed on another device. Refresh and review it again.'},{status:409});
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, scheduledFor: scheduledFor.toISOString() });
    }

    case "unclear": {
      if (status === "published") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "already_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      await query(
        "UPDATE posts SET cleared_at = NULL, status = 'draft' WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2",
        [agent.agentId, seq],
      );
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    case "hold": {
      // Taken when the composer opens a scheduled post, so a send cannot fire
      // mid-edit. Time-bounded rather than a flag: a crashed app must not be
      // able to silence a slot forever.
      if (status === "published") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "already_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      await query(
        `UPDATE posts SET hold_until = now() + make_interval(mins => $3)
          WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2`,
        [agent.agentId, seq, HOLD_MINUTES],
      );
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, holdMinutes: HOLD_MINUTES });
    }

    case "release": {
      await query("UPDATE posts SET hold_until = NULL WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2", [
        agent.agentId,
        seq,
      ]);
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    case "reschedule": {
      if (status === "published") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "cannot_reschedule_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      // null is meaningful: it lifts the post off the schedule entirely and
      // returns it to the queue as something to send by hand.
      if (body.scheduledFor === null) {
        // Approval belongs to the scheduled send. Removing that time also
        // withdraws approval, so a cleared post becomes a draft again. Keep
        // real failure/ambiguous states intact instead of hiding their outcome.
        const unscheduled = await query(
          `UPDATE posts p
              SET scheduled_for = NULL, cleared_at = NULL,
                  status = CASE WHEN p.status IN ('approved','missed') THEN 'draft' ELSE p.status END
            WHERE p.agent_id = $1 AND p.seq = $2 AND p.status <> 'published'
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM distributions d
                 WHERE d.agent_id = p.agent_id AND d.seq = p.seq
                   AND d.status IN ('in_flight', 'sent')
              )
            RETURNING seq`,
          [agent.agentId, seq],
        );
        if (!unscheduled.length) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: "This post is being sent or has already been sent. Refresh to see its latest status." },
            { status: 409 },
          );
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, scheduledFor: null });
      }
      const when = new Date(body.scheduledFor ?? "");
      if (Number.isNaN(when.getTime())) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_scheduled_for" }, { status: 400 });
      }
      if (when.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pick a send time in the future.' }, { status: 400 });
      }
      await query("UPDATE posts SET scheduled_for = $3, cleared_at = NULL, status = 'draft' WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2 AND status IN ('draft','approved','failed','missed')", [
        agent.agentId,
        seq,
        when.toISOString(),
      ]);
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, scheduledFor: when.toISOString() });
    }

    case "publish": {
      if (status === "published") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "already_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      if (status === "unknown") {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "resolve_ambiguous_first", detail: "Check LinkedIn and resolve this send first." },
          { status: 409 },
        );
      }
      const result = await publishPost(agent.agentId, seq,'manual',body.reviewed);
      if (!result.ok) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { ok: false, error: result.reason, needsReauth: result.needsReauth, ambiguous: result.ambiguous },
          { status: 502 },
        );
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, permalink: result.permalink, postUrn: result.postUrn });
    }

    case "discard": {
      if (status === "published") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "cannot_discard_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      await query("UPDATE posts SET status = 'rejected' WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2", [
        agent.agentId,
        seq,
      ]);
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    case "rewrite": {
      if (status === "published") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "cannot_rewrite_published" }, { status: 409 });
      }
      const rows = await query<{ text: string }>(
        "SELECT text FROM posts WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2",
        [agent.agentId, seq],
      );
      const current = rows[0]?.text ?? "";
      if (current.length < 20) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "nothing_to_rewrite" }, { status: 400 });
      }
      const [persona, voice] = await Promise.all([
        getPersona(agent.agentId),
        voiceReferencesFor(agent),
      ]);
      if (!persona) return NextResponse.json({ error: "persona_not_ready" }, { status: 409 });

      // Deliberately NOT saved. A variant the user has not seen yet must never
      // replace the draft they already approved of — they choose, then the app
      // sends a normal 'edit'.
      const variant = await rewriteDraft(persona, current, agent.style, Number(body.variant ?? 0), voice);
      if (!variant.ok) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "rewrite_failed", detail: variant.reason }, { status: 502 });
      }
      // Hashtags are SUGGESTIONS. The composer keeps whatever the author chose
      // and fills the remaining room under the cap from these, so pressing
      // rewrite can never delete a tag someone typed on purpose.
      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        text: variant.data.text,
        hashtags: (variant.data.hashtags ?? []).slice(0, agent.style.hashtagCount),
        servedBy: variant.data.servedBy,
      });
    }

    case "followup": {
      // Only from something that actually went out. A follow-up to a draft is a
      // rewrite with extra steps, and rewrite already exists for that.
      if (status !== "published") {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "not_published", detail: "Follow-ups are written from posts that have gone out." },
          { status: 409 },
        );
      }
      const rows = await query<{ text: string; published_at: Date | null }>(
        "SELECT text, published_at FROM posts WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = $2",
        [agent.agentId, seq],
      );
      const original = rows[0];
      if (!original || original.text.length < 20) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "nothing_to_follow" }, { status: 400 });
      }

      const [persona, voice] = await Promise.all([
        getPersona(agent.agentId),
        voiceReferencesFor(agent),
      ]);
      if (!persona) return NextResponse.json({ error: "persona_not_ready" }, { status: 409 });

      const followUp = await writeFollowUp(
        persona,
        {
          text: original.text,
          publishedAt: original.published_at?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) ?? null,
        },
        agent.style,
        voice,
      );
      if (!followUp.ok) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "followup_failed", detail: followUp.reason }, { status: 502 });
      }

      // Deliberately NOT saved, exactly like a rewrite. This is a suggestion
      // about what to write next; the composer shows it and the author decides.
      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        text: followUp.data.text,
        hashtags: followUp.data.hashtags.slice(0, agent.style.hashtagCount),
        servedBy: followUp.data.servedBy,
      });
    }

    case "resolve": {
      if (typeof body.didPublish !== "boolean") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "didPublish_required" }, { status: 400 });
      }
      if (!await resolveAmbiguousSend(agent.agentId, seq, body.didPublish)) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'This post no longer has an unconfirmed send. Refresh My Posts.' }, { status: 409 });
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    default:
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "unknown_action" }, { status: 400 });
  }
}
````

````text
import { ownsMedia } from '../../../lib/media-ownership';
/**
 * Custom posts: the composer's endpoint.
 *
 * A custom post enters the SAME table and the same publish path as an
 * agent-written one, so it inherits the idempotency key, the daily cap and the
 * length checks for free. The only differences are kind='custom' and that the
 * text came from a person.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getPersona, voiceReferencesFor } from "../../../lib/agents";
import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../lib/request-agent";
import { isCategoryId } from "../../../lib/categories";
import { query } from "../../../lib/db";
import { publishPost } from "../../../lib/distribute";
import { assemblePost, checkLength, MAX_BODY_CHARS } from "../../../lib/format";
import { polishCustomPost } from "../../../lib/writer";
import { MAX_HASHTAGS } from "../../../lib/style";
import { POST_COLUMNS, serializePost, type PostRow } from "../../../lib/post-view";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 120;

/** Load older published posts without losing them behind the status window. */
export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'not_initialized' }, { status: 400 });
  const value = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('before');
  const before = value === null ? null : Number(value);
  if (before !== null && (!Number.isInteger(before) || before < 1)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'bad_cursor' }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const posts = await query<PostRow>(
    `SELECT ${POST_COLUMNS} FROM posts
     WHERE agent_id=$1 AND status='published' AND ($2::int IS NULL OR
       (published_at,seq) < (SELECT published_at,seq FROM posts WHERE agent_id=$1 AND seq=$2))
     ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST, seq DESC LIMIT 21`,
    [agent.agentId, before],
  );
  return NextResponse.json({ posts: posts.slice(0,20).map(serializePost), hasMore: posts.length > 20 },
    { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  let body: {
    text?: string;
    mediaIds?: string[];
    category?: string;
    hashtags?: string[];
    polish?: boolean;
    publishNow?: boolean;
    /** ISO instant. Puts a hand-written post on the timetable like any other. */
    scheduledFor?: string;
    clientRequestId?: string;
  };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'bad_request' }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (body.polish && body.publishNow) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Save and review the polished draft before publishing it.' }, { status: 409 });
  }
  if (body.clientRequestId !== undefined && !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,100}$/.test(body.clientRequestId)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'bad_request_id' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  let text = (body.text ?? "").trim();
  if (text.length < 20) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "text_too_short" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (text.length > MAX_BODY_CHARS) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "text_too_long", detail: `${text.length} chars, max ${MAX_BODY_CHARS}` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  // Optional polish. A failure here is NOT fatal — the user's own words are
  // perfectly publishable, and losing their draft to a quota error would be
  // the worst possible outcome.
  let polishedBy: string | undefined;
  // Tags the polish step suggested, used only if the author gave none.
  let polishedTags: string[] = [];
  if (body.polish) {
    // Both reads at once — they are independent, and this sits in front of an
    // LLM call the author is already waiting on.
    const [persona, voice] = await Promise.all([
      getPersona(agent.agentId),
      voiceReferencesFor(agent),
    ]);
    if (persona) {
      const polished = await polishCustomPost(persona, text, agent.style, voice);
      if (polished.ok) {
        text = polished.data.text.trim();
        polishedBy = polished.data.servedBy;
        // Only when the author supplied none of their own. Polishing should
        // never overwrite tags someone deliberately chose.
        if (polishedTags.length === 0) polishedTags = polished.data.hashtags ?? [];
      } else {
        console.warn(`[compose] polish failed (${polished.reason}) — keeping the author's text`);
      }
    }
  }

  const mediaIds = (body.mediaIds ?? []).filter((id) => typeof id === "string").slice(0, 20);
  if(!await ownsMedia(agent.agentId,mediaIds))return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_media'},{status:400});
  const hashtags = [
    ...(body.hashtags ?? []).filter((h) => typeof h === "string"),
    ...((body.hashtags?.length ?? 0) === 0 ? polishedTags.slice(0, agent.style.hashtagCount) : []),
  ].slice(0, MAX_HASHTAGS);
  const category = isCategoryId(body.category) ? body.category : null;

  // Validate the assembled length now rather than at publish time, so the
  // composer can report it while the text is still on screen.
  const assembled = assemblePost({ body: text, hashtags, maxHashtags: MAX_HASHTAGS });
  const length = checkLength(assembled);
  if (!length.withinLimit) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "too_long_after_escaping", detail: `${length.escapedChars} escaped chars (max 3000)` },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  // A hand-written post can be put on the timetable exactly like a generated
  // one: the send pass does not care who wrote the text, only that the time has
  // come and it is cleared. Scheduling one counts as clearing it — you wrote
  // it, so there is nothing left for you to review.
  let scheduledFor: Date | null = null;
  if (body.scheduledFor && !body.publishNow) {
    const when = new Date(body.scheduledFor);
    if (Number.isNaN(when.getTime())) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_scheduled_for" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (when.getTime() < Date.now()) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "scheduled_in_the_past", detail: "Pick a time in the future." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
    scheduledFor = when;
  }

  const inserted = await query<{ id: string; seq: number; text: string; hashtags_json: string[]; media_json: string[]; status: string }>(
    `INSERT INTO posts (agent_id, seq, text, rationale, sources_json, fingerprint, status, kind,
                        category, media_json, hashtags_json, scheduled_for, cleared_at, client_request_id)
     SELECT $1, byline_next_seq($1), $2, $3, '[]'::jsonb, $4, $5, 'custom', $6, $7, $8,
            $9, CASE WHEN $9::timestamptz IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() END, $10
     ON CONFLICT (agent_id,client_request_id) WHERE client_request_id IS NOT NULL
     DO UPDATE SET client_request_id=EXCLUDED.client_request_id
     RETURNING id, seq, text, hashtags_json, media_json, status`,
    [
      agent.agentId,
      text,
      polishedBy ? `Written by you, edited for the hook (${polishedBy}).` : "Written by you.",
      `custom post — ${text.slice(0, 80)}`,
      body.publishNow || scheduledFor ? "approved" : "draft",
      category,
      JSON.stringify(mediaIds),
      JSON.stringify(hashtags),
      scheduledFor?.toISOString() ?? null,
      body.clientRequestId ?? null,
    ],
  );

  const post = inserted[0];
  if (!post) return NextResponse.json({ error: "insert_failed" }, { status: 500 });
  if (post.text !== text || JSON.stringify(post.hashtags_json) !== JSON.stringify(hashtags) || JSON.stringify(post.media_json) !== JSON.stringify(mediaIds)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Your earlier save succeeded. This draft is already in My Posts; review it before saving these newer changes.', seq: post.seq }, { status: 409 });
  }

  if (body.publishNow) {
    const result = await publishPost(agent.agentId, post.seq);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, id: post.id, seq: post.seq, error: result.reason, ambiguous: result.ambiguous },
        { status: 502 },
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, id: post.id, seq: post.seq, permalink: result.permalink });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    id: post.id,
    seq: post.seq,
    status: post.status,
    scheduledFor: scheduledFor?.toISOString() ?? null,
    polishedBy,
  });
}

````

````text
import { after, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requestIdentity } from '../../../lib/request-agent';
import { query } from '../../../lib/db';
import {timetableDay,manualOccurrences} from '../../../lib/timetable-home';
import {runSlotCycle} from '../../../lib/cycle';
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
export async function GET() {
  const user=await requestIdentity();
  if(!user)return NextResponse.json({error:'unauthorized'},{status:401});
  const [agent]=await query<{id:string;timezone:string;paused:boolean}>('SELECT id,timezone,paused FROM agents WHERE owner_id=$1 AND active',[user.userId]);
  if(!agent)return NextResponse.json({error:'Finish setup first.'},{status:409});
  const day=await timetableDay(agent.id,agent.timezone,agent.paused);
  return NextResponse.json(day,{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
}
export async function POST(request:Request) {
  const user=await requestIdentity();
  if(!user)return NextResponse.json({error:'unauthorized'},{status:401});
  const b=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  if(b?.action==='generate') {
    const [a]=await query<{id:string;timezone:string;paused:boolean}>(`SELECT a.id,a.timezone,a.paused FROM agents a JOIN onboarding o ON o.user_id=a.owner_id WHERE a.owner_id=$1 AND a.active AND o.completed_at IS NOT NULL`,[user.userId]);
    if(!a)return NextResponse.json({error:'Finish setup first.'},{status:409});
    if(a.paused)return NextResponse.json({error:'Resume ByLine in Settings before preparing a post.'},{status:409});
    if(b.slotIds!==undefined && (!Array.isArray(b.slotIds)||b.slotIds.some((id:unknown)=>typeof id!=='string')))return NextResponse.json({error:'Choose valid timetable entries.'},{status:400});
    const occurrences=await manualOccurrences(a.id,a.timezone,b.slotIds??[]);
    after(async()=>{for(const occurrence of occurrences)await runSlotCycle(occurrence,true);});
    return NextResponse.json({ok:true,accepted:occurrences.length>0,count:occurrences.length}, {status:202});
  } else if(b?.action==='schedule'||b?.action==='test-now') {
    return NextResponse.json({error:'Posting times are now managed in Timetable. Update ByLine to use the unified schedule.'},{status:409});
  } else if(b?.action==='notifications'&&['enabled','denied','unavailable'].includes(b.notifications)) {
    await query(`UPDATE onboarding SET config=config||$2::jsonb WHERE user_id=$1`,[user.userId,JSON.stringify({notifications:b.notifications})]);
  } else return NextResponse.json({error:'invalid_action'},{status:400});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:true});
}
````

## Source: app/api/settings/route.ts

````text
/**
 * Agent settings: categories, timezone, daily post time, auto-publish, pause.
 *
 * Changing the post time reschedules the next run immediately — otherwise a
 * change made at 10:00 would not take effect until the old slot had fired,
 * which looks exactly like the setting being ignored.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { updateAgentSettings } from "../../../lib/agents";
import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../lib/request-agent";
import { getAccountStatus } from "../../../lib/accounts";
import { parseCategories, isCategoryId, MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES } from "../../../lib/categories";
import { query } from "../../../lib/db";
import { nextDailyRun, normalizeHhMm, isValidTimeZone } from "../../../lib/schedule";
import { rescheduleAllSlots } from "../../../lib/slots";
import { PRESETS, type StyleConfig } from "../../../lib/style";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  let body: {
    categories?: unknown;
    timezone?: string;
    postTimeLocal?: string;
    autoPublish?: boolean;
    paused?: boolean;
    autoPublishCap?: number;
    style?: unknown;
    preset?: string;
    /** Writing samples, replaced wholesale. */
    corpus?: unknown;
  };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_request" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'bad_request' }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (body.categories !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(body.categories) || body.categories.length < 1 || body.categories.length > MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES || body.categories.some(id=>!isCategoryId(id)) || new Set(body.categories).size !== body.categories.length)) {
    return NextResponse.json({error:'Choose 1–12 distinct subjects from the catalogue.'},{status:400});
  }
  if (body.timezone !== undefined && (typeof body.timezone !== 'string' || !isValidTimeZone(body.timezone))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Choose a valid timezone.' }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (body.corpus !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(body.corpus) || body.corpus.length > 10 ||
      body.corpus.some(sample => typeof sample !== 'string' || sample.trim().length < 80 || sample.trim().length > 2400))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Use up to 10 writing samples, each 80–2400 characters.' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Turning on auto-publish without a working connection would produce a daily
  // stream of failed sends, so it is refused with the actual reason.
  if (body.autoPublish === true) {
    const account = await getAccountStatus(agent.agentId);
    if (!account.connected || account.needsReauth) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "linkedin_not_connected", detail: "Connect LinkedIn before enabling auto-publish." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
  }

  // Validate the time HERE rather than letting the update layer quietly skip a
  // malformed value: silently returning ok:true for a save that did nothing is
  // indistinguishable, from the UI, from the setting refusing to change.
  let postTimeLocal: string | undefined;
  if (body.postTimeLocal !== undefined) {
    const normalized = normalizeHhMm(String(body.postTimeLocal));
    if (!normalized) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "bad_post_time", detail: `Expected HH:MM, got "${body.postTimeLocal}"` },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }
    postTimeLocal = normalized;
  }

  // A preset is just a bundle of style fields — it lands in the same patch, so
  // an explicit `style` sent alongside one wins field by field.
  const preset = typeof body.preset === "string" ? PRESETS[body.preset] : undefined;
  if (body.preset !== undefined && !preset) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "unknown_preset" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const stylePatch: Partial<StyleConfig> | undefined =
    preset || body.style
      ? ({
          ...(preset ? preset.style : {}),
          ...(body.style && typeof body.style === "object" && !Array.isArray(body.style)
            ? body.style
            : {}),
        } as Partial<StyleConfig>)
      : undefined;

  const updated = await updateAgentSettings(agent.agentId, {
    categories: body.categories === undefined ? undefined : parseCategories(body.categories),
    timezone: body.timezone,
    postTimeLocal,
    autoPublish: body.autoPublish,
    paused: body.paused,
    autoPublishCap: body.autoPublishCap,
    style: stylePatch,
    corpus: Array.isArray(body.corpus) ? body.corpus.filter((c): c is string => typeof c === "string") : undefined,
  });
  if (!updated) return NextResponse.json({ error: "update_failed" }, { status: 500 });

  if (postTimeLocal || body.timezone) {
    await query(`UPDATE onboarding SET config=config||$2::jsonb,next_delivery_at=NULL
      WHERE user_id=(SELECT owner_id FROM agents WHERE id=$1) AND completed_at IS NOT NULL`,
      [agent.agentId,JSON.stringify({timezone:updated.timezone})]);
    await query(
      `INSERT INTO scheduler_state (agent_id, next_run_at) VALUES ($1, $2)
       ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO UPDATE SET next_run_at = $2`,
      [agent.agentId, nextDailyRun(updated.timezone, updated.postTimeLocal).toISOString()],
    );
  }

  // A timezone change moves every slot. Each slot stores its next occurrence as
  // an absolute instant derived from the old zone, so without this they would
  // all keep firing at the previous offset — the posts would still go out, just
  // silently at the wrong hour, which is the kind of bug nobody reports because
  // it looks like the schedule was simply set wrong.
  if (body.timezone) {
    await rescheduleAllSlots(agent.agentId, updated.timezone);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, agent: updated });
}
````

## Source: app/api/slots/[id]/route.ts

````text
/**
 * One slot: change it, or remove it.
 *
 * Every change reschedules the slot and re-derives the agent's auto-publish cap
 * (see lib/slots.ts) so the timetable and the safety limit can never disagree.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../../lib/request-agent";
import { parseCategories, isCategoryId, MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES } from "../../../../lib/categories";
import { deleteSlot, listSlots, updateSlot } from "../../../../lib/slots";
import { query } from "../../../../lib/db";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function PATCH(
  request: Request,
  context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  const { id } = await context.params;

  let body: {
    localTime?: string;
    daysMask?: number;
    leadMinutes?: number;
    autoPublish?: boolean;
    categories?: string[];
    enabled?: boolean;
    position?: number;
  };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_request" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) return NextResponse.json({error:'Check your posting time settings.'},{status:400});
  if (body.categories !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(body.categories) || body.categories.length > MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES || body.categories.some(id=>!isCategoryId(id)))) return NextResponse.json({error:'Choose up to 12 subjects from the catalogue.'},{status:400});
  const result = await updateSlot(agent.agentId, id, agent.timezone, {
    localTime: body.localTime,
    daysMask: body.daysMask,
    leadMinutes: body.leadMinutes,
    autoPublish: body.autoPublish,
    // Distinguish "not mentioned" from "cleared": an absent key leaves the
    // slot's categories alone, an empty array means "use the agent's".
    categories: body.categories === undefined ? undefined : parseCategories(body.categories),
    enabled: body.enabled,
    position: body.position,
  });

  if (!result.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: result.error },
      { status: result.error === "not_found" ? 404 : 400 },
    );
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, slot: result.slot });
}

export async function DELETE(
  _request: Request,
  context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  const { id } = await context.params;

  // Refuse to remove the last slot. An agent with an empty timetable looks
  // identical to a broken cron from the outside — disable it instead, which
  // says the same thing and can be undone with one tap.
  const slots = await listSlots(agent.agentId);
  const daily = await query(`SELECT 1 FROM onboarding o JOIN agents a ON a.owner_id=o.user_id WHERE a.id=$1 AND o.completed_at IS NOT NULL`, [agent.agentId]);
  if (slots.length <= 1 && daily.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: "last_slot",
        detail: "This is your only posting time. Disable it instead of deleting it.",
      },
      { status: 409 },
    );
  }

  if (!(await deleteSlot(agent.agentId, id))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_found" }, { status: 404 });
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}
````

````text
/**
 * The timetable: list the slots, or add one.
 *
 * Protected by middleware.ts like every other API route — nothing here repeats
 * the session check.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getRequestAgent } from "../../../lib/request-agent";
import { parseCategories, isCategoryId, MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES } from "../../../lib/categories";
import {
  createSlot,
  ensureSlotsMigrated,
  listSlots,
  MAX_LEAD_MINUTES,
  MAX_SLOTS,
  MIN_LEAD_MINUTES,
  setSlotCount,
} from "../../../lib/slots";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  // Idempotent and cheap after the first call: gives a pre-slots agent its
  // first slot from the legacy single post time, so opening the schedule screen
  // never shows an empty timetable for an agent that has been posting daily.
  await ensureSlotsMigrated(
    agent.agentId,
    agent.postTimeLocal,
    agent.timezone,
    agent.autoPublish,
  );

  return NextResponse.json({
    slots: await listSlots(agent.agentId),
    limits: {
      maxSlots: MAX_SLOTS,
      minLeadMinutes: MIN_LEAD_MINUTES,
      maxLeadMinutes: MAX_LEAD_MINUTES,
    },
    timezone: agent.timezone,
  });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const agent = await getRequestAgent();
  if (!agent) return NextResponse.json({ error: "not_initialized" }, { status: 400 });

  let body: {
    action?:string;
    count?:number;
    localTime?: string;
    daysMask?: number;
    leadMinutes?: number;
    autoPublish?: boolean;
    categories?: string[];
    enabled?: boolean;
  };
  try {
    body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bad_request" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) return NextResponse.json({error:'Check your posting time settings.'},{status:400});
  if (body.categories !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(body.categories) || body.categories.length > MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES || body.categories.some(id=>!isCategoryId(id)))) return NextResponse.json({error:'Choose up to 12 subjects from the catalogue.'},{status:400});
  if(body.action==='count') {
    if(typeof body.count!=='number'||!Number.isInteger(body.count)||body.count<1||body.count>MAX_SLOTS)
      return NextResponse.json({error:'Choose 1–5 posting times.'},{status:400});
    await setSlotCount(agent.agentId,agent.timezone,body.count);
    return NextResponse.json({ok:true,slots:await listSlots(agent.agentId)});
  }

  const result = await createSlot(agent.agentId, agent.timezone, {
    localTime: body.localTime,
    daysMask: body.daysMask,
    leadMinutes: body.leadMinutes,
    autoPublish: body.autoPublish,
    categories: parseCategories(body.categories),
    enabled: body.enabled,
  });

  if (!result.ok) {
    const status = result.error === "too_many_slots" ? 409 : 400;
    const detail =
      result.error === "too_many_slots"
        ? `You already have ${MAX_SLOTS} slots, which is the maximum. Remove one first.`
        : "A slot needs a time in HH:MM form.";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error, detail }, { status });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, slot: result.slot });
}

````
