## Source: app/page.tsx

````text
"use client";

/**
 * The whole control surface: gate, one-time setup, and the dashboard.
 *
 * Two things drive the layout. The approval queue is the primary column
 * because reading a draft properly is the entire point of running in approval
 * mode — so the full text is always expanded, never behind a "read more", and
 * the fold marker shows exactly where LinkedIn will truncate it. Everything
 * that reports state rather than asking for a decision lives in the sidebar.
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
// Type-only: erased at build time, so this pulls no server code into the bundle.
import type { StyleConfig } from "../lib/style";
import { CATEGORIES, MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES } from "../lib/categories";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- types

interface Post {
  id: string;
  seq: number;
  text: string;
  hook: string;
  rationale: string;
  status: string;
  kind: string;
  category: string | null;
  scores: Record<string, number> | null;
  sources: string[];
  media: string[];
  hashtags: string[];
  continuity: string | null;
  usedQuote: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  publishedAt: string | null;
}

interface Status {
  initialized: boolean;
  agent?: {
    agentId: string;
    name: string;
    domain: string;
    categories: string[];
    timezone: string;
    postTimeLocal: string;
    autoPublish: boolean;
    paused: boolean;
    autoPublishCap: number;
    style: StyleConfig;
  };
  account?: {
    connected: boolean;
    memberName?: string;
    daysRemaining?: number;
    expiringSoon?: boolean;
    needsReauth?: boolean;
    hasRefreshToken?: boolean;
    lastError?: string;
  };
  config: {
    liveMode: boolean;
    encryptionKey: boolean;
    memoryDegraded?: boolean;
    maxAutoCap?: number;
    presets?: { id: string; label: string; blurb: string; style: StyleConfig }[];
  };
  budget?: {
    autoUsed: number;
    autoCap: number;
    manualUsed: number;
    manualCap: number;
    linkedinDailyRequests: number;
  };
  schedule?: { nextRunLocal: string | null; cycleCount: number };
  queue?: Post[];
  history?: Post[];
  rejections?: { title: string; url: string; reason: string; createdAt: string }[];
  llm?: { model: string; calls: number; cap: number }[];
  ambiguous?: { seq: number | null; createdAt: string; lastError: string | null }[];
}

const CATEGORY_LABELS = Object.fromEntries(Object.values(CATEGORIES).map(c=>[c.id,c.label]));

function CategoryPicker({values,onChange,disabled=false}:{values:string[];onChange:(ids:string[])=>void;disabled?:boolean}) {
  const [query,setQuery]=useState('');
  const [group,setGroup]=useState('');
  const [limit,setLimit]=useState(40);
  const groups=[...new Set(Object.values(CATEGORIES).map(c=>c.groupLabel).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  const matches=Object.values(CATEGORIES).filter(c=>(!group||c.groupLabel===group)&&query.toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).every(word=>`${c.label} ${c.groupLabel??''}`.toLowerCase().includes(word)));
  const toggle=(id:string)=>onChange(values.includes(id)?values.filter(v=>v!==id):[...values,id]);
  return <div>
    <input aria-label="Search subjects" placeholder={`Search ${Object.keys(CATEGORIES).length.toLocaleString()} subjects`} value={query} onChange={e=>{setQuery(e.target.value);setLimit(40);}} />
    <select aria-label="Filter subjects by industry" value={group} onChange={e=>{setGroup(e.target.value);setLimit(40);}}><option value="">All industries</option>{groups.map(g=><option key={g} value={g}>{g}</option>)}</select>
    <p className="hint" role="status">{values.length} selected · {matches.length} results · choose up to {MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES}</p>
    <div className="chips" aria-label="Selected subjects">{values.map(id=><button type="button" className="chip" data-on key={id} disabled={disabled||values.length===1} onClick={()=>toggle(id)} aria-label={`Remove ${CATEGORY_LABELS[id]??id}`}>{CATEGORY_LABELS[id]??id} ×</button>)}</div>
    <div className="chips">{matches.slice(0,limit).map(c=><button type="button" className="chip" key={c.id} data-on={values.includes(c.id)} aria-pressed={values.includes(c.id)} disabled={disabled||(values.includes(c.id)?values.length===1:values.length>=MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES)} onClick={()=>toggle(c.id)}>{c.label}</button>)}</div>
    {matches.length===0&&<p>No matching subjects. Try a broader search.</p>}
    {matches.length>limit&&<button type="button" onClick={()=>setLimit(v=>v+40)}>Show more subjects</button>}
  </div>;
}

// The subset pre-selected at init. Deliberately NOT every category: seven
// active at once spreads the daily candidate pool thin across interests the
// author may not actually have, and adding one later is a single tap.
const DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = ["music-tech-software", "music-tech-hardware", "emerging-tech"];

const SCORE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  persona_fit: "persona fit",
  category_fit: "category fit",
  novelty: "novelty",
  timeliness: "timeliness",
  non_duplication: "non-duplication",
};

const FOLD_CHARS = 210;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

async function api(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> {
  return fetch(path, { ...init, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...init?.headers } });
}

/**
 * Shrink an image in the browser before upload. A phone photo is several
 * megabytes and the upload route sits behind a ~4.5MB serverless body cap, so
 * this is load-bearing rather than cosmetic. GIFs pass through untouched —
 * putting one through a canvas would flatten it to a single frame.
 */
async function downscale(file: File, maxDim = 1920, quality = 0.85): Promise<File> {
  if (file.type === "image/gif") return file;
  try {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
    const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
    if (scale === 1 && file.size < 2_000_000) return file;

    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = Math.round(bitmap.width * scale);
    canvas.height = Math.round(bitmap.height * scale);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return file;
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) => {
      canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/jpeg", quality);
    });
    if (!blob) return file;
    return new File([blob], file.name.replace(/\.\w+$/, "") + ".jpg", { type: "image/jpeg" });
  } catch {
    return file; // never block an upload because the resize failed
  }
}

function relative(iso: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - Date.parse(iso);
  const mins = Math.round(diff / 60_000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hours = Math.round(mins / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
  return `${Math.round(hours / 24)}d ago`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- page

export default function Page() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status | null>(null);
  const [locked, setLocked] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const res = await fetch("/api/status");
    if (res.status === 401) {
      setLocked(true);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLocked(false);
    if (res.ok) setStatus((await res.json()) as Status);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
    const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [refresh]);

  if (loading) return <div className="gate"><p style={{ color: "var(--paper-faint)" }}>Loading…</p></div>;
  if (locked) return <Gate onIn={refresh} />;
  if (!status) return <div className="gate"><p className="error-text">Could not load status.</p></div>;
  if (!status.initialized) return <Setup onDone={refresh} />;

  return <Dashboard status={status} refresh={refresh} />;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- gate

function Gate({ onIn }: { onIn: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function submit(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const res = await api("/api/auth", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ password }) });
    setBusy(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; detail?: string };
      setError(data.detail ?? (data.error === "invalid_password" ? "Wrong password." : "Login failed."));
      return;
    }
    await onIn();
  }

  return (
    <div className="gate">
      <form className="panel" onSubmit={submit}>
        <h1>LinkedIn agent</h1>
        <p>This dashboard can publish to your profile. Sign in to continue.</p>
        <input
          type="password"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Password"
          autoFocus
        />
        <div style={{ marginTop: "var(--s3)" }}>
          <button className="primary" type="submit" disabled={busy || password.length === 0}>
            {busy ? "Checking…" : "Sign in"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {error && <p className="error-text">{error}</p>}
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup

function Setup({ onDone }: { onDone: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<string[]>(DEFAULT_CATEGORIES);
  const [timezone, setTimezone] = useState(
    Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || "Asia/Kolkata",
  );
  const [postTime, setPostTime] = useState("09:30");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  function toggle(id: string) {
    setCategories((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((c) => c !== id) : [...prev, id]));
  }

  async function submit(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const res = await api("/api/init", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ name, categories, timezone, postTimeLocal: postTime }),
    });
    setBusy(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; detail?: string };
      setError(data.detail ?? data.error ?? "Setup failed.");
      return;
    }
    await onDone();
  }

  return (
    <div className="shell setup">
      <h1 style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-xl)", margin: "0 0 var(--s2)" }}>Set up your agent</h1>
      <p style={{ color: "var(--paper-faint)", marginTop: 0 }}>
        This runs once. It decides what the agent reads, how it sounds, and when it posts —
        all of it changeable afterwards.
      </p>
      <form className="panel" onSubmit={submit}>
        <label className="field">
          <span>Your name</span>
          <input type="text" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="How you sign your work" />
        </label>
        {/* There is deliberately no free-text "what you write about" box any
            more. It was the one thing here that could disagree with the
            categories, and it always eventually did: typed once, fed into the
            persona, then never revised when the categories moved underneath it.
            The scope is the categories, so it is only asked for once. */}
        <label className="field">
          <span>What you write about</span>
          <CategoryPicker values={categories} onChange={setCategories} disabled={busy} />
          <p className="hint">
            Your selection guides the articles we find and the subjects your posts cover. You can change it any time.
          </p>
        </label>
        <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
          <label className="field" style={{ flex: "1 1 8rem" }}>
            <span>Daily post time</span>
            <input type="time" value={postTime} onChange={(e) => setPostTime(e.target.value)} />
          </label>
          <label className="field" style={{ flex: "2 1 12rem" }}>
            <span>Timezone</span>
            <input type="text" value={timezone} onChange={(e) => setTimezone(e.target.value)} />
          </label>
        </div>
        <button className="primary" type="submit" disabled={busy || name.length < 2 || categories.length === 0}>
          {busy ? "Creating…" : "Create agent"}
        </button>
        {error && <p className="error-text">{error}</p>}
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dashboard

function Dashboard({ status, refresh }: { status: Status; refresh: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const agent = status.agent!;
  const account = status.account ?? { connected: false };

  return (
    <div className="shell">
      <header className="masthead">
        <div>
          <h1>{agent.name}</h1>
          <p className="sub">
            {agent.categories.map((c) => CATEGORY_LABELS[c] ?? c).join(" · ")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="row">
          {status.config.liveMode ? (
            <span className="badge">live</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="badge warn">dry run</span>
          )}
          {agent.paused ? (
            <span className="badge warn">paused</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="badge">running</span>
          )}
          {agent.autoPublish ? (
            <span className="badge warn">publishes itself</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="badge">waits for you</span>
          )}
          <button
            className="ghost"
            onClick={async () => {
              await api("/api/auth", { method: "DELETE" });
              window.location.reload();
            }}
          >
            Sign out
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <Alerts status={status} refresh={refresh} />

      <div className="columns" style={{ marginTop: "var(--s5)" }}>
        <div className="stack">
          <Queue posts={status.queue ?? []} refresh={refresh} liveMode={status.config.liveMode} />
          <Composer refresh={refresh} connected={account.connected && !account.needsReauth} />
          <History posts={status.history ?? []} />
        </div>
        <div className="stack sidebar">
          <Connection account={account} refresh={refresh} />
          <Settings agent={agent} refresh={refresh} />
          <Voice agent={agent} presets={status.config.presets ?? []} refresh={refresh} />
          <Schedule status={status} />
          <Rejections items={status.rejections ?? []} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- alerts

function Alerts({ status, refresh }: { status: Status; refresh: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const account = status.account;
  const alerts: React.ReactNode[] = [];

  if (!status.config.encryptionKey) {
    alerts.push(
      <div className="notice bad" key="key">
        <div>
          <strong>LinkedIn connection is temporarily unavailable</strong>
          <p>Please contact the workspace administrator to finish secure connection setup.</p>
        </div>
      </div>,
    );
  }

  if (!status.config.liveMode) {
    alerts.push(
      <div className="notice" key="dry">
        <div>
          <strong>Preview environment</strong>
          <p>
            You can write and review drafts here. Publishing to LinkedIn is disabled in this environment.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>,
    );
  }

  if (account?.needsReauth) {
    alerts.push(
      <div className="notice bad" key="reauth">
        <div>
          <strong>LinkedIn access expired</strong>
          <p>Reconnect LinkedIn to resume publishing. Your drafts are saved.</p>
        </div>
        <a href="/api/linkedin/connect"><button className="primary">Reconnect</button></a>
      </div>,
    );
  } else if (account?.expiringSoon) {
    alerts.push(
      <div className="notice warn" key="expiring">
        <div>
          <strong>LinkedIn access expires in {account.daysRemaining} days</strong>
          <p>Reconnect any time before then — it takes one click and nothing is lost.</p>
        </div>
        <a href="/api/linkedin/connect"><button>Reconnect now</button></a>
      </div>,
    );
  }

  for (const item of status.ambiguous ?? []) {
    alerts.push(
      <div className="notice warn" key={`amb-${item.seq}`}>
        <div>
          <strong>Unconfirmed send — p{item.seq}</strong>
          <p>
            LinkedIn never answered, so this was not retried: it may or may not have published.
            Check your profile, then tell it what happened.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="row">
          <button
            onClick={async () => {
              await api(`/api/posts/${item.seq}`, {
                method: "PATCH",
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: "resolve", didPublish: true }),
              });
              await refresh();
            }}
          >
            It published
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={async () => {
              await api(`/api/posts/${item.seq}`, {
                method: "PATCH",
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: "resolve", didPublish: false }),
              });
              await refresh();
            }}
          >
            It did not
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>,
    );
  }

  if (alerts.length === 0) return null;
  return <div className="stack" style={{ gap: "var(--s3)" }}>{alerts}</div>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- composer

interface Attachment {
  id: string;
  preview: string;
  name: string;
}

function Composer({ refresh, connected }: { refresh: () => Promise<void>; connected: boolean }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [media, setMedia] = useState<Attachment[]>([]);
  const [polish, setPolish] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const over = text.length > 2400;

  async function upload(files: FileList | File[]) {
    setError("");
    for (const raw of Array.from(files).slice(0, 9)) {
      setBusy("Uploading image…");
      const file = await downscale(raw);
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("file", file);
      const res = await fetch("/api/media", { method: "POST", body: form });
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { id?: string; error?: string; detail?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !data.id) {
        setError(data.detail ?? data.error ?? "Image upload failed.");
        break;
      }
      setMedia((prev) => [...prev, { id: data.id!, preview: URL.createObjectURL(file), name: file.name }]);
    }
    setBusy(null);
  }

  async function submit(publishNow: boolean) {
    setBusy(publishNow ? "Publishing…" : "Saving…");
    setError("");
    const res = await api("/api/posts", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ text, mediaIds: media.map((m) => m.id), polish, publishNow }),
    });
    const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; detail?: string };
    setBusy(null);
    if (!res.ok) {
      setError(data.detail ?? data.error ?? "Failed.");
      return;
    }
    setText("");
    setMedia([]);
    setPolish(false);
    await refresh();
  }

  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Write a post</h2>
      <textarea
        value={text}
        onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Something you want to say. The first line is the hook — everything past ~210 characters is hidden behind “see more”."
      />
      <div className="spread" style={{ marginTop: "var(--s2)" }}>
        <span className="counter tabular" data-over={over}>
          {text.length} / 2400
          {text.length > FOLD_CHARS && ` · fold at ${FOLD_CHARS}`}
        </span>
        <button className="ghost" onClick={() => fileInput.current?.click()} disabled={!connected}>
          + image
        </button>
      </div>

      <input
        ref={fileInput}
        type="file"
        accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif"
        multiple
        hidden
        onChange={(e) => e.target.files && void upload(e.target.files)}
      />

      <div
        className="dropzone"
        data-active={dragging}
        style={{ marginTop: "var(--s3)" }}
        onClick={() => fileInput.current?.click()}
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragging(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
        onDrop={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragging(false);
          if (e.dataTransfer.files.length) void upload(e.dataTransfer.files);
        }}
      >
        {connected
          ? "Drop images here, or click to choose. They are resized in your browser first."
          : "Connect LinkedIn to attach images."}
      </div>

      {media.length > 0 && (
        <div className="thumbs">
          {media.map((m) => (
            <div className="thumb" key={m.id}>
              {/* Local object URL for a just-picked file; next/image adds nothing here. */}
              {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
              <img src={m.preview} alt={m.name} />
              <button onClick={() => setMedia((prev) => prev.filter((x) => x.id !== m.id))}>×</button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="toggle" style={{ marginTop: "var(--s3)" }}>
        <div className="label">
          <b>Edit for the hook</b>
          <span>Tightens the opening and strips influencer tics. Keeps your meaning and your facts.</span>
        </div>
        <button className="switch" data-on={polish} onClick={() => setPolish(!polish)} aria-label="Toggle editing" />
      </div>

      <div className="post-actions">
        <button onClick={() => void submit(false)} disabled={!!busy || text.trim().length < 20}>
          Save as draft
        </button>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button
          className="primary"
          onClick={() => void submit(true)}
          disabled={!!busy || text.trim().length < 20 || over || !connected}
        >
          {busy ?? "Publish now"}
        </button>
      </div>
      {error && <p className="error-text">{error}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- queue

function Queue({
  posts,
  refresh,
  liveMode,
}: {
  posts: Post[];
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  liveMode: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Awaiting your approval ({posts.length})</h2>
      {posts.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="empty">Nothing queued. The agent drafts once a day, and stays quiet on days when nothing clears the bar.</p>
      ) : (
        posts.map((post) => (
          <PostCard key={post.id} post={post} refresh={refresh} liveMode={liveMode} editable />
        ))
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/** The judge's overall mark, from the payload or averaged from its criteria. */
function judgeTotal(scores: Record<string, number>): string {
  if (typeof scores.total === "number") return scores.total.toFixed(1);
  const rest = Object.entries(scores).filter(([k]) => k !== "total");
  if (rest.length === 0) return "—";
  return (rest.reduce((a, [, v]) => a + v, 0) / rest.length).toFixed(1);
}

function PostCard({
  post,
  refresh,
  liveMode,
  editable,
}: {
  post: Post;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  liveMode: boolean;
  editable?: boolean;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(post.text);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function act(action: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
    setBusy(action);
    setError("");
    const res = await api(`/api/posts/${post.seq}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: JSON.stringify({ action, ...extra }),
    });
    const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; detail?: string };
    setBusy(null);
    if (!res.ok) {
      setError(data.detail ?? data.error ?? "Failed.");
      return;
    }
    setEditing(false);
    await refresh();
  }

  // Show where LinkedIn truncates, so the hook can be judged before publishing.
  const foldIndex = post.text.length > FOLD_CHARS ? post.text.lastIndexOf(" ", FOLD_CHARS) : -1;

  return (
    <article className="post">
      <div className="post-meta">
        <span className="badge">{post.id}</span>
        {post.category && <span className="badge">{CATEGORY_LABELS[post.category] ?? post.category}</span>}
        <span className="badge">{post.kind === "custom" ? "yours" : "agent"}</span>
        {post.usedQuote && <span className="badge live">Marvel line</span>}
        {post.status === "failed" && <span className="badge bad">failed</span>}
        {post.status === "unknown" && <span className="badge warn">unconfirmed</span>}
        {post.media.length > 0 && <span className="badge">{post.media.length} image{post.media.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>}
        <span>{relative(post.createdAt)}</span>
      </div>

      {editing ? (
        <textarea value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {foldIndex > 0 ? (
            <>
              <p className="post-text">{post.text.slice(0, foldIndex)}</p>
              {/* The cut LinkedIn makes at 210 characters, drawn where it
                  falls, with the count of what it hides. Judging the hook
                  against that boundary is the thing this screen does that
                  LinkedIn's own composer does not. */}
              <hr
                className="fold"
                data-below={`see more · ${post.text.length - foldIndex} below`}
              />
              <p className="post-text below-fold">{post.text.slice(foldIndex + 1)}</p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p className="post-text">{post.text}</p>
          )}
          {post.hashtags.length > 0 && (
            <p className="post-text" style={{ color: "var(--daylight)", marginTop: "var(--s3)" }}>
              {post.hashtags.map((h) => `#${h}`).join(" ")}
            </p>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {/* The judge's reasoning and its five criteria, folded away together.
          "Why did it pick this" is a question asked occasionally; open under
          every draft, the meters compete with the copy on every read. */}
      {(post.rationale || post.scores) && (
        <details className="judgement">
          <summary>
            Why this one
            {post.scores && <span className="total">{judgeTotal(post.scores)} / 10</span>}
          </summary>

          {post.rationale && <p className="rationale">{post.rationale}</p>}

          {post.scores && (
            <div className="scores">
              {Object.entries(post.scores)
                .filter(([key]) => key !== "total")
                .map(([key, value]) => (
                  <div className="score" key={key}>
                    <span>{SCORE_LABELS[key] ?? key}</span>
                    <span className="meter">
                      <i style={{ width: `${(value / 10) * 100}%` }} />
                    </span>
                    <span className="tabular">{value}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </details>
      )}

      {post.sources[0] && (
        <p className="hint" style={{ marginTop: "var(--s3)" }}>
          <a href={post.sources[0]} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
            {new URL(post.sources[0]).hostname}
          </a>
        </p>
      )}

      {editable && (
        <div className="post-actions">
          {editing ? (
            <>
              <button onClick={() => void act("edit", { text: draft, hashtags: post.hashtags })} disabled={!!busy}>
                Save changes
              </button>
              <button className="ghost" onClick={() => { setEditing(false); setDraft(post.text); }}>
                Cancel
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={() => setEditing(true)}>Edit</button>
          )}
          <div className="spacer" />
          <button className="danger" onClick={() => void act("discard")} disabled={!!busy}>
            Discard
          </button>
          <button
            className="primary"
            onClick={() => void act("publish")}
            disabled={!!busy || !liveMode || post.status === "unknown"}
            title={liveMode ? undefined : "Publishing is disabled in this preview environment"}
          >
            {busy === "publish" ? "Publishing…" : "Publish"}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && <p className="error-text">{error}</p>}
    </article>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- history

function History({ posts }: { posts: Post[] }) {
  if (posts.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Published ({posts.length})</h2>
      {posts.map((post) => (
        <article className="post" key={post.id}>
          <div className="post-meta">
            <span className="badge good">{post.id}</span>
            {post.category && <span className="badge">{CATEGORY_LABELS[post.category] ?? post.category}</span>}
            <span>{post.publishedAt ? relative(post.publishedAt) : relative(post.createdAt)}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="post-text">{post.text}</p>
        </article>
      ))}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- sidebar

function Connection({
  account,
  refresh,
}: {
  account: NonNullable<Status["account"]>;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>LinkedIn</h2>
      {account.connected ? (
        <>
          <div className="spread">
            <div>
              <b>{account.memberName ?? "Connected"}</b>
              <p className="hint" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
                Access valid for {account.daysRemaining} more days
                {account.hasRefreshToken ? " · auto-renewing" : " · manual renewal"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className={`badge ${account.needsReauth ? "bad" : account.expiringSoon ? "warn" : "good"}`}>
              {account.needsReauth ? "expired" : "connected"}
            </span>
          </div>
          {account.lastError && <p className="error-text">Last error: {account.lastError}</p>}
          <div className="post-actions">
            <a href="/api/linkedin/connect"><button>Reconnect</button></a>
            <div className="spacer" />
            <button
              className="danger"
              onClick={async () => {
                if (!confirm("Disconnect LinkedIn? This also pauses the agent.")) return;
                await api("/api/linkedin/disconnect", { method: "POST" });
                await refresh();
              }}
            >
              Disconnect
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p className="hint" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
            Not connected. The agent will keep drafting, but nothing can publish.
          </p>
          <a href="/api/linkedin/connect"><button className="primary">Connect LinkedIn</button></a>
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function Settings({
  agent,
  refresh,
}: {
  agent: NonNullable<Status["agent"]>;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  // Controlled, so what you see is always what was actually sent — and it
  // re-syncs whenever the server's value changes underneath it.
  const [time, setTime] = useState(agent.postTimeLocal);
  useEffect(() => setTime(agent.postTimeLocal), [agent.postTimeLocal]);

  async function patch(body: Record<string, unknown>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const res = await api("/api/settings", { method: "PATCH", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    setBusy(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; detail?: string };
      setError(data.detail ?? data.error ?? "Failed.");
      return;
    }
    await refresh();
  }

  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Settings</h2>

      <label className="field">
        <span>Categories</span>
        <CategoryPicker values={agent.categories} onChange={categories=>void patch({categories})} disabled={busy} />
      </label>

      <label className="field">
        <span>Daily post time ({agent.timezone})</span>
        <input
          type="time"
          value={time}
          disabled={busy}
          onChange={(e) => {
            const next = e.target.value;
            setTime(next);
            // Save as soon as the value is a COMPLETE time. A time input reports
            // every keystroke, including half-entered states that read as "" —
            // saving on blur meant those were sent to the server, silently
            // dropped, and reported as a successful save.
            if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(next) && next !== agent.postTimeLocal) {
              void patch({ postTimeLocal: next });
            }
          }}
        />
      </label>

      <div className="toggle">
        <div className="label">
          <b>Publish automatically</b>
          <span>Off means every post waits for you. Turn it on once the voice sounds like you.</span>
        </div>
        <button
          className="switch"
          data-on={agent.autoPublish}
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => void patch({ autoPublish: !agent.autoPublish })}
          aria-label="Toggle auto-publish"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="toggle">
        <div className="label">
          <b>Paused</b>
          <span>Stops the daily cycle entirely. Drafts and history are untouched.</span>
        </div>
        <button
          className="switch"
          data-on={agent.paused}
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => void patch({ paused: !agent.paused })}
          aria-label="Toggle pause"
        />
      </div>

      {error && <p className="error-text">{error}</p>}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- voice

const STRUCTURE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  prose: "Paragraphs",
  bullets: "Bullet list",
  "short-lines": "Short punchy lines",
  mixed: "Lead + bullets",
};
const EMOJI_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  none: "None",
  sparing: "Sparing (max 2)",
  expressive: "Expressive",
};
const HOOK_LABELS: Record<string, string> = { plain: "Plain", sharp: "Sharp", bold: "Bold claim" };
const CTA_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  none: "No call to action",
  soft: "Soft question",
  direct: "Direct ask",
};
const REGISTER_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  practitioner: "Practitioner (peers)",
  peer: "Broad professional",
  accessible: "Plain language",
};

/** The one-line summary shown while the panel is collapsed. */
function voiceSummary(s: StyleConfig): string {
  return [
    STRUCTURE_LABELS[s.structure] ?? s.structure,
    s.emoji === "none" ? "no emoji" : `${s.emoji} emoji`,
    s.hashtagCount === 0 ? "no tags" : `${s.hashtagCount} tags`,
    `${s.minWords}–${s.maxWords} words`,
    s.signature ? `${s.signature.source} line` : "no signature",
  ].join(" · ");
}

/** Textareas edit these as one-per-line; empty lines are dropped. */
function toLines(v: string[]): string {
  return v.join("\n");
}
function fromLines(v: string): string[] {
  return v
    .split("\n")
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

interface PreviewResult {
  sourceLabel: string;
  before: string;
  after: string;
  hook: string;
  length: { escapedChars: number; withinLimit: boolean };
  servedBy?: string;
}

/**
 * The voice panel. Edits are staged locally and applied with Save, rather than
 * patched per keystroke like the other settings — there are a dozen controls
 * here and they only make sense as a combination, so previewing the whole set
 * before committing is the point.
 */
function Voice({
  agent,
  presets,
  refresh,
}: {
  agent: NonNullable<Status["agent"]>;
  presets: NonNullable<Status["config"]["presets"]>;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<StyleConfig>(agent.style);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<PreviewResult | null>(null);

  // Re-sync whenever the saved style changes underneath us (another tab, a
  // preset applied elsewhere) — but only while closed, so an open editor never
  // loses what the user is typing.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) setDraft(agent.style);
  }, [agent.style, open]);

  const dirty = JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(agent.style);

  function set<K extends keyof StyleConfig>(key: K, value: StyleConfig[K]) {
    setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, [key]: value }));
    setPreview(null); // a preview of the previous settings is worse than none
  }

  async function save() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const res = await api("/api/settings", {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: JSON.stringify({ style: draft }),
    });
    setBusy(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; detail?: string };
      setError(data.detail ?? data.error ?? "Failed to save.");
      return;
    }
    await refresh();
  }

  async function runPreview() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const res = await api("/api/style/preview", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ style: draft }),
    });
    setBusy(false);
    const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as PreviewResult & {
      error?: string;
      detail?: string;
    };
    if (!res.ok) {
      setError(data.detail ?? data.error ?? "Preview failed.");
      return;
    }
    setPreview(data);
  }

  const sig = draft.signature;

  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <h2>Voice</h2>
        <button className="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
          {open ? "Close" : "Edit"}
        </button>
      </div>
      <p className="sub" style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-micro)", margin: 0 }}>
        {voiceSummary(agent.style)}
      </p>

      {open && (
        <div style={{ marginTop: "var(--s4)" }}>
          <label className="field">
            <span>Start from a preset</span>
            <div className="chips">
              {presets.map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p.id}
                  className="chip"
                  title={p.blurb}
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDraft(p.style);
                    setPreview(null);
                  }}
                >
                  {p.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>Structure</span>
            <select
              value={draft.structure}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => set("structure", e.target.value as StyleConfig["structure"])}
            >
              {Object.entries(STRUCTURE_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>Emoji</span>
            <select
              value={draft.emoji}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => set("emoji", e.target.value as StyleConfig["emoji"])}
            >
              {Object.entries(EMOJI_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>Opening line</span>
            <select
              value={draft.hook}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => set("hook", e.target.value as StyleConfig["hook"])}
            >
              {Object.entries(HOOK_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>Closing</span>
            <select
              value={draft.cta}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => set("cta", e.target.value as StyleConfig["cta"])}
            >
              {Object.entries(CTA_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>Written for</span>
            <select
              value={draft.register}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => set("register", e.target.value as StyleConfig["register"])}
            >
              {Object.entries(REGISTER_LABELS).map(([v, l]) => (
                <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>

          <div className="row" style={{ gap: "var(--s3)" }}>
            <label className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <span>Min words</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={40}
                max={400}
                value={draft.minWords}
                disabled={busy}
                onChange={(e) => set("minWords", Number(e.target.value))}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <span>Max words</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={60}
                max={500}
                value={draft.maxWords}
                disabled={busy}
                onChange={(e) => set("maxWords", Number(e.target.value))}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <span>Hashtags</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                max={5}
                value={draft.hashtagCount}
                disabled={busy}
                onChange={(e) => set("hashtagCount", Number(e.target.value))}
              />
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="toggle">
            <div className="label">
              <b>Signature line</b>
              <span>A rationed catchphrase — at most one short quote, and not in every post.</span>
            </div>
            <button
              className="switch"
              data-on={!!sig}
              disabled={busy}
              aria-label="Toggle signature line"
              onClick={() =>
                set(
                  "signature",
                  sig
                    ? null
                    : { source: "Marvel films", maxWords: 12, budgetPerFive: 1, banned: [] },
                )
              }
            />
          </div>

          {sig && (
            <>
              <label className="field">
                <span>Quotes drawn from</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={sig.source}
                  disabled={busy}
                  placeholder="Marvel films"
                  onChange={(e) => set("signature", { ...sig, source: e.target.value })}
                />
              </label>
              <label className="field">
                <span>At most this many per 5 posts</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={5}
                  value={sig.budgetPerFive}
                  disabled={busy}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    set("signature", { ...sig, budgetPerFive: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label className="field">
                <span>Overused lines to never quote (one per line)</span>
                <textarea
                  className="compact"
                  rows={3}
                  value={toLines(sig.banned)}
                  disabled={busy}
                  onChange={(e) => set("signature", { ...sig, banned: fromLines(e.target.value) })}
                />
              </label>
            </>
          )}

          <label className="field">
            <span>Banned phrases (one per line)</span>
            <textarea
              className="compact"
              rows={4}
              value={toLines(draft.bannedPhrases)}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => set("bannedPhrases", fromLines(e.target.value))}
            />
          </label>

          <label className="field">
            <span>Your own rules (one per line)</span>
            <textarea
              className="compact"
              rows={3}
              value={toLines(draft.customRules)}
              disabled={busy}
              placeholder={"Never mention my employer by name\nAlways name the tool version"}
              onChange={(e) => set("customRules", fromLines(e.target.value))}
            />
          </label>

          <div className="row" style={{ gap: "var(--s2)", marginTop: "var(--s3)" }}>
            <button className="ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void runPreview()}>
              {busy ? "Working…" : "Preview"}
            </button>
            <button disabled={busy || !dirty} onClick={() => void save()}>
              {dirty ? "Save voice" : "Saved"}
            </button>
            {dirty && (
              <button
                className="ghost"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => {
                  setDraft(agent.style);
                  setPreview(null);
                }}
              >
                Revert
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {preview && (
            <div className="preview">
              <p className="sub" style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-micro)" }}>
                Rewritten from {preview.sourceLabel}
                ·{" "}
                {preview.length.escapedChars} chars
                {preview.length.withinLimit ? "" : " · TOO LONG"}
              </p>
              <p className="post-text">{preview.after}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && <p className="error-text">{error}</p>}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function Schedule({ status }: { status: Status }) {
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Cadence</h2>
      <ul className="list-compact">
        <li>
          Next run
          <span className="why">{status.schedule?.nextRunLocal ?? "not scheduled"}</span>
        </li>
        <li>
          Cycles run
          <span className="why tabular">{status.schedule?.cycleCount ?? 0}</span>
        </li>
        <li>
          Agent publishes
          <span className="why tabular">
            {status.budget?.autoUsed ?? 0} / {status.budget?.autoCap ?? 1} today
          </span>
        </li>
        <li>
          You published
          <span className="why tabular">
            {status.budget?.manualUsed ?? 0} today
          </span>
        </li>

      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

function Rejections({ items }: { items: NonNullable<Status["rejections"]> }) {
  if (items.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Passed over</h2>
      <ul className="list-compact">
        {items.slice(0, 8).map((r) => (
          <li key={`${r.url}-${r.createdAt}`}>
            <a href={r.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
              {r.title}
            </a>
            <span className="why">{r.reason}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

````

## Source: cloud/README.md

````text
# ByLine cloud backend

Flutter's API runs on Cloudflare Workers, D1, Cron Triggers and Workflows. Gemini generates drafts, Firebase delivers notifications, and LinkedIn uses each author's OAuth grant. The computer can be off after deployment. The original Next.js/PostgreSQL backend remains separate and is not deployed by this package.

## Deployment ownership

Use only the dedicated **ByLine** account `b79d736758ce155523d91c41c43f2ccc`. The live API is `https://byline-api.byline-b79.workers.dev`, and its D1 database is `221e7f65-aef1-47be-8150-d6625d3557cf`. The owner explicitly prohibited using Hazzino resources or branding. Do not deploy into the original personal account, rename its shared subdomain, or modify its other applications. All temporary ByLine resources created there were exported and removed; no user records were present.

## Verification and release

From `cloud/`: `npm ci`, `npm run types`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`. Tests use an isolated Miniflare database. Root `npm test` and `npm run build:check` check the existing Next.js adapters.

`scripts/prepare-secrets.mjs` writes ignored `../.byline-local/cloud-secrets.json` from the owner's private `.env` and dedicated Firebase service account. Signing/encryption keys are preserved across runs. FCM is verified with a validate-only request. Never commit, print or embed secrets in an APK. Back up keys securely; losing the encryption key prevents reading stored LinkedIn grants.

After verifying the intended account and database in `wrangler.jsonc`, apply `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply byline --remote`, then deploy with `npx wrangler deploy --secrets-file ../.byline-local/cloud-secrets.json`. Keep `LINKEDIN_LIVE=false` during initial verification. Author accounts also start paused with auto-publishing off.

1. Verify `/api/health` succeeds and protected routes reject unauthenticated requests.
2. With publishing disabled, set `BYLINE_CLOUD_ORIGIN` to the approved HTTPS origin and run `npx tsx scripts/remote-smoke.ts`. It creates one disposable author, generates a real preview/background draft, then removes that author. It consumes a few AI requests, without publishing or sending notifications.
3. Verify a naturally scheduled maintenance workflow completes. A manual trigger does not prove the timer fired. Cron configuration can take up to 15 minutes to propagate.
4. Register the approved `/api/linkedin/callback` and verify real sign-in. Preserve existing callbacks unless asked otherwise.
5. Prepare Android using the approved origin and matching Firebase project. **Do not install or update the owner's phone without fresh explicit permission.**
6. Verify real device notifications and a user-approved publication before calling those integrations end-to-end verified.

For Android, run `node scripts/prepare-cloud-android.mjs https://byline-api.byline-b79.workers.dev` from the repository root, then `scripts/build-cloud-android.ps1`. The output is `.byline-local/byline-cloud-release.apk`. Signing uses `.byline-local/byline-release.p12` and ignored `mobile/android/key.properties`; preserve both in a secure backup. These scripts contain no installation command. The previously installed debug build uses a different signing certificate; do not uninstall or replace it without explicit permission and a data-preservation plan.

## Limits and recovery

Jobs are saved before workflow dispatch, and the next tick retries failed dispatches. Drafts use stable request and slot identities. Revision checks stop obsolete preparation. Atomic publication claims prevent duplicate sends. Unknown LinkedIn outcomes require human resolution rather than an automatic resend.

External-request budgets are explicit for the free deployment: discovery spends at most 24 fetches (including redirect hops), selecting up to 12 feeds across the selected subjects. Generation shares a 12-attempt AI budget per invocation, including transient retries. A completed generation dispatches only its own notification, to at most 10 devices plus the Firebase credential request. Maintenance drains at most three notification rows per tick. Do not raise these independently: Workers Free limits external subrequests to 50, including redirects. These are separate from the daily per-author and shared provider allowances.

Temporary AI network/5xx failures try Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite after the primary Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite; both were verified accessible on the existing free-tier project on 5 November 2026. Each actual request reserves the same author's daily allowance and the selected model's shared allowance. If both are temporarily unavailable, the existing durable Workflow step backoff applies. Successful source steps remain saved. Quota exhaustion and exhausted invocation budgets do not trigger repeated transport requests. Failure notifications report the real outcome; they do not imply a draft was saved. Free-tier model availability and quotas still require periodic review against Google's pricing and project limits.

The scheduler reconciles failed workflow instances, recovers already-saved drafts and queues LinkedIn expiry reminders. `/api/health?check=scheduler` returns 503 when the last tick is missing or older than 16 minutes; `/api/health` checks database availability. Use the scheduler-aware URL for external uptime monitoring. An in-provider health check alone cannot alert during a total provider outage.

This is bounded free hosting, not unlimited capacity or guaranteed availability. D1 has read/write/storage limits, Workflows has usage limits, and Gemini has API quotas. Global and per-author AI reservation caps are enforced; no paid fallback is configured. Keep Gemini project billing disabled for this zero-cost setup. LinkedIn credentials expire and users must reconnect.

A total Cloudflare outage also stops its timer. Independent monitoring and tested off-provider backups remain launch requirements for paying customers. Existing Neon data is quota-paused and has not been migrated. The Vercel website still uses its original backend.

References: [Cron propagation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/cron-triggers/), [D1 pricing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/), [Workflows pricing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workflows/reference/pricing/), [Gemini pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing).

````

````text
-- Initial D1 schema. Dates are UTC ISO strings; JSON is validated TEXT.

-- Extracted from the verified local PostgreSQL schema; no user data is included.

-- Subsequent changes must be separate numbered migrations.

CREATE TABLE "agents" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)),2) || '-a' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)),2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))),
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "domain" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "persona_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("persona_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("persona_json")),
  "persona_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "is_demo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_demo" IN (0,1)),
  "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0,1)),
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  "categories_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK ("categories_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("categories_json")),
  "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Kolkata',
  "post_time_local" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '09:30',
  "auto_publish" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_publish" IN (0,1)),
  "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0,1)),
  "auto_publish_cap" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "style_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK ("style_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("style_json")),
  "corpus_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK ("corpus_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("corpus_json")),
  "edit_notes" TEXT,
  "edit_notes_from" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "owner_id" TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES byline_users(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (persona_hash)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agents_owner_unique ON agents (owner_id) WHERE (owner_id IS NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE "ai_provider_days" (
  "model" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "day" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "next_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (model, day)
);

CREATE TABLE "ai_usage" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "owner" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "model" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "success" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("success" IN (0,1)),
  "input_tokens" INTEGER,
  "output_tokens" INTEGER,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
);

CREATE TABLE "ai_user_days" (
  "owner" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "day" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "requests" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (owner, day)
);

CREATE TABLE "byline_sessions" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)),2) || '-a' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)),2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))),
  "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES byline_users(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE "byline_users" (
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)),2) || '-a' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)),2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))),
  "provider" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "subject" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (provider, subject)
);

CREATE TABLE "device_tokens" (
  "token" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "agent_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "platform" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'android',
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  "last_seen_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (token)
);

CREATE INDEX device_tokens_agent ON device_tokens (agent_id);

CREATE TABLE "distributions" (
  "id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "agent_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "seq" INTEGER,
  "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "target" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'linkedin_member',
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_flight',
  "external_urn" TEXT,
  "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "last_error" TEXT,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  "settled_at" TEXT,
````

````text
-- Durable dispatch outbox: creating a Workflow is retried without losing the request.
CREATE TABLE generation_jobs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(id),
  payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload)),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK(state IN ('queued','working','completed','failed')),
  stage TEXT,
  error TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
);
CREATE INDEX generation_jobs_dispatch ON generation_jobs(state,created_at);
CREATE INDEX generation_jobs_agent ON generation_jobs(agent_id,state);

-- A single insert reserves both budgets under the same D1 transaction.
CREATE TABLE ai_reservations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner TEXT NOT NULL,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX ai_reservations_day ON ai_reservations(day);
CREATE TRIGGER ai_reservation_counters AFTER INSERT ON ai_reservations BEGIN
  INSERT INTO ai_user_days(owner,day,requests) VALUES(NEW.owner,NEW.day,1)
    ON CONFLICT(owner,day) DO UPDATE SET requests=requests+1;
  INSERT INTO ai_provider_days(model,day,attempts,next_at) VALUES(NEW.model,NEW.day,1,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',NEW.created_at,'+4 seconds'))
    ON CONFLICT(model,day) DO UPDATE SET attempts=attempts+1,
      next_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',MAX(NEW.created_at,next_at),'+4 seconds');
END;
CREATE INDEX native_auth_created ON native_auth(created_at);
CREATE INDEX oauth_states_created ON oauth_states(created_at);
CREATE INDEX byline_sessions_expiry ON byline_sessions(expires_at);
CREATE INDEX notification_outbox_pending ON notification_outbox(delivered_at,retry_at);
CREATE INDEX post_slots_next ON post_slots(enabled,next_run_at);
ALTER TABLE agents ADD COLUMN revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE post_slots ADD COLUMN revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE slot_runs ADD COLUMN job_id TEXT;
ALTER TABLE onboarding ADD COLUMN finish_token TEXT;
ALTER TABLE onboarding ADD COLUMN preview_lease TEXT;
ALTER TABLE distributions ADD COLUMN send_day TEXT;
CREATE INDEX distributions_daily ON distributions(agent_id,source,send_day);
ALTER TABLE distributions ADD COLUMN resolution_token TEXT;
ALTER TABLE agents ADD COLUMN edit_token TEXT;
````

## Source: cloud/scripts/live-smoke.ts

````text
// Real AI, isolated local database. Never publishes, changes cloud data, or touches a phone.
import {readFileSync,readdirSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {parseEnv} from 'node:util';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {Miniflare,convertV4MiniflareOptions} from 'miniflare';
import {provisionIdentity} from '../src/identities';
import {signSession} from '../src/crypto';
import {defaultSetup} from '../../lib/setup-config';
// @ts-expect-error Existing local operator helper is JavaScript; its token is never persisted here.
import {googleOperatorFetch} from '../../scripts/google-operator.mjs';
const env=parseEnv(readFileSync(new URL('../../.env',import.meta.url),'utf8'));
if(!env.GEMINI_API_KEY)throw new Error('Gemini key is missing');
const lookup=await googleOperatorFetch(`https://apikeys.googleapis.com/v2/keys:lookupKey?keyString=${encodeURIComponent(env.GEMINI_API_KEY)}`);
if(!lookup.ok)throw new Error('Unable to verify the Gemini project');
const project=(await lookup.json()).parent.split('/')[1];
const billing=await googleOperatorFetch(`https://cloudbilling.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${project}/billingInfo`);
if(!billing.ok||(await billing.json()).billingEnabled!==false)throw new Error('Billing must be verified disabled before this smoke test');
const secret=crypto.randomUUID()+crypto.randomUUID();
const runtime=new Miniflare(convertV4MiniflareOptions({modules:true,
  scriptPath:fileURLToPath(new URL('../.wrangler/test-build/index.js',import.meta.url)),compatibilityDate:'2026-10-27',compatibilityFlags:['nodejs_compat'],d1Databases:['DB'],
  workflows:{CONTENT:{name:'byline-content',className:'ContentWorkflow'},MAINTENANCE:{name:'byline-maintenance',className:'MaintenanceWorkflow'}},
  bindings:{APP_SECRET:secret,TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY:'c'.repeat(64),GEMINI_API_KEY:env.GEMINI_API_KEY},
}));
try {
  const db=await runtime.getD1Database('DB');
  for(const f of readdirSync(new URL('../migrations/',import.meta.url)).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.sql')).sort()) {
    const sql=readFileSync(new URL(`../migrations/${f}`,import.meta.url),'utf8');
    await db.batch(sql.replace(/^--.*$/gm,'').split(/;\s*(?=CREATE|ALTER|$)/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s=>db.prepare(s)));
  }
  const author=await provisionIdentity(db,{provider:'linkedin',subject:'isolated-live-smoke',name:'ByLine test author'});
  const session=crypto.randomUUID(),expires=Date.now()+600000;
  await db.prepare('INSERT INTO byline_sessions(id,user_id,expires_at) VALUES(?,?,?)').bind(session,author.userId,new Date(expires).toISOString()).run();
  const config={...defaultSetup,categories:['ai-ml'],style:{minWords:80,maxWords:160,hashtagCount:0,signature:null}};
  await db.prepare('UPDATE onboarding SET config=?,revision=1 WHERE user_id=?').bind(JSON.stringify(config),author.userId).run();
  const response=await runtime.dispatchFetch('https://byline.example/api/onboarding',{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${await signSession(secret,author.userId,session,expires)}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'preview',revision:1})});
  const result=await response.json() as {error?:string;preview?:{text:string;title:string;sources:string[];testMode:boolean}};
  if(!response.ok||!result.preview)throw new Error(result.error??`Smoke returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
  const report={testedAt:new Date().toISOString(),billingEnabled:false,status:response.status,model:'gemini-3.5-flash-lite',preview:result.preview,
    limitations:['Runs in local Workers runtime, not the deployed Free plan.','No LinkedIn publish, phone installation, or notification was performed.']};
  writeFileSync(new URL('../../.byline-local/cloud-live-smoke.json',import.meta.url),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:true,status:response.status,title:result.preview.title,words:result.preview.text.split(/\s+/).length,testMode:result.preview.testMode}));
}finally {await runtime.dispose();}

````

## Source: cloud/scripts/prepare-secrets.mjs

````text
// Prepare ignored deployment secrets without echoing their values.
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync,existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import {parseEnv} from 'node:util';
import {randomBytes,createPrivateKey,sign} from 'node:crypto';
const read=name=>parseEnv(readFileSync(new URL(`../../${name}`,import.meta.url),'utf8'));
const local=read('.env');
const file=new URL('../../.byline-local/cloud-secrets.json',import.meta.url);
const saved=existsSync(file)?JSON.parse(readFileSync(file,'utf8')):{};
const fcm=JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../../.byline-local/byline-cloud-fcm.json',import.meta.url),'utf8'));
if(fcm.project_id!=='linkdin-43813')throw new Error('Firebase project does not match the ByLine Android configuration');
if(!fcm.client_email||!fcm.private_key)throw new Error('FCM server credentials are missing');
const key=createPrivateKey(fcm.private_key),now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
const b64=s=>Buffer.from(s).toString('base64url');
const jwt=`${b64(JSON.stringify({alg:'RS256',typ:'JWT'}))}.${b64(JSON.stringify({iss:fcm.client_email,scope:'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging',aud:'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',iat:now,exp:now+3600}))}`;
const result=await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',{method:'POST',body:new URLSearchParams({grant_type:'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',assertion:`${jwt}.${sign('RSA-SHA256',Buffer.from(jwt),key).toString('base64url')}`}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});
if(!result.ok)throw new Error(`FCM server credential verification failed (HTTP ${result.status})`);
const access=await result.json();
const dryRun=await fetch(`https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${encodeURIComponent(fcm.project_id)}/messages:send`,{
  method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access.access_token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
  body:JSON.stringify({validate_only:true,message:{topic:'byline-deployment-validation',data:{kind:'configuration-check'}}}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});
if(!dryRun.ok)throw new Error(`FCM send permission verification failed (HTTP ${dryRun.status})`);
await dryRun.body?.cancel();
const secrets={APP_SECRET:saved.APP_SECRET??randomBytes(32).toString('hex'),TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY:saved.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY??randomBytes(32).toString('base64'),
  GEMINI_API_KEY:local.GEMINI_API_KEY,LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID:local.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID,LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET:local.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET,FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:JSON.stringify(fcm),
  CRON_SECRET:saved.CRON_SECRET??randomBytes(32).toString('hex'),LINKEDIN_LIVE:saved.LINKEDIN_LIVE??'false'};
for(const [name,value] of Object.entries(secrets))if(!value)throw new Error(`${name} is missing`);
writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(secrets,null,2),{mode:0o600});
console.log(JSON.stringify({prepared:true,secretNames:Object.keys(secrets),firebaseProject:fcm.project_id,fcmCredentialsVerified:true,fcmSendPermissionVerified:true,notificationSent:false,publishingEnabled:secrets.LINKEDIN_LIVE==='true'}));

````

## Source: cloud/scripts/remote-smoke.ts

````text
// Operator-only deployment verification. Credentials never leave this process's private output.
// Creates one synthetic author in D1 and removes only that author through the normal API.
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync,unlinkSync} from 'node:fs';
import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {signSession} from '../src/crypto';
import {defaultSetup,setupPersona,setupStyle} from '../../lib/setup-config';
const origin=process.env.BYLINE_CLOUD_ORIGIN;
if(!origin||!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+$/.test(origin))throw new Error('Set BYLINE_CLOUD_ORIGIN to the approved HTTPS backend origin');
const secrets=JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../../.byline-local/cloud-secrets.json',import.meta.url),'utf8'));
if(secrets.LINKEDIN_LIVE!=='false')throw new Error('Run this initial release smoke with publishing disabled');
const user=crypto.randomUUID(),agent=crypto.randomUUID(),session=crypto.randomUUID(),expires=Date.now()+30*60000;
const config={...defaultSetup,categories:['ai-ml'],style:{minWords:80,maxWords:160,hashtagCount:0,signature:null}};
const quote=(s:string)=>`'${s.replaceAll("'","''")}'`;
const file=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../.byline-local/remote-smoke.sql',import.meta.url));
function sql(source:string) {
  writeFileSync(file,source);
  try {
    const input=/^\s*SELECT\b/i.test(source)?['--command',source]:['--file',file];
    const output=execFileSync(process.execPath,['node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js','d1','execute','byline','--remote',...input,'--json'],{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:1024*1024});
    const start=output.search(/^\[/m);
    if(start<0)throw new Error('Wrangler did not return its JSON result');
    return JSON.parse(output.slice(start));
  }
  finally {unlinkSync(file);}
}
const token=await signSession(secrets.APP_SECRET,user,session,expires);
async function request(path:string,method='GET',payload?:unknown) {
  const r=await fetch(origin+path,{method,headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},...(payload===undefined?{}:{body:JSON.stringify(payload)}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(180000)});
  const value=await r.json();
  if(!r.ok)throw new Error(`${path}: HTTP ${r.status}, ${JSON.stringify(value).slice(0,250)}`);
  return value;
}
const report:Record<string,unknown>={at:new Date().toISOString(),origin,phoneTouched:false,linkedinPublished:false};
try {
  sql(`INSERT INTO byline_users(id,provider,subject,name) VALUES(${quote(user)},'linkedin',${quote('deployment-smoke-'+user)},'Deployment verification');
    INSERT INTO agents(id,name,domain,persona_json,persona_hash,owner_id,paused,timezone,categories_json,style_json) VALUES(${quote(agent)},'Deployment verification','AI research',${quote(JSON.stringify(setupPersona(config,'Deployment verification')))},'smoke',${quote(user)},1,'UTC','["ai-ml"]',${quote(JSON.stringify(setupStyle(config)))});
    INSERT INTO onboarding(user_id,config,revision) VALUES(${quote(user)},${quote(JSON.stringify(config))},1);
    INSERT INTO byline_sessions(id,user_id,expires_at) VALUES(${quote(session)},${quote(user)},${quote(new Date(expires).toISOString())});`);
  const status=await request('/api/status');
  console.log(JSON.stringify({stage:'authenticated',initialized:status.initialized,scheduler:status.scheduler}));
  const preview=await request('/api/onboarding','POST',{action:'preview',revision:1});
  if(!preview.preview?.text||preview.preview.testMode!==false)throw new Error('A real preview was not returned');
  report.preview=preview.preview;
  console.log(JSON.stringify({stage:'real-cloud-preview',title:preview.preview.title,words:preview.preview.text.split(/\s+/).length}));
  sql(`UPDATE onboarding SET completed_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE user_id=${quote(user)};
    UPDATE agents SET paused=0 WHERE id=${quote(agent)};`);
  await request('/api/cycle/run','POST',{});
  console.log(JSON.stringify({stage:'cloud-workflow-accepted'}));
  for(let i=0;i<60;i++) {
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000));
    const s=await request('/api/status');
    if(s.queue.length) {
      report.workflowDraft=s.queue[0];report.scheduler=s.scheduler;
      console.log(JSON.stringify({stage:'cloud-workflow-draft',seq:s.queue[0].seq,words:s.queue[0].text.split(/\s+/).length,scheduler:s.scheduler}));
      break;
    }
    if(i%6===5)console.log(JSON.stringify({stage:'waiting-for-cloud-workflow',seconds:(i+1)*5}));
  }
  if(!report.workflowDraft)throw new Error('Cloud workflow did not produce a draft within five minutes');
  report.ok=true;
} catch(error) {report.ok=false;report.error=error instanceof Error?error.message:'Verification failed';process.exitCode=1;console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:report.error}));}
finally {
  // Preserve diagnostic job states before removing only this disposable author.
  try {report.jobs=sql(`SELECT state,stage,error FROM generation_jobs WHERE agent_id=${quote(agent)};`)[0]?.results;}catch {report.diagnosticsUnavailable=true;}
  try {await request('/api/account/delete','POST',{confirmation:'DELETE'});report.cleanup=true;}
  catch {report.cleanup=false;report.cleanupUser=user;report.cleanupAgent=agent;}
  writeFileSync(new URL('../../.byline-local/cloud-remote-smoke.json',import.meta.url),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:report.ok,cleanup:report.cleanup,jobs:report.jobs}));
}
````

````text
// Dedicated FCM sender for the hosted backend. Existing project bindings are preserved.
import {writeFileSync,existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import {googleOperatorFetch} from '../../scripts/google-operator.mjs';
const project='linkdin-43813',name='byline-cloud-push';
const email=`${name}@${project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com`;
const file=new URL('../../.byline-local/byline-cloud-fcm.json',import.meta.url);
async function api(url,method='GET',body) {
  const r=await googleOperatorFetch(url,{method,...(body===undefined?{}:{body:JSON.stringify(body)})});
  if(!r.ok)throw new Error(`Google setup failed: HTTP ${r.status}`);
  return r.json();
}
const base=`https://iam.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${project}/serviceAccounts`;
const list=await api(base);
if(!(list.accounts??[]).some(a=>a.email===email))await api(base,'POST',{accountId:name,serviceAccount:{displayName:'ByLine Cloudflare notification sender',description:'Only sends FCM notifications for ByLine. Server credential; never included in the mobile app.'}});
const policyUrl=`https://cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${project}`;
const policy=await api(`${policyUrl}:getIamPolicy`,'POST',{options:{requestedPolicyVersion:3}});
const member=`serviceAccount:${email}`,role='roles/firebasecloudmessaging.admin';
let binding=policy.bindings?.find(b=>b.role===role&&!b.condition);
if(!binding?.members.includes(member)) {
  if(binding)binding.members.push(member);
  else {policy.bindings??=[];policy.bindings.push({role,members:[member]});}
  await api(`${policyUrl}:setIamPolicy`,'POST',{policy});
}
if(!existsSync(file)) {
  const key=await api(`${base}/${email}/keys`,'POST',{privateKeyType:'TYPE_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_FILE',keyAlgorithm:'KEY_ALG_RSA_2048'});
  writeFileSync(file,Buffer.from(key.privateKeyData,'base64'),{mode:0o600});
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({configured:true,project,serviceAccount:email,role,keyStoredLocally:true,notificationSent:false}));
````
