import type { Completion } from '../../lib/llm-contract';
import { boundedText } from '../../lib/http-body';
import { localClock } from '../../lib/schedule';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';

export const USER_AI_LIMIT=40;
export const PROVIDER_AI_LIMIT=100;
export const AI_MODEL='gemini-3.5-flash-lite';
export const AI_FALLBACK_MODEL='gemini-3.1-flash-lite';
export const isTransientAiFailure=(reason:string)=>['provider_http_500','provider_http_502','provider_http_503','provider_http_504','provider_unavailable'].includes(reason);
export async function reserveAi(db:D1Database,owner:string,model:string,day:string,at=new Date(),userCap=USER_AI_LIMIT,providerCap=PROVIDER_AI_LIMIT) {
  const row=await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ai_reservations(id,owner,model,day,created_at)
    SELECT ?,?,?,?,? WHERE COALESCE((SELECT requests FROM ai_user_days WHERE owner=? AND day=?),0)<?
      AND COALESCE((SELECT attempts FROM ai_provider_days WHERE model=? AND day=?),0)<?
      AND COALESCE((SELECT next_at FROM ai_provider_days WHERE model=? AND day=?),'')<?
    RETURNING id`).bind(crypto.randomUUID(),owner,model,day,at.toISOString(),owner,day,userCap,model,day,providerCap,model,day,new Date(at.getTime()+16000).toISOString()).first<{id:string}>();
  if(!row)return null;
  const counter=await db.prepare('SELECT next_at FROM ai_provider_days WHERE model=? AND day=?').bind(model,day).first<{next_at:string}>();
  return {id:row.id,waitMs:Math.max(0,Date.parse(counter!.next_at)-at.getTime()-4000)};
}
export function withProviderRetry(complete:Completion,wait:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)),fallback:Completion=complete):Completion {
  return async args=>{
    const first=await complete(args);
    if(first.ok||!isTransientAiFailure(first.reason))return first;
    await wait(1500);
    return fallback(args);
  };
}
/** Every attempt reserves quota; transient failures get one bounded retry, never a paid fallback. */
export function completion(env:AppEnv,owner:string):Completion {
  let remaining=12;
  const limited=(model:string):Completion=>{
    const single=singleCompletion(env,owner,model);
    return args=>remaining-->0?single(args):Promise.resolve({ok:false,reason:'ai_invocation_budget'});
  };
  // Both models are available on the existing free-tier project. Each actual
  // request reserves its author's allowance and that model's shared allowance.
  return withProviderRetry(limited(AI_MODEL),undefined,limited(AI_FALLBACK_MODEL));
}
/** Let the durable step retry temporary outages without re-fetching saved sources. */
export function durableCompletion(complete:Completion):Completion {
  return async args=>{
    const result=await complete(args);
    if(!result.ok&&isTransientAiFailure(result.reason))throw new Error(result.reason);
    return result;
  };
}
function singleCompletion(env:AppEnv,owner:string,model:string):Completion {
  return async args=>{
    if(!env.GEMINI_API_KEY)return {ok:false,reason:'missing_gemini_api_key'};
    const day=localClock('America/Los_Angeles').date;
    const reservation=await reserveAi(env.DB,owner,model,day);
    if(!reservation)return {ok:false,reason:'ai_allowance_or_pacing_limit'};
    if(reservation.waitMs)await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,reservation.waitMs));
    let success=false;
    let input:number|null=null,output:number|null=null;
    try {
      const response=await fetch(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${model}:generateContent`,{
        method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','x-goog-api-key':env.GEMINI_API_KEY},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(45000),
        body:JSON.stringify({systemInstruction:{parts:[{text:args.system}]},contents:[{role:'user',parts:[{text:args.user}]}],
          generationConfig:{maxOutputTokens:Math.min(args.maxOutputTokens??2048,8192),...(args.jsonMode?{responseMimeType:'application/json'}:{})}}),
      });
      if(!response.ok){
        // Provider diagnostics stay in operator logs; never expose keys or raw
        // provider responses through the app's generation status.
        let detail='';
        try {
          const failure=JSON.parse(await boundedText(response,16384)) as {error?:{message?:string}};
          detail=(failure.error?.message??'').replaceAll(env.GEMINI_API_KEY,'[redacted]').slice(0,500);
        }catch { /* An invalid provider response is still a bounded failure. */ }
        console.warn(JSON.stringify({event:'ai_provider_rejected',model,status:response.status,detail}));
        return {ok:false,reason:response.status===429?'provider_quota_reached':`provider_http_${response.status}`};
      }
      const data=JSON.parse(await boundedText(response,128*1024)) as {candidates?:{finishReason?:string;content?:{parts?:{text?:string;thought?:boolean}[]}}[];usageMetadata?:{promptTokenCount?:number;candidatesTokenCount?:number}};
      input=data.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount??null; output=data.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount??null;
      const candidate=data.candidates?.[0];
      const text=candidate?.content?.parts?.filter(p=>!p.thought).map(p=>p.text??'').join('')??'';
      if(!text.trim()||candidate?.finishReason!=='STOP')return {ok:false,reason:'incomplete_or_blocked_completion'};
      success=true;
      return {ok:true,text,model};
    }catch(error){
      const detail=(error instanceof Error?`${error.name}: ${error.message}`:'Unknown provider failure').replaceAll(env.GEMINI_API_KEY,'[redacted]').slice(0,500);
      console.warn(JSON.stringify({event:'ai_provider_failed',model,detail}));
      return {ok:false,reason:detail.includes('Too many subrequests')?'request_budget_exceeded':'provider_unavailable'};
    }
    finally {
      await env.DB.prepare('INSERT INTO ai_usage(owner,model,success,input_tokens,output_tokens) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)').bind(owner,model,success?1:0,input,output).run();
    }
  };
}

import { nativeReturnUri } from '../../lib/native-return';
import { nativeCallbackPage } from '../../lib/native-callback';
import { SCOPES } from '../../lib/linkedin';
import { provisionIdentity, sessionOwner } from './identities';
import { digest, signSession, verifySession, encryptToken } from './crypto';
import { body, json, HttpError, responseJson } from './http';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
type AuthEnv=Omit<AppEnv,'CONTENT'|'MAINTENANCE'>;

export type Owner={userId:string;agentId:string;name:string;sessionId:string};
const ago=(ms:number)=>new Date(Date.now()-ms).toISOString();
const now=()=>new Date().toISOString();
const flowLife=10*60*1000;
export async function authenticate(request:Request,env:AuthEnv):Promise<Owner|null> {
  const bearer=/^Bearer (\S+)$/.exec(request.headers.get('Authorization')??'');
  // This API is for the native client. Cookie authentication is not accepted.
  if(!bearer)return null;
  const id=await verifySession(env.APP_SECRET,bearer[1]);
  if(!id)return null;
  const owner=await sessionOwner(env.DB,id.userId,id.sessionId);
  return owner?{...owner,sessionId:id.sessionId}:null;
}
export async function limitLogin(request:Request,env:AuthEnv) {
  const client=await digest(env.APP_SECRET+':'+(request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP')??'local'));
  const result=await env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO login_attempts(client)
    SELECT ? WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM login_attempts WHERE client=? AND at>?)<10 RETURNING id`)
    .bind(client,client,ago(15*60*1000)).first();
  if(!result)throw new HttpError(429,'Please wait before trying to sign in again.');
}
export function capabilities(env:AuthEnv) {
  return {linkedin:!!(env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID&&env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET),google:!!(env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&&env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET),localTest:false};
}
export function authorizationUrl(env:AuthEnv,provider:string,state:string,redirect:string) {
  const linkedin=provider==='linkedin';
  return `${linkedin?'https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/authorization':'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth'}?${new URLSearchParams({
    client_id:linkedin?env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID:env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID!,redirect_uri:redirect,response_type:'code',state,
    scope:linkedin?SCOPES.join(' '):'openid profile email',
  })}`;
}
export async function nativeAuth(request:Request,env:AuthEnv) {
  if(request.method==='GET')return json(capabilities(env));
  const b=await body(request);
  if(typeof b.verifier!=='string'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43,128}$/.test(b.verifier))throw new HttpError(400,'invalid_request');
  const hash=await digest(b.verifier);
  if(b.action==='poll') {
    if(typeof b.id!=='string'||!/^native-[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(b.id))throw new HttpError(400,'invalid_request');
    const sessionId=crypto.randomUUID();
    const expires=Date.now()+30*86400000;
    // Consume the flow and create its session in one transaction. Concurrent polls cannot issue two sessions.
    const result=await env.DB.batch([
      env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO byline_sessions(id,user_id,expires_at)
        SELECT ?,user_id,? FROM native_auth WHERE id=? AND verifier_hash=? AND created_at>? AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND error IS NULL RETURNING user_id`)
        .bind(sessionId,new Date(expires).toISOString(),b.id,hash,ago(flowLife)),
      env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM native_auth WHERE id=? AND verifier_hash=? AND created_at>? AND (user_id IS NOT NULL OR error IS NOT NULL) RETURNING error`)
        .bind(b.id,hash,ago(flowLife)),
    ]);
    const user=result[0].results[0] as {user_id:string}|undefined;
    if(user)return json({token:await signSession(env.APP_SECRET,user.user_id,sessionId,expires)});
    if(result[1].results.length)return json({error:'sign_in_failed',detail:'Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.'},400);
    return json({pending:true});
  }
  if(b.action!==undefined&&b.action!=='start')throw new HttpError(400,'Unknown sign-in action.');
  await limitLogin(request,env);
  const provider=b.provider;
  if((provider!=='google'&&provider!=='linkedin')||!capabilities(env)[provider])throw new HttpError(503,'This sign-in option is not configured.');
  const returnUri=nativeReturnUri(b.returnUri);
  if(b.returnUri!=null&&!returnUri)throw new HttpError(400,'invalid_return_uri');
  const id=`native-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  const redirect=new URL(provider==='linkedin'?'/api/linkedin/callback':'/api/native-auth/callback',request.url).href;
  await env.DB.prepare('INSERT INTO native_auth(id,provider,verifier_hash,redirect_uri,return_uri) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)').bind(id,provider,hash,redirect,returnUri).run();
  return json({id,url:authorizationUrl(env,provider,id,redirect)});
}
type Grant={access_token:string;expires_in:number;refresh_token?:string;scope?:string};
type Identity={sub:string;name?:string;picture?:string};
async function exchange(env:AuthEnv,provider:string,code:string,redirect:string) {
  const linkedin=provider==='linkedin';
  const grant=await responseJson<Grant>(await fetch(linkedin?'https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken':'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',{
    method:'POST',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000),body:new URLSearchParams({grant_type:'authorization_code',code,redirect_uri:redirect,
      client_id:linkedin?env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID:env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID!,client_secret:linkedin?env.LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET:env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET!}),
  }));
  if(typeof grant.access_token!=='string'||!grant.access_token||grant.access_token.length>16384||!Number.isFinite(grant.expires_in)||grant.expires_in<=0)throw new Error('Invalid provider grant');
  const identity=await responseJson<Identity>(await fetch(linkedin?'https://api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo':'https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo',{
    headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${grant.access_token}`},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
  }));
  if(typeof identity.sub!=='string'||!identity.sub||identity.sub.length>256)throw new Error('Invalid provider identity');
  return {grant,identity};
}
async function accountStatement(env:AuthEnv,agentId:string,grant:Grant,identity:Identity) {
  const access=await encryptToken(env.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY,grant.access_token);
  const refresh=grant.refresh_token?await encryptToken(env.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY,grant.refresh_token):null;
  return env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO linkedin_accounts(agent_id,member_urn,member_name,member_picture,access_token_enc,refresh_token_enc,scopes,expires_at)
    VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(agent_id) DO UPDATE SET member_urn=excluded.member_urn,member_name=excluded.member_name,
    member_picture=excluded.member_picture,access_token_enc=excluded.access_token_enc,refresh_token_enc=excluded.refresh_token_enc,
    scopes=excluded.scopes,expires_at=excluded.expires_at,connected_at=?,last_error=NULL`)
    .bind(agentId,`urn:li:person:${identity.sub}`,typeof identity.name==='string'?identity.name.slice(0,100):null,
      typeof identity.picture==='string'?identity.picture.slice(0,2048):null,access,refresh,grant.scope??null,new Date(Date.now()+grant.expires_in*1000).toISOString(),now());
}
export async function authCallback(request:Request,env:AuthEnv) {
  const params=new URL(request.url).searchParams;
  const state=params.get('state')??'';
  if(state.startsWith('native-')) {
    const flow=await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE native_auth SET claimed_at=? WHERE id=? AND claimed_at IS NULL AND created_at>?
      RETURNING provider,redirect_uri,return_uri`).bind(now(),state,ago(flowLife)).first<{provider:string;redirect_uri:string;return_uri:string|null}>();
    if(!flow)return nativeCallbackPage(false);
    try {
      if(params.has('error')||!params.get('code'))throw new Error('Sign-in cancelled');
      const {grant,identity}=await exchange(env,flow.provider,params.get('code')!,flow.redirect_uri);
      const user=await provisionIdentity(env.DB,{provider:flow.provider,subject:flow.provider==='linkedin'?`urn:li:person:${identity.sub}`:identity.sub,name:identity.name??'ByLine author'});
      const statements:D1PreparedStatement[]=[];
      if(flow.provider==='linkedin')statements.push(await accountStatement(env,user.agentId,grant,identity));
      statements.push(env.DB.prepare('UPDATE native_auth SET user_id=? WHERE id=?').bind(user.userId,state));
      await env.DB.batch(statements);
      return nativeCallbackPage(true,flow.return_uri);
    }catch {
      await env.DB.prepare('UPDATE native_auth SET error=? WHERE id=?').bind('Sign-in failed. Please try again.',state).run();
      return nativeCallbackPage(false,flow.return_uri);
    }
  }
  const flow=await env.DB.prepare('DELETE FROM oauth_states WHERE state=? AND created_at>? RETURNING agent_id,return_uri').bind(state,ago(flowLife)).first<{agent_id:string;return_uri:string|null}>();
  if(!flow)return nativeCallbackPage(false);
  try {
    if(params.has('error')||!params.get('code'))throw new Error('Connection cancelled');
    const {grant,identity}=await exchange(env,'linkedin',params.get('code')!,new URL('/api/linkedin/callback',request.url).href);
    await (await accountStatement(env,flow.agent_id,grant,identity)).run();
    return nativeCallbackPage(true,flow.return_uri);
  }catch {return nativeCallbackPage(false,flow.return_uri);}
}
export async function connectLinkedIn(request:Request,env:AuthEnv,owner:Owner) {
  if(!capabilities(env).linkedin)throw new HttpError(503,'LinkedIn is not configured.');
  const p=new URL(request.url).searchParams;
  const returnUri=nativeReturnUri(p.get('returnUri'));
  if(p.has('returnUri')&&!returnUri)throw new HttpError(400,'invalid_return_uri');
  const state=crypto.randomUUID();
  await env.DB.prepare('INSERT INTO oauth_states(state,agent_id,native,return_uri) VALUES(?,?,1,?)').bind(state,owner.agentId,returnUri).run();
  return json({url:authorizationUrl(env,'linkedin',state,new URL('/api/linkedin/callback',request.url).href)});
}

const encoder=new TextEncoder();
const hex=(bytes:Uint8Array)=>Array.from(bytes,b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
export async function digest(value:string) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',encoder.encode(value))));
}
async function signingKey(secret:string,usage:'sign'|'verify') {
  if(secret.length<32)throw new Error('Session secret is not configured');
  return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',encoder.encode(secret),{name:'HMAC',hash:'SHA-256'},false,[usage]);
}
export async function signSession(secret:string,userId:string,sessionId:string,expires:number) {
  const payload=`v2.${userId}.${sessionId}.${expires}`;
  const mac=await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC',await signingKey(secret,'sign'),encoder.encode(payload));
  return `${payload}.${hex(new Uint8Array(mac))}`;
}
export async function verifySession(secret:string,value:string,now=Date.now()) {
  const p=value.split('.');
  const uuid=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if(p.length!==5||p[0]!=='v2'||!uuid.test(p[1])||!uuid.test(p[2])||!/^\d{13}$/.test(p[3])||Number(p[3])<=now||!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(p[4]))return null;
  const mac=Uint8Array.from(p[4].match(/../g)!,b=>parseInt(b,16));
  const valid=await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC',await signingKey(secret,'verify'),mac,encoder.encode(p.slice(0,4).join('.')));
  return valid?{userId:p[1],sessionId:p[2]}:null;
}
function unbase64(s:string):Uint8Array { return Uint8Array.from(atob(s),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)); }
function base64(b:Uint8Array):string {return btoa(Array.from(b,c=>String.fromCharCode(c)).join(''));}
async function encryptionKey(raw:string,usage:'encrypt'|'decrypt') {
  const value=raw.trim();
  const bytes=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(value)?Uint8Array.from(value.match(/../g)!,h=>parseInt(h,16)):unbase64(value);
  if(bytes.length!==32)throw new Error('Token encryption key is not configured');
  return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',bytes,{name:'AES-GCM'},false,[usage]);
}
/** Same v1 layout as the original backend: nonce, GCM tag, ciphertext. */
export async function encryptToken(secret:string,plaintext:string) {
  const iv=crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const encrypted=new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv},await encryptionKey(secret,'encrypt'),encoder.encode(plaintext)));
  const result=new Uint8Array(12+encrypted.length);
  result.set(iv); result.set(encrypted.subarray(-16),12); result.set(encrypted.subarray(0,-16),28);
  return 'v1:'+base64(result);
}
export async function decryptToken(secret:string,ciphertext:string) {
  if(!ciphertext.startsWith('v1:'))throw new Error('Unsupported token format');
  const bytes=unbase64(ciphertext.slice(3));
  if(bytes.length<=28)throw new Error('Invalid encrypted token');
  const data=new Uint8Array(bytes.length-12);
  data.set(bytes.subarray(28)); data.set(bytes.subarray(12,28),data.length-16);
  const plaintext=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:bytes.subarray(0,12)},await encryptionKey(secret,'decrypt'),data);
  return new TextDecoder().decode(plaintext);
}

import { body,HttpError,json } from './http';
import type { Owner } from './auth';
export async function deleteAccount(request:Request,db:D1Database,owner:Owner) {
  if((await body(request)).confirmation!=='DELETE')throw new HttpError(400,'Type DELETE to confirm account deletion.');
  const clear="NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=? AND status='in_flight')";
  const statements:D1PreparedStatement[]=[];
  for(const table of ['generation_jobs','notification_outbox','review_deliveries','device_tokens','push_log','oauth_states','linkedin_accounts','media_assets','rejections','scheduler_state','post_counters','posts','post_slots'])
    statements.push(db.prepare(`DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE agent_id=? AND ${clear}`).bind(owner.agentId,owner.agentId));
  for(const table of ['ai_usage','ai_user_days','ai_reservations'])statements.push(db.prepare(`DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE owner IN (?,?) AND ${clear}`).bind(owner.userId,owner.agentId,owner.agentId));
  for(const table of ['byline_sessions','native_auth','onboarding'])statements.push(db.prepare(`DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE user_id=? AND ${clear}`).bind(owner.userId,owner.agentId));
  statements.push(db.prepare(`DELETE FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=? AND ${clear}`).bind(owner.agentId,owner.agentId));
  statements.push(db.prepare(`DELETE FROM agents WHERE id=? AND owner_id=? AND ${clear}`).bind(owner.agentId,owner.userId,owner.agentId));
  statements.push(db.prepare(`DELETE FROM byline_users WHERE id=? AND ${clear} RETURNING id`).bind(owner.userId,owner.agentId));
  const result=await db.batch(statements);
  if(!result.at(-1)!.meta.changes)throw new HttpError(409,'A publish request is unresolved. Check its outcome before deleting your account. No data was removed.');
  return json({ok:true,deleted:true});
}

export interface DraftInput {
  agentId: string;
  requestId: string;
  text: string;
  rationale: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  sources: unknown[];
  slotId?: string;
  slotDate?: string;
  category?:string;
  hashtags?:string[];
  media?:string[];
  scores?:unknown;
  continuity?:string|null;
  usedQuote?:boolean;
  scheduledFor?:string|null;
  cleared?:boolean;
  agentRevision?:number;
  slotRevision?:number;
}

/** Allocation and insert commit together; retries return the original draft. */
export async function saveDraft(db: D1Database, draft: DraftInput) {
  if (!draft.requestId || !draft.text.trim()) throw new Error('Draft identity and text are required');
  if (!!draft.slotId !== !!draft.slotDate) throw new Error('Slot identity needs a date');
  const prior = `SELECT seq FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND (client_request_id=?
    OR (? IS NOT NULL AND slot_id=? AND slot_date=?))`;
  const priorArgs = [draft.agentId, draft.requestId, draft.slotId ?? null, draft.slotId ?? null, draft.slotDate ?? null];
  const guard=`(? IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agents WHERE id=? AND revision=? AND active=1 AND paused=0))
    AND (? IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_slots WHERE id=? AND agent_id=? AND revision=? AND enabled=1))`;
  const guardArgs=[draft.agentRevision??null,draft.agentId,draft.agentRevision??null,draft.slotRevision??null,draft.slotId??null,draft.agentId,draft.slotRevision??null];
  const result = await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO post_counters(agent_id,value)
      SELECT ?,COALESCE(MAX(seq),0)+1 FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? HAVING NOT EXISTS(${prior}) AND ${guard}
      ON CONFLICT(agent_id) DO UPDATE SET value=MAX(post_counters.value+1,excluded.value)`)
      .bind(draft.agentId, draft.agentId, ...priorArgs,...guardArgs),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO posts(agent_id,seq,text,rationale,sources_json,fingerprint,status,kind,client_request_id,slot_id,slot_date,
      category,hashtags_json,media_json,scores_json,continuity,used_quote,scheduled_for,cleared_at)
      SELECT ?,value,?,?,?,?,'draft',?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,? FROM post_counters WHERE agent_id=? AND NOT EXISTS(${prior}) AND ${guard}`)
      .bind(draft.agentId, draft.text, draft.rationale, JSON.stringify(draft.sources), draft.fingerprint,
        draft.slotId ? 'auto' : 'custom', draft.requestId, draft.slotId ?? null, draft.slotDate ?? null,
        draft.category??null,JSON.stringify(draft.hashtags??[]),JSON.stringify(draft.media??[]),draft.scores?JSON.stringify(draft.scores):null,
        draft.continuity??null,draft.usedQuote?1:0,draft.scheduledFor??null,draft.cleared?new Date().toISOString():null,draft.agentId, ...priorArgs,...guardArgs),
    db.prepare(prior).bind(...priorArgs),
  ]);
  const row = result[2].results[0] as { seq: number } | undefined;
  if (!row) throw new Error('Draft was not saved');
  return row.seq;
}

/** Expose actionable failures without leaking database queries or provider responses. */
export function generationError(error:unknown) {
  const message=error instanceof Error?error.message:'';
  const safe=new Set([
    'Preparation stopped because settings changed or ByLine was paused.',
    'The posting time changed.',
    'No source closely matches your subjects yet. Try again later or adjust your subjects.',
    'No suitable story cleared the relevance checks.',
    'The sample needs another pass to match your writing preferences.',
    'The draft needs another pass to match your writing preferences.',
  ]);
  if(safe.has(message))return message;
  if(['ai_allowance_or_pacing_limit','provider_quota_reached','ai_invocation_budget'].includes(message))return 'The AI allowance is temporarily exhausted. Please try again later.';
  if(message==='no_candidates')return 'No recent sources are available for these subjects. Please try again later.';
  if(message==='provider_unavailable'||/^provider_http_5\d\d$/.test(message))return 'The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Your content is saved; please try again later.';
  return 'Preparation could not finish. Your saved content is unchanged; please try again later.';
}

import { discover, type Candidate } from '../../lib/discovery-core';
import { judgeCandidates,PUBLISH_THRESHOLD } from '../../lib/judge-core';
import { writePost, type PriorPost } from '../../lib/writer-core';
import { parseSetup,setupCategories,setupPersona,setupStyle,type SetupConfig } from '../../lib/setup-config';
import { critique } from '../../lib/critique';
import { nextSlotRun } from '../../lib/schedule';
import { pickSamples } from '../../lib/voice-prompt';
import { completion,durableCompletion } from './ai';
import { loadAgent } from './models';
import { saveDraft } from './drafts';
import { failJob,type GenerationJob } from './jobs';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
import type { SlotRow } from './slots';
import { generationError } from './generation-errors';
export type RunStep=<T extends Rpc.Serializable<T>>(name:string,work:()=>Promise<T>)=>Promise<T>;
export const directly:RunStep=(_name,work)=>work();
const memory={facts:[],source:'none' as const,degraded:false};
async function feedResult(db:D1Database,name:string,outcome:{ok:true;items:number}|{ok:false;error:string}) {
  const ok=outcome.ok&&outcome.items>0,now=new Date().toISOString();
  await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO feed_health(name,last_ok_at,last_failed_at,fails_in_a_row,last_error,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET last_ok_at=COALESCE(excluded.last_ok_at,last_ok_at),last_failed_at=COALESCE(excluded.last_failed_at,last_failed_at),
    fails_in_a_row=CASE WHEN excluded.last_ok_at IS NULL THEN fails_in_a_row+1 ELSE 0 END,last_error=excluded.last_error,updated_at=excluded.updated_at`)
    .bind(name,ok?now:null,ok?null:now,ok?0:1,ok?null:'Feed is unavailable or returned no stories.',now).run();
}
export async function generatePreview(env:AppEnv,userId:string,name:string,config:SetupConfig) {
  const categories=setupCategories(config),persona=setupPersona(config,name),style=setupStyle(config);
  const candidates=await discover((name,result)=>feedResult(env.DB,name,result),{categories,maxFetches:24,maxFeeds:12});
  const complete=completion(env,userId);
  const judged=await judgeCandidates(complete,persona,categories,candidates,memory,[]);
  if(!judged.ok)throw new Error(judged.reason);
  const source=judged.data.scored.find(s=>s.total>=PUBLISH_THRESHOLD);
  if(!source)throw new Error('No source closely matches your subjects yet. Try again later or adjust your subjects.');
  const draft=await writePost(complete,{persona,style,winner:source,runnersUp:[],memory,priorPosts:[],repairAttempts:2,samples:config.samples.map(text=>({text,origin:'corpus'}))});
  if(!draft.ok)throw new Error(draft.reason);
  if(critique(draft.data.text,style,{hashtags:draft.data.hashtags,usedQuote:draft.data.used_quote}).length)throw new Error('The sample needs another pass to match your writing preferences.');
  return {text:draft.data.text.trim()+(draft.data.hashtags.length?'\n\n'+draft.data.hashtags.map(h=>'#'+h).join(' '):''),sources:[source.url],title:source.title,testMode:false};
}
export async function generateJob(env:AppEnv,id:string,payload:GenerationJob,step:RunStep) {
  const complete=durableCompletion(completion(env,payload.userId));
  try {
    const context=await step('load-author',async()=>{
      const a=await loadAgent(env.DB,payload.agentId);
      if(!a.row.active||a.row.paused||a.row.revision!==payload.agentRevision)throw new Error('Preparation stopped because settings changed or ByLine was paused.');
      const slot=payload.slotId?await env.DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM post_slots WHERE id=? AND agent_id=?').bind(payload.slotId,payload.agentId).first<SlotRow>():null;
      if(payload.slotId&&(!slot||!slot.enabled||slot.revision!==payload.slotRevision))throw new Error('The posting time changed.');
      const rows=(await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id,fingerprint,text,category,used_quote,status FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND status!='rejected' ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 12").bind(payload.agentId).all<{id:string;fingerprint:string;text:string;category:string|null;used_quote:number;status:string}>()).results;
      return {...a,slot,rows};
    });
    const stage=async(name:string)=>{
      await env.DB.batch([
        env.DB.prepare('UPDATE generation_jobs SET stage=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?').bind(name,new Date().toISOString(),id),
        env.DB.prepare('UPDATE slot_runs SET stage=? WHERE job_id=? AND outcome=\'pending\'').bind(name,id),
      ]);
    };
    await step('stage-discover',()=>stage('discovering'));
    const categories=context.slot&&JSON.parse(context.slot.categories_json).length?JSON.parse(context.slot.categories_json):context.settings.categories;
    const candidates:Candidate[]=await discover(
      (name,result)=>step(`feed-health:${name}`,()=>feedResult(env.DB,name,result)),{categories,maxFetches:24,maxFeeds:12},
      (name,work)=>step(`source:${name}`,work));
    await step('stage-judge',()=>stage('judging'));
    const judged=await step('judge',()=>judgeCandidates(complete,context.persona,categories,candidates,memory,context.rows.map(p=>p.fingerprint)));
    if(!judged.ok)throw new Error(judged.reason);
    const winner=judged.data.scored.find(s=>s.total>=PUBLISH_THRESHOLD);
    if(!winner)throw new Error('No suitable story cleared the relevance checks.');
    await step('stage-write',()=>stage('writing'));
    const priorPosts:PriorPost[]=context.rows.map(r=>({id:r.id,fingerprint:r.fingerprint,opening:r.text.slice(0,210),usedQuote:!!r.used_quote}));
    const draft=await step('write',()=>writePost(complete,{persona:context.persona,style:context.settings.style,winner,repairAttempts:2,
      runnersUp:judged.data.scored.slice(1,3),memory,priorPosts,samples:pickSamples(context.settings.corpus,context.rows.filter(p=>p.status==='published').map(p=>p.text)),editNotes:context.settings.editNotes}));
    if(!draft.ok)throw new Error(draft.reason);
    const violations=critique(draft.data.text,context.settings.style,{hashtags:draft.data.hashtags,usedQuote:draft.data.used_quote,sourceUrl:winner.url});
    if(violations.length){
      console.warn(JSON.stringify({event:'draft_quality_failed',job:id,rules:violations.map(v=>v.rule)}));
      throw new Error('The draft needs another pass to match your writing preferences.');
    }
    await step('stage-save',()=>stage('saving'));
    const seq=await step('save-draft',()=>saveDraft(env.DB,{agentId:payload.agentId,requestId:id,text:draft.data.text.trim(),rationale:draft.data.rationale,
      fingerprint:draft.data.fingerprint,sources:[winner.url],category:winner.category,hashtags:draft.data.hashtags,scores:winner.scores,continuity:draft.data.continuity,
      usedQuote:draft.data.used_quote,slotId:payload.slotId,slotDate:payload.runDate,agentRevision:payload.agentRevision,slotRevision:payload.slotRevision,
      scheduledFor:payload.scheduledFor&&Date.parse(payload.scheduledFor)>Date.now()?payload.scheduledFor:null}));
    await step('settle',async()=>{
      const now=new Date().toISOString();
      const queries=[env.DB.prepare("UPDATE slot_runs SET post_seq=?,generated_at=?,outcome='drafted',stage='ready' WHERE job_id=? AND post_seq IS NULL").bind(seq,now,id),
        env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO notification_outbox(agent_id,payload,dedupe_key) VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`).bind(payload.agentId,JSON.stringify({kind:'draft_ready',seq}),`draft:${payload.agentId}:${seq}`),
        env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO scheduler_state(agent_id,last_run_at,cycle_count) SELECT ?,?,1 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generation_jobs WHERE id=? AND state!='completed') ON CONFLICT(agent_id) DO UPDATE SET last_run_at=excluded.last_run_at,cycle_count=cycle_count+1`).bind(payload.agentId,now,id)];
      if(context.slot)queries.push(env.DB.prepare('UPDATE post_slots SET next_run_at=? WHERE id=? AND revision=?').bind(nextSlotRun(context.settings.timezone,context.slot.local_time,context.slot.days_mask,new Date(Math.max(Date.now(),Date.parse(payload.scheduledFor!))))!.toISOString(),context.slot.id,context.slot.revision));
      queries.push(env.DB.prepare("UPDATE generation_jobs SET state='completed',stage='ready',updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND state!='completed'").bind(now,id));
      await env.DB.batch(queries);
    });
    return {seq};
  } catch(error) {
    const reason=generationError(error);
    await step('record-failure',()=>failJob(env.DB,id,payload.agentId,reason));
    return {error:reason};
  }
}

import { boundedText } from '../../lib/http-body';

export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(public status:number, message:string) { super(message); }
}
export function json(value:unknown, status=200):Response {
  return Response.json(value,{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store','X-Content-Type-Options':'nosniff','Referrer-Policy':'no-referrer'}});
}
export async function body(request:Request):Promise<Record<string,unknown>> {
  try {
    const value:unknown=JSON.parse(await boundedText(request,64*1024));
    if (!value || typeof value!=='object' || Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error();
    return value as Record<string,unknown>;
  } catch { throw new HttpError(400,'Invalid request body.'); }
}
export function text(value:unknown, max:number):string {
  if(typeof value!=='string'||value.length>max)throw new HttpError(400,'Invalid text value.');
  return value.trim();
}
export async function responseJson<T>(response:Response,maxBytes=128*1024):Promise<T> {
  if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`Provider returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
  return JSON.parse(await boundedText(response,maxBytes)) as T;
}

/** D1 transactions use a single atomic batch, never simulated BEGIN/COMMIT. */
export async function provisionIdentity(
  db: D1Database,
  identity: { provider: string; subject: string; name: string },
): Promise<{ userId: string; agentId: string }> {
  if (!['linkedin', 'google'].includes(identity.provider) || !identity.subject || identity.subject.length > 512) {
    throw new Error('Invalid verified identity');
  }
  const name = identity.name.trim().slice(0, 100) || 'ByLine author';
  const userId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const agentId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const persona = JSON.stringify({
    input: { name, domain: 'Your selected topics' },
    identity: { voice: 'Clear and thoughtful. Do not invent personal experiences or opinions.', interests: [], opinions: [], skeptical_of: [] },
    generator: 'fallback',
  });
  const byIdentity = 'SELECT id FROM byline_users WHERE provider=? AND subject=?';
  const args = [identity.provider, identity.subject];
  const result = await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO byline_users(id,provider,subject,name) VALUES(?,?,?,?)
      ON CONFLICT(provider,subject) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name`).bind(userId, ...args, name),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO agents(id,name,domain,persona_json,persona_hash,owner_id,paused,timezone,post_time_local,style_json,categories_json)
      SELECT ?,?,'Your selected topics',?,'byline:' || id,id,1,'UTC','09:00','{"signature":null}','["emerging-tech"]'
      FROM byline_users WHERE provider=? AND subject=?
      ON CONFLICT(owner_id) WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING`).bind(agentId, name, persona, ...args),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO onboarding(user_id) ${byIdentity} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`).bind(...args),
    db.prepare(`SELECT u.id AS userId,a.id AS agentId FROM byline_users u JOIN agents a ON a.owner_id=u.id
      WHERE u.provider=? AND u.subject=?`).bind(...args),
  ]);
  const saved = result[3].results[0] as { userId: string; agentId: string } | undefined;
  if (!saved) throw new Error('Identity provisioning failed');
  return saved;
}

/** Session ownership is resolved server-side; callers cannot select another agent. */
export async function sessionOwner(db: D1Database, userId: string, sessionId: string, now = new Date()) {
  return db.prepare(`SELECT u.id AS userId,a.id AS agentId,u.name FROM byline_sessions s
    JOIN byline_users u ON u.id=s.user_id JOIN agents a ON a.owner_id=u.id
    WHERE s.id=? AND s.user_id=? AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>?`)
    .bind(sessionId, userId, now.toISOString()).first<{ userId: string; agentId: string; name: string }>();
}

import { authenticate,authCallback,nativeAuth,connectLinkedIn } from './auth';
import { json,HttpError } from './http';
import { onboardingRoute } from './onboarding';
import { slotsRoute } from './slots';
import { statusRoute } from './status';
import { settingsRoute,interestsRoute } from './settings';
import { postsRoute,postAction,rewriteRoute } from './posts';
import { devicesRoute } from './notifications';
import { mediaRoute } from './media';
import { deleteAccount } from './delete-account';
import { reviewRoute,cycleRoute } from './scheduler';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
export { ContentWorkflow } from './workflow';
export { MaintenanceWorkflow } from './scheduler';

export default {
  async fetch(request:Request,env:AppEnv):Promise<Response> {
    try {
      const path=new URL(request.url).pathname,method=request.method;
      if(path==='/api/health'&&method==='GET') {
        try {
          await env.DB.prepare('SELECT 1').first();
          if(new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('check')==='scheduler') {
            const heartbeat=await env.DB.prepare("SELECT updated_at FROM system_status WHERE key='cloud_scheduler'").first<{updated_at:string}>();
            const healthy=!!heartbeat&&Date.now()-Date.parse(heartbeat.updated_at)<16*60000;
            return json({ok:healthy,db:'ok',scheduler:{healthy,lastTickAt:heartbeat?.updated_at??null}},healthy?200:503);
          }
          return json({ok:true,db:'ok',service:'byline-cloud'});
        }
        catch{return json({ok:false,db:'unavailable'},503);}
      }
      if(path==='/api/native-auth'&&['GET','POST'].includes(method))return await nativeAuth(request,env);
      if(['/api/linkedin/callback','/api/native-auth/callback'].includes(path)&&method==='GET')return await authCallback(request,env);
      const owner=await authenticate(request,env);
      if(!owner)return json({error:'unauthorized'},401);
      if(path==='/api/auth'&&method==='DELETE') {
        await env.DB.prepare('UPDATE byline_sessions SET revoked_at=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?').bind(new Date().toISOString(),owner.sessionId,owner.userId).run();
        return json({ok:true});
      }
      if(path==='/api/onboarding'&&['GET','POST'].includes(method))return await onboardingRoute(request,env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/status'&&method==='GET')return await statusRoute(env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/settings'&&method==='PATCH')return await settingsRoute(request,env.DB,owner);
      if(path==='/api/interests'&&['GET','POST'].includes(method))return await interestsRoute(request,env.DB,owner);
      if(path==='/api/posts'&&['GET','POST'].includes(method))return await postsRoute(request,env,owner);
      const post=/^\/api\/posts\/([1-9][0-9]{0,8})$/.exec(path);
      if(post&&method==='PATCH')return await postAction(request,env,owner,Number(post[1]));
      if(path==='/api/compose/rewrite'&&method==='POST')return await rewriteRoute(request,env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/style/preview'&&method==='POST')return await rewriteRoute(request,env,owner,true);
      if(path==='/api/review-delivery'&&['GET','POST'].includes(method))return await reviewRoute(request,env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/cycle/run'&&method==='POST')return await cycleRoute(env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/devices'&&['POST','DELETE'].includes(method))return await devicesRoute(request,env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/media'&&method==='POST')return await mediaRoute(request,env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/account/delete'&&method==='POST')return await deleteAccount(request,env.DB,owner);
      if(path==='/api/linkedin/connect'&&method==='GET')return await connectLinkedIn(request,env,owner);
      if(path==='/api/linkedin/disconnect'&&method==='POST') {
        await env.DB.batch([env.DB.prepare('DELETE FROM linkedin_accounts WHERE agent_id=?').bind(owner.agentId),env.DB.prepare('UPDATE agents SET auto_publish=0,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?').bind(owner.agentId)]);
        return json({ok:true});
      }
      if(path==='/api/slots'&&['GET','POST'].includes(method))return await slotsRoute(request,env.DB,owner);
      const slot=/^\/api\/slots\/([a-f0-9-]{36})$/.exec(path);
      if(slot&&['PATCH','DELETE'].includes(method))return await slotsRoute(request,env.DB,owner,slot[1]);
      return json({error:'not_found'},404);
    } catch(error) {
      if(error instanceof HttpError)return json({error:error.message},error.status);
      console.error(JSON.stringify({event:'request_failed',path:new URL(request.url).pathname}));
      return json({error:'The request could not be completed. Please try again.'},500);
    }
  },
  async scheduled(event:ScheduledController,env:AppEnv) {
    const id=`tick-${Math.floor(event.scheduledTime/300000)}`;
    await env.MAINTENANCE.createBatch([{id,params:{cleanup:new Date(event.scheduledTime).getUTCMinutes()===0}}]);
  },
} satisfies ExportedHandler<AppEnv>;

import type { AppEnv } from './env';
import { HttpError } from './http';
import { type SlotRow } from './slots';
export interface GenerationJob {kind:'slot'|'manual';agentId:string;userId:string;agentRevision:number;slotRevision?:number;slotId?:string;runDate?:string;scheduledFor?:string}
/** Persist failure and its notification together; replay cannot duplicate it. */
export async function failJob(db:D1Database,id:string,agentId:string,reason:string) {
  const detail=reason.slice(0,200);
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare("UPDATE generation_jobs SET state='failed',error=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND agent_id=? AND state!='completed'").bind(detail,new Date().toISOString(),id,agentId),
    db.prepare("UPDATE slot_runs SET outcome='failed',detail=?,retry_at=? WHERE job_id=? AND post_seq IS NULL").bind(detail,new Date(Date.now()+10*60000).toISOString(),id),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO notification_outbox(agent_id,payload,dedupe_key)
      SELECT ?,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generation_jobs WHERE id=? AND agent_id=? AND state='failed') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`)
      .bind(agentId,JSON.stringify({kind:'draft_failed',detail}),`generation-failed:${id}`,id,agentId),
  ]);
}
export async function enqueueSlot(db:D1Database,slot:SlotRow,userId:string,agentRevision:number,date:string,scheduledFor:string) {
  const id=crypto.randomUUID(),now=new Date().toISOString();
  const payload:GenerationJob={kind:'slot',agentId:slot.agent_id,userId,agentRevision,slotRevision:slot.revision,slotId:slot.id,runDate:date,scheduledFor};
  const results=await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO slot_runs(slot_id,run_date,scheduled_for,job_id,stage) SELECT ?,?,?,?,'discovering'
      WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agents WHERE id=? AND paused=0 AND active=1 AND revision=?)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_slots WHERE id=? AND enabled=1 AND revision=?)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND slot_id=? AND slot_date=?)
      ON CONFLICT(slot_id,run_date) DO UPDATE SET job_id=excluded.job_id,outcome='pending',stage='discovering',detail=NULL,attempts=attempts+1,retry_at=?
      WHERE post_seq IS NULL AND attempts<3 AND retry_at<? AND (outcome!='pending' OR retry_at<?)`)
      .bind(slot.id,date,scheduledFor,id,slot.agent_id,agentRevision,slot.id,slot.revision,slot.agent_id,slot.id,date,now,now,new Date(Date.now()-20*60000).toISOString()),
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO generation_jobs(id,agent_id,payload) SELECT ?,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM slot_runs WHERE slot_id=? AND run_date=? AND job_id=?)`)

/** The database outbox survives a failed Workflow create; the next cloud tick retries it. */
export async function dispatchJobs(env:AppEnv) {
  const jobs=(await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id,payload FROM generation_jobs WHERE state='queued' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10").all<{id:string;payload:string}>()).results;
  for(const job of jobs) {
    try {
      // createBatch ignores IDs that already exist, including after a lost acknowledgement.
      const created=await env.CONTENT.createBatch([{id:job.id,params:JSON.parse(job.payload) as GenerationJob}]);
      if(!created.length)await (await env.CONTENT.get(job.id)).status();
      await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE generation_jobs SET state='working',updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND state='queued'").bind(new Date().toISOString(),job.id).run();
    }catch {console.warn(JSON.stringify({event:'generation_dispatch_failed',job:job.id}));}
  }
}

/** A runtime failure can prevent the workflow's catch block from recording its outcome. */
export async function reconcileJobs(env:AppEnv) {
  const stale=(await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id,agent_id FROM generation_jobs WHERE state='working' AND updated_at<? ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 5")
    .bind(new Date(Date.now()-5*60000).toISOString()).all<{id:string;agent_id:string}>()).results;
  for(const job of stale) {
    try {
      const state=await (await env.CONTENT.get(job.id)).status();
      if(!['errored','terminated','complete'].includes(state.status))continue;
      const saved=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT seq,created_at,status FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND client_request_id=?').bind(job.agent_id,job.id).first<{seq:number;created_at:string;status:string}>();
      if(saved) {
        await env.DB.batch([
          env.DB.prepare("UPDATE generation_jobs SET state='completed',stage='ready',error=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND state='working'").bind(new Date().toISOString(),job.id),
          env.DB.prepare('UPDATE slot_runs SET post_seq=?,generated_at=?,outcome=?,stage=\'ready\' WHERE job_id=? AND post_seq IS NULL').bind(saved.seq,saved.created_at,saved.status==='published'?'published':'drafted',job.id),
          env.DB.prepare('INSERT INTO notification_outbox(agent_id,payload,dedupe_key) VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING').bind(job.agent_id,JSON.stringify({kind:'draft_ready',seq:saved.seq}),`draft:${job.agent_id}:${saved.seq}`),
        ]);
        continue;
      }
      const reason='Background preparation stopped before completion. Please prepare the draft again.';
      await failJob(env.DB,job.id,job.agent_id,reason);
    }catch {console.warn(JSON.stringify({event:'generation_reconcile_deferred',job:job.id}));}
  }
}

import { initializeImageUpload,uploadImageBytes } from '../../lib/linkedin';
import { usableToken } from './publish';
import { HttpError,json } from './http';
import type { Owner } from './auth';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
export async function mediaRoute(request:Request,env:AppEnv,owner:Owner) {
  const max=4*1024*1024+65536;
  if(!request.body)throw new HttpError(400,'Choose an image.');
  const reader=request.body.getReader(),chunks:Uint8Array[]=[],headers=new Headers(request.headers);let count=0;
  try {while(true){const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;count+=value.byteLength;if(count>max){await reader.cancel();throw new HttpError(413,'Use an image smaller than 4 MB.');}chunks.push(value);}}finally{reader.releaseLock();}
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(count);let offset=0;for(const c of chunks){bytes.set(c,offset);offset+=c.length;}
  const form=await new Response(bytes,{headers}).formData(),file=form.get('file');
  if(!(file instanceof File)||file.size>4*1024*1024||!['image/jpeg','image/png','image/gif'].includes(file.type))throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a JPG, PNG or GIF smaller than 4 MB.');
  const token=await usableToken(env,owner.agentId),registered=await initializeImageUpload(token.token,token.memberUrn);
  if(!registered.ok)throw new HttpError(502,'LinkedIn could not start the image upload.');
  const altText=String(form.get('altText')??'').slice(0,300),id=crypto.randomUUID();
  await env.DB.prepare('INSERT INTO media_assets(id,agent_id,linkedin_urn,upload_url,alt_text,filename) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)').bind(id,owner.agentId,registered.data.imageUrn,registered.data.uploadUrl,altText,file.name.slice(0,255)).run();
  const uploaded=await uploadImageBytes(token.token,registered.data.uploadUrl,await file.arrayBuffer(),file.type);
  await env.DB.prepare('UPDATE media_assets SET status=? WHERE id=? AND agent_id=?').bind(uploaded.ok?'uploaded':'failed',id,owner.agentId).run();
  if(!uploaded.ok)throw new HttpError(502,'The image upload did not finish. Please try again.');
  return json({ok:true,id,imageUrn:registered.data.imageUrn,altText});
}

import { body,json,HttpError,responseJson } from './http';
import { boundedText } from '../../lib/http-body';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
import type { Owner } from './auth';
const b64=(s:string|Uint8Array)=>btoa(typeof s==='string'?s:Array.from(s,b=>String.fromCharCode(b)).join('')).replaceAll('+','-').replaceAll('/','_').replaceAll('=','');
interface ServiceAccount {project_id:string;client_email:string;private_key:string}
async function pushCredentials(env:AppEnv) {
  if(!env.FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON)return null;
  const account=JSON.parse(env.FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON) as ServiceAccount;
  const now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000),payload=`${b64(JSON.stringify({alg:'RS256',typ:'JWT'}))}.${b64(JSON.stringify({iss:account.client_email,scope:'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/firebase.messaging',aud:'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',iat:now,exp:now+3600}))}`;
  const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(account.private_key.replace(/-----[^-]+-----/g,'').replace(/\s/g,'')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
  const key=await crypto.subtle.importKey('pkcs8',bytes,{name:'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',hash:'SHA-256'},false,['sign']);
  const sig=new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',key,new TextEncoder().encode(payload)));
  const result=await responseJson<{access_token:string}>(await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',{
    method:'POST',body:new URLSearchParams({grant_type:'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',assertion:`${payload}.${b64(sig)}`}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)}));
  return {project:account.project_id,token:result.access_token};
}
export interface Notice {kind:string;seq?:number;detail?:string}
function notification(n:Notice) {
  if(n.kind==='draft_ready')return {title:'A draft is ready to read',body:`Your draft${n.seq?` #${n.seq}`:''} is ready for review.`};
  if(n.kind==='published')return {title:'Posted to LinkedIn',body:`Post #${n.seq} went out.`};
  if(n.kind==='token_expiring')return {title:'Reconnect LinkedIn',body:'Your LinkedIn connection is expiring. Open ByLine to reconnect.'};
  if(n.kind==='test')return {title:'Notifications are working',body:'ByLine can now notify this device.'};
  if(n.kind==='draft_failed')return {title:'Your draft needs attention',body:n.detail??'Preparation could not finish. Open ByLine to try again.'};
  return {title:'ByLine needs your attention',body:n.detail??'Open ByLine to review the latest status.'};
}
export async function notify(env:AppEnv,agentId:string,event:Notice,target?:string) {
  const devices=(await env.DB.prepare('SELECT token FROM device_tokens WHERE agent_id=? AND (? IS NULL OR token=?) LIMIT 10').bind(agentId,target??null,target??null).all<{token:string}>()).results;
  if(!devices.length)return 0;
  const auth=await pushCredentials(env);if(!auth)return 0;
  let delivered=0;
  for(const {token} of devices) {
    try {
      const response=await fetch(`https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${encodeURIComponent(auth.project)}/messages:send`,{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${auth.token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000),
        body:JSON.stringify({message:{token,notification:notification(event),data:{kind:event.kind,tab:'queue',...(event.seq?{seq:String(event.seq)}:{})},
          android:{priority:'HIGH',collapse_key:`byline-${event.kind}-${event.seq??''}`,notification:{channel_id:event.kind==='draft_ready'?'linkdin_updates':'linkdin_alerts',tag:`byline-${event.kind}-${event.seq??''}`}}}})});
      if(response.ok){delivered++;await response.body?.cancel();}
      else {
        const failure=await boundedText(response,16384);
        if(response.status===404&&failure.includes('UNREGISTERED'))await env.DB.prepare('DELETE FROM device_tokens WHERE agent_id=? AND token=?').bind(agentId,token).run();
      }
    }catch { /* The durable outbox retries later. Never log tokens. */ }
  }
  return delivered;
}
export async function devicesRoute(request:Request,env:AppEnv,owner:Owner) {
  // Older Android releases send DELETE's token in the query string.
  const b=request.method==='DELETE'&&!request.body
    ?{token:new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('token')}:await body(request);
  if(request.method==='DELETE') {
    if(typeof b.token==='string')await env.DB.prepare('DELETE FROM device_tokens WHERE token=? AND agent_id=?').bind(b.token,owner.agentId).run();
    return json({ok:true});
  }
  if(b.action==='test') {
    const delivered=await notify(env,owner.agentId,{kind:'test'},typeof b.token==='string'?b.token:undefined);
    return json(delivered?{ok:true,delivered}:{error:'No notification could be delivered. Enable notifications on this device first.'},delivered?200:503);
  }
  if(typeof b.token!=='string'||b.token.length<20||b.token.length>4096)throw new HttpError(400,'Invalid notification token.');
  const platform=typeof b.platform==='string'?b.platform.slice(0,30):'android';
  await env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO device_tokens(token,agent_id,platform) VALUES(?,?,?)
    ON CONFLICT(token) DO UPDATE SET agent_id=excluded.agent_id,platform=excluded.platform,last_seen_at=?`).bind(b.token,owner.agentId,platform,new Date().toISOString()).run();
  return json({ok:true,configured:!!env.FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON});
}
export async function drainNotifications(env:AppEnv,dedupeKey?:string) {
  if(!env.FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON)return;
  // Claim with a future retry time so concurrent ticks do not immediately resend.
  const rows=await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE notification_outbox SET attempts=attempts+1,retry_at=? WHERE id IN
    (SELECT id FROM notification_outbox WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND retry_at<=? AND attempts<5 AND (? IS NULL OR dedupe_key=?) ORDER BY id LIMIT 3) RETURNING id,agent_id,payload`)
    .bind(new Date(Date.now()+10*60000).toISOString(),new Date().toISOString(),dedupeKey??null,dedupeKey??null).all<{id:number;agent_id:string;payload:string}>();
  for(const row of rows.results)if(await notify(env,row.agent_id,JSON.parse(row.payload)))await env.DB.prepare('UPDATE notification_outbox SET delivered_at=? WHERE id=?').bind(new Date().toISOString(),row.id).run();
}

import { INDUSTRIES,VOICES,defaultSetup,parseSetup,setupCategories,setupPersona,setupStyle,firstDelivery } from '../../lib/setup-config';
import { ALL_CATEGORY_IDS,CATEGORIES,describeCategories } from '../../lib/categories';
import { localClock } from '../../lib/schedule';
import { accountStatus } from './models';
import { generatePreview } from './generation';
import { body,json,HttpError } from './http';
import type { Owner } from './auth';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
import { generationError } from './generation-errors';
interface SetupRow {config:string;revision:number;preview:string|null;preview_revision:number|null;accepted_revision:number|null;completed_at:string|null;next_delivery_at:string|null;generating_until:string|null}
export async function setupStatus(db:D1Database,owner:Owner) {
  const row=await db.prepare('SELECT config,revision,preview,preview_revision,accepted_revision,completed_at,next_delivery_at,generating_until FROM onboarding WHERE user_id=?').bind(owner.userId).first<SetupRow>();
  if(!row)throw new HttpError(409,'Setup is unavailable. Sign in again.');
  const config={...defaultSetup,...JSON.parse(row.config)};
  const next=row.completed_at?(await db.prepare('SELECT min(next_run_at) AS at FROM post_slots WHERE agent_id=? AND enabled=1').bind(owner.agentId).first<{at:string|null}>())?.at??null:row.next_delivery_at;
  return {...row,config,preview:row.preview?JSON.parse(row.preview):null,next_delivery_at:next,
    nextDeliveryLabel:next?`${localClock(config.timezone,new Date(next)).date} at ${config.time} (${config.timezone})`:null,
    account:await accountStatus(db,owner.agentId),industries:INDUSTRIES,voices:VOICES,categories:ALL_CATEGORY_IDS.map(id=>CATEGORIES[id]),testMode:false};
}
export async function onboardingRoute(request:Request,env:AppEnv,owner:Owner) {
  if(request.method==='GET')return json(await setupStatus(env.DB,owner));
  const b=await body(request),current=await setupStatus(env.DB,owner);
  if(current.completed_at)return json(current);
  if(typeof b.revision!=='number'||!Number.isInteger(b.revision))throw new HttpError(400,'Reload setup and try again.');
  if(b.action==='save') {
    const config=parseSetup(b.config);
    const row=await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE onboarding SET config=?,revision=revision+1,preview=NULL,preview_revision=NULL,accepted_revision=NULL
      WHERE user_id=? AND revision=? AND completed_at IS NULL RETURNING user_id`).bind(JSON.stringify(config),owner.userId,b.revision).first();
    if(!row)throw new HttpError(409,'Setup changed on another device. Reload and try again.');
  }else if(b.action==='preview') {
    const config=parseSetup(current.config),lease=crypto.randomUUID(),now=new Date(),day=now.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    const acquired=await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE onboarding SET preview_lease=?,generating_until=?,preview_attempts=CASE WHEN attempts_day=? THEN preview_attempts+1 ELSE 1 END,attempts_day=?
      WHERE user_id=? AND revision=? AND completed_at IS NULL AND (generating_until IS NULL OR generating_until<?)
      AND (attempts_day!=? OR preview_attempts<10) RETURNING revision`)
      .bind(lease,new Date(now.getTime()+3*60000).toISOString(),day,day,owner.userId,b.revision,now.toISOString(),day).first();
    if(!acquired)throw new HttpError(409,'A sample is running, settings changed, or today’s sample allowance was reached.');
    try {
      const sample=await generatePreview(env,owner.userId,owner.name,config);
      await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE onboarding SET preview=?,preview_revision=?,accepted_revision=NULL WHERE user_id=? AND revision=? AND preview_lease=? AND completed_at IS NULL`)
        .bind(JSON.stringify(sample),b.revision,owner.userId,b.revision,lease).run();
    }catch(error){throw new HttpError(503,generationError(error));}
    finally {await env.DB.prepare('UPDATE onboarding SET generating_until=NULL,preview_lease=NULL WHERE user_id=? AND preview_lease=?').bind(owner.userId,lease).run();}
  }else if(b.action==='accept') {
    const accepted=await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE onboarding SET accepted_revision=revision WHERE user_id=? AND revision=? AND preview_revision=revision AND preview IS NOT NULL AND generating_until IS NULL RETURNING user_id`).bind(owner.userId,b.revision).first();
    if(!accepted)throw new HttpError(409,'Generate and review a sample for your current voice first.');
  }else if(b.action==='finish') {
    const config=parseSetup({...current.config,time:b.time,timezone:b.timezone,notifications:b.notifications});
    const categories=setupCategories(config),nonce=crypto.randomUUID(),now=new Date().toISOString();
    const next=firstDelivery(config).toISOString();
    const gate='EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM onboarding WHERE user_id=? AND finish_token=?)';
    const done=await env.DB.batch([
      env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE onboarding SET completed_at=?,config=?,timetable_migrated=1,next_delivery_at=NULL,finish_token=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND revision=? AND accepted_revision=revision AND preview_revision=revision AND generating_until IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM linkedin_accounts WHERE agent_id=? AND expires_at>?) RETURNING user_id`)
        .bind(now,JSON.stringify(config),nonce,owner.userId,b.revision,owner.agentId,now),
      env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE agents SET paused=0,domain=?,categories_json=?,style_json=?,corpus_json=?,persona_json=?,timezone=?,post_time_local=?,revision=revision+1
        WHERE id=? AND ${gate}`).bind(describeCategories(categories),JSON.stringify(categories),JSON.stringify(setupStyle(config)),JSON.stringify(config.samples),JSON.stringify(setupPersona(config,owner.name)),config.timezone,config.time,owner.agentId,owner.userId,nonce),
      env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO post_slots(agent_id,local_time,days_mask,lead_minutes,auto_publish,next_run_at) SELECT ?,?,127,15,0,? WHERE ${gate}`)
        .bind(owner.agentId,config.time,next,owner.userId,nonce),
    ]);
    if(!done[0].meta.changes)throw new HttpError(409,'Accept the latest sample and connect LinkedIn before finishing.');
  }else throw new HttpError(400,'Unknown setup action.');
  return json(await setupStatus(env.DB,owner));
}

import { assemblePost,checkLength,MAX_BODY_CHARS,hookOf } from '../../lib/format';
import { rewriteDraft,writeFollowUp,polishCustomPost } from '../../lib/writer-core';
import { parseStyle } from '../../lib/style';

import { critique } from '../../lib/critique';
import { isCategoryId } from '../../lib/categories';
import { body,json,text,HttpError } from './http';
import { loadAgent,postView,type CloudPost } from './models';

import { completion } from './ai';

export function tags(value:unknown) {
  if(value===undefined)return [];
  if(!Array.isArray(value)||value.length>15||value.some(t=>typeof t!=='string'||!/^#?[A-Za-z0-9]{3,40}$/.test(t)))throw new HttpError(400,'Use up to 15 alphanumeric hashtags.');
  return [...new Set(value.map(t=>t.replace(/^#/,'')))];
}
function reviewed(value:unknown):Reviewed|undefined {
  if(value===undefined)return undefined;
  if(!value||typeof value!=='object'||!('text'in value)||typeof value.text!=='string'||!('hashtags'in value)||!Array.isArray(value.hashtags)||!('media'in value)||!Array.isArray(value.media))throw new HttpError(400,'Invalid review.');
  return {text:value.text,hashtags:tags(value.hashtags),media:value.media};
}
function future(value:unknown):string|null {
  if(value==null)return null;
  if(typeof value!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value))||Date.parse(value)<=Date.now())throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a send time in the future.');
  return new Date(value).toISOString();
}

  const {settings:agent,persona}=await loadAgent(db,id);
  const published=(await db.prepare("SELECT text FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND status='published' ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 3").bind(id).all<{text:string}>()).results;
  return {agent,persona,voice:{samples:pickSamples(agent.corpus,published.map(p=>p.text)),editNotes:agent.editNotes}};
}
export async function postsRoute(request:Request,env:AppEnv,owner:Owner) {
  if(request.method==='GET') {
    const cursor=new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('before'),before=cursor===null?null:Number(cursor);
    if(before!==null&&(!Number.isInteger(before)||before<1))throw new HttpError(400,'Invalid archive cursor.');
    const rows=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND status='published' AND (? IS NULL OR
      (published_at,seq)<(SELECT published_at,seq FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=?)) ORDER BY published_at DESC,seq DESC LIMIT 21`)
      .bind(owner.agentId,before,owner.agentId,before).all<CloudPost>()).results;
    return json({posts:rows.slice(0,20).map(postView),hasMore:rows.length>20});
  }
  const b=await body(request);
  let value=text(b.text,MAX_BODY_CHARS);
  if(value.length<20)throw new HttpError(400,'Write at least 20 characters.');
  const requestId=b.clientRequestId===undefined?crypto.randomUUID():text(b.clientRequestId,100);
  if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,100}$/.test(requestId))throw new HttpError(400,'Invalid request identifier.');

  }
  const media=b.mediaIds??[];await ownedImages(env.DB,owner.agentId,media);
  if(!checkLength(assemblePost({body:value,hashtags,maxHashtags:15})).withinLimit)throw new HttpError(400,'The post exceeds LinkedIn’s text limit.');
  const at=b.publishNow?null:future(b.scheduledFor);
  const seq=await saveDraft(env.DB,{agentId:owner.agentId,requestId,text:value,rationale:polishedBy?'Written by you and polished with AI.':'Written by you.',fingerprint:value.slice(0,100),sources:[],hashtags,media:media as string[],scheduledFor:at,cleared:!!at,category:isCategoryId(b.category)?b.category:undefined});
  const saved=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT text,hashtags_json,media_json FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=?').bind(owner.agentId,seq).first<{text:string;hashtags_json:string;media_json:string}>();
  if(saved!.text!==value||saved!.hashtags_json!==JSON.stringify(hashtags)||saved!.media_json!==JSON.stringify(media))return json({error:'Your earlier save succeeded. Review the saved draft before changing it.',seq},409);

}
export async function postAction(request:Request,env:AppEnv,owner:Owner,seq:number) {
  const b=await body(request),post=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=?').bind(owner.agentId,seq).first<CloudPost>();
  if(!post)throw new HttpError(404,'Post not found.');
  if(b.action==='publish'){const r=await publish(env,owner.agentId,seq,'manual',reviewed(b.reviewed));return json(r,r.ok?200:502);}
  if(b.action==='resolve') {
    if(typeof b.didPublish!=='boolean')throw new HttpError(400,'Confirm whether the post appeared on LinkedIn.');
    return json(await resolveSend(env.DB,owner.agentId,seq,b.didPublish));
  }
  if(b.action==='rewrite'||b.action==='followup') {
    if((b.action==='rewrite'&&post.status==='published')||(b.action==='followup'&&post.status!=='published'))throw new HttpError(409,'This action does not apply to the current post.');
    if(post.status==='unknown'||await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=? AND status IN ('in_flight','unknown')").bind(owner.agentId,seq).first())throw new HttpError(409,'Resolve the pending send before changing this post.');
    const c=await voiceContext(env.DB,owner.agentId),complete=completion(env,owner.userId);
    const r=b.action==='rewrite'?await rewriteDraft(complete,c.persona,post.text,c.agent.style,Number.isInteger(b.variant)?Math.abs(Number(b.variant))%4:0,c.voice)
      :await writeFollowUp(complete,c.persona,{text:post.text,publishedAt:post.published_at},c.agent.style,c.voice);
    if(!r.ok)throw new HttpError(503,'The writer is unavailable. Your original post is saved.');
    return json({ok:true,...r.data});
  }
  let set:string,args:unknown[]=[];
  if(b.action==='edit') {
    const value=text(b.text,MAX_BODY_CHARS),hashtags=tags(b.hashtags),media=b.mediaIds??JSON.parse(post.media_json??'[]');
    if(value.length<20)throw new HttpError(400,'Write at least 20 characters.');
    await ownedImages(env.DB,owner.agentId,media);
    if(!checkLength(assemblePost({body:value,hashtags,maxHashtags:15,sourceUrl:(media as string[]).length?undefined:JSON.parse(post.sources_json??'[]')[0]})).withinLimit)throw new HttpError(400,'The post exceeds LinkedIn’s text limit.');
    set="original_text=COALESCE(original_text,text),text=?,hashtags_json=?,media_json=?,status='draft',cleared_at=NULL";args=[value,JSON.stringify(hashtags),JSON.stringify(media)];
  }else if(b.action==='clear') {
    if(!post.scheduled_for)throw new HttpError(409,'Choose a send time or publish manually.');
    const r=reviewed(b.reviewed);
    if(r&&(r.text!==post.text||JSON.stringify(r.hashtags)!==post.hashtags_json||JSON.stringify(r.media)!==post.media_json))throw new HttpError(409,'The post changed. Refresh and review it again.');
    set="cleared_at=?,hold_until=NULL,status='approved'";args=[new Date().toISOString()];
  }else if(b.action==='unclear')set="cleared_at=NULL,status='draft'";
  else if(b.action==='hold'){set='hold_until=?';args=[new Date(Date.now()+15*60000).toISOString()];}
  else if(b.action==='release')set='hold_until=NULL';
  else if(b.action==='reschedule'){set="scheduled_for=?,cleared_at=NULL,status='draft'";args=[future(b.scheduledFor)];}
  else if(b.action==='discard')set="status='rejected',cleared_at=NULL,scheduled_for=NULL";
  else throw new HttpError(400,'Unknown post action.');
  // The condition and mutation are one statement: a publish cannot start between a check and an edit.
  const updated=await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE posts SET ${set} WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=? AND status IN ('draft','approved','failed','missed')
    AND text=? AND hashtags_json=? AND media_json=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM distributions d WHERE d.agent_id=posts.agent_id AND d.seq=posts.seq AND d.status IN ('in_flight','sent','unknown')) RETURNING seq`)
    .bind(...args,owner.agentId,seq,post.text,post.hashtags_json,post.media_json).first();
  if(!updated)throw new HttpError(409,'This post changed or a send has started. Refresh to see its latest state.');
  return json({ok:true,scheduledFor:b.action==='reschedule'?args[0]:post.scheduled_for,holdMinutes:15});
}
export async function rewriteRoute(request:Request,env:AppEnv,owner:Owner,preview=false) {
  const b=await body(request),c=await voiceContext(env.DB,owner.agentId);
  let value=typeof b.text==='string'?text(b.text,MAX_BODY_CHARS):'';
  let sourceLabel='your draft';
  if(preview&&!value) {
    const last=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT text FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1').bind(owner.agentId).first<{text:string}>();
    const setup=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT json_extract(preview,\'$.text\') AS text FROM onboarding WHERE user_id=? AND accepted_revision=preview_revision').bind(owner.userId).first<{text:string|null}>();
    value=last?.text??setup?.text??c.voice.samples[0]?.text??'';sourceLabel=last?'your latest post':setup?.text?'your reviewed setup sample':'your writing sample';
  }
  if(value.length<20)throw new HttpError(400,'Add a draft or writing sample first.');
  const style=preview?parseStyle({...c.agent.style,...(b.style&&typeof b.style==='object'?b.style:{})}):c.agent.style;
  const complete=completion(env,owner.userId),r=preview?await polishCustomPost(complete,c.persona,value,style,c.voice):await rewriteDraft(complete,c.persona,value,style,Number.isInteger(b.variant)?Math.abs(Number(b.variant))%4:0,c.voice);
  if(!r.ok)throw new HttpError(503,'The writer is temporarily unavailable. Your original text is saved.');
  const after=assemblePost({body:r.data.text,hashtags:r.data.hashtags,maxHashtags:style.hashtagCount});
  if(preview)return json({ok:true,sourceLabel,before:value,after,hook:hookOf(after),length:checkLength(after),style,servedBy:r.data.servedBy});
  return json({ok:true,...r.data});
}

import { createPost,postPermalink,type PostImage } from '../../lib/linkedin';
import { assemblePost,checkLength } from '../../lib/format';
import { localClock } from '../../lib/schedule';
import { decryptToken } from './crypto';
import { HttpError } from './http';
import { loadAgent,type CloudPost } from './models';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
export type Reviewed={text:string;hashtags:string[];media:string[]};
export async function usableToken(env:AppEnv,agentId:string) {
  const account=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT member_urn,access_token_enc,expires_at FROM linkedin_accounts WHERE agent_id=?').bind(agentId).first<{member_urn:string;access_token_enc:string;expires_at:string}>();
  if(!account||Date.parse(account.expires_at)<=Date.now()+60000)throw new HttpError(409,'Reconnect LinkedIn before publishing.');
  return {token:await decryptToken(env.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY,account.access_token_enc),memberUrn:account.member_urn};
}
export async function ownedImages(db:D1Database,agentId:string,ids:unknown):Promise<PostImage[]> {
  if(!Array.isArray(ids)||ids.length>20||ids.some(id=>typeof id!=='string')||new Set(ids).size!==ids.length)throw new HttpError(400,'Invalid images.');
  if(!ids.length)return [];
  const rows=(await db.prepare(`SELECT id,linkedin_urn,alt_text FROM media_assets WHERE agent_id=? AND status='uploaded' AND id IN (${ids.map(()=>'?').join(',')})`).bind(agentId,...ids).all<{id:string;linkedin_urn:string;alt_text:string|null}>()).results;
  if(rows.length!==ids.length)throw new HttpError(400,'An image is unavailable or belongs to another account.');
  return ids.map(id=>{const row=rows.find(r=>r.id===id)!;return {imageUrn:row.linkedin_urn,altText:row.alt_text??undefined};});
}
export async function publish(env:AppEnv,agentId:string,seq:number,source:'manual'|'auto'='manual',reviewed?:Reviewed) {
  if(env.LINKEDIN_LIVE!=='true')throw new HttpError(409,'LinkedIn publishing has not been enabled on this deployment.');
  const {settings:agent}=await loadAgent(env.DB,agentId);
  const post=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=?').bind(agentId,seq).first<CloudPost>();
  if(!post)throw new HttpError(404,'Post not found.');
  const hashtags=JSON.parse(post.hashtags_json??'[]'),media=JSON.parse(post.media_json??'[]');
  if(reviewed&&(reviewed.text!==post.text||JSON.stringify(reviewed.hashtags)!==JSON.stringify(hashtags)||JSON.stringify(reviewed.media)!==JSON.stringify(media)))throw new HttpError(409,'This post changed. Refresh and review it again.');
  const credentials=await usableToken(env,agentId),images=await ownedImages(env.DB,agentId,media);
  const text=assemblePost({body:post.text,hashtags,maxHashtags:15,sourceUrl:media.length?undefined:JSON.parse(post.sources_json??'[]')[0]});
  if(!checkLength(text).withinLimit)throw new HttpError(400,'This post exceeds LinkedIn’s text limit.');
  const now=new Date().toISOString(),day=localClock(agent.timezone).date,key=`linkedin:${agentId}:${seq}`;
  const eligible=`p.status IN ('draft','approved','failed','missed') AND p.text=? AND p.hashtags_json=? AND p.media_json=? AND a.active=1
    AND (?='manual' OR (a.paused=0 AND p.scheduled_for<=? AND p.scheduled_for>=?
      AND (p.hold_until IS NULL OR p.hold_until<=?) AND (p.cleared_at IS NOT NULL OR (a.auto_publish=1 AND s.auto_publish=1 AND s.enabled=1))))`;
  const claim=await env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO distributions(agent_id,seq,idempotency_key,source,send_day,status,attempts)
    SELECT p.agent_id,p.seq,?,?,?,'in_flight',1 FROM posts p JOIN agents a ON a.id=p.agent_id LEFT JOIN post_slots s ON s.id=p.slot_id
    WHERE p.agent_id=? AND p.seq=? AND ${eligible}
      AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempts),0) FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=? AND source=? AND send_day=?)<?
    ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET status='in_flight',attempts=attempts+1,last_error=NULL,created_at=?,settled_at=NULL,source=excluded.source,send_day=excluded.send_day
      WHERE distributions.status='failed' RETURNING id`)
    .bind(key,source,day,agentId,seq,post.text,post.hashtags_json,post.media_json,source,now,new Date(Date.now()-45*60000).toISOString(),now,
      agentId,source,day,source==='manual'?40:Math.min(5,Math.max(1,agent.autoPublishCap)),now).first<{id:number}>();
  if(!claim)throw new HttpError(409,'This post is already being sent, needs review, or has reached its daily send allowance.');
  // From this point any exception is ambiguous. The permanent claim prevents an automatic resend.
  let result:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createPost>>;
  try {
    await env.DB.prepare('UPDATE posts SET linkedin_text=? WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=?').bind(text,agentId,seq).run();
    result=await createPost({token:credentials.token,authorUrn:credentials.memberUrn,text,images});
  }catch {result={ok:false,reason:'send_outcome_unknown'};}
  const sentAt=new Date().toISOString();
  if(result.ok) {
    await env.DB.batch([
      env.DB.prepare("UPDATE distributions SET status='sent',external_urn=?,settled_at=? WHERE id=?").bind(result.data.postUrn,sentAt,claim.id),
      env.DB.prepare("UPDATE posts SET status='published',published_at=?,hold_until=NULL WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=?").bind(sentAt,agentId,seq),
      env.DB.prepare('UPDATE linkedin_accounts SET last_ok_at=?,last_error=NULL WHERE agent_id=?').bind(sentAt,agentId),
      env.DB.prepare("UPDATE slot_runs SET outcome='published' WHERE post_seq=? AND slot_id IN (SELECT id FROM post_slots WHERE agent_id=?)").bind(seq,agentId),
    ]);
    return {ok:true,postUrn:result.data.postUrn,permalink:postPermalink(result.data.postUrn)};
  }
  const definite=!!result.status&&result.status>=400&&result.status<500;
  const reason=definite?`LinkedIn rejected the request (HTTP ${result.status}).`:'The send outcome is unknown. Check LinkedIn before trying again.';
  await env.DB.batch([
    env.DB.prepare('UPDATE distributions SET status=?,last_error=?,settled_at=? WHERE id=?').bind(definite?'failed':'unknown',reason,sentAt,claim.id),
    env.DB.prepare('UPDATE posts SET status=?,cleared_at=NULL WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=?').bind(definite?'failed':'unknown',agentId,seq),
    env.DB.prepare('UPDATE linkedin_accounts SET last_error=? WHERE agent_id=?').bind(reason,agentId),
  ]);
  return {ok:false,error:reason,ambiguous:!definite,needsReauth:result.status===401};
}
export async function resolveSend(db:D1Database,agentId:string,seq:number,didPublish:boolean) {
  const nonce=crypto.randomUUID();
  const changed=await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`UPDATE distributions SET status=?,settled_at=?,last_error=NULL,resolution_token=? WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=? AND
      (status='unknown' OR (status='in_flight' AND created_at<?)) RETURNING id`)
      .bind(didPublish?'sent':'failed',new Date().toISOString(),nonce,agentId,seq,new Date(Date.now()-10*60000).toISOString()),
    db.prepare(`UPDATE posts SET status=?,published_at=?,cleared_at=NULL WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=? AND status!='published'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=? AND seq=? AND resolution_token=?)`)
      .bind(didPublish?'published':'draft',didPublish?new Date().toISOString():null,agentId,seq,agentId,seq,nonce),
  ]);
  if(!changed[0].meta.changes)throw new HttpError(409,'There is no unresolved send to confirm yet.');
  return {ok:true};
}
