````text
import { WorkflowEntrypoint,type WorkflowEvent,type WorkflowStep } from 'cloudflare:workers';
import { localClock,nextSlotRun } from '../../lib/schedule';
import { dispatchJobs,enqueueSlot,enqueueManual,reconcileJobs } from './jobs';
import { publish } from './publish';
import { drainNotifications } from './notifications';
import { listSlots,timetable,type SlotRow } from './slots';
import { loadAgent } from './models';
import { body,HttpError,json } from './http';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
import type { Owner } from './auth';

export async function scanSchedule(env:AppEnv) {
  const at=new Date(),now=at.toISOString();
  const due=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT s.*,a.owner_id,a.timezone,a.revision AS agent_revision FROM post_slots s JOIN agents a ON a.id=s.agent_id
    WHERE s.enabled=1 AND a.active=1 AND a.paused=0 AND s.next_run_at<=?
      AND s.next_run_at<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',?,printf('+%d minutes',s.lead_minutes+8))
    ORDER BY s.next_run_at LIMIT 5`).bind(new Date(at.getTime()+728*60000).toISOString(),now).all<SlotRow&{owner_id:string;timezone:string;agent_revision:number}>()).results;
  for(const slot of due) {
    const date=localClock(slot.timezone,new Date(slot.next_run_at!)).date;
    const run=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT attempts,post_seq FROM slot_runs WHERE slot_id=? AND run_date=?').bind(slot.id,date).first<{attempts:number;post_seq:number|null}>();
    if(Date.parse(slot.next_run_at!)<at.getTime()-45*60000||(run&&((run.post_seq!==null)||run.attempts>=3))) {
      await env.DB.batch([
        env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO slot_runs(slot_id,run_date,scheduled_for,outcome,detail) VALUES(?,?,?,'missed','This occurrence could not be prepared in time.') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`).bind(slot.id,date,slot.next_run_at),
        env.DB.prepare('UPDATE post_slots SET next_run_at=? WHERE id=? AND revision=? AND next_run_at=?').bind(nextSlotRun(slot.timezone,slot.local_time,slot.days_mask,at)!.toISOString(),slot.id,slot.revision,slot.next_run_at),
      ]);
    }else await enqueueSlot(env.DB,slot,slot.owner_id,slot.agent_revision,date,slot.next_run_at!);
  }
  await env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO system_status(key,value,updated_at) VALUES('cloud_scheduler','{}',?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=excluded.updated_at`).bind(now).run();
}
export async function publishDue(env:AppEnv) {
  if(env.LINKEDIN_LIVE!=='true')return;
  const now=new Date().toISOString(),late=new Date(Date.now()-45*60000).toISOString();
  await env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE posts SET status='missed',cleared_at=NULL WHERE scheduled_for<? AND status IN ('draft','approved','failed')
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM distributions d WHERE d.agent_id=posts.agent_id AND d.seq=posts.seq AND d.status IN ('sent','in_flight','unknown'))`).bind(late).run();
  const due=(await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT p.agent_id,p.seq FROM posts p JOIN agents a ON a.id=p.agent_id LEFT JOIN post_slots s ON s.id=p.slot_id
    WHERE a.active=1 AND a.paused=0 AND p.status IN ('draft','approved') AND p.scheduled_for<=? AND p.scheduled_for>=?
      AND (p.hold_until IS NULL OR p.hold_until<=?) AND (p.cleared_at IS NOT NULL OR (a.auto_publish=1 AND s.auto_publish=1 AND s.enabled=1))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM distributions d WHERE d.agent_id=p.agent_id AND d.seq=p.seq AND d.status IN ('in_flight','sent','unknown')) ORDER BY p.scheduled_for LIMIT 3`)
    .bind(now,late,now).all<{agent_id:string;seq:number}>()).results;
  for(const p of due) {
    try {
      const result=await publish(env,p.agent_id,p.seq,'auto');
      await env.DB.prepare('INSERT INTO notification_outbox(agent_id,payload,dedupe_key) VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING')
        .bind(p.agent_id,JSON.stringify({kind:result.ok?'published':'publish_failed',seq:p.seq}),`send:${p.agent_id}:${p.seq}`).run();
    } catch(error) {
      console.warn(JSON.stringify({event:'scheduled_publish_deferred',status:error instanceof HttpError?error.status:500}));
    }
  }
}
export async function cleanExpired(db:D1Database) {
  const before=(ms:number)=>new Date(Date.now()-ms).toISOString();
  await db.batch([
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO notification_outbox(agent_id,payload,dedupe_key)
      SELECT agent_id,'{"kind":"token_expiring"}','token-expiring:' || agent_id || ':' || expires_at FROM linkedin_accounts
      WHERE expires_at<? ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`).bind(new Date(Date.now()+7*86400000).toISOString()),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM native_auth WHERE created_at<?').bind(before(3600000)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM oauth_states WHERE created_at<?').bind(before(3600000)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE at<?').bind(before(86400000)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM byline_sessions WHERE expires_at<? OR revoked_at<?').bind(before(0),before(86400000)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM ai_usage WHERE created_at<?').bind(before(30*86400000)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM ai_reservations WHERE day<?').bind(before(30*86400000).slice(0,10)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM ai_user_days WHERE day<?').bind(before(30*86400000).slice(0,10)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM ai_provider_days WHERE day<?').bind(before(30*86400000).slice(0,10)),
    db.prepare("DELETE FROM generation_jobs WHERE state IN ('completed','failed') AND created_at<?").bind(before(30*86400000)),
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM notification_outbox WHERE delivered_at<?').bind(before(30*86400000)),
  ]);
}
export class MaintenanceWorkflow extends WorkflowEntrypoint<AppEnv,{cleanup:boolean}> {
  async run(event:WorkflowEvent<{cleanup:boolean}>,step:WorkflowStep) {
    const retry={retries:{limit:2,delay:'15 seconds' as const,backoff:'exponential' as const}};
    await step.do('publish-due',retry,()=>publishDue(this.env));
    await step.do('scan-timetable',retry,()=>scanSchedule(this.env));
    await step.do('reconcile-drafts',retry,()=>reconcileJobs(this.env));
    await step.do('dispatch-drafts',retry,()=>dispatchJobs(this.env));
    await step.do('deliver-notifications',retry,()=>drainNotifications(this.env));
    if(event.payload.cleanup)await step.do('expire-old-records',retry,()=>cleanExpired(this.env.DB));
  }
}
export async function reviewRoute(request:Request,env:AppEnv,owner:Owner) {
  if(request.method==='GET')return json(await timetable(env.DB,owner));
  const b=await body(request);
  if(b.action==='notifications'&&['enabled','denied','unavailable'].includes(String(b.notifications))) {
    await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE onboarding SET config=json_set(config,'$.notifications',?) WHERE user_id=?").bind(b.notifications,owner.userId).run();return json({ok:true});
  }
  if(b.action!=='generate')throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a timetable entry to prepare.');
  const c=await loadAgent(env.DB,owner.agentId);
  const setup=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT completed_at FROM onboarding WHERE user_id=?').bind(owner.userId).first<{completed_at:string|null}>();
  if(!setup?.completed_at||c.settings.paused)throw new HttpError(409,'Finish setup and resume ByLine before preparing posts.');
  if(b.slotIds!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(b.slotIds)||b.slotIds.some(s=>typeof s!=='string')))throw new HttpError(400,'Choose valid timetable entries.');
  const day=await timetable(env.DB,owner),slots=await listSlots(env.DB,owner.agentId);let count=0;
  for(const e of day.entries.filter(e=>e.canPrepare&&(!Array.isArray(b.slotIds)||!b.slotIds.length||b.slotIds.includes(e.slotId)))) {
    if(await enqueueSlot(env.DB,slots.find(s=>s.id===e.slotId)!,owner.userId,c.row.revision,day.date,e.scheduledFor))count++;
  }
  await dispatchJobs(env);
  return json({ok:true,accepted:count>0,count},202);
}
export async function cycleRoute(env:AppEnv,owner:Owner) {
  const c=await loadAgent(env.DB,owner.agentId);
  const setup=await env.DB.prepare('SELECT completed_at FROM onboarding WHERE user_id=?').bind(owner.userId).first<{completed_at:string|null}>();
  if(!setup?.completed_at||c.settings.paused)throw new HttpError(409,'Finish setup and resume ByLine before preparing a draft.');
  await enqueueManual(env.DB,{kind:'manual',agentId:owner.agentId,userId:owner.userId,agentRevision:c.row.revision});
  await dispatchJobs(env);return json({ok:true,accepted:true},202);
````

````text
import { isCategoryId,MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES,describeCategories } from '../../lib/categories';
import { parseStyle,PRESETS } from '../../lib/style';
import { normalizeHhMm,isValidTimeZone,nextSlotRun } from '../../lib/schedule';
import { loadAgent,accountStatus } from './models';
import { listSlots } from './slots';
import { body,json,HttpError } from './http';
import type { Owner } from './auth';

export async function settingsRoute(request:Request,db:D1Database,owner:Owner) {
  const b=await body(request),c=await loadAgent(db,owner.agentId),a=c.settings;
  for(const key of ['paused','autoPublish'])if(b[key]!==undefined&&typeof b[key]!=='boolean')throw new HttpError(400,'Check your publishing preferences.');
  if(b.categories!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(b.categories)||!b.categories.length||b.categories.length>MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES||b.categories.some(v=>!isCategoryId(v))||new Set(b.categories).size!==b.categories.length))throw new HttpError(400,'Choose 1–12 distinct subjects.');
  if(b.timezone!==undefined&&(typeof b.timezone!=='string'||!isValidTimeZone(b.timezone)))throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a valid timezone.');
  if(b.corpus!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(b.corpus)||b.corpus.length>10||b.corpus.some(t=>typeof t!=='string'||t.trim().length<80||t.trim().length>2400)))throw new HttpError(400,'Use up to 10 writing samples, each 80–2400 characters.');
  if(b.autoPublishCap!==undefined&&(typeof b.autoPublishCap!=='number'||!Number.isInteger(b.autoPublishCap)||b.autoPublishCap<1||b.autoPublishCap>5))throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a daily automatic posting limit from 1–5.');
  const time=b.postTimeLocal===undefined?a.postTimeLocal:typeof b.postTimeLocal==='string'?normalizeHhMm(b.postTimeLocal):null;
  if(!time)throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a valid posting time.');
  if(b.autoPublish===true){const account=await accountStatus(db,a.agentId);if(!account.connected||account.needsReauth)throw new HttpError(409,'Connect LinkedIn before enabling automatic publishing.');}
  const preset=typeof b.preset==='string'?PRESETS[b.preset]:undefined;
  if(b.preset!==undefined&&!preset)throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a valid voice preset.');
  if(b.style!==undefined&&(!b.style||typeof b.style!=='object'||Array.isArray(b.style)))throw new HttpError(400,'Check your writing preferences.');
  const categories=(b.categories??a.categories) as typeof a.categories,zone=(b.timezone??a.timezone) as string;
  const style=parseStyle({...a.style,...preset?.style,...(b.style as object??{})});
  const persona={...c.persona,builtFor:categories,input:{...c.persona.input,domain:describeCategories(categories)}};
  const nonce=crypto.randomUUID();
  const statements=[db.prepare(`UPDATE agents SET categories_json=?,domain=?,timezone=?,post_time_local=?,auto_publish=?,paused=?,auto_publish_cap=?,style_json=?,corpus_json=?,persona_json=?,edit_token=?,revision=revision+1
    WHERE id=? AND revision=? RETURNING id`).bind(JSON.stringify(categories),describeCategories(categories),zone,time,(b.autoPublish??a.autoPublish)?1:0,(b.paused??a.paused)?1:0,
      b.autoPublishCap??a.autoPublishCap,JSON.stringify(style),JSON.stringify(b.corpus??a.corpus),JSON.stringify(persona),nonce,a.agentId,c.row.revision)];
  // A timezone change and its timetable updates commit together and are guarded by the same revision.
  if(zone!==a.timezone)for(const slot of await listSlots(db,a.agentId))statements.push(db.prepare(`UPDATE post_slots SET next_run_at=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=? AND agent_id=?
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agents WHERE id=? AND edit_token=?)`).bind(slot.enabled?nextSlotRun(zone,slot.local_time,slot.days_mask)!.toISOString():null,slot.id,a.agentId,a.agentId,nonce));
  statements.push(db.prepare(`UPDATE onboarding SET config=json_set(config,'$.timezone',?) WHERE user_id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agents WHERE id=? AND edit_token=?)`).bind(zone,owner.userId,a.agentId,nonce));
  const result=await db.batch(statements);
  if(!result[0].meta.changes)throw new HttpError(409,'Settings changed on another device. Reload and try again.');
  return json({ok:true,agent:(await loadAgent(db,a.agentId)).settings});
}
export async function interestsRoute(request:Request,db:D1Database,owner:Owner) {
  if(request.method==='GET'){const c=await loadAgent(db,owner.agentId);return json({topics:c.persona.identity.interests});}
  const b=await body(request),topics=b.topics;
  if(!Array.isArray(topics)||topics.length<1||topics.length>12||topics.some(t=>typeof t!=='string'||t.trim().length<2||t.trim().length>80))throw new HttpError(400,'Add 1–12 topics, each 2–80 characters.');
  const clean=topics.map(t=>t.trim());
  if(new Set(clean.map(t=>t.toLowerCase())).size!==clean.length)throw new HttpError(400,'Each topic should be different.');
  await db.prepare(`UPDATE agents SET persona_json=json_set(persona_json,'$.managed',json('true'),'$.identity.interests',json(?)),revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?`).bind(JSON.stringify(clean),owner.agentId).run();
  return json({ok:true,topics:clean});
}
````

````text
import { nextSlotRun, normalizeHhMm, localClock, describeDays, formatInZone } from '../../lib/schedule';
import { isCategoryId, MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES } from '../../lib/categories';
import { body,json,HttpError } from './http';
import { loadAgent, postView, type CloudPost } from './models';
import type { Owner } from './auth';
export const SLOT_LIMITS={maxSlots:5,minLeadMinutes:10,maxLeadMinutes:720,missedAfterMinutes:45};
export interface SlotRow {id:string;agent_id:string;local_time:string;days_mask:number;lead_minutes:number;auto_publish:number;categories_json:string;enabled:number;position:number;next_run_at:string|null;revision:number}
export function slotView(s:SlotRow,zone?:string) {
  return {id:s.id,agentId:s.agent_id,localTime:s.local_time,daysMask:s.days_mask,leadMinutes:s.lead_minutes,autoPublish:!!s.auto_publish,
    categories:JSON.parse(s.categories_json),enabled:!!s.enabled,position:s.position,nextRunAt:s.next_run_at,
    daysLabel:describeDays(s.days_mask),nextRunLocal:zone&&s.next_run_at?formatInZone(new Date(s.next_run_at),zone):null};
}
export async function listSlots(db:D1Database,id:string) {return (await db.prepare('SELECT * FROM post_slots WHERE agent_id=? ORDER BY position,id').bind(id).all<SlotRow>()).results;}
function fields(b:Record<string,unknown>,prior?:SlotRow) {
  const time=typeof b.localTime==='string'?normalizeHhMm(b.localTime):prior?.local_time??'09:00';
  if(!time)throw new HttpError(400,'Choose a valid posting time.');
  const days=b.daysMask??prior?.days_mask??127,lead=b.leadMinutes??prior?.lead_minutes??15;
  if(typeof days!=='number'||!Number.isInteger(days)||days<1||days>127||typeof lead!=='number'||!Number.isInteger(lead)||lead<10||lead>720)throw new HttpError(400,'Check posting days and review time.');
  for(const key of ['enabled','autoPublish'])if(b[key]!==undefined&&typeof b[key]!=='boolean')throw new HttpError(400,'Check posting settings.');
  const categories=b.categories??JSON.parse(prior?.categories_json??'[]');
  if(!Array.isArray(categories)||categories.length>MAX_SELECTED_CATEGORIES||categories.some(c=>!isCategoryId(c)))throw new HttpError(400,'Choose up to 12 valid subjects.');
  return {time,days,lead,categories:JSON.stringify([...new Set(categories)]),enabled:b.enabled??!!(prior?.enabled??1),auto:b.autoPublish??!!(prior?.auto_publish??0)};
}
export async function slotsRoute(request:Request,db:D1Database,owner:Owner,id?:string) {
  const {settings:agent}=await loadAgent(db,owner.agentId);
  if(request.method==='GET')return json({slots:(await listSlots(db,owner.agentId)).map(s=>slotView(s,agent.timezone)),limits:SLOT_LIMITS,timezone:agent.timezone});
  const existing=await listSlots(db,owner.agentId);
  if(id&&request.method==='DELETE') {
    await db.batch([
      db.prepare(`UPDATE posts SET scheduled_for=NULL,cleared_at=NULL WHERE agent_id=? AND slot_id=? AND status NOT IN ('published','unknown')
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM distributions d WHERE d.agent_id=posts.agent_id AND d.seq=posts.seq AND d.status='in_flight')`).bind(owner.agentId,id),
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM post_slots WHERE agent_id=? AND id=?').bind(owner.agentId,id),
    ]);
    return json({ok:true});
  }
  const b=await body(request);
  if(b.action==='count'&&!id) {
    if(typeof b.count!=='number'||!Number.isInteger(b.count)||b.count<1||b.count>5)throw new HttpError(400,'Choose 1–5 posting times.');
    // Keep existing times; disabling excess slots preserves their history.
    const statements:D1PreparedStatement[]=[];
    for(let i=0;i<Math.max(existing.length,b.count);i++) {
      const slot=existing[i];
      if(slot) {
        const enabled=i<b.count;
        statements.push(db.prepare('UPDATE post_slots SET enabled=?,next_run_at=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=? AND agent_id=?').bind(enabled?1:0,enabled?nextSlotRun(agent.timezone,slot.local_time,slot.days_mask)!.toISOString():null,slot.id,owner.agentId));
      }else {
        const time=['09:00','12:00','15:00','18:00','20:00'][i];
        statements.push(db.prepare(`INSERT INTO post_slots(agent_id,local_time,days_mask,position,next_run_at)
          SELECT ?,?,127,?,? WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM post_slots WHERE agent_id=?)<5`).bind(owner.agentId,time,i,nextSlotRun(agent.timezone,time,127)!.toISOString(),owner.agentId));
      }
    }
    await db.batch(statements);
    return json({ok:true,slots:(await listSlots(db,owner.agentId)).map(s=>slotView(s,agent.timezone))});
  }
  const prior=id?existing.find(s=>s.id===id):undefined;
  if(id&&!prior)throw new HttpError(404,'Posting time not found.');
  const f=fields(b,prior);
  const next=f.enabled?nextSlotRun(agent.timezone,f.time,f.days)!.toISOString():null;
  const result=id
    ?await db.prepare(`UPDATE post_slots SET local_time=?,days_mask=?,lead_minutes=?,auto_publish=?,categories_json=?,enabled=?,next_run_at=?,revision=revision+1
      WHERE id=? AND agent_id=? AND revision=? RETURNING *`).bind(f.time,f.days,f.lead,f.auto?1:0,f.categories,f.enabled?1:0,next,id,owner.agentId,prior!.revision).first<SlotRow>()
    :await db.prepare(`INSERT INTO post_slots(agent_id,local_time,days_mask,lead_minutes,auto_publish,categories_json,enabled,next_run_at,position)
      SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,COALESCE(MAX(position),-1)+1 FROM post_slots WHERE agent_id=? HAVING count(*)<5 RETURNING *`)
      .bind(owner.agentId,f.time,f.days,f.lead,f.auto?1:0,f.categories,f.enabled?1:0,next,owner.agentId).first<SlotRow>();
  if(!result)throw new HttpError(409,id?'Posting time changed. Reload and try again.':'You already have five posting times.');
  return json({ok:true,slot:slotView(result,agent.timezone)});
}
export async function timetable(db:D1Database,owner:Owner) {
  const {settings:a}=await loadAgent(db,owner.agentId);
  const today=localClock(a.timezone);
  const slots=(await listSlots(db,a.agentId)).filter(s=>s.enabled&&(s.days_mask&(1<<today.weekday))!==0);
  const runs=(await db.prepare(`SELECT r.* FROM slot_runs r JOIN post_slots s ON s.id=r.slot_id WHERE s.agent_id=? AND r.run_date=?`).bind(a.agentId,today.date).all<{slot_id:string;post_seq:number|null;outcome:string;stage:string|null;retry_at:string;attempts:number;detail:string|null}>()).results;
  const posts=(await db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND (slot_date=? OR created_at>? OR scheduled_for>?) ORDER BY seq LIMIT 100`).bind(a.agentId,today.date,new Date(Date.now()-48*3600000).toISOString(),new Date(Date.now()-48*3600000).toISOString()).all<CloudPost & {slot_date:string|null}>()).results;
  const entries=slots.map(s=>{
    const run=runs.find(r=>r.slot_id===s.id),saved=posts.find(p=>p.seq===run?.post_seq||p.slot_id===s.id&&p.slot_date===today.date);
    // Keep the occurrence consumed, but never return a discarded draft as ready.
    const discarded=saved?.status==='rejected',p=discarded?undefined:saved;
    const active=run?.outcome==='pending'&&Date.parse(run.retry_at)>Date.now()-20*60000;
    const completed=Math.max(0,['discovering','judging','writing','saving'].indexOf(run?.stage??''));
    const from=new Date(Date.now()-36*3600000);
    let occurrence=nextSlotRun(a.timezone,s.local_time,s.days_mask,from)!;
    if(localClock(a.timezone,occurrence).date!==today.date)occurrence=nextSlotRun(a.timezone,s.local_time,s.days_mask,occurrence)!;
    return {slotId:s.id,time:s.local_time,scheduledFor:occurrence.toISOString(),post:p?postView(p):null,
      progress:p?{state:'ready',stage:'ready',completed:4,total:4}:discarded?{state:'paused',completed:4,total:4,message:'You discarded this draft. Your next posting time is unchanged.'}:active?{state:'working',stage:run?.stage??'discovering',completed,total:4}
        :a.paused?{state:'paused',completed,total:4,message:'Resume ByLine in Settings to prepare posts.'}
        :run?{state:run.attempts<3?'waiting':'paused',stage:run.stage,completed,total:4,message:run.detail??'No suitable story was found. Your preferences are saved.'}:{state:'idle',completed:0,total:4},
      canPrepare:!a.paused&&!p&&!discarded&&!active&&(!run||Date.parse(run.retry_at)<=Date.now())};
  }).sort((x,y)=>x.time.localeCompare(y.time));
  const assigned=new Set(entries.flatMap(e=>e.post?[e.post.seq]:[]));
  return {date:today.date,timezone:a.timezone,paused:a.paused,entries,posts:posts.filter(p=>p.status!=='rejected'&&!assigned.has(p.seq)&&localClock(a.timezone,new Date(p.created_at!)).date===today.date).map(postView),total:entries.length,ready:entries.filter(e=>e.post).length};
}
````

````text
import { ALL_CATEGORY_IDS,CATEGORIES } from '../../lib/categories';
import { PRESETS,MAX_HASHTAGS } from '../../lib/style';
import { formatInZone,localClock } from '../../lib/schedule';
import { loadAgent,accountStatus,postView,type CloudPost } from './models';
import { listSlots,slotView,SLOT_LIMITS } from './slots';
import { AI_MODEL,AI_FALLBACK_MODEL,PROVIDER_AI_LIMIT } from './ai';
import { json } from './http';
import type { Owner } from './auth';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
export async function statusRoute(env:AppEnv,owner:Owner) {
  const {settings:agent}=await loadAgent(env.DB,owner.agentId);
  const [slots,account,posts,schedule,heartbeat,budget,calls,ambiguous,timeline,rejections,generation,setup]=await Promise.all([
    listSlots(env.DB,owner.agentId),accountStatus(env.DB,owner.agentId),
    env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND status IN ('draft','approved','failed','unknown','missed') ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 200)
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM posts WHERE agent_id=? AND status='published' ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 20)`).bind(owner.agentId,owner.agentId).all<CloudPost>(),
    env.DB.prepare('SELECT last_run_at,cycle_count FROM scheduler_state WHERE agent_id=?').bind(owner.agentId).first<{last_run_at:string|null;cycle_count:number}>(),
    env.DB.prepare("SELECT value,updated_at FROM system_status WHERE key='cloud_scheduler'").first<{value:string;updated_at:string}>(),
    env.DB.prepare("SELECT source,count(*) AS n FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=? AND status='sent' AND send_day=? GROUP BY source").bind(owner.agentId,localClock(agent.timezone).date).all<{source:string;n:number}>(),
    env.DB.prepare('SELECT model,attempts AS calls FROM ai_provider_days WHERE day=?').bind(localClock('America/Los_Angeles').date).all<{model:string;calls:number}>(),
    env.DB.prepare("SELECT seq,status,last_error AS reason,created_at AS createdAt FROM distributions WHERE agent_id=? AND (status='unknown' OR (status='in_flight' AND created_at<?)) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20").bind(owner.agentId,new Date(Date.now()-10*60000).toISOString()).all(),
    env.DB.prepare('SELECT r.*,s.local_time FROM slot_runs r JOIN post_slots s ON s.id=r.slot_id WHERE s.agent_id=? AND run_date>=? ORDER BY run_date DESC LIMIT 40').bind(owner.agentId,new Date(Date.now()-7*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10)).all(),
    env.DB.prepare('SELECT title,url,reason,scores_json,created_at FROM rejections WHERE agent_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15').bind(owner.agentId).all<{title:string;url:string;reason:string;scores_json:string;created_at:string}>(),
    env.DB.prepare('SELECT id,state,stage,error,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt FROM generation_jobs WHERE agent_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1').bind(owner.agentId).first(),
    env.DB.prepare('SELECT config FROM onboarding WHERE user_id=?').bind(owner.userId).first<{config:string}>(),
  ]);
  const next=slots.filter(s=>s.enabled&&s.next_run_at).map(s=>s.next_run_at!).sort()[0]??null;
  const age=heartbeat?Date.now()-Date.parse(heartbeat.updated_at):Infinity;
  return json({initialized:true,agent,account,generation,reviewDelivery:{config:{notifications:setup?JSON.parse(setup.config).notifications??'later':'later'}},
    config:{liveMode:env.LINKEDIN_LIVE==='true',encryptionKey:!!env.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY,memoryDegraded:false,maxAutoCap:5,maxHashtags:MAX_HASHTAGS,
      presets:Object.entries(PRESETS).map(([id,p])=>({id,label:p.label,blurb:p.blurb,style:p.style})),
      categories:ALL_CATEGORY_IDS.map(id=>({id,label:CATEGORIES[id].label,blurb:CATEGORIES[id].blurb,groupLabel:CATEGORIES[id].groupLabel}))},
    budget:{autoUsed:budget.results.find(r=>r.source==='auto')?.n??0,autoCap:agent.autoPublishCap,manualUsed:budget.results.find(r=>r.source==='manual')?.n??0,manualCap:40,linkedinDailyRequests:150},
    schedule:{lastRunAt:schedule?.last_run_at??null,nextRunAt:next,nextRunLocal:next?formatInZone(new Date(next),agent.timezone):null,cycleCount:schedule?.cycle_count??0},
    slots:slots.map(s=>slotView(s,agent.timezone)),slotLimits:SLOT_LIMITS,timeline:timeline.results.map(r=>({slotId:r.slot_id,localTime:r.local_time,runDate:r.run_date,scheduledFor:r.scheduled_for,outcome:r.outcome,postSeq:r.post_seq,detail:r.detail,generatedAt:r.generated_at})),
    scheduler:{healthy:age<16*60000,lastTickAt:heartbeat?.updated_at??null,minutesSince:Number.isFinite(age)?Math.floor(age/60000):null,staleAfterMinutes:16},
    watchdog:{lastAt:null,minutesSince:null},
    queue:posts.results.filter(p=>['draft','approved','failed','unknown','missed'].includes(p.status)).map(postView),history:posts.results.filter(p=>p.status==='published').slice(0,20).map(postView),
    rejections:rejections.results.map(r=>({title:r.title,url:r.url,reason:r.reason,scores:JSON.parse(r.scores_json),createdAt:r.created_at})),
    llm:calls.results.map(r=>({...r,cap:[AI_MODEL,AI_FALLBACK_MODEL].includes(r.model)?PROVIDER_AI_LIMIT:0})),ambiguous:ambiguous.results});
}
````

## Source: cloud/src/workflow.ts

````text
import { WorkflowEntrypoint,type WorkflowEvent,type WorkflowStep } from 'cloudflare:workers';
import { generateJob } from './generation';
import type { GenerationJob } from './jobs';
import type { AppEnv } from './env';
import { drainNotifications } from './notifications';

export class ContentWorkflow extends WorkflowEntrypoint<AppEnv,GenerationJob> {
  async run(event:WorkflowEvent<GenerationJob>,step:WorkflowStep) {
    const result=await generateJob(this.env,event.instanceId,event.payload,(name,work)=>step.do(name,{retries:{limit:2,delay:'15 seconds',backoff:'exponential'},timeout:'3 minutes'},work));
    try {
      const key='seq' in result?`draft:${event.payload.agentId}:${result.seq}`:`generation-failed:${event.instanceId}`;
      await step.do('notify-outcome',{retries:{limit:2,delay:'15 seconds',backoff:'exponential'}},()=>drainNotifications(this.env,key));
    }catch { console.warn(JSON.stringify({event:'notification_delivery_deferred',job:event.instanceId})); }
    // The outbox remains available to the scheduled dispatcher if delivery fails.
    return result;
  }
}
````

````text
import {before,after,test} from 'node:test';

import {Miniflare,convertV4MiniflareOptions} from 'miniflare';

const runtime=new Miniflare(convertV4MiniflareOptions({
  modules:true,scriptPath:fileURLToPath(new URL('../.wrangler/test-build/index.js',import.meta.url)),
  compatibilityDate:'2026-10-27',compatibilityFlags:['nodejs_compat'],d1Databases:['DB'],
  workflows:{CONTENT:{name:'byline-content',className:'ContentWorkflow'},MAINTENANCE:{name:'byline-maintenance',className:'MaintenanceWorkflow'}},
  bindings:{APP_SECRET:secret,TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY:'b'.repeat(64),LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID:'test-id',LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET:'test-secret'},
}));

  for(const file of readdirSync(new URL('../migrations/',import.meta.url)).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.sql')).sort()) {
    const sql=readFileSync(new URL(`../migrations/${file}`,import.meta.url),'utf8');
    await db.batch(sql.replace(/^--.*$/gm,'').split(/;\s*(?=CREATE|ALTER|$)/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s=>db.prepare(s)));
  }
});
after(()=>runtime.dispose());

  await db.prepare('INSERT INTO byline_sessions(id,user_id,expires_at) VALUES(?,?,?)').bind(id,a.userId,new Date(expires).toISOString()).run();
  return {...a,token:await signSession(secret,a.userId,id,expires)};
}
async function call(token:string,path:string,method='GET',payload?:unknown) {

}

  await db.prepare("INSERT INTO generation_jobs(id,agent_id,payload,state) VALUES('other-job',?,'{}','working')").bind(b.agentId).run();

test('the compiled Worker responds to health and rejects protected routes without a session',async()=>{

test('discard removes manual and timetable drafts from every feed without affecting another author',async()=>{

  const device='test-device-token-shared-phone-123';

  assert.equal((await db.prepare('SELECT agent_id FROM device_tokens WHERE token=?').bind(device).first())?.agent_id,a.agentId);
  // Account switching reassigns this phone; a late logout cannot unregister its new owner.

  assert.equal((await db.prepare('SELECT agent_id FROM device_tokens WHERE token=?').bind(device).first())?.agent_id,b.agentId);

  await call(a.token,'/api/auth','DELETE');
  assert.equal((await call(a.token,'/api/status')).status,401);
  assert.equal((await call(b.token,'/api/status')).status,200);
});
````

````text
import { after, before, test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { Miniflare, convertV4MiniflareOptions } from 'miniflare';
import { provisionIdentity, sessionOwner } from '../src/identities.ts';
import { saveDraft } from '../src/drafts.ts';
import { reserveAi } from '../src/ai.ts';
import { nativeAuth, authCallback, authenticate } from '../src/auth.ts';
import { signSession, verifySession, encryptToken, decryptToken } from '../src/crypto.ts';
import type { AppEnv } from '../src/env.ts';
import {reconcileJobs,failJob} from '../src/jobs.ts';
import {generationError} from '../src/generation-errors.ts';
import {drainNotifications} from '../src/notifications.ts';

const runtime = new Miniflare(convertV4MiniflareOptions({
  modules: true,
  script: 'export default {fetch(){return new Response("local database test")}}',
  compatibilityDate: '2026-10-27',
  d1Databases: ['DB'],
}));
let db: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof runtime.getD1Database>>;
before(async () => {
  db = await runtime.getD1Database('DB');
  for(const file of readdirSync(new URL('../migrations/',import.meta.url)).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.sql')).sort()) {
    const sql=readFileSync(new URL(`../migrations/${file}`,import.meta.url),'utf8');
    // Keep trigger bodies together while separating CREATE and ALTER statements.
    await db.batch(sql.replace(/^--.*$/gm,'').split(/;\s*(?=CREATE|ALTER|$)/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s=>db.prepare(s)));
  }
});
after(async () => { await runtime.dispose(); });

test('notification batches stay bounded and each author receives only their own draft notice',async()=>{
  // Clear only this test runtime's old outbox fixtures.
  await db.prepare('DELETE FROM notification_outbox').run();
  const accounts=await Promise.all([0,1,2,3].map(i=>provisionIdentity(db,{provider:'linkedin',subject:`push-owner-${i}`,name:`Push ${i}`})));
  for(const [i,a] of accounts.entries()) {
    await db.prepare('INSERT INTO notification_outbox(agent_id,payload,dedupe_key) VALUES(?,?,?)').bind(a.agentId,JSON.stringify({kind:'draft_ready',seq:i+1}),`push-test:${i}`).run();
    for(let j=0;j<10;j++)await db.prepare('INSERT INTO device_tokens(token,agent_id,platform) VALUES(?,?,?)').bind(`push-${i}-device-${j}`,a.agentId,'android').run();
  }
  const key=await crypto.subtle.generateKey({name:'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5',modulusLength:2048,publicExponent:new Uint8Array([1,0,1]),hash:'SHA-256'},true,['sign','verify']);
  if(!('privateKey' in key))throw new Error('Expected an RSA key pair');
  const exported=await crypto.subtle.exportKey('pkcs8',key.privateKey);
  if(!(exported instanceof ArrayBuffer))throw new Error('Expected PKCS8 bytes');
  const pem=`-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n${Buffer.from(new Uint8Array(exported)).toString('base64')}\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----`;
  const env={DB:db,FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:JSON.stringify({project_id:'test',client_email:'test@example.com',private_key:pem})} as AppEnv;
  let requests=0;const recipients=new Set<string>();const original=globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.fetch=async(url,init)=>{
    requests++;
    if(String(url)==='https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token')return Response.json({access_token:'test'});
    const {message}=JSON.parse(String(init?.body));
    const owner=Number(message.token.split('-')[1]);
    assert.equal(message.data.seq,String(owner+1));
    recipients.add(message.token);
    return Response.json({name:'test-message'});
  };
  try {
    await drainNotifications(env,'push-test:3');
    assert.equal(requests,11);assert.equal(recipients.size,10);
    assert.ok([...recipients].every(token=>token.startsWith('push-3-')));
    requests=0;recipients.clear();
    await drainNotifications(env);
    assert.equal(requests,33);assert.equal(recipients.size,30);
    assert.equal((await db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM notification_outbox WHERE delivered_at IS NULL').first())?.n,0);
  }finally{globalThis.fetch=original;}
});

  assert.equal(tables.results.length, 28);

  await assert.rejects(db.prepare("INSERT INTO system_status(key,value) VALUES('invalid','invalid json')").run(), /CHECK/);
});

test('failed workflow reconciliation releases stuck jobs and preserves already saved drafts',async()=>{
  const a=await provisionIdentity(db,{provider:'linkedin',subject:'workflow-recovery',name:'Recovery test'});
  const ids=['stopped','running','saved'].map(()=>crypto.randomUUID());
  for(const id of ids)await db.prepare("INSERT INTO generation_jobs(id,agent_id,payload,state,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,'{}','working','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z')").bind(id,a.agentId).run();
  await saveDraft(db,{agentId:a.agentId,requestId:ids[2],text:'The draft survived even though acknowledgement failed.',rationale:'Recovery test',fingerprint:'recovery',sources:[]});
  const env={DB:db,CONTENT:{get:async(id:string)=>({status:async()=>({status:id===ids[1]?'running':'errored'})})}} as unknown as AppEnv;
  await reconcileJobs(env);
  const rows:{id:string;state:string}[]=(await db.prepare('SELECT id,state FROM generation_jobs WHERE agent_id=?').bind(a.agentId).all<{id:string;state:string}>()).results;
  assert.equal(rows.find(r=>r.id===ids[0])?.state,'failed');
  assert.equal(rows.find(r=>r.id===ids[1])?.state,'working');
  assert.equal(rows.find(r=>r.id===ids[2])?.state,'completed');
  await reconcileJobs(env);
  assert.equal((await db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM posts WHERE agent_id=?').bind(a.agentId).first())?.n,1);
  assert.equal((await db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM notification_outbox WHERE agent_id=?').bind(a.agentId).first())?.n,2);
  await failJob(db,ids[0],a.agentId,'Still failed');
  await failJob(db,ids[2],a.agentId,'Must not overwrite completed work');
  assert.equal((await db.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM notification_outbox WHERE agent_id=?').bind(a.agentId).first())?.n,2);
  assert.equal((await db.prepare('SELECT state FROM generation_jobs WHERE id=?').bind(ids[2]).first())?.state,'completed');
  assert.ok(!generationError(new Error('D1_ERROR: sensitive SQL secret-value')).includes('secret-value'));
});

test('session MACs reject tampering and token encryption authenticates ciphertext',async()=>{

  const token=await signSession(secret,user,session,Date.now()+100000);
  assert.deepEqual(await verifySession(secret,token),{userId:user,sessionId:session});
  assert.equal(await verifySession(secret,token.replace(user,crypto.randomUUID())),null);
  assert.equal(await verifySession(secret,token,Date.now()+200000),null);
  const key='1'.repeat(64),encrypted=await encryptToken(key,'test-provider-access-token');
  assert.equal(await decryptToken(key,encrypted),'test-provider-access-token');
  assert.notEqual(encrypted,await encryptToken(key,'test-provider-access-token'));
  await assert.rejects(decryptToken('2'.repeat(64),encrypted));
});

test('native OAuth preserves the mobile contract, claims callback once, and issues one session',async()=>{
  const env:Omit<AppEnv,'CONTENT'|'MAINTENANCE'>={DB:db,APP_SECRET:'test-app-secret-at-least-32-characters',TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY:'a'.repeat(64),
    LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID:'test-client',LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET:'test-client-secret',GEMINI_API_KEY:'test-key'};
  const verifier='v'.repeat(64);
  const req=(payload:unknown)=>new Request('https://byline.example/api/native-auth',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','CF-Connecting-IP':'192.0.2.1'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});
  const start=await (await nativeAuth(req({provider:'linkedin',verifier}),env)).json() as {id:string;url:string};
  assert.equal(new URL(start.url).searchParams.get('state'),start.id);
  const original=globalThis.fetch;
  let exchanges=0;
  globalThis.fetch=async url=>{
    if(String(url).endsWith('/accessToken')){exchanges++;return Response.json({access_token:'test-access-token',expires_in:3600});}
    assert.equal(String(url),'https://api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo');
    return Response.json({sub:'oauth-test-member',name:'OAuth author'});
  };
  try {
    const callback=new Request(`https://byline.example/api/linkedin/callback?state=${start.id}&code=test-code`);
    assert.equal((await authCallback(callback,env)).status,200);
    assert.equal((await authCallback(callback,env)).status,400);
    assert.equal(exchanges,1);
  }finally {globalThis.fetch=original;}
  assert.deepEqual(await (await nativeAuth(req({action:'poll',id:start.id,verifier:'w'.repeat(64)}),env)).json(),{pending:true});
  const polls=await Promise.all(Array.from({length:6},async()=>await (await nativeAuth(req({action:'poll',id:start.id,verifier}),env)).json() as {token?:string;pending?:boolean}));
  const tokens=polls.filter(p=>p.token);
  assert.equal(tokens.length,1);
  const request=new Request('https://byline.example/api/status',{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${tokens[0].token}`}});
  assert.equal((await authenticate(request,env))?.name,'OAuth author');
  const encrypted=await db.prepare("SELECT access_token_enc FROM linkedin_accounts WHERE agent_id=(SELECT id FROM agents WHERE owner_id=(SELECT id FROM byline_users WHERE subject='urn:li:person:oauth-test-member'))").first<{access_token_enc:string}>();
  assert.equal(await decryptToken(env.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY,encrypted!.access_token_enc),'test-access-token');
});
````

````text
import {test} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {boundedFeedFetch,balanceFeeds,feedsForCategories} from '../../lib/discovery-core';
import {withProviderRetry,durableCompletion} from '../src/ai';

test('redirect loops and concurrent sources cannot spend the writing request budget',async()=>{
  const original=globalThis.fetch;let calls=0;
  globalThis.fetch=async(_url,init)=>{assert.equal(init?.redirect,'manual');calls++;return new Response(null,{status:302,headers:{location:'/loop'}});};
  try {
    const request=boundedFeedFetch(24);
    await Promise.allSettled(Array.from({length:12},()=>request('https://example.com/feed',{})));
    assert.equal(calls,24);
    await assert.rejects(request('https://example.com/extra',{}),/budget/);
    assert.equal(calls,24);
  }finally{globalThis.fetch=original;}
});

test('source selection covers every selected category before adding more feeds',()=>{
  const categories=['ai-ml','dev-tooling','emerging-tech','business'] as const;
  const available=feedsForCategories([...categories]);
  const selected=balanceFeeds(available,[...categories],4);
  assert.equal(selected.length,4);
  assert.deepEqual(new Set(selected.map(f=>f.category)),new Set(categories));
});

test('temporary AI failures retry once; quota and runtime budgets do not retry',async()=>{
  let calls=0,waits=0;
  const retry=withProviderRetry(async()=>++calls===1?{ok:false,reason:'provider_http_503'}:{ok:true,text:'ready',model:'test'},async()=>{waits++;});
  assert.equal((await retry({system:'test',user:'test'})).ok,true);
  assert.equal(calls,2);assert.equal(waits,1);
  for(const reason of ['provider_quota_reached','request_budget_exceeded','provider_http_401']) {
    calls=0;
    const run=withProviderRetry(async()=>{calls++;return {ok:false,reason};},async()=>assert.fail('must not retry'));
    assert.equal((await run({system:'test',user:'test'})).ok,false);assert.equal(calls,1);
  }
});

test('durable steps retry outages but do not retry exhausted quota',async()=>{
  const args={system:'test',user:'test'};
  await assert.rejects(durableCompletion(async()=>({ok:false,reason:'provider_http_503'}))(args),/provider_http_503/);
  assert.deepEqual(await durableCompletion(async()=>({ok:false,reason:'provider_quota_reached'}))(args),{ok:false,reason:'provider_quota_reached'});
});

test('an unavailable primary uses the selected free fallback, while quota failures do not',async()=>{
  let fallbackCalls=0;
  const fallback=async()=>{fallbackCalls++;return {ok:true as const,text:'real alternative output',model:'secondary'};};
  const run=withProviderRetry(async()=>({ok:false,reason:'provider_http_503'}),async()=>{},fallback);
  assert.deepEqual(await run({system:'s',user:'u'}),{ok:true,text:'real alternative output',model:'secondary'});
  assert.equal(fallbackCalls,1);
  const limited=withProviderRetry(async()=>({ok:false,reason:'provider_quota_reached'}),async()=>{},fallback);
  await limited({system:'s',user:'u'});assert.equal(fallbackCalls,1);
});
````

````text
import {test} from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {writePost,writerOutputBudget,type WriteArgs} from '../../lib/writer-core';
import {defaultSetup,setupPersona} from '../../lib/setup-config';
import {DEFAULT_STYLE} from '../../lib/style';
import {critique} from '../../lib/critique';

const style={...DEFAULT_STYLE,minWords:400,maxWords:500,hashtagCount:9};
const args:WriteArgs={
  persona:setupPersona(defaultSetup,'Test author'),style,repairAttempts:2,
  winner:{title:'Source-backed engineering',url:'https://example.com/story',summary:'Evidence about software.',source:'test',categoryHint:'dev-tooling',category:'dev-tooling',reason:'Relevant',total:8,scores:{persona_fit:8,category_fit:8,novelty:8,timeliness:8,non_duplication:8}},
  runnersUp:[],memory:{facts:[],source:'none',degraded:false},priorPosts:[],
};
const draft=(words:number)=>({text:'A clear opening. '+Array(words-3).fill('code').join(' '),rationale:'This source supports a concrete engineering discussion without adding unsupported personal claims.',fingerprint:'engineering evidence and practical software evaluation',continuity:null,hashtags:Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>`Topic${i}`),used_quote:false});

test('the repair gate checks the complete post length including its source and tags',async()=>{
  const overlong={...draft(410),text:'A clear opening. '+Array(407).fill('evidence').join(' ')};
  let calls=0;
  const result=await writePost(async request=>{
    if(calls)assert.match(request.system,/2400 characters/);
    return {ok:true,text:JSON.stringify(calls++?draft(410):overlong),model:'test'};
  },args);
  assert.ok(result.ok);assert.equal(calls,2);
  assert.equal(result.data.text,draft(410).text);
  assert.ok(critique(draft(410).text,style,{hashtags:draft(410).hashtags,sourceUrl:'https://example.com/'+ 'a'.repeat(1100)}).some(v=>v.rule==='linkedin_length'));
});

test('long drafts receive enough output budget and a second bounded repair can finish them',async()=>{
  let calls=0;

    assert.equal(request.maxOutputTokens,writerOutputBudget(style));
    assert.ok(request.maxOutputTokens!>1536);

  },args);

});
````

````text
# Complete ByLine documentation

- [Download the complete PDF](../output/pdf/ByLine-Complete-Project-Handbook.pdf)
- [Readable handbook source](handbook.md)
- [Every file, dependency and source listing](generated-reference.md)
- [Machine-readable file inventory and SHA-256 hashes](repository-inventory.json)
- [PDF coverage and checksum](handbook-build.json)
- [Download and install the Android app](../releases/android/README.md)
- [Current verification evidence](../reports/ByLine-release-verification-2026-11-07.md)

The PDF includes the architecture, technology usage, accounts, onboarding, discovery,
AI, scheduling, publication, notifications, data model, API, configuration,
developer setup, operations, troubleshooting, every repository file's purpose,
resolved npm dependencies, test titles and selected phone UI previews. The PDF is a
100-120 page reading edition. Complete project text source and historical documents
remain in the linked generated reference rather than filling hundreds of PDF pages.

Rebuild from the repository root with Python 3 and `reportlab`/`pypdf` installed:

```powershell
python -m pip install reportlab pypdf
python scripts/build-handbook.py
```

The generator enumerates Git-tracked and non-ignored files. It fails on files with
no defined purpose so additions must be documented. It never reads ignored private
environments, build caches or databases. Derived document artifacts are catalogued
without recursive self-hashes. The signed APK must be prepared and its release
metadata updated before building the handbook.

Inventory `sha256` values identify the captured workstation bytes. Text entries also
include `lf_sha256` with CRLF normalized to LF so Git's cross-platform newline
conversion can be verified without treating it as a content change. Binary hashes
(including the APK) are exact on every platform.

The PDF's source lines use escaped non-ASCII characters/normalized punctuation for
portable rendering. Repository files and their recorded hashes remain byte-exact.
Historical reports and comments describe their original snapshot; use the current
implementation and fresh verification report for current behavior.
````

## Source: lib/accounts.ts

````text
/**
 * The connected LinkedIn account: storage, decryption, and the expiry policy.
 *
 * The whole design is shaped by one fact: LinkedIn issues programmatic refresh
 * tokens only to approved Marketing Developer Platform partners. A standard
 * self-serve app gets a 60-day access token and nothing else. So this module
 * treats re-authorization as a normal scheduled event rather than an error —
 * it warns while the token still works, and pauses cleanly when it doesn't.
 */
import { query } from "./db";
import { decrypt, encrypt } from "./crypto";
import { refreshAccessToken, type MemberIdentity, type TokenGrant } from "./linkedin";

/** Start warning this many days before expiry — enough runway to act without urgency. */
export const REAUTH_WARNING_DAYS = 10;

interface AccountRow {
  agent_id: string;
  member_urn: string;
  member_name: string | null;
  member_picture: string | null;
  access_token_enc: string;
  refresh_token_enc: string | null;
  scopes: string | null;
  expires_at: Date;
  connected_at: Date;
  last_ok_at: Date | null;
  last_error: string | null;
}

export interface AccountStatus {
  connected: boolean;
  memberUrn?: string;
  memberName?: string;
  memberPicture?: string;
  expiresAt?: string;
  daysRemaining?: number;
  /** Token is still valid but inside the warning window. */
  expiringSoon?: boolean;
  /** Token is gone or expired: nothing can publish until the user reconnects. */
  needsReauth?: boolean;
  hasRefreshToken?: boolean;
  lastOkAt?: string;
  lastError?: string;
}

function daysUntil(date: Date): number {
  return Math.floor((date.getTime() - Date.now()) / 86_400_000);
}

export async function saveAccount(
  agentId: string,
  grant: TokenGrant,
  identity: MemberIdentity,
): Promise<void> {
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + grant.expiresInSeconds * 1000).toISOString();
  await query(
    `INSERT INTO linkedin_accounts
       (agent_id, member_urn, member_name, member_picture, access_token_enc, refresh_token_enc, scopes, expires_at, connected_at, last_error)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, now(), NULL)
     ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO UPDATE SET
       member_urn        = EXCLUDED.member_urn,
       member_name       = EXCLUDED.member_name,
       member_picture    = EXCLUDED.member_picture,
       access_token_enc  = EXCLUDED.access_token_enc,
       refresh_token_enc = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.refresh_token_enc, linkedin_accounts.refresh_token_enc),
       scopes            = EXCLUDED.scopes,
       expires_at        = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
       connected_at      = now(),
       last_error        = NULL`,
    [
      agentId,
      identity.personUrn,
      identity.name ?? null,
      identity.picture ?? null,
      encrypt(grant.accessToken),
      grant.refreshToken ? encrypt(grant.refreshToken) : null,
      grant.scope ?? null,
      expiresAt,
    ],
  );
}

async function loadRow(agentId: string): Promise<AccountRow | null> {
  const rows = await query<AccountRow>("SELECT * FROM linkedin_accounts WHERE agent_id = $1", [
    agentId,
  ]);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

export async function getAccountStatus(agentId: string): Promise<AccountStatus> {
  const row = await loadRow(agentId);
  if (!row) return { connected: false };
  const days = daysUntil(row.expires_at);
  return {
    connected: true,
    memberUrn: row.member_urn,
    memberName: row.member_name ?? undefined,
    memberPicture: row.member_picture ?? undefined,
    expiresAt: row.expires_at.toISOString(),
    daysRemaining: Math.max(0, days),
    expiringSoon: days <= REAUTH_WARNING_DAYS && row.expires_at.getTime() > Date.now(),
    needsReauth: row.expires_at.getTime() <= Date.now(),
    hasRefreshToken: !!row.refresh_token_enc,
    lastOkAt: row.last_ok_at?.toISOString(),
    lastError: row.last_error ?? undefined,
  };
}

export type TokenLookup =
  | { ok: true; token: string; memberUrn: string }
  | { ok: false; reason: "not_connected" | "expired" | "decrypt_failed"; detail?: string };

/**
 * Fetch a usable access token, transparently refreshing first if a refresh
 * token exists (it will not, for a standard app — see the file header).
 *
 * Returning `expired` is a normal outcome, not an exception: callers pause and
 * surface the reconnect prompt instead of retrying.
 */
export async function getUsableToken(agentId: string): Promise<TokenLookup> {
  const row = await loadRow(agentId);
  if (!row) return { ok: false, reason: "not_connected" };

  let accessTokenEnc = row.access_token_enc;
  let expiresAt = row.expires_at;

  // Refresh a little early so a cycle never starts with a token about to die.
  const nearlyExpired = expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now() < 6 * 3_600_000;
  if (nearlyExpired && row.refresh_token_enc) {
    try {
      const refreshed = await refreshAccessToken(decrypt(row.refresh_token_enc));
      if (refreshed.ok) {
        accessTokenEnc = encrypt(refreshed.data.accessToken);
        expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + refreshed.data.expiresInSeconds * 1000);
        await query(
          `UPDATE linkedin_accounts
              SET access_token_enc = $2,
                  refresh_token_enc = COALESCE($3, refresh_token_enc),
                  expires_at = $4
            WHERE agent_id = $1`,
          [
            agentId,
            accessTokenEnc,
            refreshed.data.refreshToken ? encrypt(refreshed.data.refreshToken) : null,
            expiresAt.toISOString(),
          ],
        );
        console.log(`[accounts] agent=${agentId} access token refreshed`);
      } else {
        console.warn(`[accounts] agent=${agentId} refresh failed: ${refreshed.reason}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[accounts] agent=${agentId} refresh threw:`, String(err));
    }
  }

  if (expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) return { ok: false, reason: "expired" };

  try {
    return { ok: true, token: decrypt(accessTokenEnc), memberUrn: row.member_urn };
  } catch (err) {
    // Almost always a rotated TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY — the fix is to reconnect.
    return { ok: false, reason: "decrypt_failed", detail: String((err as Error)?.message ?? err) };
  }
}

export async function recordAccountOk(agentId: string): Promise<void> {
  await query(
    "UPDATE linkedin_accounts SET last_ok_at = now(), last_error = NULL WHERE agent_id = $1",
    [agentId],
  );
}

export async function recordAccountError(agentId: string, error: string): Promise<void> {
  await query("UPDATE linkedin_accounts SET last_error = $2 WHERE agent_id = $1", [
    agentId,
    error.slice(0, 500),
  ]);
}

/** Disconnect: the token is dropped entirely rather than left dormant in a row. */
export async function disconnectAccount(agentId: string): Promise<void> {
  await query("DELETE FROM linkedin_accounts WHERE agent_id = $1", [agentId]);
}

````

## Source: lib/agents.ts

````text
/**
 * Agent init, settings, and idempotency.
 *
 * The persona payload is canonicalized (recursively sorted keys) and hashed;
 * the hash has a UNIQUE constraint, so re-running init with identical input
 * returns the existing agent and never resets state, while different input
 * creates a new, fully isolated one.
 *
 * This app is single-operator in practice — one person, one profile — so
 * getPrimaryAgent() is what the UI and cron actually use. The multi-agent
 * structure is inherited and kept because it costs nothing and keeps the
 * option open.
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { CategoryId } from "./categories";
import { LEGACY_CATEGORY_IDS as ALL_CATEGORY_IDS, describeCategories, parseCategories, sameCategorySet } from "./categories";
import { query } from "./db";
import { MAX_AUTO_CAP } from "./distribute";
import { expandPersona, type PersonaRecord } from "./persona";
import { normalizeHhMm } from "./schedule";
import { parseStyle, type StyleConfig } from "./style";
import { parseCorpus, pickSamples, SAMPLES_IN_PROMPT, type VoiceSample } from "./voice";

export function canonicalize(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonicalize).join(",")}]`;
  const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)
    .sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))
    .map(([k, v]) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalize(v)}`);
  return `{${entries.join(",")}}`;
}

export interface InitPersona {
  name: string;
  domain: string;
  categories?: CategoryId[];
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface AgentSettings {
  agentId: string;
  name: string;
  domain: string;
  categories: CategoryId[];
  timezone: string;
  postTimeLocal: string;
  autoPublish: boolean;
  paused: boolean;
  active: boolean;
  /** How many posts the AGENT may send per rolling 24h, 1-3. Manual publishing
   *  is bounded by LinkedIn's limits instead — see lib/distribute.ts. */
  autoPublishCap: number;
  /** Always complete — parseStyle fills every field from the house style. */
  style: StyleConfig;
  /** Writing samples the author supplied, as few-shot examples for the writer. */
  corpus: string[];
  /** Standing summary of how this author rewrites the agent. Null until earned. */
  editNotes: string | null;
}

export async function ensureAgent(
  persona: InitPersona,
  options: { timezone?: string; postTimeLocal?: string } = {},
): Promise<{ agentId: string; created: boolean }> {
  const categories = parseCategories(persona.categories);
  const hash = createHash("sha256").update(canonicalize(persona)).digest("hex");

  const inserted = await query<{ id: string }>(
    `INSERT INTO agents (name, domain, persona_json, persona_hash, categories_json, timezone, post_time_local)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
     ON CONFLICT (persona_hash) DO NOTHING
     RETURNING id`,
    [
      persona.name,
      persona.domain,
      JSON.stringify({ input: persona }),
      hash,
      JSON.stringify(categories.length > 0 ? categories : ALL_CATEGORY_IDS),
      options.timezone ?? "Asia/Kolkata",
      options.postTimeLocal ?? "09:30",
    ],
  );

  if (inserted.length === 0) {
    const existing = await query<{ id: string }>("SELECT id FROM agents WHERE persona_hash = $1", [
      hash,
    ]);
    return { agentId: existing[0].id, created: false };
  }

  const agentId = inserted[0].id;
  // Due immediately: the first cycle runs right after init responds.
  await query(
    `INSERT INTO scheduler_state (agent_id, next_run_at) VALUES ($1, now())
     ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO NOTHING`,
    [agentId],
  );
  return { agentId, created: true };
}

/**
 * The one LLM call that expands the raw persona into a full editorial
 * identity. Deliberately NOT part of ensureAgent: init must answer fast (pure
 * DB work), so callers run this in the background via after(). expandPersona
 * never throws — it falls back mechanically if the LLM is unavailable. Until
 * it completes, getPersona returns null and cycles skip harmlessly.
 */
export async function expandStoredPersona(agentId: string): Promise<void> {
  const rows = await query<{
    persona_json: { input: InitPersona; identity?: unknown };
    categories_json: CategoryId[];
  }>("SELECT persona_json, categories_json FROM agents WHERE id = $1", [agentId]);
  if (rows.length === 0 || rows[0].persona_json.identity) return; // gone or already expanded
  const input = rows[0].persona_json.input;
  const record = await expandPersona(input.name, input.domain, rows[0].categories_json ?? []);
  await query("UPDATE agents SET persona_json = $2 WHERE id = $1", [
    agentId,
    JSON.stringify({ ...record, input }),
  ]);
}

/**
 * Rebuild the stored identity when it no longer matches the agent's categories.
 *
 * The persona is DERIVED from the categories, so switching one off has to
 * change it. Nothing did: expandStoredPersona refuses to re-run once
 * `identity` exists and updateAgentSettings never touched persona_json, so an
 * agent whose music categories had been switched off months ago still carried
 * music interests, music opinions and a music domain line into every judge and
 * writer prompt. Discovery stopped fetching music; the persona kept asking for
 * it, so whatever in the remaining feeds looked closest to music won.
 *
 * Called at the top of a cycle rather than from the settings PATCH on purpose:
 * selecting categories is several taps and each one is its own request, so
 * rebuilding per request would spend an LLM call per tap. The domain line the
 * UI reads is updated synchronously by updateAgentSettings; only the identity
 * waits, and it waits exactly until the moment it is next used.
 *
 * Never throws, and never leaves the agent without an identity: a failed
 * rebuild keeps the previous record, and the next cycle tries again.
 */
export async function refreshPersonaIfStale(agentId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const rows = await query<{
      name: string;
      persona_json: PersonaRecord & { input: InitPersona };
      categories_json: CategoryId[];
    }>("SELECT name, persona_json, categories_json FROM agents WHERE id = $1", [agentId]);
    const record = rows[0]?.persona_json;
    // Not expanded yet — that is expandStoredPersona's job, not this one's.
    if (!record?.identity || (record as unknown as {managed?:boolean}).managed) return false;

    const parsed = parseCategories(rows[0].categories_json);
    const categories = parsed.length > 0 ? parsed : ALL_CATEGORY_IDS;
    // A record with no builtFor predates this field: rebuild once to learn it.
    // A fallback record is retried too — it is the mechanical identity written
    // when the LLM was unavailable, and it should not be the permanent answer.
    const fresh =
      record.builtFor !== undefined &&
      record.generator === "llm" &&
      sameCategorySet(record.builtFor, categories);
    if (fresh) return false;

    const domain = describeCategories(categories);
    const rebuilt = await expandPersona(rows[0].name, domain, categories);
    await query("UPDATE agents SET persona_json = $2, domain = $3 WHERE id = $1", [
      agentId,
      // input.name is preserved; input.domain follows the categories, because
      // personaBlock prints it and a stale one is the loudest bias in the prompt.
      // input.categories is refreshed for the same reason — it is not read by
      // anything today, and leaving the setup-time list sitting in the record
      // is exactly the kind of quietly-wrong field this whole change is about.
      JSON.stringify({
        ...rebuilt,
        input: { ...record.input, name: rows[0].name, domain, categories },
      }),
      domain,
    ]);
    console.log(
      `[persona] rebuilt for agent=${agentId} (${rebuilt.generator}) — categories now: ${categories.join(", ")}`,
    );
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    // A cycle with a slightly stale persona is far better than no cycle.
    console.warn("[persona] refresh failed, keeping the stored identity:", String((err as Error)?.message ?? err));
    return false;
  }
}

export async function getPersona(agentId: string): Promise<PersonaRecord | null> {
  const rows = await query<{ persona_json: PersonaRecord }>(
    "SELECT persona_json FROM agents WHERE id = $1",
    [agentId],
  );
  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const p = rows[0].persona_json;
  if (!p.identity) return null; // persona expansion still pending or failed badly
  return p;
}

interface SettingsRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  domain: string;
  categories_json: CategoryId[];
  timezone: string;
  post_time_local: string;
  auto_publish: boolean;
  paused: boolean;
  active: boolean;
  auto_publish_cap: number | null;
  style_json: unknown;
  corpus_json: unknown;
  edit_notes: string | null;
}

function toSettings(r: SettingsRow): AgentSettings {
  const categories = parseCategories(r.categories_json);
  return {
    agentId: r.id,
    name: r.name,
    domain: r.domain,
    categories: categories.length > 0 ? categories : ALL_CATEGORY_IDS,
    timezone: r.timezone,
    postTimeLocal: r.post_time_local,
    autoPublish: r.auto_publish,
    paused: r.paused,
    active: r.active,
    autoPublishCap: Math.min(MAX_AUTO_CAP, Math.max(1, r.auto_publish_cap ?? 1)),
    style: parseStyle(r.style_json),
    corpus: parseCorpus(r.corpus_json),
    editNotes: r.edit_notes,
  };
}

const SETTINGS_COLUMNS =
  `id, name, domain, categories_json, timezone, post_time_local, auto_publish, paused, active,
   auto_publish_cap, style_json, corpus_json, edit_notes`;

export async function getAgentSettings(agentId: string): Promise<AgentSettings | null> {
  const rows = await query<SettingsRow>(
    `SELECT ${SETTINGS_COLUMNS} FROM agents WHERE id = $1`,
    [agentId],
  );
  return rows[0] ? toSettings(rows[0]) : null;
}

/** The single agent this installation drives. Null before init has run. */
export async function getPrimaryAgent(): Promise<AgentSettings | null> {
  const rows = await query<SettingsRow>(
    `SELECT ${SETTINGS_COLUMNS} FROM agents WHERE active AND owner_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1`,
  );
  return rows[0] ? toSettings(rows[0]) : null;
}

/**
 * The author's voice references: the samples they chose plus what they have
 * actually published, and the standing notes learned from their edits.
 *
 * Shared by the cycle and by the composer's rewrite actions on purpose. The
 * cycle used to be the only caller, so "Rewrite with AI" ran on the style
 * toggles alone — the writing samples and edit notes, which are the half of
 * the Voice screen that actually carries a voice, never reached it. Editing
 * them changed what the agent wrote on its own and changed nothing about the
 * rewrites, which reads exactly like the setting being ignored.
 */
export interface VoiceReferences {
  samples: VoiceSample[];
  editNotes: string | null;
}

export async function voiceReferencesFor(agent: AgentSettings): Promise<VoiceReferences> {
  const published = (
    await query<{ text: string }>(
      // posts.text, not original_text: the published version is the one the
      // author was willing to sign, edits and all. That is the voice to imitate.
      // Drafts are excluded — text nobody approved is not evidence of anything.
      `SELECT text FROM posts
        WHERE agent_id = $1 AND status = 'published' AND length(text) > 200
        ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST, seq DESC
        LIMIT $2`,
      [agent.agentId, SAMPLES_IN_PROMPT * 2],
    )
  ).map((r) => r.text);
  return { samples: pickSamples(agent.corpus, published), editNotes: agent.editNotes };
}

export interface SettingsPatch {
  categories?: CategoryId[];
  timezone?: string;
  postTimeLocal?: string;
  autoPublish?: boolean;
  paused?: boolean;
  autoPublishCap?: number;
  /** Partial style patch, merged over the current config and re-validated. */
  style?: Partial<StyleConfig>;
  /** Replaces the writing samples wholesale. An empty array clears them. */
  corpus?: string[];
}

export async function updateAgentSettings(
  agentId: string,
  patch: SettingsPatch,
): Promise<AgentSettings | null> {
  const sets: string[] = [];
  const params: unknown[] = [agentId];

  const push = (fragment: string, value: unknown) => {
    params.push(value);
    sets.push(`${fragment} = $${params.length}`);
  };

  if (patch.categories) {
    const categories = parseCategories(patch.categories);
    // Refuse to leave the agent with nothing to look for — an empty category
    // list would silently discover nothing and look like a broken cron.
    if (categories.length === 0) return getAgentSettings(agentId);
    push("categories_json", JSON.stringify(categories));
    // The scope line is a rendering of the categories, so it moves with them in
    // the same write. It used to be free text typed once at setup, which is how
    // the app came to describe an agent as covering music above a list of
    // chips with every music category switched off. The full identity is
    // rebuilt later, by refreshPersonaIfStale at the top of the next cycle.
    push("domain", describeCategories(categories));
    // Managed profiles keep the author's voice and examples, while their
    // scope follows the currently selected subjects in the same transaction.
    params.push(describeCategories(categories));
    sets.push(`persona_json = CASE WHEN persona_json->>'managed'='true' THEN jsonb_set(persona_json,'{input,domain}',to_jsonb($${params.length}::text)) ELSE persona_json END`);
  }
  if (patch.timezone) push("timezone", patch.timezone);
  if (patch.postTimeLocal !== undefined) {
    // Normalize rather than pattern-match: "9:30" and "18:00:00" are both
    // things a browser will hand us, and the old strict test dropped them on
    // the floor while still reporting success.
    const normalized = normalizeHhMm(patch.postTimeLocal);
    if (normalized) push("post_time_local", normalized);
  }
  if (typeof patch.autoPublish === "boolean") push("auto_publish", patch.autoPublish);
  if (typeof patch.paused === "boolean") push("paused", patch.paused);
  if (typeof patch.autoPublishCap === "number" && Number.isFinite(patch.autoPublishCap)) {
    // Clamped rather than rejected: the ceiling is a safety property of the
    // agent, not a preference, so an out-of-range request lands at the bound.
    push("auto_publish_cap", Math.min(MAX_AUTO_CAP, Math.max(1, Math.round(patch.autoPublishCap))));
  }

  if (patch.corpus !== undefined) {
    // Replaced wholesale rather than merged: the corpus is an ordered list the
    // author edits as a set, and a merge would make removing a sample impossible.
    push("corpus_json", JSON.stringify(parseCorpus(patch.corpus)));
  }

  if (patch.style) {
    // Merge over the CURRENT style rather than over the defaults, so the UI can
    // send one changed toggle without silently resetting every other field.
    const current = await getAgentSettings(agentId);
    const merged = parseStyle({ ...(current?.style ?? {}), ...patch.style });
    push("style_json", JSON.stringify(merged));
  }

  if (sets.length === 0) return getAgentSettings(agentId);
  await query(`UPDATE agents SET ${sets.join(", ")} WHERE id = $1`, params);
  return getAgentSettings(agentId);
}
````

````text
import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks';
import { query } from './db';
import { sessionIdentity } from './auth';
const context=new AsyncLocalStorage<string>();
export async function withAgentUsage<T>(agentId:string,work:()=>Promise<T>) {
  const [agent]=await query<{owner_id:string|null}>('SELECT owner_id FROM agents WHERE id=$1',[agentId]);
  return context.run(agent?.owner_id??agentId,work);
}
export async function usageOwner() {
  if(context.getStore())return context.getStore()!;
  try {
    const {headers}=await import('next/headers');
    const h=await headers();
    const token=h.get('authorization')?.replace(/^Bearer /,'')??h.get('cookie')?.split(';').map(x=>x.trim()).find(x=>x.startsWith('lc_session='))?.slice(11);
    return (await sessionIdentity(token))?.userId??'legacy-owner';
  }catch{return 'legacy-owner';}
}
export async function reserveUserCall(owner:string,day:string) {
  const configured=Number(process.env.BYLINE_AI_CALLS_PER_USER_DAY);
  const cap=Number.isFinite(configured)&&configured>0?Math.floor(configured):60;
  const rows=await query(`INSERT INTO ai_user_days(owner,day,requests) VALUES($1,$2,1)
    ON CONFLICT(owner,day) DO UPDATE SET requests=ai_user_days.requests+1 WHERE ai_user_days.requests<$3 RETURNING owner`,[owner,day,cap]);
  return rows.length>0;
}
export async function reserveProviderCall(model:string,day:string,cap:number) {
  const [slot]=await query<{next_at:Date}>(`INSERT INTO ai_provider_days(model,day,attempts,next_at) VALUES($1,$2,1,now()+interval '4 seconds')
    ON CONFLICT(model,day) DO UPDATE SET attempts=ai_provider_days.attempts+1,next_at=GREATEST(now(),ai_provider_days.next_at)+interval '4 seconds'
    WHERE ai_provider_days.attempts<$3 AND ai_provider_days.next_at<now()+interval '15 seconds' RETURNING next_at`,[model,day,Math.max(1,Math.floor(cap*.9))]);
  if(!slot)return false;
  const wait=slot.next_at.getTime()-Date.now()-4000;
  if(wait>0)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,wait));
  return true;
}
export async function recordAiUsage(owner:string,model:string,success:boolean,input?:number,output?:number) {
  await query('INSERT INTO ai_usage(owner,model,success,input_tokens,output_tokens) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)',[owner,model,success,input??null,output??null]);
}
````

````text
/**
 * Dashboard authentication — a single shared password, because there is
 * exactly one user.
 *
 * This is not over-engineering: the dashboard can publish to a real LinkedIn
 * profile, and a Vercel URL is guessable and crawlable. Without a gate, the
 * "publish this draft" endpoint is a public API for posting as you.
 *
 * The session cookie is `<expiryMs>.<hmac>` signed with APP_SECRET. Web Crypto
 * is used rather than node:crypto so the exact same code runs in middleware
 * (edge runtime) and in route handlers (node runtime) — one implementation,
 * one place to get it wrong.
 */

const encoder = new TextEncoder();

export const SESSION_COOKIE = "lc_session";
const SESSION_DAYS = 30;

async function hmacKey(secret: string): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  return crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    encoder.encode(secret),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" },
    false,
    ["sign"],
  );
}

function toHex(buffer: ArrayBuffer): string {
  return [...new Uint8Array(buffer)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

/** Length-independent comparison so a wrong-length token cannot be distinguished by timing. */
function timingSafeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}

async function sign(payload: string, secret: string): Promise<string> {
  const key = await hmacKey(secret);
  return toHex(await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, encoder.encode(payload)));
}

export function authConfigured(): boolean {
  return !!process.env.APP_PASSWORD && !!process.env.APP_SECRET;
}

export async function createSession(): Promise<{ value: string; maxAge: number }> {
  const secret = process.env.APP_SECRET;
  if (!secret) throw new Error("APP_SECRET is not set");
  const maxAge = SESSION_DAYS * 86_400;
  const expiry = String(Date.now() + maxAge * 1000);
  return { value: `${expiry}.${await sign(expiry, secret)}`, maxAge };
}

export async function verifySession(cookie: string | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  const secret = process.env.APP_SECRET;
  if (!secret || !cookie) return false;
  if (cookie.startsWith('v2.')) return (await sessionIdentity(cookie)) !== null;
  if (cookie.split('.').length !== 2) return false;
  const [expiry, mac] = cookie.split(".");
  if (!expiry || !mac) return false;
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(expiry)) || Number(expiry) < Date.now()) return false;
  return timingSafeEqual(mac, await sign(expiry, secret));
}

/** Native sessions carry identity, never a client-selected agent id. */
export async function createUserSession(userId: string, sessionId: string) {
  const secret = process.env.APP_SECRET;
  if (!secret) throw new Error('APP_SECRET is not set');
  const maxAge = SESSION_DAYS * 86400;
  const payload = `v2.${userId}.${sessionId}.${Date.now() + maxAge * 1000}`;
  return { value: `${payload}.${await sign(payload, secret)}`, maxAge };
}

export async function sessionIdentity(value: string | undefined): Promise<{ userId: string; sessionId: string } | null> {
  if (!value || !process.env.APP_SECRET) return null;
  const parts = value.split('.');
  const uuid = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if (parts.length !== 5 || parts[0] !== 'v2' || !uuid.test(parts[1]) || !uuid.test(parts[2]) ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(parts[3])) || Number(parts[3]) <= Date.now()) return null;
  if (!timingSafeEqual(parts[4], await sign(parts.slice(0, 4).join('.'), process.env.APP_SECRET))) return null;
  return { userId: parts[1], sessionId: parts[2] };
}

export async function passwordMatches(candidate: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const expected = process.env.APP_PASSWORD;
  if (!expected) return false;
  // Compare digests so the comparison is constant-length regardless of input.
  const secret = process.env.APP_SECRET ?? expected;
  const [a, b] = await Promise.all([sign(candidate, secret), sign(expected, secret)]);
  return timingSafeEqual(a, b);
}
````
