````text
/// Push notifications: permission, registration, and what a tap does.
///
/// Android displays background messages through FCM. Foreground messages use
/// the native notification bridge so the test button and daily alerts also
/// appear in the notification shade while ByLine is open.
library;

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart'
    show defaultTargetPlatform, TargetPlatform;
import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import 'state/app_state.dart';
import 'desktop_notifications.dart';
import 'android_notifications.dart';

/// Destination indices, matching the order in home_screen.dart. The server
/// sends a NAME rather than a number so the two can be reordered
/// independently — which is exactly what happened when five tabs became three:
/// the queue and the timetable are one screen now, and voice and status are
/// both behind Settings. The server's vocabulary did not have to change.
const _tabs = {
  'queue': 1,
  'schedule': 1,
  'compose': 0,
  'voice': 2,
  'status': 2,
};

/// Wire up push for this session.
///
/// Called after sign-in rather than at launch: registration attaches this
/// device to the agent, and that request needs a session cookie. Never throws —
/// on a phone with notifications refused, or no Play Services, the app must
/// carry on being a perfectly good control surface.
StreamSubscription<String>? _tokenSubscription;
Future<void> stopPush() async {
  await stopDesktopNotifications();
  await clearAndroidNotifications();
  await _tokenSubscription?.cancel();
  _tokenSubscription = null;
}

Future<String> startPush(AppState state, {bool askPermission = true}) async {
  if (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.windows) {
    return startDesktopNotifications(state);
  }
  if (defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.android &&
      defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.iOS &&
      defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.macOS) {
    return 'unavailable';
  }
  try {
    final messaging = FirebaseMessaging.instance;

    // Asked once by Android; asking again after a refusal is a no-op rather
    // than a second prompt, so this is safe to call on every launch.
    final settings = askPermission
        ? await messaging.requestPermission()
        : await messaging.getNotificationSettings();
    if (settings.authorizationStatus == AuthorizationStatus.denied) {
      debugPrint('[push] notifications refused — nothing will be delivered');
      return 'denied';
    }

    final token = await messaging.getToken();
    if (token == null || !await state.registerDevice(token)) {
      return 'unavailable';
    }

    // FCM rotates tokens on its own schedule and tells nobody but this stream.
    // Without it the server keeps a dead address and every alert is delivered
    // nowhere, which looks exactly like the alerts not working.
    await _tokenSubscription?.cancel();
    _tokenSubscription = messaging.onTokenRefresh.listen((next) {
      debugPrint('[push] token rotated — re-registering');
      state.registerDevice(next);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    debugPrint('[push] setup failed, continuing without notifications: $err');
    return 'unavailable';
  }
  return 'enabled';
}

/// Shows foreground messages and routes taps. Wraps the signed-in shell.
///
/// A widget rather than a bare listener because both jobs need a
/// [BuildContext] that outlives the screens — the banner needs a Messenger, and
/// a tap has to change tabs from outside any tab.
class PushListener extends StatefulWidget {
  const PushListener({super.key, required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  State<PushListener> createState() => _PushListenerState();
}

class _PushListenerState extends State<PushListener> {
  StreamSubscription<RemoteMessage>? _foreground;
  StreamSubscription<RemoteMessage>? _opened;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    stopAndroidNotificationTaps();
    _foreground?.cancel();
    _opened?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    if (defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.android &&
        defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.iOS &&
        defaultTargetPlatform != TargetPlatform.macOS) {
      return;
    }
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) listenAndroidNotificationTaps(_openDestination);
    });
    try {
      // Arrived while the app was open. Android draws nothing in this case.
      _foreground = FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen(_showInApp);

      // Tapped while the app was backgrounded.
      _opened = FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen(_openTab);

      // Tapped while the app was DEAD. The message that launched the app is
      // delivered once, here, and nowhere else — miss it and the tap silently
      // does nothing but open the queue.
      FirebaseMessaging.instance
          .getInitialMessage()
          .then((message) {
            if (message != null) _openTab(message);
          })
          .catchError((_) {});
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _showInApp(RemoteMessage message) async {
    if (!mounted) return;

    // The message says something changed on the server, and the user is looking
    // straight at the screen that would show it. Refreshing here is what makes
    // a draft appear in the queue on its own rather than on the next pull-down.
    context.read<AppState>().refresh(quiet: true);

    final title = message.notification?.title;
    final body = message.notification?.body;
    if (title == null && body == null) return;

    if (await showAndroidNotification(message) || !mounted) return;

    // Keep the existing banner as a fallback on other platforms or when
    // Android notifications have been disabled.
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            if (title != null)
              Text(title, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            if (body != null) Text(body, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13)),
          ],
        ),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 6),
        action: SnackBarAction(
          label: 'Show',
          onPressed: () => _openTab(message),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openTab(RemoteMessage message) {
    _openDestination(message.data['tab'] as String?);
  }

  void _openDestination(String? destination) {
    final tab = _tabs[destination];
    if (tab == null || !mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
    context.read<AppState>().requestTab(tab);
    context.read<AppState>().refresh(quiet: true);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.child;
}
````

````text
/// What went out, and what never did.
///
/// Split from the Desk because nothing here needs a decision — mixing "read
/// this and choose" with "look at what happened" is what made the old queue
/// three segments deep and put a reference list in front of a deadline.
///
/// PASSED OVER earns its place. Seeing what the judge rejected, and why, is the
/// fastest way to tell whether the categories and the threshold are set right:
/// a desk that has been empty for three days means something completely
/// different if this list is full than if it is also empty.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import '../api/models.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/form_select.dart';
import '../widgets/draft_card.dart';
import '../widgets/primitives.dart';
import 'draft_commands.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';

enum _Shelf { published, passed }

class ArchiveScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ArchiveScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ArchiveScreen> createState() => _ArchiveScreenState();
}

class _ArchiveScreenState extends State<ArchiveScreen> {
  _Shelf _shelf = _Shelf.published;
  final List<Post> _older = [];
  bool _loadingOlder = false, _hasMore = true;
  String? _historyError;

  Future<void> _loadOlder() async {
    if (_loadingOlder) return;
    final history = context.read<AppState>().status?.history ?? [];
    final cursor = _older.isNotEmpty
        ? _older.last.seq
        : history.lastOrNull?.seq;
    if (cursor == null) return;
    setState(() {
      _loadingOlder = true;
      _historyError = null;
    });
    try {
      final result = await context.read<AppState>().api.get(
        '/api/posts?before=$cursor',
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _older.addAll(
          (result['posts'] as List).map(
            (p) => Post.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(p as Map)),
          ),
        );
        _hasMore = result['hasMore'] == true;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _historyError = '$e');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _loadingOlder = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final status = state.status;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: () async {
        await state.refresh();
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _older.clear();
            _hasMore = true;
            _historyError = null;
          });
        }
      },
      backgroundColor: C.ink2,
      color: C.filament,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, S.x4, S.x4, S.x7),
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              const Text('Archive', style: T.title),
              const Spacer(),
              WriteButton(onTap: () => writeSomething(context)),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
          _ShelfBar(
            value: _shelf,
            published: status?.history.length ?? 0,
            passed: status?.rejections.length ?? 0,
            onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _shelf = v),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
          const StudioBanner(
            compact: true,
            scene: StudioScene.ideas,
            eyebrow: 'YOUR BODY OF WORK',
            title: 'Every post adds a chapter.',
            caption:
                'Revisit what you shared and find the thread for your next idea.',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
          ...switch (_shelf) {
            _Shelf.published => _published(context, state, status),
            _Shelf.passed => _passed(status),
          },
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _published(
    BuildContext context,
    AppState state,
    AppStatus? status,
  ) {
    final history = {
      for (final post in [...(status?.history ?? <Post>[]), ..._older])
        post.seq: post,
    }.values.toList();
    if (history.isEmpty) {
      return [
        const Empty(
          icon: Icons.send_outlined,
          title: 'Nothing published yet',
          blurb: 'Posts that reached LinkedIn appear here, newest first.',
        ),
      ];
    }
    return [
      for (final post in history) ...[
        DraftCard(
          post: post,
          busy: state.loading,
          actions: commandsFor(context, post),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
      ],
      if (_historyError != null) Text(_historyError!, style: T.small),
      if (_hasMore && (status?.history.length ?? 0) >= 20)
        OutlinedButton(
          onPressed: _loadingOlder ? null : _loadOlder,
          child: Text(_loadingOlder ? 'Loading…' : 'Load older posts'),
        ),
    ];
  }

  List<Widget> _passed(AppStatus? status) {
    final rejections = status?.rejections ?? const <Rejection>[];
    if (rejections.isEmpty) {
      return [
        const Empty(
          icon: Icons.filter_alt_outlined,
          title: 'Nothing passed over',
          blurb:
              'Stories the judge scored and turned down appear here, with its reasoning.',
        ),
      ];
    }
    return [
      Text(
        'What the judge read and turned down. If everything here looks like something '
        'you would have posted, the bar is too high — or the topics are too narrow.',
        style: T.small,
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
      for (final item in rejections) ...[
        _PassedOver(item: item),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
      ],
    ];
  }
}

/// Filter history using a compact dropdown.
class _ShelfBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ShelfBar({
    required this.value,
    required this.published,
    required this.passed,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final _Shelf value;
  final int published, passed;
  final ValueChanged<_Shelf> onChanged;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => FormSelect<_Shelf>(
    label: 'Show history',
    value: value,
    options: {
      _Shelf.published: 'Published ($published)',
      _Shelf.passed: 'Passed over ($passed)',
    },
    onChanged: onChanged,
  );
}

class _PassedOver extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PassedOver({required this.item});

  final Rejection item;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          item.title,
          style: T.bodyStrong.copyWith(fontSize: 16, height: 1.35),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: S.x3),
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            border: Border(left: BorderSide(color: C.ruleStrong, width: 2)),
          ),
          child: Text(item.reason, style: T.small),
        ),
        if (item.url.isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
          TextButton.icon(
            onPressed: () async {
              final url = Uri.tryParse(item.url);
              if (url == null || !['https', 'http'].contains(url.scheme)) {
                return;
              }
              final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
              try {
                if (await launchUrl(
                  url,
                  mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                )) {
                  return;
                }
              } catch (_) {}
              messenger.showSnackBar(
                const SnackBar(
                  content: Text('Could not open this source article.'),
                ),
              );
            },
            icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new, size: 16),
            label: Text(_host(item.url)),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  static String _host(String url) {
    final parsed = Uri.tryParse(url);
    return parsed?.host.isNotEmpty == true ? parsed!.host : url;
  }
}
````

````text
/// Write a new post, or edit a drafted one.
///
/// A FULL-SCREEN ROUTE, not a tab. Writing has a beginning and an end; as a tab
/// it was ambient, its half-finished state lived forever in an IndexedStack,
/// and "edit this draft" had to travel through a counter in app state to bring
/// a sibling tab forward. Here it is pushed, it owns the screen while it is
/// open, and closing it asks about unsaved text.
///
/// One screen for both jobs, because they are the same job: getting a piece of
/// text right before it goes out. A separate edit sheet had no attachments, no
/// rewrite and no voice summary — everything the composer already had.
///
/// Four things here are deliberate:
///
///   * Rewriting NEVER overwrites silently. A variant is shown beside the
///     current text and replaces it only when the author says so.
///   * A voice change does not rewrite anything on its own. It raises a banner
///     offering to. Silently regenerating text somebody typed, because they
///     touched a toggle on another screen, would be indefensible.
///   * Rewriting reads the CURRENT voice — every style rule, plus the author's
///     samples and edit notes — because the server builds that prompt fresh on
///     each request. Anything saved on the Voice screen is in effect on the
///     very next press.
///   * Images upload on save, not on pick, so abandoning a draft does not leave
///     orphaned assets registered at LinkedIn.
library;

import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/client.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/draft_card.dart';
import '../widgets/primitives.dart';

/// Mirrors MAX_BODY_CHARS in lib/format.ts.
const int kMaxBodyChars = 2400;

/// Words, counted the same way the server counts them.
///
/// Must stay in step with countWords() in lib/critique.ts — that is the count
/// the writer is repaired against, and a composer that disagreed with it would
/// send the author chasing a number the backend was not enforcing.
int countWords(String text) => text.trim().isEmpty
    ? 0
    : text.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).where((w) => w.isNotEmpty).length;

/// Guards against a second push. The compose request counter can fire while the
/// composer is already open — tapping "edit" on a card that is already loaded,
/// or a follow-up arriving — and stacking two composers would leave one of them
/// holding an edit lock nobody can release.
bool _composerOpen = false;

/// Open the composer. Loads whatever app state is pointing at: a post to edit,
/// a follow-up to season it with, or nothing at all.
Future<void> openComposer(BuildContext context) async {
  if (_composerOpen) return;
  final state = context.read<AppState>();
  _composerOpen = true;
  try {
    await Navigator.of(context).push(
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => const ComposerScreen(),
        fullscreenDialog: true,
      ),
    );
  } finally {
    state.stopEditing();
    _composerOpen = false;
  }
}

class ComposerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ComposerScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ComposerScreen> createState() => _ComposerScreenState();
}

class _ComposerScreenState extends State<ComposerScreen> {
  final _text = TextEditingController();
  final _tagInput = TextEditingController();
  final _picker = ImagePicker();

  /// Hashtags on this post. Loaded from the draft when editing — sending an
  /// empty list on every edit silently stripped the tags the writer chose.
  List<String> _hashtags = [];

  bool _polish = false;
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _error;
  String? _status;

  /// Local image files chosen but not yet uploaded.
  final List<XFile> _pending = [];

  /// Media ids already attached to the draft being edited.
  List<String> _existingMedia = [];
  List<String> _sources = const [];
  late final String _createRequestId = base64UrlEncode(
    List.generate(32, (_) => Random.secure().nextInt(256)),
  ).replaceAll('=', '');

  /// A rewrite waiting to be accepted or dismissed.
  String? _variant;
  List<String> _variantHashtags = const [];
  String? _variantVoice;
  int _variantIndex = 0;

  /// The post being edited, or null when writing something new.
  int? _loadedSeq;

  /// The text this screen opened with, so leaving can tell whether anything
  /// was actually typed.
  String _openedWith = '';

  String get _draftSnapshot => jsonEncode({
    'text': _text.text.trim(),
    'hashtags': _hashtags,
    'media': _existingMedia,
    'pending': _pending.map((f) => f.path).toList(),
    'scheduledFor': _scheduledFor?.toIso8601String(),
  });

  /// When this post should go out, or null for "not on the timetable". A
  /// hand-written post can be scheduled exactly like a generated one.
  DateTime? _scheduledFor;

  /// The voice at the moment the current text was loaded or generated.
  /// Compared against the live one to decide whether the text is stale.
  String? _voiceAtLoad;

  /// Held rather than looked up.
  ///
  /// [dispose] has to release the edit lock, and by the time it runs this
  /// element is deactivated — `context.read` from there throws "looking up a
  /// deactivated widget's ancestor is unsafe", which took the whole screen down
  /// every time the composer was closed on a draft.
  late final AppState _state;

  bool get _editing => _loadedSeq != null;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _text.addListener(() => setState(() {}));

    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    _state = state;
    _voiceAtLoad = state.styleFingerprint;

    final target = state.editing;
    if (target != null) {
      _loadedSeq = target.seq;
      _text.text = target.text;
      _existingMedia = List.of(target.media);
      _sources = List.of(target.sources);
      _hashtags = List.of(target.hashtags);
      _scheduledFor = target.scheduledFor;
      // Take the edit lock so the scheduled send cannot fire while this is open
      // and publish half a sentence. Time-bounded on the server, so forgetting
      // to release it costs a delay rather than a silenced posting time.
      if (target.isScheduled) state.holdForEditing(target.seq);
    } else {
      // A follow-up arrives as text with no post behind it, and is consumed on
      // the way so it cannot resurrect over something typed later.
      final seed = state.takeComposeSeed();
      if (seed != null) {
        _text.text = seed.text;
        _hashtags = List.of(seed.hashtags);
        _status = 'A follow-up, ready to edit. Not saved yet.';
      }
    }
    _openedWith = _draftSnapshot;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    final seq = _loadedSeq;
    if (seq != null) {
      // Release the hold on the way out, or a scheduled post stays blocked
      // until the server expires it.
      _state.releaseEditing(seq);
    }
    _text.dispose();
    _tagInput.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Leaving with typed text asks first. Everything else closes silently.
  Future<bool> _confirmLeave() async {
    if (_busy) return false;
    if (_draftSnapshot == _openedWith) return true;
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(_editing ? 'Leave without saving?' : 'Discard this post?'),
        content: Text(
          _editing
              ? 'The queued draft keeps its saved text, hashtags, attachments and schedule.'
              : 'Your unsaved text, hashtags, attachments and schedule changes will be lost.',
          style: T.small,
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Keep writing'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: C.flare,
              foregroundColor: C.onFilament,
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: Text(_editing ? 'Leave' : 'Discard'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    return ok == true;
  }

  /// LinkedIn's hashtag template accepts a single alphanumeric word; anything
  /// shorter than three characters is noise. Mirrors normalizeHashtag in
  /// lib/format.ts, which is what actually assembles the published text.
  void _addTag(int cap) {
    final cleaned = _tagInput.text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]'), '');
    if (cleaned.length < 3 || cleaned.length > 40) return;
    if (_hashtags.length >= cap ||
        _hashtags.any((tag) => tag.toLowerCase() == cleaned.toLowerCase())) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _hashtags = [..._hashtags, cleaned];
      _tagInput.clear();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _pickImages() async {
    try {
      // Downscale at pick time: /api/media caps the body at 4MB and a modern
      // phone photo is several times that.
      final picked = await _picker.pickMultiImage(
        maxWidth: 1920,
        maxHeight: 1920,
        imageQuality: 85,
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (picked.isEmpty) return;
      setState(() {
        _pending.addAll(picked);
        final total = _pending.length + _existingMedia.length;
        if (total > 20) {
          _pending.removeRange(20 - _existingMedia.length, _pending.length);
        }
        _error = null;
      });
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _error = 'Could not open the picker: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<List<String>?> _uploadPending() async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    try {
      while (_pending.isNotEmpty) {
        final ids = await state.uploadImages([_pending.first.path]);
        if (!mounted) return null;
        setState(() {
          _existingMedia = [..._existingMedia, ...ids];
          _pending.removeAt(0);
        });
      }
      return List.of(_existingMedia);
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = 'Image upload failed — $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _rewrite() async {
    final typed = _text.text.trim();
    // Rewrite what is on screen, including edits to an existing draft.
    if (_busy || typed.length < 20) return;

    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
      _status = null;
    });
    try {
      final state = context.read<AppState>();
      final voice = state.styleFingerprint;
      final text = await state.rewriteText(typed, variant: _variantIndex);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _variant = text;
        _variantHashtags = List.of(state.lastVariantHashtags);
        _variantVoice = voice;
        _variantIndex++;
        _busy = false;
      });
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _busy = false;
        _error = '$e';
      });
    }
  }

  void _acceptVariant() {
    final variant = _variant;
    if (variant == null) return;

    // Accept the same body and tags that were shown together in the preview.
    // Merging old tags here kept an outdated count until the server saved it.
    setState(() {
      _text.text = variant;
      _hashtags = List.of(_variantHashtags);
      _variant = null;
      _voiceAtLoad = _variantVoice;
      _status = 'Text and hashtags updated. Not saved yet.';
    });
  }

  /// Show the post exactly as it will be assembled, then confirm.
  ///
  /// Nothing leaves this screen without the author having seen the final text —
  /// body and hashtags together, with the fold where LinkedIn will cut it. The
  /// text box shows the body alone, which is not the same thing: the tags and
  /// the truncation are where posts actually go wrong.
  Future<bool> _previewAndConfirm({required bool publishNow}) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final ok = await showModalBottomSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      builder: (ctx) => _PreviewSheet(
        body: _text.text.trim(),
        hashtags: _hashtags,
        source:
            _pending.isEmpty && _existingMedia.isEmpty && _sources.isNotEmpty
            ? _sources.first
            : null,
        imageCount: _pending.length + _existingMedia.length,
        publishNow: publishNow,
        liveMode: state.status?.liveMode ?? false,
        editing: _editing,
      ),
    );
    return ok == true;
  }

  Future<void> _save({required bool publishNow}) async {
    if (_busy) return;
    // AI changes must be reviewed before a save or a send, never afterwards.
    if (_polish) {
      await _rewrite();
      if (mounted && _error == null) {
        setState(() {
          _polish = false;
          _status =
              'Review the suggested text and hashtags below before saving.';
        });
      }
      return;
    }
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    final confirmed = await _previewAndConfirm(publishNow: publishNow);
    if (!confirmed) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
      _status = null;
    });

    final mediaIds = await _uploadPending();
    if (mediaIds == null) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
      return;
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    // Keep successful uploads attached when a save/send needs another try.
    setState(() {
      _existingMedia = List.of(mediaIds);
      _pending.clear();
    });

    String? error;
    final seq = _loadedSeq;
    if (seq != null) {
      error = await state.editPost(
        seq,
        _text.text.trim(),
        _hashtags,
        mediaIds: mediaIds,
      );
      // Saving ends the edit, so the hold goes with it — otherwise a scheduled
      // post would sit blocked until the server expired the lock.
      if (error == null) {
        await state.releaseEditing(seq);
        _openedWith = _draftSnapshot;
      }
      if (error == null && publishNow) error = await state.sendNow(seq);
    } else {
      error = await state.compose(
        text: _text.text.trim(),
        polish: false,
        publishNow: false,
        hashtags: _hashtags,
        mediaIds: mediaIds,
        scheduledFor: _scheduledFor,
        onCreated: (createdSeq) {
          _loadedSeq = createdSeq;
        },
        clientRequestId: _createRequestId,
      );
      if (error == null) _openedWith = _draftSnapshot;
      if (error == null && publishNow && _loadedSeq != null) {
        error = await state.sendNow(_loadedSeq!);
      }
    }

    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = false;
      _error = error;
    });
    if (error != null) return;

    state.stopEditing();
    messenger.showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          publishNow
              ? 'Published.'
              : seq != null
              ? 'Draft updated.'
              : 'Draft saved in My posts.',
        ),
      ),
    );
    // The work is done and the result is on the Desk. Staying on a blank
    // composer would leave the author looking at nothing.
    navigator.pop();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final style = state.style;

    final length = _text.text.trim().length;
    final tooShort = length < 20;
    final tooLong = length > kMaxBodyChars;
    final hookLength = _text.text.split('\n').first.length;

    // The rule the author configured is in WORDS. Every counter here used to be
    // in characters, so the one number they had actually set was the one number
    // the screen never showed — a post could sit at a fifth of the required
    // length with nothing on screen disagreeing.
    final words = countWords(_text.text);
    final wordsOff =
        words > 0 && (words < style.minWords || words > style.maxWords);
    final canSend = !_busy && !tooShort && !tooLong;

    // Compared against the FULL voice, not style.summary. That summary names
    // the structure, the emoji policy and the tag count and nothing else, so
    // changing the register, the hook, the length or a custom rule left this
    // banner silent — the voice really had moved on and the composer said
    // nothing about it.
    final voiceStale =
        _voiceAtLoad != null &&
        _voiceAtLoad != state.styleFingerprint &&
        length > 0;

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, _) async {
        if (didPop) return;
        // Captured before the dialog: the lint cannot see that this closure's
        // context and the State's are the same one.
        final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
        if (await _confirmLeave() && mounted) navigator.pop();
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
            tooltip: 'Close',
            onPressed: _busy
                ? null
                : () async {
                    final navigator = Navigator.of(context);
                    if (await _confirmLeave() && mounted) navigator.pop();
                  },
          ),
          title: Text(
            _editing ? 'Editing ${state.editing?.id ?? ''}' : 'Write',
          ),
          actions: [
            if (_busy)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(right: S.x4),
                child: Center(
                  child: SizedBox(
                    height: 17,
                    width: 17,
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: PageSurface(
            child: ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, S.x2, S.x4, S.x5),
              children: [
                const StudioBanner(
                  compact: true,
                  scene: StudioScene.writing,
                  eyebrow: 'THE WRITING ROOM',
                  title: 'Give your idea a little space.',
                  caption:
                      'Start with one clear thought. Make the rest sound like you.',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                if (voiceStale) ...[
                  Notice(
                    tone: Tone.desk,
                    icon: Icons.tune,
                    title: 'Your voice changed',
                    body:
                        'This text was written under the old settings — ${style.summary}.',
                    actionLabel: 'Rewrite',
                    onAction: _busy || tooShort ? null : _rewrite,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
                ],

                // The page IS the text field. No panel around it, nothing
                // competing: this is the one thing the screen is for.
                TextField(
                  // Keyed so a test can reach the body field by name. Without it
                  // the only handle is `find.byType(TextField).first`, which
                  // silently becomes the hashtag input once the page is scrolled
                  // far enough to unmount this one.
                  key: const Key('composer-body'),
                  controller: _text,
                  maxLines: null,
                  minLines: 10,
                  autofocus: !_editing,
                  style: T.copy,
                  enabled: !_busy,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    hintText:
                        'What happened, what you learned, what you disagree with.',
                    border: InputBorder.none,
                    focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                    enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                    filled: false,
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x4),

                // One compact line of meters. Words first: it is the rule the
                // author set and the one the writer is held to. Characters matter
                // only near LinkedIn's ceiling, which ordinary posts never reach.
                Wrap(
                  spacing: S.x2,
                  runSpacing: S.x2,
                  children: [
                    Slug(
                      '$words / ${style.minWords}–${style.maxWords} words',
                      tone: words == 0
                          ? Tone.quiet
                          : (wordsOff ? Tone.desk : Tone.out),
                    ),
                    if (length > 0)
                      Slug(
                        'hook $hookLength / $kFoldChars',
                        tone: hookLength > kFoldChars ? Tone.desk : Tone.out,
                      ),
                    if (tooLong || length > kMaxBodyChars - 400)
                      Slug(
                        '$length / $kMaxBodyChars',
                        tone: tooLong ? Tone.broken : Tone.quiet,
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x5),

                if (style.hashtagCount > 0 || _hashtags.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  _Hashtags(
                    tags: _hashtags,
                    cap: style.hashtagCount,
                    controller: _tagInput,
                    busy: _busy,
                    onAdd: () => _addTag(style.hashtagCount),
                    onRemove: (tag) =>
                        setState(() => _hashtags = [..._hashtags]..remove(tag)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
                ],

                _Attachments(
                  pending: _pending,
                  existingCount: _existingMedia.length,
                  busy: _busy,
                  onAdd: _pickImages,
                  onRemove: (i) => setState(() => _pending.removeAt(i)),
                  onClearExisting: () => setState(() => _existingMedia = []),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x5),

                if (!_editing) ...[
                  const SectionRule('Before it goes out'),
                  SwitchRow(
                    title: 'Polish in your voice',
                    blurb:
                        'Shows a suggested rewrite for you to review before saving or publishing.',
                    value: _polish,
                    onChanged: _busy
                        ? null
                        : (v) => setState(() => _polish = v),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
                ],

                // Available while writing something new too, not only when
                // editing a saved draft — a second opinion is most useful before
                // the text has been committed to anything.
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _busy || tooShort ? null : _rewrite,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_outlined, size: 17),
                  label: Text(
                    _variant == null
                        ? 'Rewrite in my voice'
                        : 'Try another version',
                  ),
                ),
                if (tooShort && length > 0)
                  const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: S.x2),
                    child: Text(
                      'Write at least 20 characters to rewrite.',
                      style: T.micro,
                    ),
                  ),

                if (_status != null)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: S.x3),
                    child: Text(
                      _status!,
                      style: T.micro.copyWith(color: C.daylight),
                    ),
                  ),
                if (_error != null) ErrorNote(_error!),

                if (_variant != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
                  _Variant(
                    text: _variant!,
                    hashtags: _variantHashtags,
                    busy: _busy,
                    onAccept: _acceptVariant,
                    onDismiss: () => setState(() => _variant = null),
                    onAnother: _busy ? null : _rewrite,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        // Pinned, so the commit never scrolls away under the text it applies to.
        bottomNavigationBar: _CommitBar(
          editing: _editing,
          canSend: canSend,
          connected: state.status?.account.usable ?? false,
          onSave: () => _save(publishNow: false),
          onPublish: () => _save(publishNow: true),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Save and publish, pinned to the bottom.
class _CommitBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CommitBar({
    required this.editing,
    required this.canSend,
    required this.connected,
    required this.onSave,
    required this.onPublish,
  });

  final bool editing;
  final bool canSend;
  final bool connected;
  final VoidCallback onSave;
  final VoidCallback onPublish;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
      color: C.ink2,
      border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: C.rule)),
    ),
    child: SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(S.x3),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: FilledButton(
                    onPressed: canSend ? onSave : null,
                    child: Text(editing ? 'Save changes' : 'Save draft'),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: canSend && connected ? onPublish : null,
                    child: const Text('Publish now'),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (!connected)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: S.x2),
                child: Text(
                  'Connect LinkedIn to publish directly.',
                  style: T.micro,
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

/// The post exactly as it will be sent: body and hashtags assembled, with the
/// fold in place.
class _PreviewSheet extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PreviewSheet({
    required this.body,
    required this.hashtags,
    this.source,
    required this.imageCount,
    required this.publishNow,
    required this.liveMode,
    required this.editing,
  });

  final String body;
  final List<String> hashtags;
  final String? source;
  final int imageCount;
  final bool publishNow;
  final bool liveMode;
  final bool editing;

  /// Includes the same source line the server appends to text-only posts.
  String get _assembled => [
    body,
    if (source != null) 'Source: $source',
    if (hashtags.isNotEmpty) hashtags.map((h) => '#$h').join(' '),
  ].join('\n\n');

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final text = _assembled;
    final action = publishNow
        ? (liveMode ? 'Publish to LinkedIn' : 'Publish (dry run)')
        : editing
        ? 'Save changes'
        : 'Save draft';

    return DraggableScrollableSheet(
      initialChildSize: 0.9,
      minChildSize: 0.5,
      maxChildSize: 0.95,
      expand: false,
      builder: (context, controller) => Column(
        children: [
          const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
          Container(
            width: 36,
            height: 4,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: C.ruleStrong,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
            ),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, S.x3, S.x2, 0),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                // Expanded rather than Spacer: at 360pt the label and the Back
                // button together overflowed the sheet by 19 pixels.
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'THIS IS WHAT GOES OUT',
                    style: T.slug,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ),
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
                  child: const Text('Back'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: ListView(
              controller: controller,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, S.x3, S.x4, S.x4),
              children: [
                FoldedCopy(text),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: S.x2,
                  runSpacing: S.x2,
                  children: [
                    Slug(
                      '${text.length} chars',
                      tone: text.length > kMaxBodyChars
                          ? Tone.broken
                          : Tone.quiet,
                    ),
                    Slug(
                      hashtags.isEmpty ? 'no tags' : '${hashtags.length} tags',
                    ),
                    if (imageCount > 0)
                      Slug('$imageCount image${imageCount == 1 ? '' : 's'}'),
                    if (publishNow)
                      Slug(
                        liveMode ? 'live' : 'dry run',
                        tone: liveMode ? Tone.out : Tone.desk,
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                if (publishNow) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
                  Text(
                    liveMode
                        ? 'This posts to your profile now. It cannot be unpublished from here.'
                        : 'Live mode is off, so nothing will actually reach LinkedIn.',
                    style: T.micro,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          SafeArea(
            top: false,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, 0, S.x4, S.x3),
              child: SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
                  child: Text(action),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Hashtag editor. Capped by the voice config, because that same cap is applied
/// again server-side at assembly time — letting the author add five when their
/// style allows two would silently drop three.
class _Hashtags extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Hashtags({
    required this.tags,
    required this.cap,
    required this.controller,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onAdd,
    required this.onRemove,
  });

  final List<String> tags;
  final int cap;
  final TextEditingController controller;
  final bool busy;
  final VoidCallback onAdd;
  final ValueChanged<String> onRemove;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final full = tags.length >= cap;
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SectionRule(
          'Hashtags',
          trailing: Text(
            '${tags.length} / $cap',
            style: T.data.copyWith(fontSize: 12.5),
          ),
        ),
        if (tags.isNotEmpty)
          Wrap(
            spacing: S.x2,
            runSpacing: S.x2,
            children: [
              for (final tag in tags)
                InputChip(
                  label: Text('#$tag'),
                  onDeleted: busy ? null : () => onRemove(tag),
                  backgroundColor: C.ink2,
                  side: const BorderSide(color: C.ruleStrong),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
                  ),
                  labelStyle: T.body.copyWith(color: C.daylight),
                  deleteIconColor: C.paperFaint,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        if (!full) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: TextField(
                  controller: controller,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                  onSubmitted: (_) => onAdd(),
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(hintText: 'MusicTech'),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
              OutlinedButton(
                onPressed: busy ? null : onAdd,
                child: const Text('Add'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// A proposed rewrite, shown beside the current text rather than replacing it.
class _Variant extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Variant({
    required this.text,
    required this.hashtags,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onAccept,
    required this.onDismiss,
    required this.onAnother,
  });

  final String text;
  final List<String> hashtags;
  final bool busy;
  final VoidCallback onAccept;
  final VoidCallback onDismiss;
  final VoidCallback? onAnother;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ObjectCard(
    tone: Tone.desk,
    child: Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            const Slug('suggested', tone: Tone.desk),
            const Spacer(),
            Text('${text.length} chars', style: T.mono),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
        Text('Not saved. Use this text and these hashtags?', style: T.micro),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
        Text(text, style: T.copy),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
        Text(
          hashtags.isEmpty
              ? 'No hashtags'
              : hashtags.map((tag) => '#$tag').join(' '),
          style: T.small,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: FilledButton(
                onPressed: busy ? null : onAccept,
                child: const Text('Use this'),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
            Expanded(
              child: OutlinedButton(
                onPressed: onAnother,
                child: const Text('Another'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x1),
        Center(
          child: TextButton(
            onPressed: busy ? null : onDismiss,
            child: const Text('Discard suggestion'),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

class _Attachments extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Attachments({
    required this.pending,
    required this.existingCount,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onAdd,
    required this.onRemove,
    required this.onClearExisting,
  });

  final List<XFile> pending;
  final int existingCount;
  final bool busy;
  final VoidCallback onAdd;
  final ValueChanged<int> onRemove;
  final VoidCallback onClearExisting;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SectionRule(
          'Images',
          trailing: existingCount > 0
              ? TextButton(
                  onPressed: busy ? null : onClearExisting,
                  style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                    minimumSize: const Size(0, 32),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: S.x2),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    'Remove $existingCount attached',
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                )
              : null,
        ),
        SizedBox(
          height: 84,
          child: ListView(
            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
            children: [
              for (var i = 0; i < pending.length; i++)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: S.x2),
                  child: Stack(
                    children: [
                      ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
                        child: Image.file(
                          File(pending[i].path),
                          width: 84,
                          height: 84,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Container(
                            width: 84,
                            height: 84,
                            color: C.ink3,
                            child: const Icon(
                              Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                              color: C.paperFaint,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Positioned(
                        top: 0,
                        right: 0,
                        child: GestureDetector(
                          onTap: busy ? null : () => onRemove(i),
                          child: Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              color: C.ink,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                            child: const Icon(
                              Icons.close,
                              size: 15,
                              color: C.flare,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              InkWell(
                onTap: busy ? null : onAdd,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
                child: Container(
                  width: 84,
                  height: 84,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border.all(color: C.ruleStrong),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
                  ),
                  child: const Column(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.add_photo_alternate_outlined,
                        color: C.paperDim,
                      ),
                      SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text('Add', style: T.micro),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
````

````text
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';

class DeleteAccountScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DeleteAccountScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<DeleteAccountScreen> createState() => _DeleteAccountScreenState();
}

class _DeleteAccountScreenState extends State<DeleteAccountScreen> {
  final _confirmation = TextEditingController();
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _error;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _confirmation.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _delete() async {
    if (_busy || _confirmation.text.trim() != 'DELETE') return;
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      await state.api.post('/api/account/delete', {'confirmation': 'DELETE'});
      await state.signOut();
      if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _busy = false;
          _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Delete ByLine account')),
    body: PageSurface(
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        children: [
          const Text('Remove your ByLine setup', style: T.title),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'This permanently removes your ByLine profile, timetable, drafts, writing samples, preferences, history and saved LinkedIn credentials from the active service. It signs out all your ByLine sessions and stops future automation.',
            style: T.body,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'Posts already published on LinkedIn remain there. Remove those directly on LinkedIn if you want to. Previously created operator backups may retain data until they are removed under the operator’s retention policy.',
            style: T.small,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'Also remove ByLine from LinkedIn’s permitted services to withdraw the permission recorded by LinkedIn.',
            style: T.body,
          ),
          TextButton.icon(
            onPressed: _busy
                ? null
                : () => launchUrl(
                    Uri.parse(
                      'https://www.linkedin.com/psettings/permitted-services',
                    ),
                    mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                  ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new),
            label: const Text('Open LinkedIn permitted services'),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          TextField(
            controller: _confirmation,
            enabled: !_busy,
            onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'Type DELETE to confirm',
              helperText: 'This cannot be undone.',
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: _busy || _confirmation.text.trim() != 'DELETE'
                ? null
                : _delete,
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: C.flare),
            child: Text(_busy ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete ByLine account'),
          ),
          if (_error != null)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
              child: Text(_error!, style: T.small.copyWith(color: C.flare)),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  );
}
````

````text
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../push.dart';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';
import '../desktop_notifications.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart'
    show defaultTargetPlatform, TargetPlatform;

class DeliverySettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DeliverySettingsScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<DeliverySettingsScreen> createState() => _DeliverySettingsScreenState();
}

class _DeliverySettingsScreenState extends State<DeliverySettingsScreen> {
  String? _message;
  bool _busy = false;
  Future<void> _save({bool notifications = false}) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _message = null;
    });
    final permission = notifications ? await startPush(state) : null;
    final error = await state.mutate(
      () => state.api.post('/api/review-delivery', {
        'action': 'notifications',
        'notifications': ?permission,
      }),
    );
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _busy = false;
        _message =
            error ??
            (notifications
                ? (permission == 'enabled'
                      ? 'Notifications enabled.'
                      : 'Notifications are $permission. You can still review posts in ByLine.')
                : 'Notifications updated.');
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Notifications')),
      body: PageSurface(
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          children: [
            const StudioBanner(
              compact: true,
              scene: StudioScene.routine,
              eyebrow: 'A LITTLE DAILY RHYTHM',
              title: 'Make room for your ideas.',
              caption: 'Get notified when a draft is ready in your timetable.',
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _save(notifications: true),
              child: const Text('Enable notifications'),
            ),
            if (_busy) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _busy
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final state = context.read<AppState>();
                      final error =
                          defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.windows
                          ? await testDesktopNotification(state)
                          : await state.testDeviceNotification();
                      if (mounted) {
                        setState(
                          () => _message =
                              error ??
                              'Test notification sent. Check this device.',
                        );
                      }
                    },
              child: const Text('Send a test notification'),
            ),
            if (_message != null) Text(_message!),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
````

## Source: mobile/lib/screens/desk_screen.dart

````text
/// The desk: the deadline, what is waiting on you, and the day so far.
///
/// This is the screen the app exists for. The daily loop is
///
///   1. is anything waiting on me, and how long have I got
///   2. read it properly, above the fold first
///   3. decide
///
/// and all three now happen without leaving this page. The design this replaces
/// split them: the countdown lived on Schedule, the drafts on Queue, so the
/// most urgent object in the product was rendered twice, in two shapes, one tab
/// apart. Here the next post due IS the first draft on the page, wearing its
/// countdown.
///
/// Order is by claim on your attention, not by category:
///
///   conditions   anything that makes the rest of the screen mean something
///                different — a stopped scheduler, a dead token
///   the lede     the next post out, at full weight
///   the desk     every other draft asking for a decision
///   stranded     posts that failed or were never confirmed
///   today        the rail — including the slots that chose silence
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/models.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/day_rail.dart';
import '../widgets/draft_card.dart';
import '../widgets/primitives.dart';
import 'draft_commands.dart';
import 'settings_screen.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';
import '../widgets/preparation_progress.dart';

class DeskScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const DeskScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final status = state.status;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: state.refresh,
      backgroundColor: C.ink2,
      color: C.filament,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, S.x4, S.x4, S.x7),
        children: [
          _Masthead(state: state),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
          const StudioBanner(
            compact: true,
            title: 'Good ideas start here.',
            eyebrow: 'ON YOUR DESK',
            caption: 'A place to read, refine and make each post your own.',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
          if (status == null)
            const _Waiting()
          else
            ..._body(context, state, status),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Widget> _body(BuildContext context, AppState state, AppStatus status) {
    final queue = status.queue;
    final next = status.nextDue;
    final drafts = queue
        .where(
          (p) =>
              p.isDraft ||
              (p.status == 'approved' && p.isScheduled && p.isCleared),
        )
        .toList();
    // Stranded means "this went wrong and needs a hand". A post that has been
    // cleared is 'approved' on the server too, so without the schedule check a
    // perfectly healthy cleared draft was filed under "needs a hand" and told
    // the reader its publish had failed — while ALSO appearing above as the
    // lede, which is the same post twice on one screen.
    final stranded = queue
        .where(
          (p) =>
              !p.isDraft &&
              !p.isPublished &&
              p.seq != next?.seq &&
              !(p.isScheduled && p.isCleared),
        )
        .toList();
    final rest = drafts.where((p) => p.seq != next?.seq).toList();
    final today =
        status.timeline.where((e) => e.runDate == _localToday()).toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => a.localTime.compareTo(b.localTime));

    return [
      ..._conditions(context, state, status),
      if (state.generation?['state'] == 'failed') ...[
        Text('Draft preparation could not finish', style: T.bodyStrong),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          state.generation?['error'] as String? ??
              'Please try preparing the draft again.',
          style: T.body,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
      ],
      if (state.preparingDraft) ...[
        PreparationProgress(
          progress: {
            'state': 'working',
            'stage': state.generation?['stage'] ?? 'discovering',
            'completed': [
              'discovering',
              'judging',
              'writing',
              'saving',
            ].indexOf(state.generation?['stage'] ?? 'discovering').clamp(0, 3),
          },
        ),
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
          child: Text(
            'You can close ByLine. We’ll notify you when the draft is ready or needs attention.',
          ),
        ),
      ],

      // The lede. One object, wearing its own deadline.
      if (next != null) ...[
        DraftCard(
          post: next,
          hero: true,
          emphasis: true,
          busy: state.loading,
          actions: commandsFor(context, next),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
      ],

      if (rest.isNotEmpty) ...[
        SectionRule(
          next == null ? 'On the desk' : 'Also on the desk',
          tone: Tone.desk,
          trailing: Text(
            '${rest.length}',
            style: T.data.copyWith(color: C.filament),
          ),
        ),
        for (final post in rest) ...[
          DraftCard(
            post: post,
            busy: state.loading,
            actions: commandsFor(context, post),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
      ],

      if (stranded.isNotEmpty) ...[
        const SectionRule('Needs a hand', tone: Tone.broken),
        for (final post in stranded) ...[
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: S.x2),
            child: Text(explainStranded(post.status), style: T.small),
          ),
          DraftCard(
            post: post,
            busy: state.loading,
            actions: commandsFor(
              context,
              post,
              actionable: post.status != 'unknown',
            ),
          ),
          if (post.status == 'unknown')
            OutlinedButton(
              onPressed: state.loading
                  ? null
                  : () => resolveSend(context, post),
              child: const Text('Confirm publishing result'),
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
      ],

      if (next == null &&
          drafts.isEmpty &&
          stranded.isEmpty &&
          !state.loading &&
          !state.preparingDraft)
        Empty(
          icon: Icons.done_all,
          title: 'Nothing on the desk',
          blurb: status.slots.isEmpty
              ? 'There are no posting times set yet, so the agent has nothing to write to. '
                    'Add one in Settings → Timetable.'
              : 'The agent reads on its timetable and stays quiet on days when nothing '
                    'clears the bar. Check the Archive to see what it passed over.',
          actionLabel: 'Ask it to write one now',
          onAction: state.loading || (state.agent?.paused ?? false)
              ? null
              : () => runCycleNow(context),
        ),

      if (today.isNotEmpty) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
        const SectionRule('Today'),
        DayRail(entries: today),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
      ] else if (drafts.isNotEmpty) ...[
        const SectionRule('Today'),
        Text(
          next == null
              ? 'No posting time has run yet today.'
              : 'The first posting time of the day has not reported in yet.',
          style: T.small,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
      ],

      // The agent's counterpart to the write button: this one asks IT to write.
      // Named to be unmistakably different from writing something yourself.
      if (drafts.isNotEmpty || stranded.isNotEmpty)
        OutlinedButton.icon(
          onPressed:
              state.loading ||
                  state.preparingDraft ||
                  (state.agent?.paused ?? false)
              ? null
              : () => runCycleNow(context),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_outlined, size: 17),
          label: const Text('Ask the agent to write one now'),
        ),
      if (state.agent?.paused ?? false)
        const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: S.x2),
          child: Text(
            'Paused — turn it back on in Settings → Timetable.',
            style: T.micro,
          ),
        ),
    ];
  }

  /// Anything that changes what the rest of the screen means, ONE LINE EACH.
  ///
  /// These sit between the reader and the thing with a countdown, so they have
  /// to earn their height. The first cut of this screen used the full
  /// three-line [Notice] and stacked two of them — an expiring token and a dry
  /// run — which between them pushed the deadline off the bottom of a 390pt
  /// phone. The explanation belongs on the settings page that owns the problem;
  /// here, one line and a way to get there.
  ///
  /// Dry run is deliberately NOT in this list. The masthead already carries it
  /// as a state chip forty pixels above, it is a standing condition rather than
  /// news, and it would otherwise be the permanent first thing on the screen
  /// for as long as live mode stays off — which is on purpose, for days.
  List<Widget> _conditions(
    BuildContext context,
    AppState state,
    AppStatus status,
  ) {
    final out = <Widget>[];

    void add(Widget w) {
      out.add(w);
      out.add(const SizedBox(height: S.x2));
    }

    if (!status.scheduler.healthy) {
      add(
        ConditionStrip(
          tone: Tone.broken,
          icon: Icons.cloud_off,
          text: status.scheduler.neverRan
              ? 'The scheduler never started — no posting time will fire'
              : 'The scheduler stopped — posting times will not fire',
          onTap: () => openTimetable(context),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (status.account.needsReauth) {
      add(
        ConditionStrip(
          tone: Tone.broken,
          icon: Icons.link_off,
          text: 'LinkedIn access expired — nothing can publish',
          onTap: () => openLinkedIn(context),
        ),
      );
    } else if (status.account.expiringSoon) {
      add(
        ConditionStrip(
          tone: Tone.desk,
          icon: Icons.schedule,
          text:
              'LinkedIn access expires in ${status.account.daysRemaining} days',
          onTap: () => openLinkedIn(context),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (state.error != null) add(ErrorNote(state.error!));

    if (out.isNotEmpty) out.add(const SizedBox(height: S.x2));
    return out;
  }

  static String _localToday() {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    return '${now.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${now.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${now.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }
}

/// The date, the name of the page, and what the agent is currently doing.
///
/// A masthead rather than an app bar: the Desk earns the full width, and the
/// state words here are the answer to "why is nothing happening" — paused, dry
/// run, waiting on you — which is otherwise a trip into settings.
class _Masthead extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Masthead({required this.state});

  final AppState state;

  static const _days = ['MON', 'TUE', 'WED', 'THU', 'FRI', 'SAT', 'SUN'];
  static const _months = [
    'JAN',
    'FEB',
    'MAR',
    'APR',
    'MAY',
    'JUN',
    'JUL',
    'AUG',
    'SEP',
    'OCT',
    'NOV',
    'DEC',
  ];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final status = state.status;
    final agent = state.agent;
    final waiting = state.onTheDesk;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Text(
              '${_days[now.weekday - 1]}  ${now.day}  ${_months[now.month - 1]}',
              style: T.slug,
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            WriteButton(onTap: () => writeSomething(context)),
            const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
            if (state.loading)
              const SizedBox(
                height: 16,
                width: 16,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
              )
            else
              IconButton(
                onPressed: state.refresh,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh, size: 20),
                tooltip: 'Refresh',
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 32, minHeight: 32),
              ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
        Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
          textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
          children: [
            const Text('The desk', style: T.display),
            const SizedBox(width: S.x3),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                waiting > 0 ? '$waiting waiting on you' : 'nothing waiting',
                style: T.slug.copyWith(
                  color: waiting > 0 ? C.filament : C.paperFaint,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (status != null && agent != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
          Wrap(
            spacing: S.x2,
            runSpacing: S.x2,
            children: [
              // Colour marks the ABNORMAL case only. All three of these lit up
              // in three different colours on a perfectly ordinary day, which
              // is three colours saying nothing. Paused, dry run and
              // publishes-itself are the three states that would make someone
              // say "wait, what?" — their opposites are the quiet default.
              Slug(
                agent.paused ? 'paused' : 'running',
                tone: agent.paused ? Tone.desk : Tone.quiet,
                icon: agent.paused ? Icons.pause : null,
              ),
              Slug(
                status.liveMode ? 'live' : 'dry run',
                tone: status.liveMode ? Tone.quiet : Tone.desk,
              ),
              Slug(
                agent.autoPublish ? 'publishes itself' : 'waits for you',
                tone: agent.autoPublish ? Tone.desk : Tone.quiet,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// First load, before any status has arrived. A skeleton of the shape that is
/// coming, rather than a spinner in the middle of an empty page — the layout
/// should not jump when the data lands.
class _Waiting extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Waiting();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      for (final height in [120.0, 220.0])
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: S.x3),
          child: Container(
            height: height,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: C.ink2,
              border: Border.all(color: C.rule),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.md),
            ),
          ),
        ),
    ],
  );
}
````
