````text
/// Everything you can do to a post, in one place.
///
/// The Desk and the Archive both render posts and both need the same verbs, so
/// the confirmations, the wording and the undo live here rather than being
/// written twice and drifting apart.
///
/// Two rules run through all of it:
///
///   * Anything irreversible on LinkedIn's side asks first — including in dry
///     run, so the habit is identical when live mode is on.
///   * Anything reversible does NOT ask, and offers undo instead. Clearing a
///     draft is one tap away from being un-cleared until its time comes, so a
///     dialog in front of it would be a tax on the action you take most.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/models.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/draft_card.dart';
import 'composer_screen.dart';

/// Build the action set for [post].
///
/// [actionable] is false for an ambiguous send — one LinkedIn never confirmed —
/// which must not be republished blind.
DraftActions commandsFor(
  BuildContext context,
  Post post, {
  bool actionable = true,
}) {
  if (post.status == 'unknown') return const DraftActions();
  if (!actionable) return const DraftActions();

  if (post.isPublished) {
    // The one thing still worth doing with a post that has gone out. Answers
    // with text and saves nothing, then opens the composer with it loaded.
    return DraftActions(onFollowUp: () => followUp(context, post.seq));
  }

  return DraftActions(
    // On a scheduled post the primary action clears it for its own time. On an
    // unscheduled one there is no time to clear it for, so sending is the only
    // thing approving can mean.
    onClear:
        post.isScheduled &&
            !post.isCleared &&
            post.scheduledFor!.isAfter(DateTime.now())
        ? () => clearForItsTime(context, post)
        : null,
    onSendNow: () => sendNow(context, post),
    // Offered on every unpublished draft, whether or not it came from a slot.
    // A post from the agent arrives with its slot's time; one from "run a cycle
    // now" or the composer arrives with none, and this is how it gets one.
    onSchedule: () => pickSendTime(context, post),
    onUnschedule: post.isScheduled ? () => removeSendTime(context, post) : null,
    onDiscard: () => discard(context, post),
    onEdit: () => context.read<AppState>().startEditing(post),
  );
}

/// "I have read it. Let it go at its time."
///
/// NOT publishing, and the difference is the point of the whole schedule.
/// Nothing reaches LinkedIn now, so it does not need the irreversibility
/// warning that [sendNow] does — it is one tap from reversible until the time
/// comes, and the snackbar says so.
Future<void> clearForItsTime(BuildContext context, Post post) async {
  final state = context.read<AppState>();
  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  final at = post.scheduledFor;
  final error = await state.clear(post.seq, reviewed: post);
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(
      content: Text(
        error ??
            'Scheduled — publishes ${at == null ? "at its time" : whenLabel(at)}.',
      ),
      action: error != null
          ? null
          : SnackBarAction(
              label: 'Undo',
              onPressed: () => state.unclear(post.seq),
            ),
    ),
  );
}

/// Publishing is irreversible on LinkedIn's side, so it always asks.
Future<void> sendNow(BuildContext context, Post post) async {
  final state = context.read<AppState>();
  final live = state.status?.liveMode ?? false;
  final scheduled = post.scheduledFor;

  final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
    context: context,
    builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
      title: Text(live ? 'Publish now?' : 'Publish now (dry run)?'),
      content: Text(
        !live
            ? 'Live mode is off, so nothing will actually reach LinkedIn.'
            : scheduled != null
            ? 'This posts to your profile immediately, instead of ${whenLabel(scheduled)}. '
                  'It cannot be unpublished from here.'
            : 'This posts to your profile now. It cannot be unpublished from here.',
        style: T.small,
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
          child: const Text('Cancel'),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
          child: const Text('Publish now'),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  if (ok != true || !context.mounted) return;

  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  final error = await state.sendNow(post.seq, reviewed: post);
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(content: Text(error ?? 'Published ${post.id}.')),
  );
}

/// Give this one post a send time.
///
/// A plain time picker, not a date picker: "publish this at 21:00" is how the
/// decision is actually made. A time that has already passed today means
/// tomorrow, because nobody picking 07:00 at midnight means seven hours ago.
Future<void> pickSendTime(BuildContext context, Post post) async {
  final state = context.read<AppState>();
  final existing = post.scheduledFor;
  final picked = await showTimePicker(
    context: context,
    initialTime: existing != null
        ? TimeOfDay(hour: existing.hour, minute: existing.minute)
        : TimeOfDay.now(),
    helpText: 'SEND THIS POST AT',
  );
  if (picked == null || !context.mounted) return;

  final now = DateTime.now();
  var when = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day, picked.hour, picked.minute);
  if (!when.isAfter(now)) when = when.add(const Duration(days: 1));

  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  final error = await state.reschedule(post.seq, when);
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(
      content: Text(
        error ??
            'Sends ${whenLabel(when)}. Schedule it before then or publish it manually.',
      ),
    ),
  );
}

Future<void> removeSendTime(BuildContext context, Post post) async {
  final state = context.read<AppState>();
  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  final error = await state.reschedule(post.seq, null);
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(
      content: Text(error ?? 'Send time removed. It waits for you now.'),
    ),
  );
}

Future<void> discard(BuildContext context, Post post) async {
  final state = context.read<AppState>();
  final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
    context: context,
    builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('Discard this draft?'),
      content: const Text(
        'It leaves the queue, and the story will not be written about again.',
        style: T.small,
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
          child: const Text('Keep'),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: C.flare,
            foregroundColor: C.paper,
          ),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
          child: const Text('Discard'),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  if (ok != true || !context.mounted) return;

  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  final error = await state.discard(post.seq);
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(content: Text(error ?? 'Discarded ${post.id}.')),
  );
}

/// Ask for a follow-up, then hand it to the composer.
///
/// This is the slowest thing in the app and it is worth saying so. The writer
/// call is paced four seconds behind any other model call, then usually spends
/// a SECOND call repairing the draft to the author's word range — half a minute
/// is normal and a minute is not alarming.
///
/// The notice stays up until the work finishes rather than expiring after a few
/// seconds. A message that disappears while the request is still running reads
/// as the tap having been lost, which is exactly what this looked like before.
Future<void> followUp(BuildContext context, int seq) async {
  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    const SnackBar(
      content: Row(
        children: [
          SizedBox(
            width: 16,
            height: 16,
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
          ),
          SizedBox(width: S.x3),
          Expanded(
            child: Text('Writing a follow-up — this takes up to a minute.'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      // Effectively "until dismissed": hidden explicitly below. The server
      // gives up at 120s, so nothing can outlive this.
      duration: Duration(minutes: 3),
    ),
  );
  final error = await context.read<AppState>().followUp(seq);
  messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();
  if (error != null) {
    messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error)));
  }
  // On success the state bump opens the composer with the follow-up loaded;
  // see the compose request watcher in the shell.
}

/// Why a post is sitting outside the draft list, in the reader's terms.
String explainStranded(String status) => switch (status) {
  'approved' =>
    'This post has not been sent. Choose a publish time or use Publish now.',
  'failed' => 'The last send was rejected. Fix the text and try again.',
  'unknown' =>
    'LinkedIn never confirmed this send. Check your profile, then resolve it '
        'below before trying again.',
  'missed' => 'The send time passed. Choose a new time or use Publish now.',
  _ => '',
};

Future<void> resolveSend(BuildContext context, Post post) async {
  final state = context.read<AppState>();
  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  final didPublish = await showDialog<bool>(
    context: context,
    builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('Check your LinkedIn profile'),
      content: const Text(
        'Look for this exact post on your profile before choosing. If you cannot tell yet, cancel and check again later.',
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
          child: const Text('Cancel'),
        ),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
          child: const Text('Confirmed: not published'),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
          child: const Text('Confirmed: published'),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  if (didPublish == null) return;
  final error = await state.mutate(
    () => state.api.patch('/api/posts/${post.seq}', {
      'action': 'resolve',
      'didPublish': didPublish,
    }),
  );
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(
      content: Text(
        error ??
            (didPublish
                ? 'Marked as published.'
                : 'Returned to Drafts. Review it before sending again.'),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

/// Ask the agent to run a whole cycle right now, off the timetable.
Future<void> runCycleNow(BuildContext context) async {
  final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
  final error = await context.read<AppState>().runCycleNow();
  messenger.showSnackBar(
    SnackBar(
      content: Text(
        error ??
            'Started in the cloud. You can close ByLine; we’ll notify you when the draft is ready or needs attention.',
      ),
    ),
  );
}

/// Open the composer for a brand new post.
void writeSomething(BuildContext context) {
  context.read<AppState>().stopEditing();
  openComposer(context);
}
````

````text
/// Sign in, and say where the server is.
///
/// The address field is not a power-user setting — it is the first thing that
/// goes wrong. The Android emulator cannot reach the host on `localhost` (that
/// resolves to the emulated device), so this screen states the working value
/// rather than leaving it to be discovered.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/client.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/primitives.dart';

class GateScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const GateScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<GateScreen> createState() => _GateScreenState();
}

class _GateScreenState extends State<GateScreen> {
  late final TextEditingController _url;
  final _password = TextEditingController();
  bool _obscure = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _url = TextEditingController(text: context.read<AppState>().baseUrl);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _url.dispose();
    _password.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    await state.setBaseUrl(_url.text);
    final signedIn = await state.signIn(_password.text);
    if (signedIn && mounted && Navigator.of(context).canPop()) {
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();

    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Center(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(S.x5),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 420),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Text('THE DESK', style: T.slug.copyWith(color: C.filament)),
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
                  const Text('LinkdIn', style: T.display),
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
                  Text(
                    'Your posting agent reads overnight and waits for an editor.',
                    style: T.small,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x7),

                  Field(
                    label: 'Server address',
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: _url,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
                      autocorrect: false,
                      enabled: !state.loading,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        hintText: ApiClient.defaultBaseUrl,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Field(
                    label: 'Password',
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: _password,
                      obscureText: _obscure,
                      enabled: !state.loading,
                      onSubmitted: (_) => _submit(),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        hintText: 'APP_PASSWORD',
                        suffixIcon: IconButton(
                          icon: Icon(
                            _obscure ? Icons.visibility_off : Icons.visibility,
                            size: 19,
                          ),
                          color: C.paperFaint,
                          tooltip: _obscure ? 'Show password' : 'Hide password',
                          onPressed: () => setState(() => _obscure = !_obscure),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  FilledButton(
                    onPressed: state.loading ? null : _submit,
                    child: state.loading
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            height: 17,
                            width: 17,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                              strokeWidth: 2,
                              color: C.onFilament,
                            ),
                          )
                        : const Text('Sign in'),
                  ),
                  if (state.error != null) ErrorNote(state.error!),

                  const SizedBox(height: S.x6),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(S.x3),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: C.ink2,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
                      border: Border.all(color: C.rule),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text('RUNNING THE BACKEND LOCALLY?', style: T.slug),
                        const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
                        Text(
                          'Use 10.0.2.2 instead of localhost — inside the emulator, '
                          'localhost is the emulator itself, not your machine.',
                          style: T.micro,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
````

````text
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';
import '../widgets/profile_card.dart';
import '../widgets/form_select.dart';
import 'voice_screen.dart';
import 'timetable_screen.dart';
import 'archive_screen.dart';
import 'composer_screen.dart';
import 'desk_screen.dart';
import 'settings_screen.dart';
import 'today_screen.dart';

class HomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key, this.initialIndex = 0});

  /// Which destination to open on. Exists for the design preview and for tests,
  /// which otherwise have to reach a screen by tapping through a canvas.
  final int initialIndex;

  @override
  State<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}

class _HomeScreenState extends State<HomeScreen> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  late int _index = widget.initialIndex;
  int _seenComposeRequest = 0;
  int _seenTabRequest = 0;
  Timer? _recoveryTimer;
  bool _active = true;
  bool _refreshing = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _recoveryTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 15), (_) {
      final state = context.read<AppState>();
      if (state.error != null || state.status == null || state.preparingDraft) {
        _refreshAfterReturn();
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _refreshAfterReturn() async {
    if (!mounted || !_active || _refreshing) return;
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    if (state.phase != AuthPhase.signedIn) return;
    _refreshing = true;
    try {
      await state.refresh(quiet: true);
    } finally {
      _refreshing = false;
    }
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    _active = state == AppLifecycleState.resumed;
    if (_active) _refreshAfterReturn();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _recoveryTimer?.cancel();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();

    // "Edit this draft" and "write a follow-up" are both raised from app state
    // — by a card here, or by a notification. The composer is a route, so
    // something above the tabs has to push it.
    if (state.composeRequest != _seenComposeRequest) {
      _seenComposeRequest = state.composeRequest;
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        if (mounted) openComposer(context);
      });
    }

    // A tapped notification names the destination it is about — a failed send
    // opens the Desk, a stalled scheduler opens Settings. Landing on whatever
    // was already showing would make the tap feel like it did nothing.
    if (state.tabRequest != _seenTabRequest) {
      _seenTabRequest = state.tabRequest;
      final wanted = state.requestedTab;
      if (_index != wanted && wanted >= 0 && wanted < 3) {
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          if (mounted) setState(() => _index = wanted);
        });
      }
    }

    final wide = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 860;
    const labels = ['Home', 'My posts', 'Me'];
    const icons = [
      Icons.home_outlined,
      Icons.article_outlined,
      Icons.person_outline,
    ];
    final content = IndexedStack(
      index: _index,
      children: [
        state.api.isNativeSession ? const TodayScreen() : const DeskScreen(),
        const _PostsWorkspace(),
        const SettingsScreen(),
      ],
    );
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        toolbarHeight: wide ? 72 : 60,
        title: SizedBox(width: 140, child: const ByLineMark()),
        actions: [
          if (wide) ...[
            for (var i = 0; i < labels.length; i++)
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border(
                    bottom: BorderSide(
                      color: _index == i ? C.paper : Colors.transparent,
                      width: 2,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                child: TextButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () => setState(() => _index = i),
                  icon: i == 1
                      ? _PostsIcon(
                          pending: state.onTheDesk,
                          selected: _index == i,
                        )
                      : Icon(
                          icons[i],
                          color: _index == i ? C.paper : C.paperDim,
                        ),
                  label: Text(
                    labels[i],
                    style: T.bodyStrong.copyWith(
                      color: _index == i ? C.paper : C.paperDim,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            const SizedBox(width: 24),
          ] else
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Refresh ByLine',
              onPressed: state.refresh,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            ),
        ],
        bottom: const PreferredSize(
          preferredSize: Size.fromHeight(1),
          child: Divider(height: 1),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        bottom: false,
        child: ReadingWidth(
          width: 1080,
          child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              if (wide)
                SizedBox(
                  width: 250,
                  child: ListView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 20, 16, 24),
                    children: [
                      ProfileCard(onEdit: () => setState(() => _index = 2)),
                      const Divider(height: 24),
                      Material(
                        color: Colors.transparent,
                        child: Column(
                          children: [
                            ListTile(
                              leading: const Icon(Icons.edit_note),
                              title: const Text('My writing voice'),
                              onTap: () => _open(context, const VoiceScreen()),
                            ),
                            ListTile(
                              leading: const Icon(Icons.interests_outlined),
                              title: const Text('My interests'),
                              onTap: () => _open(context, const TopicsScreen()),
                            ),
                            ListTile(
                              leading: const Icon(Icons.schedule),
                              title: const Text('Timetable'),
                              onTap: () =>
                                  _open(context, const TimetableScreen()),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              Expanded(
                key: const ValueKey('workspace'),
                child: PageSurface(width: 820, child: content),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: wide
          ? null
          : NavigationBar(
              height: 72,
              backgroundColor: C.ink2,
              indicatorColor: Colors.transparent,
              selectedIndex: _index,
              onDestinationSelected: (i) => setState(() => _index = i),
              destinations: [
                NavigationDestination(
                  icon: Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
                  selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.home),
                  label: 'Home',
                ),
                NavigationDestination(
                  icon: _PostsIcon(
                    pending: state.onTheDesk,
                    selected: _index == 1,
                  ),
                  label: 'My posts',
                ),
                NavigationDestination(
                  icon: _SettingsIcon(
                    alert: state.needsAttention,
                    selected: _index == 2,
                  ),
                  label: 'Me',
                ),
              ],
            ),
    );
  }
}

void _open(BuildContext context, Widget page) =>
    Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => page));

class _PostsWorkspace extends StatefulWidget {
  const _PostsWorkspace();
  @override
  State<_PostsWorkspace> createState() => _PostsWorkspaceState();
}

class _PostsWorkspaceState extends State<_PostsWorkspace> {
  String _view = 'drafts';
  int _seenRequest = 0;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    if (_seenRequest != state.tabRequest) {
      _seenRequest = state.tabRequest;
      if (state.requestedTab == 1) _view = 'drafts';
    }
    return Column(
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 20, 16, 8),
          child: FormSelect<String>(
            label: 'My posts',
            value: _view,
            options: const {
              'drafts': 'Drafts & scheduled posts',
              'history': 'Published posts & source history',
            },
            onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _view = v),
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: IndexedStack(
            index: _view == 'drafts' ? 0 : 1,
            children: const [DeskScreen(), ArchiveScreen()],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// The My posts icon, badged with what needs a DECISION — not with what merely
/// exists. A cleared draft is still in the queue but is no longer asking
/// anything of you, and a badge that never clears is a badge people learn to
/// ignore.
class _PostsIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _PostsIcon({required this.pending, required this.selected});

  final int pending;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Badge(
    isLabelVisible: pending > 0,
    label: Text('$pending'),
    backgroundColor: C.filament,
    textColor: C.onFilament,
    child: Icon(selected ? Icons.article : Icons.article_outlined),
  );
}

/// Settings carries a dot, not a count: what is wrong there is a condition —
/// a stopped scheduler, an expired token — and a number would imply a list.
class _SettingsIcon extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SettingsIcon({required this.alert, required this.selected});

  final bool alert;
  final bool selected;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Badge(
    isLabelVisible: alert,
    backgroundColor: C.flare,
    smallSize: 7,
    child: Icon(selected ? Icons.person : Icons.person_outline),
  );
}
````

````text
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_timezone/flutter_timezone.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../api/client.dart';
import '../api/models.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../push.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';
import '../widgets/form_select.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';
import '../widgets/writing_preferences.dart';

class OnboardingScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OnboardingScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.initial,
    required this.onComplete,
  });
  final Map<String, dynamic> initial;
  final VoidCallback onComplete;
  @override
  State<OnboardingScreen> createState() => _OnboardingScreenState();
}

class _OnboardingScreenState extends State<OnboardingScreen> {
  late Map<String, dynamic> _data;
  late Map<String, dynamic> _config;
  final _samples = List.generate(3, (_) => TextEditingController());
  final _voiceNotes = TextEditingController();
  final _bannedPhrases = TextEditingController();
  final _topic = TextEditingController();
  final _zone = TextEditingController();
  int _step = 0;
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _error;
  Timer? _poll;
  bool get _test => _data['testMode'] == true;
  bool get _connected =>
      (_data['account'] as Map?)?['connected'] == true &&
      (_data['account'] as Map?)?['needsReauth'] != true;
  List<String> get _topics => List<String>.from(_config['topics'] as List);
  StyleConfig get _style => StyleConfig.fromJson({
    'signature': null,
    'register': _config['voice'] == 'professional' ? 'practitioner' : 'peer',
    'structure': _config['voice'] == 'punchy' ? 'short-lines' : 'prose',
    'minWords': _config['voice'] == 'punchy' ? 60 : 100,
    'maxWords': _config['voice'] == 'punchy' ? 140 : 200,
    ...Map<String, dynamic>.from((_config['style'] as Map?) ?? {}),
  });
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _data = widget.initial;
    _config = Map<String, dynamic>.from(_data['config'] as Map);
    final samples = List<String>.from(_config['samples'] as List);
    for (var i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
      _samples[i].text = samples[i];
    }
    _voiceNotes.text = _config['voiceNotes'] as String? ?? '';
    _bannedPhrases.text = _style.bannedPhrases.join('\n');
    _zone.text = _config['timezone'] as String;
    if (_data['accepted_revision'] != null) {
      _step = 4;
    } else if (_data['preview'] != null) {
      _step = 3;
    } else if (_connected) {
      _step = 1;
    }
    if (_data['revision'] == 0) {
      FlutterTimezone.getLocalTimezone()
          .then((v) {
            if (mounted) {
              setState(() {
                _zone.text = v.identifier;
                _config['timezone'] = v.identifier;
              });
            }
          })
          .catchError((_) {});
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _poll?.cancel();
    _voiceNotes.dispose();
    _bannedPhrases.dispose();
    _topic.dispose();
    _zone.dispose();
    for (final s in _samples) {
      s.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<bool> _action(
    String action, [
    Map<String, dynamic> extra = const {},
  ]) async {
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final response = await context.read<AppState>().api.post(
        '/api/onboarding',
        {'action': action, 'revision': _data['revision'], ...extra},
        kWriterTimeout,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(response as Map));
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = e.toString());
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _connect() async {
    final api = context.read<AppState>().api;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final url = await context.read<AppState>().linkedInConsentUrl();
      if (url == null) {
        throw Exception(
          'Could not start LinkedIn connection. Please try again.',
        );
      }
      if (!await launchUrl(
        Uri.parse(url),
        mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
      )) {
        throw Exception('Could not open LinkedIn.');
      }
      _poll?.cancel();
      var ticks = 0;
      _poll = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 3), (_) async {
        if (!mounted || ++ticks > 200) {
          _poll?.cancel();
          return;
        }
        try {
          final d = await api.get('/api/onboarding');
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() => _data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(d as Map));
            if (_connected) _poll?.cancel();
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = e.toString());
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _voiceContinue() async {
    _config['voiceNotes'] = _voiceNotes.text.trim();
    _config['samples'] = _samples
        .map((s) => s.text.trim())
        .where((s) => s.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    _config['timezone'] = _zone.text;
    if (await _action('save', {'config': _config}) && mounted) {
      setState(() => _step = 3);
      await _action('preview');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _defaultVoice() async {
    _voiceNotes.clear();
    _bannedPhrases.clear();
    for (final sample in _samples) {
      sample.clear();
    }
    setState(() {
      _config['voice'] = 'professional';
      _config.remove('style');
    });
    await _voiceContinue();
  }

  Future<void> _finish(bool ask) async {
    if (_busy) return;
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    String permission = 'later';
    if (ask) {
      permission = await startPush(context.read<AppState>());
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (await _action('finish', {
          'time': _config['time'],
          'timezone': _zone.text,
          'notifications': permission,
        }) &&
        mounted) {
      setState(() => _step = 6);
    }
  }

  Widget _button(String label, VoidCallback f) => Padding(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
    child: FilledButton(onPressed: _busy ? null : f, child: Text(label)),
  );
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final titles = [
      'Connect LinkedIn',
      'What do you talk about?',
      'Make it sound like you',
      'Your first sample',
      'When should we bring your post?',
      'One small daily habit',
      'You’re ready',
    ];
    final industries = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
      (_data['industries'] as List).map(
        (v) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(v as Map),

    final industry = industries.firstWhere(
      (i) => i['id'] == _config['industry'],

    final catalogue = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(

          (industry['categories'] as List?) ??
          [],
    );

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const ByLineMark(),
        leading: _step > 0 && _step < 6
            ? IconButton(
                onPressed: _busy ? null : () => setState(() => _step--),

            : null,
        actions: [
          TextButton(

        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(

                    ? 'WELCOME TO YOUR WRITING SPACE'
                    : 'MAKE BYLINE YOURS',
                caption: const [
                  'Your next chapter starts with a connection.',
                  'Follow the subjects that make you curious.',
                  'Bring your personality to the page.',
                  'See your ideas take shape.',
                  'Build a rhythm that works for you.',
                  'A small nudge. The final word is yours.',
                  'One thoughtful post at a time.',
                ][_step],
                scene: switch (_step) {
````

````text
/// Everything you set once and revisit — behind one index.
///
/// Three of the old five bottom-bar destinations were configuration, each
/// holding a permanent seat for something touched once a month. They are rows
/// here instead, and every row carries a LIVE SUMMARY: the timezone and the
/// posting times, the voice in a phrase, the topics, whether LinkedIn is
/// connected and for how much longer. Most questions this screen exists to
/// answer are answered without opening anything.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import '../api/models.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';
import '../widgets/form_select.dart';
import '../widgets/profile_card.dart';
import '../widgets/personal_topics.dart';
import '../widgets/primitives.dart';
import 'timetable_screen.dart';
import 'voice_screen.dart';
import 'delivery_settings_screen.dart';
import 'delete_account_screen.dart';

/// Fallback labels, used only when the server has not sent its categories yet —
/// a cold start, or a backend too old to serve them. The live list comes from
/// /api/status so adding a category needs no client release.
///
/// It has to list every id, not just the ones an early build shipped with: when
/// this held only the three original ids, a cold start rendered a picker with
/// four categories missing and no hint they existed.
const _fallbackCategoryLabels = {
  'music-tech-software': 'Music tech — software',
  'music-tech-hardware': 'Music tech — hardware',
  'emerging-tech': 'Emerging tech',
  'ai-ml': 'AI & ML engineering',
  'dev-tooling': 'Developer tooling',
  'hardware-embedded': 'Hardware & embedded',
  'compute-silicon': 'Compute & silicon',
};

/// When a quiet watchdog actually means something is wrong.
///
/// This was 90 minutes, against a watchdog that runs every THREE HOURS
/// (`.github/workflows/watchdog.yml`, `cron: "0 */3 * * *"`). A perfectly
/// healthy agent therefore spent half of every cycle showing a red alarm
/// saying the watchdog may have stopped — which is worse than no check at all,
/// because an alarm that cries wolf on schedule is one you learn to ignore.
///
/// Four hours: the 180-minute cadence, plus the 15-30 minutes GitHub's cron
/// routinely runs late (the workflow's own comments call this out), plus
/// margin. A genuinely dead watchdog still surfaces within about an hour.
const int kWatchdogStaleMinutes = 240;

/// The shared shape of every settings page: a plain title, a scrolling body,
/// and nothing else competing with it.
class SettingsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsPage({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.children,
    this.blurb,
  });

  final String title;
  final String? blurb;
  final List<Widget> children;

  @override
  State<SettingsPage> createState() => _SettingsPageState();
}

class _SettingsPageState extends State<SettingsPage> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Every page in here is a READOUT of status fetched somewhere else, and
    // some of it is time-sensitive — "last health check, 162 minutes ago" was
    // being rendered from a payload hours old, on an agent that had checked in
    // four minutes earlier. Quiet, so it does not flash a spinner over a screen
    // that already has content to show.
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) context.read<AppState>().refresh(quiet: true);
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.title)),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: PageSurface(
          child: RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: state.refresh,
            backgroundColor: C.ink2,
            color: C.filament,
            child: ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, S.x5, S.x4, S.x6),
              children: [
                if (widget.blurb != null) ...[
                  Text(widget.blurb!, style: T.small),
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
                ],
                ...widget.children,
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Jump straight to the page that owns a problem.
///
/// The Desk raises conditions but does not fix them; these are how a
/// one-line strip up there leads to the controls down here.
void openTimetable(BuildContext context) => Navigator.of(
  context,
).push(MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const TimetableScreen()));

void openLinkedIn(BuildContext context) => Navigator.of(
  context,
).push(MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const LinkedInScreen()));

class SettingsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const SettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final status = state.status;
    final agent = state.agent;

    if (status == null || agent == null) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
    }

    final labels = availableCategories(state);
    final chosen = labels.keys.where(agent.categories.contains).toList();

    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 20, 16, 32),
      children: [
        const ProfileCard(),
        const Divider(height: 24),
        FormSection(
          title: 'Writing preferences',
          description: 'Make every suggestion sound more like you.',
          child: Column(
            children: [
              NavRow(
                label: 'Voice',
                icon: Icons.edit_note,
                value: state.style.summary,
                onTap: () => _open(context, const VoiceScreen()),
              ),
              const Divider(),
              NavRow(
                label: 'Topics',
                icon: Icons.interests_outlined,
                value: chosen.isEmpty
                    ? 'Choose your interests'
                    : chosen.map((id) => labels[id] ?? id).join(' · '),
                onTap: () => _open(context, const TopicsScreen()),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const Divider(height: 24),
        FormSection(
          title: 'Schedule & notifications',
          child: Column(
            children: [
              if (state.api.isNativeSession) ...[
                NavRow(
                  label: 'Notifications',
                  icon: Icons.notifications_none,
                  value: '${agent.postTimeLocal} · ${agent.timezone}',
                  onTap: () => _open(context, const DeliverySettingsScreen()),
                ),
                const Divider(),
              ],
              NavRow(
                label: 'Timetable',
                icon: Icons.event_note,
                value: _timetableSummary(status, agent),
                tone: status.scheduler.healthy ? null : Tone.broken,
                onTap: () => _open(context, const TimetableScreen()),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const Divider(height: 24),
        FormSection(
          title: 'Account',
          child: Column(
            children: [
              NavRow(
                label: 'LinkedIn',
                icon: status.account.usable ? Icons.link : Icons.link_off,
                value: _accountSummary(status.account),
                tone: status.account.usable ? Tone.out : Tone.broken,
                onTap: () => _open(context, const LinkedInScreen()),
              ),
              const Divider(),
              NavRow(
                label: 'Diagnostics',
                icon: Icons.monitor_heart_outlined,
                value:
                    'Model usage, health checks, ${status.cycleCount} cycles run',
                onTap: () => _open(context, const DiagnosticsScreen()),
              ),
              const Divider(),
              ListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                leading: const Icon(Icons.logout),
                title: const Text('Sign out'),
                onTap: state.signOut,
              ),
              if (state.api.isNativeSession)
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, color: C.flare),
                  title: const Text(
                    'Delete ByLine account',
                    style: TextStyle(color: C.flare),
                  ),
                  onTap: () => _open(context, const DeleteAccountScreen()),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  static void _open(BuildContext context, Widget page) {
    Navigator.of(context).push(MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => page));
  }

  static String _timetableSummary(AppStatus status, Agent agent) {
    if (!status.scheduler.healthy) {
      return status.scheduler.neverRan
          ? 'The scheduler never started — no posting time will fire'
          : 'The scheduler stopped — posting times will not fire';
    }
    if (agent.paused) return 'Paused · ${agent.timezone}';
    final on = status.slots.where((s) => s.enabled).toList();
    if (on.isEmpty) return 'No posting times set · ${agent.timezone}';
    final times = on.map((s) => s.localTime).join(', ');
    return '$times · ${agent.timezone}';
  }

  static String _accountSummary(Account account) {
    if (!account.connected) return 'Not connected — nothing can publish';
    if (account.needsReauth) {
      return 'Access expired — reconnect to resume posting';
    }
    final days = account.daysRemaining;
    final who = account.memberName ?? 'Connected';
    return days == null ? who : '$who · $days days of access left';
  }
}

/// The categories to offer, preferring the server's list.
///
/// Falls back to the built-in map only when the server has sent none. Any
/// category the agent already has selected but the server did not list is
/// appended, so an id this build does not recognise stays visible and removable
/// rather than silently vanishing from the picker.
Map<String, String> availableCategories(AppState state) {
  final served = state.status?.categories ?? const <CategoryInfo>[];
  final out = <String, String>{};
  if (served.isEmpty) {
    out.addAll(_fallbackCategoryLabels);
  } else {
    for (final c in served) {
      out[c.id] = c.groupLabel == null
          ? c.label
          : '${c.label} · ${c.groupLabel}';
    }
  }
  for (final id in state.agent?.categories ?? const <String>[]) {
    out.putIfAbsent(id, () => id);
  }
  return out;
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------- linkedin

/// Connect or disconnect LinkedIn, from the phone.
///
/// Consent is an OAuth redirect and genuinely cannot happen inside the app's
/// own HTTP client — the screen needs a real browser, and the session that
/// comes back has to belong to one. So the app asks the server for the consent
/// URL (`/api/linkedin/connect?json=1`, which answers with the URL instead of a
/// 302) and hands it to the system browser.
class LinkedInScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LinkedInScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<LinkedInScreen> createState() => _LinkedInScreenState();
}

class _LinkedInScreenState extends State<LinkedInScreen> {
  bool _busy = false;

  Future<void> _connect() async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    setState(() => _busy = true);
    final url = await state.linkedInConsentUrl();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _busy = false);

    if (url == null) {
      messenger.showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            'Could not start the connection. Is the server reachable?',
          ),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final opened = await launchUrl(
      Uri.parse(url),
      mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
    );
    if (!mounted) return;
    messenger.showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          opened
              ? 'Finish in your browser. ByLine will refresh when you return.'
              : 'No browser could open the LinkedIn page.',
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _confirmDisconnect() async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Disconnect LinkedIn?'),
        content: const Text(
          'The stored token is deleted and nothing can publish until you reconnect. '
          'Your drafts and history are untouched.',
          style: T.small,
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: C.flare,
              foregroundColor: C.paper,
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Disconnect'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true || !mounted) return;

    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final error = await state.disconnectLinkedIn();
    messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error ?? 'Disconnected.')));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final account = state.status?.account;
    if (account == null) {
      return const SettingsPage(title: 'LinkedIn', children: []);
    }

    final busy = _busy || state.loading;
    final connected = account.connected;

    return SettingsPage(
      title: 'LinkedIn',
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              account.usable ? Icons.check_circle_outline : Icons.error_outline,
              size: 18,
              color: account.usable ? C.daylight : C.flare,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                connected
                    ? (account.memberName ?? 'Connected')
                    : 'Not connected',
                style: T.body,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (account.daysRemaining != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
          Text(
            'Access valid for ${account.daysRemaining} more days. LinkedIn tokens last '
            '60 days and cannot refresh themselves.',
            style: T.small,
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: busy ? null : _connect,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.link, size: 17),
                // Reconnecting an expiring token is the same round trip as a
                // first connection, but calling it "Connect" when something is
                // already connected reads as though it would replace nothing.
                label: Text(connected ? 'Reconnect' : 'Connect LinkedIn'),
              ),
            ),
            if (connected) ...[
              const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
              OutlinedButton(
                onPressed: busy ? null : _confirmDisconnect,
                child: const Text('Disconnect'),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
        Text(
          connected
              ? 'Reconnecting opens LinkedIn in your browser and issues a fresh 60-day token.'
              : 'Opens LinkedIn in your browser to approve posting access.',
          style: T.micro,
        ),
        if (account.lastError != null) ErrorNote(account.lastError!),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------- diagnostics

class DiagnosticsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const DiagnosticsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final status = state.status;
    if (status == null) {
      return const SettingsPage(title: 'Diagnostics', children: []);
    }

    final watchdog = status.watchdogMinutesSince;

    return SettingsPage(
      title: 'Diagnostics',
      children: [
        const SectionRule('Model usage today'),
        Text(
          'Quotas are per model, so the cascade stacks them.',
          style: T.micro,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
        if (status.llm.isEmpty)
          Text('No model calls recorded today.', style: T.small)
        else
          for (final usage in status.llm)
            Readout(
              usage.model,
              usage.cap > 0
                  ? '${usage.calls} / ${usage.cap}'
                  : '${usage.calls}',
            ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),

        const SectionRule('Health'),
        // The safety net's own pulse. The watchdog is what notices the agent
        // dying; nothing noticed the watchdog dying, and it runs somewhere that
        // switches scheduled jobs off after sixty quiet days. A number that
        // keeps climbing here is the only sign that would ever appear.
        if (watchdog != null)
          Readout(
            'Last health check',
            '$watchdog min ago',
            tone: watchdog < kWatchdogStaleMinutes ? Tone.out : Tone.broken,
          ),
        if (watchdog != null && watchdog >= kWatchdogStaleMinutes) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
          Text(
            'Nothing has pinged the health check in over four hours — the watchdog '
            'itself may have stopped. Check the schedule on the watchdog workflow.',
            style: T.micro.copyWith(color: C.flare),
          ),
        ],
        Readout(
          'Scheduler',
          status.scheduler.healthy ? 'running' : 'stopped',
          tone: status.scheduler.healthy ? Tone.out : Tone.broken,
        ),
        Readout('Cycles run', '${status.cycleCount}'),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x5),

        const SectionRule('Server'),
        Text(state.baseUrl, style: T.mono),
      ],
    );
  }
}
````

````text
/// When this agent posts, and what it is allowed to do without you.
///
/// The whole scheduling feature in one place. What used to be here and is not
/// any more: the day's rail and "run a cycle now", both of which are about
/// TODAY and belong on the Desk with the drafts they produce. What is left is
/// the recurring shape of a week, and the two switches that decide whether
/// anything can reach LinkedIn unattended.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/models.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/form_select.dart';
import '../widgets/primitives.dart';
import 'settings_screen.dart';

/// Bit per weekday, 0 = Sunday — matching lib/schedule.ts, JS getDay() and
/// Postgres DOW. Rendered Monday-first because that is how a working week reads.
const _dayOrder = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0];
const _maskWeekdays = 0x3E;

class TimetableScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const TimetableScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final status = state.status;
    final agent = state.agent;
    if (status == null || agent == null) {
      return const SettingsPage(title: 'Timetable', children: []);
    }

    return SettingsPage(
      title: 'Timetable',
      children: [
        const Text('Your posting schedule', style: T.title),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        const Text(
          'Choose up to five posting times. Each enabled time has its own post on Home. New posts wait for you unless you explicitly enable automatic publishing.',
          style: T.small,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 24),
        // Above everything: when this is wrong, nothing else on the screen
        // means what it appears to mean.
        if (!status.scheduler.healthy) ...[
          Notice(
            tone: Tone.broken,
            icon: Icons.cloud_off,
            title: status.scheduler.neverRan
                ? 'The scheduler never started'
                : 'The scheduler stopped',
            body: status.scheduler.neverRan
                ? 'Nothing has ever called the scheduler on this server, so none of the '
                      'times below will fire. Check the connection and contact support if this continues.'
                : 'Nothing has checked in recently. None of the times below will fire '
                      'until it is running again.',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
        ],

        FormSelect<int>(
          label: 'Number of posting times',
          value: status.slots.isEmpty ? null : status.slots.length,
          options: const {
            1: '1 post per scheduled day',
            2: '2 posts per scheduled day',
            3: '3 posts per scheduled day',
            4: '4 posts per scheduled day',
            5: '5 posts per scheduled day',
          },
          onChanged: state.loading
              ? null
              : (count) async {
                  final error = await state.mutate(
                    () => state.api.post('/api/slots', {
                      'action': 'count',
                      'count': count,
                    }),
                  );
                  if (context.mounted && error != null) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(
                      context,
                    ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error)));
                  }
                },
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        const Text(
          'One post per enabled time on its selected days. Timetable changes affect future drafts. Change an existing post’s time on its card. Reducing the number removes the last times; saved posts stay in My posts.',
          style: T.small,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
        SectionRule(
          'Posting times',
          trailing: Text(
            '${status.slots.where((s) => s.enabled).length} / ${status.slotLimits.maxSlots}',
            style: T.data.copyWith(fontSize: 12.5),
          ),
        ),
        Text(
          'Each posting time has a draft waiting for you before it goes out, so you '
          'always get the review window you asked for.',
          style: T.micro,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x4),

        if (status.slots.isEmpty)
          Text(
            'No posting times yet. Add one to start your schedule.',
            style: T.small,
          )
        else
          for (final slot in status.slots) ...[
            _SlotCard(
              slot: slot,
              canRemove: state.api.isNativeSession || status.slots.length > 1,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
          ],

        const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
        if (state.canAddSlot)
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            onPressed: state.loading ? null : () => _addSlot(context),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 17),
            label: const Text('Add a posting time'),
          )
        else
          Text(
            'You have all ${status.slotLimits.maxSlots} posting times. '
            'Remove one to add another.',
            style: T.micro,
          ),

        const SizedBox(height: S.x6),
        const SectionRule('Publishing'),
        NavRow(
          label: 'Timezone',
          // Every posting time is read in this zone, so changing it moves the
          // whole timetable — the server reschedules each slot on the way.
          value: agent.timezone,
          onTap: state.loading ? null : () => _editTimezone(context, agent),
        ),
        const Divider(),
        SwitchRow(
          title: 'Paused',
          blurb: 'Stops every posting time. Drafts and history are untouched.',
          value: agent.paused,
          onChanged: state.loading ? null : state.setPaused,
        ),
        const Divider(),
        SwitchRow(
          title: 'Publish without me',
          blurb: status.account.usable
              ? 'The master switch. Individual times can still be set to wait for you.'
              : 'Connect LinkedIn before enabling this.',
          value: agent.autoPublish,
          onChanged: state.loading || !status.account.usable
              ? null
              : state.setAutoPublish,
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: S.x6),
        ExpansionTile(
          tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          title: const Text('Advanced publishing limits'),
          children: [
            const SectionRule('Automatic publishing limit'),
            Text(
              'An optional lower limit on automatic publishing. This does not set how many drafts are prepared. It follows how many '
              'posting times you have, so you should rarely need to touch it. Your own '
              'posts do not count against it.',
              style: T.micro,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
            _CapStepper(
              value: agent.autoPublishCap,
              max: status.maxAutoCap,
              enabled: !state.loading,
              onChanged: state.setAutoPublishCap,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
            _Budget(
              label: 'Agent published',
              used: status.budget.autoUsed,
              cap: status.budget.autoCap,
              tone: status.budget.autoExhausted ? Tone.desk : Tone.out,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
            _Budget(
              label: 'You published',
              used: status.budget.manualUsed,
              cap: status.budget.manualCap,
              tone: Tone.quiet,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
            Text(
              'Your own publishing is limited only by LinkedIn, which allows about '
              '${status.budget.linkedinDailyRequests} API calls a day across posts, image '
              'uploads and token checks.',
              style: T.micro,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Future<void> _addSlot(BuildContext context) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final picked = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: const TimeOfDay(hour: 9, minute: 30),
      helpText: 'NEW POSTING TIME',
    );
    if (picked == null) return;

    // Weekdays by default rather than daily: several posts a day every single
    // day is a volume almost nobody actually wants, and it is easier to add
    // weekends than to notice you are posting 21 times a week.
    final error = await state.addSlot(
      localTime:
          '${picked.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
          '${picked.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
      daysMask: _maskWeekdays,
    );
    if (error != null) messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error)));
  }

  Future<void> _editTimezone(BuildContext context, Agent agent) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final controller = TextEditingController(text: agent.timezone);
    final value = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Timezone'),
        content: TextField(
          controller: controller,
          autofocus: true,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(hintText: 'Asia/Kolkata'),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, controller.text.trim()),
            child: const Text('Save'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return;
    // An unrecognised zone is not rejected — lib/schedule.ts falls back to UTC
    // and logs, so a typo shows up as a wrong next-run time rather than a crash.
    final error = await state.setTimezone(value);
    if (error != null) messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error)));
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------- slots

/// One recurring posting time. A card, because it is an object you act on.
class _SlotCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SlotCard({required this.slot, required this.canRemove});

  final PostSlot slot;
  final bool canRemove;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final busy = state.loading;
    final limits = state.slotLimits;

    return ObjectCard(
      tone: slot.enabled ? Tone.desk : null,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(S.x3),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              InkWell(
                onTap: busy ? null : () => _pickTime(context),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: S.x1,
                    vertical: S.x1,
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    slot.localTime,
                    style: T.clock.copyWith(
                      fontSize: 30,
                      letterSpacing: -0.8,
                      color: slot.enabled ? C.paper : C.paperFaint,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: S.x3),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(slot.daysLabel, style: T.small),
                    if (slot.enabled && slot.nextRunLocal != null)
                      Text('Next ${slot.nextRunLocal}', style: T.micro),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Switch(
                value: slot.enabled,
                onChanged: busy
                    ? null
                    : (v) => state.setSlotEnabled(slot.id, v),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
          _DayPicker(
            mask: slot.daysMask,
            enabled: !busy && slot.enabled,
            onChanged: (m) => state.setSlotDays(slot.id, m),
          ),
          const Divider(color: C.rule, height: S.x5),
          _LeadRow(slot: slot, limits: limits, enabled: !busy && slot.enabled),
          const Divider(color: C.rule, height: S.x5),
          // Scoped wording on purpose. This toggle and the master switch on the
          // page below used to share the label "Publish without me", which is
          // the kind of duplicate that makes a screen impossible to reason
          // about — two controls, same words, different reach.
          SwitchRow(
            title: 'This time publishes itself',
            blurb: slot.autoPublish
                ? 'Goes out at ${slot.localTime} whether or not you have read it.'
                : 'Waits for you to choose Schedule post or Publish now.',
            value: slot.autoPublish,
            onChanged: busy || !slot.enabled
                ? null
                : (v) => _confirmAutoPublish(context, v),
          ),
          if (slot.categories.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
            Wrap(
              spacing: S.x2,
              runSpacing: S.x2,
              children: [
                for (final c in slot.categories)
                  Slug(state.status?.categoryLabel(c) ?? c),
              ],
            ),
          ],
          if (canRemove) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
            Align(
              alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
              child: TextButton.icon(
                onPressed: busy ? null : () => _confirmRemove(context),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 17),
                label: const Text('Remove'),
                style: TextButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: C.paperFaint),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _pickTime(BuildContext context) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final parts = slot.localTime.split(':');
    final picked = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: TimeOfDay(
        hour: int.tryParse(parts.first) ?? 9,
        minute: int.tryParse(parts.last) ?? 30,
      ),
      helpText: 'POSTING TIME',
    );
    if (picked == null) return;
    await state.setSlotTime(
      slot.id,
      '${picked.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${picked.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
    );
  }

  /// Turning this ON is the one setting here that can put unreviewed text on a
  /// real profile, so it asks. Turning it off never does.
  Future<void> _confirmAutoPublish(BuildContext context, bool value) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    if (!value) {
      await state.setSlotAutoPublish(slot.id, false);
      return;
    }

    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Publish without reading it?'),
        content: Text(
          'The ${slot.localTime} time will post to your profile on its own, even if you '
          'never open the draft. You can still edit or stop it during the '
          '${slot.leadMinutes}-minute window before it sends.',
          style: T.small,
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Turn on'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    await state.setSlotAutoPublish(slot.id, true);
  }

  Future<void> _confirmRemove(BuildContext context) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text('Remove the ${slot.localTime} time?'),
        content: const Text(
          'Drafts it already made stay on the desk. Nothing new will be written for it.',
          style: T.small,
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Keep'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: C.flare,
              foregroundColor: C.onFilament,
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Remove'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    final error = await state.removeSlot(slot.id);
    if (error != null) messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error)));
  }
}

/// A summarized weekday field opens a staged checklist.
class _DayPicker extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DayPicker({
    required this.mask,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onChanged,
  });
  final int mask;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<int> onChanged;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MultiSelectField(
    label: 'Days of the week',
    options: const {
      '1': 'Monday',
      '2': 'Tuesday',
      '3': 'Wednesday',
      '4': 'Thursday',
      '5': 'Friday',
      '6': 'Saturday',
      '0': 'Sunday',
    },
    values: [
      for (final day in _dayOrder)
        if ((mask & (1 << day)) != 0) '$day',
    ],
    onChanged: enabled
        ? (v) => onChanged(v.fold<int>(0, (a, d) => a | (1 << int.parse(d))))
        : null,
  );
}

/// The review window. Stepped in fives rather than typed, because the exact
/// number does not matter and a stepper cannot produce a value the server has
/// to clamp.
class _LeadRow extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LeadRow({
    required this.slot,
    required this.limits,
    required this.enabled,
  });

  final PostSlot slot;
  final SlotLimits limits;
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final value = slot.leadMinutes;

    return Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text('Time to review', style: T.bodyStrong),
              // "Waiting for you", not "written" — the agent starts earlier
              // than this so the finished draft is on the desk when the window
              // opens. Promising the moment work BEGINS would promise the
              // wrong thing.
              Text(
                'On your desk this long before it goes out, at least.',
                style: T.micro,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
        _Step(
          icon: Icons.remove,
          label: 'Less review time',
          onTap: enabled && value - 5 >= limits.minLeadMinutes
              ? () => state.setSlotLead(slot.id, value - 5)
              : null,
        ),
        SizedBox(
          width: 52,
          child: Text(
            value >= 60
                ? '${(value / 60).toStringAsFixed(value % 60 == 0 ? 0 : 1)}h'
                : '${value}m',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: T.data.copyWith(fontSize: 16, color: C.paper),
          ),
        ),
        _Step(
          icon: Icons.add,
          label: 'More review time',
          onTap: enabled && value + 5 <= limits.maxLeadMinutes
              ? () => state.setSlotLead(slot.id, value + 5)
              : null,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _Step extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Step({required this.icon, required this.onTap, required this.label});

  final IconData icon;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final String label;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => IconButton(
    onPressed: onTap,
    icon: Icon(icon, size: 18),
    tooltip: label,
    style: IconButton.styleFrom(
      minimumSize: const Size(kMinTouch, kMinTouch),
      backgroundColor: C.ink3,
      foregroundColor: onTap == null ? C.paperFaint : C.paper,
      side: const BorderSide(color: C.ruleStrong),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm)),
    ),
  );
}

class _CapStepper extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CapStepper({
    required this.value,
    required this.max,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final int value;
  final int max;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<int> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Wrap(
    spacing: S.x2,
    runSpacing: S.x2,
    crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
    children: [
      for (var n = 1; n <= max; n++)
        Semantics(
          selected: n == value,
          button: true,
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: enabled && n != value ? () => onChanged(n) : null,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
            child: Container(
              width: 52,
              height: kMinTouch,
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: n == value ? C.filamentWash : C.ink2,
                border: Border.all(
                  color: n == value ? C.filament : C.ruleStrong,
                ),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
              ),
              child: Text(
                '$n',
                style: T.data.copyWith(
                  fontSize: 17,
                  color: n == value ? C.filament : C.paperDim,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: S.x2),
        child: Text(value == 1 ? 'post / day' : 'posts / day', style: T.micro),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

class _Budget extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Budget({
    required this.label,
    required this.used,
    required this.cap,
    required this.tone,
  });

  final String label;
  final int used;
  final int cap;
  final Tone tone;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: Text(label, style: T.body)),
          Text(
            '$used / $cap',
            style: T.data.copyWith(fontSize: 13, color: tone.ink),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
      Meter(value: cap == 0 ? 0 : used / cap, tone: tone),
    ],
  );
}
````
