````text
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../api/models.dart';
import '../api/client.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';
import '../widgets/draft_card.dart';
import '../widgets/preparation_progress.dart';
import 'composer_screen.dart';
import 'draft_commands.dart';
import 'timetable_screen.dart';

/// Home follows the timetable: one occurrence and one draft per enabled time.
class TodayScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const TodayScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<TodayScreen> createState() => _TodayScreenState();
}

class _TodayScreenState extends State<TodayScreen> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  Map<String, dynamic>? _day;
  String? _error;
  bool _polling = false,
      _starting = false,
      _active = true,
      _reconnecting = false;
  Timer? _timer;
  DateTime _nextPoll = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _poll(force: true));
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 3), (_) => _poll());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState lifecycle) {
    _active = lifecycle == AppLifecycleState.resumed;
    if (_active) _poll(force: true);
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get _entries => (_day?['entries'] as List? ?? [])
      .map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map))
      .toList();
  Future<void> _poll({bool force = false}) async {
    if (!mounted ||
        !_active ||
        _polling ||
        (!force && DateTime.now().isBefore(_nextPoll))) {
      return;
    }
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final id = state.agent?.agentId;
    if (!state.api.isNativeSession) return;
    _polling = true;
    try {
      final result = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        await state.api.get('/api/review-delivery') as Map,
      );
      if (!mounted || state.agent?.agentId != id) return;
      final before = _entries
          .map((e) => (e['post'] as Map?)?['seq'])
          .whereType<num>()
          .toSet();
      setState(() {
        _day = result;
        _reconnecting = false;
        _error = null;
      });
      final after = _entries
          .map((e) => (e['post'] as Map?)?['seq'])
          .whereType<num>()
          .toSet();
      if (after.difference(before).isNotEmpty) await state.refresh(quiet: true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is ApiException && e.isUnauthorized) {
        await state.signOut();
        return;
      }
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _reconnecting = true;
          if (_day == null) _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    } finally {
      _polling = false;
      final working = _entries.any(
        (e) => (e['progress'] as Map?)?['state'] == 'working',
      );
      _nextPoll = DateTime.now().add(
        Duration(seconds: working || _starting ? 3 : 15),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _prepare([String? slotId]) async {
    if (_starting) return;
    setState(() {
      _starting = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      await context.read<AppState>().api.post('/api/review-delivery', {
        'action': 'generate',
        if (slotId != null) 'slotIds': [slotId],
      });
      _nextPoll = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);
      await _poll(force: true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = e.toString());
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _starting = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    await context.read<AppState>().refresh();
    await _poll(force: true);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _error = null);
  }

  Future<void> _timetable() async {
    await Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: (_) => const TimetableScreen()),
    );
    if (mounted) await _refresh();
  }

  Post _currentPost(Map raw, AppState state) {
    final post = Post.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw));
    for (final current in [
      ...?state.status?.queue,
      ...?state.status?.history,
    ]) {
      if (current.seq == post.seq) return current;
    }
    return post;
  }

  Widget _post(Post post, AppState state) => DraftCard(
    key: ValueKey('home-${post.seq}'),
    post: post,
    busy: state.loading,
    actions: commandsFor(context, post, actionable: post.status != 'rejected'),
  );
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final entries = _entries;
    final ready = entries.where((e) => e['post'] != null).length;
    final canPrepare = entries.any((e) => e['canPrepare'] == true);
    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _refresh,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 20, 20, 28),
        children: [
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => openComposer(context),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined),
            label: const Text('Start a post'),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          StudioBanner(
            title: entries.isEmpty ? 'Your writing day' : 'Today’s posts',
            caption: entries.isEmpty
                ? 'Your timetable decides when ByLine prepares posts.'
                : '$ready of ${entries.length} posts prepared · ${_day?['timezone'] ?? state.agent?.timezone ?? ''}',
            eyebrow: 'YOUR TIMETABLE',
            scene: StudioScene.routine,
            compact: true,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: [
              if (canPrepare)
                FilledButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _starting || state.loading
                      ? null
                      : () => _prepare(),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome),
                  label: Text(
                    _starting ? 'Starting…' : 'Prepare today’s posts',
                  ),
                ),
              TextButton.icon(
                onPressed: _timetable,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.schedule),
                label: const Text('Edit timetable'),
              ),
              TextButton.icon(
                onPressed: _refresh,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                label: const Text('Refresh'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (_day == null && !_reconnecting)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: LinearProgressIndicator(),
            ),
          if (_reconnecting)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
              child: Text(
                'Reconnecting to ByLine. Showing the last saved progress.',
                style: T.small,
              ),
            ),
          if (_error != null)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
              child: Text(_error!, style: T.small.copyWith(color: C.flare)),
            ),
          if (_day != null && entries.isEmpty)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 20),
              child: Text(
                'No posting times are enabled for today. Add or change times and days in Timetable. You can still write a post whenever you want.',
                style: T.body,
              ),
            ),
          for (final entry in entries) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 20),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.schedule, size: 18, color: C.filament),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    '${entry['time']} · ${entry['post'] == null ? 'Planned post' : 'Your post'}',
                    style: T.bodyStrong,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (entry['post'] is Map) ...[
              if (_currentPost(entry['post'] as Map, state).isDraft)
                const PreparationProgress(
                  progress: {
                    'state': 'ready',
                    'stage': 'ready',
                    'completed': 4,
                  },
                ),
              _post(_currentPost(entry['post'] as Map, state), state),
            ] else ...[
              if ((entry['progress'] as Map?)?['state'] != 'idle')
                PreparationProgress(
                  progress: Map<String, dynamic>.from(entry['progress'] as Map),
                  reconnecting: _reconnecting,
                )
              else
                const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                  child: Text(
                    'A draft will be prepared before this posting time. You can also prepare it now.',
                    style: T.small,
                  ),
                ),
              if (entry['canPrepare'] == true)
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _starting
                      ? null
                      : () => _prepare(entry['slotId'] as String),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome, size: 18),
                  label: const Text('Prepare this post'),
                ),
            ],
          ],
          if ((_day?['posts'] as List? ?? []).isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 28),
            const Text('Other posts today', style: T.title),
            for (final raw in _day!['posts'] as List) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _post(_currentPost(raw as Map, state), state),
            ],
          ],
          const WritingPrompt(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
````

````text
/// The voice editor — every setting from lib/style.ts, on a phone.
///
/// Three decisions shape this screen:
///
/// 1. Plain-language guidance first. Dropdowns keep structured preferences
///    compact, while examples and free text remain directly editable.
///
/// 2. Edits are staged and applied with Save. A dozen controls only make sense
///    as a combination, and Preview exists so the combination can be read
///    before it is committed to tomorrow's post.
///
/// 3. Save and Preview live in a bar pinned to the bottom, not at the end of
///    the scroll. Change a chip at the top of a screen this long and the
///    control that commits it was six sections away.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/models.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';
import '../widgets/form_select.dart';
import '../widgets/primitives.dart';
import '../widgets/unsaved_changes_guard.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';
import '../widgets/writing_preferences.dart';

class VoiceScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const VoiceScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<VoiceScreen> createState() => _VoiceScreenState();
}

class _VoiceScreenState extends State<VoiceScreen> {
  StyleConfig? _draft;
  late final TextEditingController _rules;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _rules = TextEditingController(
      text: context.read<AppState>().style.customRules.join('\n'),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _rules.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Map<String, dynamic>? _preview;
  bool _previewing = false;
  String? _error;

  StyleConfig get _style => _draft ?? context.read<AppState>().style;

  void _set(StyleConfig next) => setState(() {
    _draft = next;
    // A preview of the previous settings is worse than no preview.
    _preview = null;
  });

  bool get _dirty {
    if (_draft == null) return false;
    final saved = context.read<AppState>().style;
    return _draft!.toJson().toString() != saved.toJson().toString();
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (_style.customRules.length > 12 ||
        _style.customRules.any((r) => r.length > 240)) {
      setState(
        () => _error =
            'Use up to 12 instructions, each no longer than 240 characters.',
      );
      return;
    }
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final submitted = _style;
    final error = await context.read<AppState>().setStyle(submitted);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _error = error;
      if (error == null &&
          _style.toJson().toString() == submitted.toJson().toString()) {
        _draft = null;
      }
    });
    if (error == null) {
      messenger.showSnackBar(const SnackBar(content: Text('Voice saved.')));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _runPreview() async {
    setState(() {
      _previewing = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final requested = _style.toJson().toString();
      final state = context.read<AppState>();
      final voice = state.styleFingerprint;
      final result = await state.previewStyle(_style);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        if (requested == _style.toJson().toString() &&
            voice == state.styleFingerprint) {
          _preview = result;
        }
        _previewing = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _error = '$e';
        _previewing = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final style = _style;
    final sig = style.signature;

    return UnsavedChangesGuard(
      dirty: _dirty,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('Voice'),
          actions: [
            if (_dirty)
              const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(right: S.x4),
                child: Center(child: Slug('unsaved', tone: Tone.desk)),
              ),
          ],
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: PageSurface(
            child: ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x4, S.x5, S.x4, S.x5),
              children: [
                const StudioBanner(
                  compact: true,
                  scene: StudioScene.voice,
                  eyebrow: 'YOUR POINT OF VIEW',
                  title: 'Make it sound like you.',
                  caption:
                      'Your words, your rhythm, your way of seeing things.',
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                // The staged style, not the saved one. Showing the saved summary
                // while the controls below display something else reads as "my
                // change did nothing".
                Text(style.summary, style: T.body.copyWith(color: C.paperDim)),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
                const SectionRule('Describe your voice'),
                const Text(
                  'Tell ByLine how you want to sound. Your examples and instructions shape every draft.',
                  style: T.small,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: _rules,
                  minLines: 4,
                  maxLines: 8,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Your own rules',
                    hintText:
                        'Write like I’m explaining an idea to a colleague.\nKeep it practical and warm.\nAvoid buzzwords and exaggerated claims.',
                    helperText:
                        'Up to 12 instructions, one per line; 240 characters each.',
                    helperMaxLines: 2,
                  ),
                  onChanged: (v) =>
                      _set(_style.copyWith(customRules: _lines(v))),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                const _WritingSamples(),
                const SizedBox(height: 24),
                const SectionRule('Optional starting points'),
                FormSelect<String>(
                  label: 'Start from a preset',
                  hint: 'Custom voice — choose a preset to replace it',
                  value: null,
                  options: {
                    for (final p in state.status?.presets ?? <StylePreset>[])
                      p.id: p.label,
                  },
                  onChanged: (id) {
                    final preset = state.status!.presets.firstWhere(
                      (p) => p.id == id,
                    );
                    final next = preset.style.copyWith(
                      customRules: _style.customRules,
                      bannedPhrases: _style.bannedPhrases,
                    );
                    _set(next);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x6),

                ExpansionTile(
                  tilePadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  title: const Text('Fine-tune your writing'),
                  subtitle: const Text(
                    'Structure, length, emoji, signatures and phrases to avoid',
                  ),
                  children: [
                    WritingPreferences(
                      value: style,
                      onChanged: state.loading ? null : _set,
                    ),
                    const SectionRule('Signature line'),
                    SwitchRow(
                      title: 'Use a signature line',
                      blurb:
                          'A rationed catchphrase — at most one short quote, and not in '
                          'every post.',
                      value: sig != null,
                      onChanged: (on) => _set(
                        on
                            ? style.copyWith(
                                signature: const SignatureConfig(
                                  source: 'Books and talks',
                                  maxWords: 12,
                                  budgetPerFive: 1,
                                  banned: [],
                                ),
                              )
                            : style.copyWith(clearSignature: true),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (sig != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
                      Field(
                        label: 'Quotes drawn from',
                        child: TextFormField(
                          initialValue: sig.source,
                          style: T.body,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(
                            hintText:
                                'An author, book or speaker you return to',
                          ),
                          // _set, not a bare assignment: _dirty is computed during
                          // build, so writing _draft without a rebuild leaves Save
                          // disabled and the edit unsaveable.
                          onChanged: (v) => _set(
                            style.copyWith(signature: sig.copyWith(source: v)),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      _Stepper(
                        label: 'At most per 5 posts',
                        value: sig.budgetPerFive,
                        min: 1,
                        max: 5,
                        step: 1,
                        onChanged: (v) => _set(
                          style.copyWith(
                            signature: sig.copyWith(budgetPerFive: v),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: S.x5),

                    const SectionRule('Rules'),
                    Field(
                      label: 'Banned phrases',
                      hint: 'One per line.',
                      child: TextFormField(
                        initialValue: style.bannedPhrases.join('\n'),
                        maxLines: 5,
                        minLines: 3,
                        style: T.body,
                        onChanged: (v) =>
                            _set(style.copyWith(bannedPhrases: _lines(v))),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),

                if (_error != null) ErrorNote(_error!),

                if (_preview != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
                  _Preview(preview: _preview!),
                ],

                if (_dirty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: S.x4),
                  Center(
                    child: TextButton(
                      onPressed: () => setState(() {
                        _draft = null;
                        _rules.text = context
                            .read<AppState>()
                            .style
                            .customRules
                            .join('\n');
                        _preview = null;
                      }),
                      child: const Text('Revert changes'),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        bottomNavigationBar: _ActionBar(
          dirty: _dirty,
          previewing: _previewing,
          busy: state.loading,
          onPreview: _runPreview,
          onSave: _save,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static List<String> _lines(String v) =>
      v.split('\n').map((s) => s.trim()).where((s) => s.isNotEmpty).toList();
}

/// Pinned to the bottom so the commit is always one reach away.
class _ActionBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ActionBar({
    required this.dirty,
    required this.previewing,
    required this.busy,
    required this.onPreview,
    required this.onSave,
  });

  final bool dirty;
  final bool previewing;
  final bool busy;
  final VoidCallback onPreview;
  final VoidCallback onSave;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(
      color: C.ink2,
      border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: C.rule)),
    ),
    child: SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(S.x3),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: previewing || busy ? null : onPreview,
                icon: previewing
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        height: 15,
                        width: 15,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                      )
                    : const Icon(Icons.visibility_outlined, size: 17),
                label: Text(previewing ? 'Writing…' : 'Preview'),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
            Expanded(
              child: FilledButton(
                onPressed: dirty && !busy ? onSave : null,
                child: Text(dirty ? 'Save' : 'Saved'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

/// Writing samples, and what the agent has learned from your edits.
class _WritingSamples extends StatefulWidget {
  const _WritingSamples();

  @override
  State<_WritingSamples> createState() => _WritingSamplesState();
}

class _WritingSamplesState extends State<_WritingSamples> {
  static const _minSampleChars = 80;

  final _input = TextEditingController();
  bool _adding = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _input.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _add() async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
    final text = _input.text.trim();
    if (text.length < _minSampleChars) return;

    setState(() => _adding = true);
    final error = await state.addCorpusSample(text);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _adding = false);
    if (error == null) {
      _input.clear();
      FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    } else {
      messenger.showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(error)));
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final state = context.watch<AppState>();
    final samples = state.corpus;
    final notes = state.agent?.editNotes;
    final typed = _input.text.trim().length;
    final canAdd =
        typed >= _minSampleChars &&
        typed <= 2400 &&
        samples.length < 10 &&
        !_adding &&
        !state.loading;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        SectionRule(
          'How you write',
          trailing: samples.isEmpty
              ? null
              : Text(
                  '${samples.length}',
                  style: T.data.copyWith(fontSize: 12.5),
                ),
        ),
        Text(
          samples.isEmpty
              ? 'Paste a few posts you are happy with. The writer studies them before '
                    'drafting — this changes the voice more than any setting below.'
              : 'The writer studies up to three of these before drafting.',
          style: T.micro,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x4),

        for (var i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) ...[
          _Sample(
            text: samples[i],
            onRemove: state.loading ? null : () => state.removeCorpusSample(i),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
        ],
        if (samples.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: S.x2),

        TextField(
          key: const Key('voice-sample'),
          controller: _input,
          maxLength: 2400,
          maxLines: 5,
          minLines: 3,
          style: T.body,
          onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
            hintText:
                'Paste a post here — one you wrote, or one whose voice you want.',
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                // A short paste teaches a model nothing and the server drops it
                // silently — so say the threshold rather than letting the button
                // look broken.
                samples.length >= 10
                    ? 'You have 10 samples. Remove one to add another.'
                    : typed == 0
                    ? 'At least $_minSampleChars characters.'
                    : typed < _minSampleChars
                    ? '${_minSampleChars - typed} more characters needed.'
                    : '$typed characters.',
                style: T.micro,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: canAdd ? _add : null,
              child: Text(_adding ? 'Adding…' : 'Add sample'),
            ),
          ],
        ),

        if (notes != null && notes.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: S.x5),
          ObjectCard(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(S.x3),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text('WHAT IT LEARNED FROM YOUR EDITS', style: T.slug),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
                Text(notes.trim(), style: T.small),
                const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
                Text(
                  'Written from drafts you rewrote before publishing. It updates itself '
                  'as you edit more.',
                  style: T.micro,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _Sample extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Sample({required this.text, required this.onRemove});

  final String text;
  final VoidCallback? onRemove;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(S.x3, S.x2, S.x1, S.x2),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: C.ink2,
      border: Border.all(color: C.rule),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm),
    ),
    child: Row(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            text,
            style: T.small,
            maxLines: 3,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
        ),
        IconButton(
          onPressed: onRemove,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 17),
          tooltip: 'Remove this sample',
          style: IconButton.styleFrom(
            minimumSize: const Size(kMinTouch, kMinTouch),
            foregroundColor: C.paperFaint,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

/// Numeric control with big hit areas. A phone keyboard for a number between 0
/// and 5 is the wrong tool; two 48px buttons are the right one.
class _Stepper extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Stepper({
    required this.label,
    required this.value,
    required this.min,
    required this.max,
    required this.step,
    required this.onChanged,
  });

  final String label;
  final int value;
  final int min;
  final int max;
  final int step;
  final ValueChanged<int> onChanged;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: S.x3),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(child: Text(label, style: T.body)),
          _StepButton(
            icon: Icons.remove,
            label: 'Decrease $label',
            onTap: value - step >= min ? () => onChanged(value - step) : null,
          ),
          SizedBox(
            width: 52,
            child: Text(
              '$value',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: T.data.copyWith(fontSize: 17, color: C.paper),
            ),
          ),
          _StepButton(
            icon: Icons.add,
            label: 'Increase $label',
            onTap: value + step <= max ? () => onChanged(value + step) : null,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _StepButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StepButton({
    required this.icon,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.label,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final String label;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => IconButton(
    onPressed: onTap,
    icon: Icon(icon, size: 19),
    tooltip: label,
    style: IconButton.styleFrom(
      minimumSize: const Size(kMinTouch, kMinTouch),
      backgroundColor: C.ink2,
      foregroundColor: onTap == null ? C.paperFaint : C.paper,
      side: const BorderSide(color: C.ruleStrong),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(R.sm)),
    ),
  );
}

class _Preview extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Preview({required this.preview});

  final Map<String, dynamic> preview;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final after = preview['after'] as String? ?? '';
    final sourceLabel = preview['sourceLabel'] as String? ?? 'a sample';
    final length = preview['length'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
    final chars = length?['escapedChars'];
    final within = length?['withinLimit'] != false;

    return ObjectCard(
      tone: Tone.out,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              const Slug('preview', tone: Tone.out),
              const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
              if (chars != null)
                Slug('$chars chars', tone: within ? Tone.quiet : Tone.broken),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x2),
          Text('Rewritten from $sourceLabel — not saved.', style: T.micro),
          const SizedBox(height: S.x3),
          Text(after, style: T.copy),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
````

````text
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../state/app_state.dart';
import '../api/client.dart';
import '../auth_return.dart';
import 'gate_screen.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import '../widgets/experience.dart';
import '../widgets/editorial.dart';

class WelcomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const WelcomeScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<WelcomeScreen> createState() => _WelcomeScreenState();
}

class _WelcomeScreenState extends State<WelcomeScreen> {
  Map<String, dynamic>? _providers;
  String? _error;
  bool _busy = false;
  int _attempt = 0;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final api = context.read<AppState>().api;
    try {
      final v = await api.get('/api/native-auth');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _providers = Map<String, dynamic>.from(v as Map));
      }
      final pending = await api.pendingSignIn();
      if (mounted && pending != null && !_busy) {
        await _signIn(pending['provider'] as String, pending: pending);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(
          () => _error =
              'Cannot reach ByLine. Check your internet connection and try again.',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _signIn(String provider, {Map<String, dynamic>? pending}) async {
    final state = context.read<AppState>();
    final attempt = ++_attempt;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final rng = Random.secure();
      final verifier =
          pending?['verifier'] as String? ??
          base64UrlEncode(
            List.generate(48, (_) => rng.nextInt(256)),
          ).replaceAll('=', '');
      final returnUri = pending == null
          ? await prepareDesktopAuthReturn()
          : null;
      var result = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
        pending ??
            await state.api.post('/api/native-auth', {
                  'provider': provider,
                  'verifier': verifier,
                  'returnUri': ?returnUri,
                })
                as Map,
      );
      if (result['url'] != null) {
        if (pending == null) {
          await state.api.savePendingSignIn({
            ...result,
            'provider': provider,
            'verifier': verifier,
            'startedAt': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
          });
        }
        if (pending == null &&
            !await launchUrl(
              Uri.parse(result['url'] as String),
              mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
            )) {
          throw Exception('Could not open sign-in.');
        }
        final id = result['id'];
        final deadline = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
          pending?['startedAt'] as int? ??
              DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
        ).add(const Duration(minutes: 10));
        while (DateTime.now().isBefore(deadline)) {
          await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2));
          if (!mounted || attempt != _attempt) return;
          try {
            result = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
              await state.api.post('/api/native-auth', {
                    'action': 'poll',
                    'id': id,
                    'verifier': verifier,
                  })
                  as Map,
            );
          } on ApiException catch (e) {
            // Android may suspend networking while the sign-in browser is in
            // front. Keep the saved flow alive so returning to ByLine recovers.
            if (e.status == 0 || e.status == 429 || e.status >= 500) continue;
            rethrow;
          }
          if (result['token'] != null) break;
        }
      }
      if (result['token'] is! String) {
        await state.api.clearPendingSignIn();
        throw Exception('Sign-in expired. Please try again.');
      }
      if (!mounted || attempt != _attempt) return;
      await state.api.saveNativeSession(result['token'] as String);
      await state.bootstrap();
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is ApiException && e.error == 'sign_in_failed') {
        await state.api.clearPendingSignIn();
      }
      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = e.toString());
    } finally {
      if (mounted && attempt == _attempt) setState(() => _busy = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const SizedBox(width: 144, child: ByLineMark())),
    body: SafeArea(
      child: LayoutBuilder(
        builder: (context, constraints) {
          final wide = constraints.maxWidth >= 860;
          final signIn = Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  const Text('Welcome to ByLine', style: T.title),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  const Text(
                    'Sign in to create your personal writing routine.',
                    style: T.body,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 28),
                  if (_providers?['google'] == true)
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _signIn('google'),
                      child: const Text('Continue with Google'),
                    ),
                  if (_providers?['linkedin'] == true)
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _signIn('linkedin'),
                      child: const Text('Continue with LinkedIn'),
                    ),
                  if (_providers?['localTest'] == true) ...[
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: _busy ? null : () => _signIn('local'),
                      child: const Text('Try local preview'),
                    ),
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      child: Text(
                        'Test environment: sample content, no AI charges and no LinkedIn publishing.',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_busy) ...[
                    const LinearProgressIndicator(),
                    const Text(
                      'Finish sign-in in your browser. ByLine will continue automatically.',
                    ),
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: () {
                        _attempt++;
                        cancelDesktopAuthReturn();
                        context.read<AppState>().api.clearPendingSignIn();
                        setState(() => _busy = false);
                      },
                      child: const Text('Cancel'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (_error != null)
                    Text(
                      _error!,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF805200)),
                    ),
                  if (_providers == null)
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: _load,
                      child: const Text('Retry connection'),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  const Text(
                    'A few minutes to make it yours. Your voice, your final say.',
                    style: T.small,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: _busy
                        ? null
                        : () => Navigator.of(context).push(
                            MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                              builder: (_) => const GateScreen(),
                            ),
                          ),
                    child: const Text('Existing installation'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
          return Center(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 1040),
                child: wide
                    ? Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          const Expanded(
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.only(right: 64),
                              child: _WelcomeIntro(),
                            ),
                          ),
                          SizedBox(width: 440, child: signIn),
                        ],
                      )
                    : Column(
                        children: [
                          const _WelcomeIntro(compact: true),
                          const SizedBox(height: 28),
                          signIn,
                        ],
                      ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class _WelcomeIntro extends StatelessWidget {
  const _WelcomeIntro({this.compact = false});
  final bool compact;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      StudioArt(height: compact ? 120 : 220),
      const SizedBox(height: 20),
      Text(
        'Make your next\npost count.',
        style: T.display.copyWith(
          fontSize: 40,
          height: 1.15,
          color: C.filament,
        ),
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 20),
      const Text(
        'Your ideas deserve a place in the conversation.',
        style: T.bodyStrong,
      ),
      const SizedBox(height: 12),
      const Text(
        'ByLine brings you a relevant story, writes a first draft in your voice, and leaves the final word to you.',
        style: T.body,
      ),
      if (!compact) ...[
        const SizedBox(height: 24),
        const ListTile(
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          leading: Icon(Icons.article_outlined, color: C.filament),
          title: Text('Grounded in real sources'),
          subtitle: Text('Always know where a story comes from.'),
        ),
        const ListTile(
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          leading: Icon(Icons.edit_note, color: C.filament),
          title: Text('Shaped by your voice'),
          subtitle: Text('Use your own instructions and past posts.'),
        ),
        const ListTile(
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          leading: Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, color: C.filament),
          title: Text('Published on your terms'),
          subtitle: Text('Publish now, edit or skip. You decide.'),
        ),
      ],
    ],
  );
}
````

````text
/// Single app-wide store.
///
/// One ChangeNotifier is the right size here: the backend hands back the entire
/// dashboard in one GET /api/status, so there is exactly one server truth to
/// hold and every mutation ends by re-fetching it. Splitting that into per-
/// screen stores would create the possibility of two screens disagreeing, which
/// is precisely the bug class an approval queue must not have.
library;

import '../auth_return.dart';
import 'dart:async' show unawaited;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ChangeNotifier, debugPrint;

import '../api/client.dart';
import '../push.dart' show stopPush;
import '../api/models.dart';

enum AuthPhase { unknown, signedOut, signedIn }

class AppState extends ChangeNotifier {
  AppState(this._api);

  final ApiClient _api;
  ApiClient get api => _api;

  AuthPhase phase = AuthPhase.unknown;
  AppStatus? status;
  Map<String, dynamic>? reviewDelivery;
  Map<String, dynamic>? generation;
  bool get preparingDraft =>
      ['queued', 'working'].contains(generation?['state']);

  /// Set while a full refresh is in flight, so screens can show a spinner
  /// without every button needing its own flag.
  bool loading = false;
  int _refreshRevision = 0;

  /// The last error worth showing at the top of a screen. Cleared on success.
  String? error;

  /// The draft the composer is editing, or null when composing something new.
  /// Lives here rather than in the composer because the queue is what starts
  /// an edit, and the two screens are siblings in a tab shell.
  Post? editing;

  /// Bumped whenever the composer should jump to the front. The home shell
  /// watches this rather than the editing target itself, so "edit this again"
  /// still switches tabs when the same post is already loaded.
  int composeRequest = 0;

  /// Text waiting to be dropped into an EMPTY composer, and the tags with it.
  ///
  /// Distinct from [editing], which loads an existing post to change. This is a
  /// suggestion for something new — currently only a follow-up — and it is
  /// consumed once: the composer takes it, clears it, and it never reappears if
  /// the user navigates away and back.
  String? composeSeed;
  List<String> composeSeedHashtags = const [];

  /// Take the pending seed, if any, and forget it.
  ({String text, List<String> hashtags})? takeComposeSeed() {
    final text = composeSeed;
    if (text == null) return null;
    final tags = composeSeedHashtags;
    composeSeed = null;
    composeSeedHashtags = const [];
    return (text: text, hashtags: tags);
  }

  /// A tab a notification asked for, and a counter so the same tab twice still
  /// registers. Same shape as [composeRequest] and for the same reason: the
  /// shell has to be able to tell "asked again" from "asked once".
  int tabRequest = 0;
  int requestedTab = 0;

  /// Bring a tab forward. Called when a notification is tapped.
  void requestTab(int index) {
    requestedTab = index;
    tabRequest++;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void startEditing(Post post) {
    editing = post;
    composeRequest++;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void stopEditing() {
    if (editing == null) return;
    editing = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  String get baseUrl => _api.baseUrl;
  Agent? get agent => status?.agent;
  StyleConfig get style => agent?.style ?? StyleConfig.houseStyle;

  /// Everything that shapes how the writer sounds, as one comparable string.
  ///
  /// For change DETECTION, never for display. The composer used to watch
  /// [StyleConfig.summary], which names the structure, the emoji policy and the
  /// tag count — three fields out of a prompt built from every style rule plus
  /// the author's writing samples and edit notes. Editing the register, the
  /// length, a banned phrase or a sample moved the real voice and left the
  /// composer's "voice changed" banner silent.
  String get styleFingerprint {
    final a = agent;
    if (a == null) return '';
    return [
      a.style.toJson().toString(),
      a.corpus.join(String.fromCharCode(0)),
      a.editNotes ?? '',
    ].join('|');
  }

  /// How many drafts are asking for a DECISION right now.
  ///
  /// Not how many drafts exist. A cleared draft is still in the queue but has
  /// stopped asking anything of you, and a badge that never clears is a badge
  /// people learn to ignore.
  int get onTheDesk {
    final s = status;
    if (s == null) return 0;
    return s.queue
        .where((p) => !p.isCleared && (p.isDraft || p.status == 'approved'))
        .length;
  }

  /// Something in the machinery needs a human — the scheduler has stopped, or
  /// LinkedIn access is expiring or gone. Deliberately excludes drafts: those
  /// are the job, not a fault.
  bool get needsAttention {
    final s = status;
    if (s == null) return false;
    return !s.scheduler.healthy ||
        s.account.needsReauth ||
        s.account.expiringSoon;
  }

  Future<void> bootstrap() async {
    phase = _api.hasSession ? AuthPhase.signedIn : AuthPhase.signedOut;
    notifyListeners();
    if (phase == AuthPhase.signedIn) await refresh();
  }

  Future<void> setBaseUrl(String value) async {
    await _api.setBaseUrl(value);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<bool> signIn(String password) async {
    error = null;
    loading = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      await _api.logIn(password);
      phase = AuthPhase.signedIn;
      loading = false;
      notifyListeners();
      await refresh();
      return true;
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      error = e.error == 'invalid_password' ? 'Wrong password.' : e.toString();
      loading = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> signOut() async {
    _refreshRevision++;
    phase = AuthPhase.signedOut;
    await stopPush();
    if (_deviceToken != null) {
      try {
        await _api.delete('/api/devices', {'token': _deviceToken});
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    _deviceToken = null;
    editing = null;
    composeSeed = null;
    composeSeedHashtags = const [];
    _draftWatch++;
    await _api.logOut();
    phase = AuthPhase.signedOut;
    status = null;
    reviewDelivery = null;
    generation = null;
    error = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Re-read everything from the server.
  ///
  /// [quiet] skips the loading flag. A background poll must not disable every
  /// control on screen every fifteen seconds — the spinner is for refreshes the
  /// user asked for and is waiting on.
  Future<void> refresh({bool quiet = false}) async {
    final revision = ++_refreshRevision;
    if (!quiet) {
      loading = true;
      notifyListeners();
    }
    try {
      final json = await _api.get('/api/status');
      if (revision != _refreshRevision) return;
      status = AppStatus.fromJson(json as Map<String, dynamic>);
      reviewDelivery = json['reviewDelivery'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(json['reviewDelivery'] as Map)
          : null;
      generation = json['generation'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(json['generation'] as Map)
          : null;
      error = null;
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      if (revision != _refreshRevision) return;
      // An expired or rejected cookie must drop us back to the gate rather than
      // leaving a signed-in shell that fails on every tap.
      if (e.isUnauthorized) {
        _draftWatch++;
        await stopPush();
        await _api.clearSession();
        phase = AuthPhase.signedOut;
        status = null;
        reviewDelivery = null;
        generation = null;
        editing = null;
        composeSeed = null;
        composeSeedHashtags = const [];
      }
      error = e.toString();
    }
    loading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Watch for the draft a cycle is about to produce.
  ///
  /// A cycle answers in about a second and then works for another 30-60 in the
  /// background, so the refresh that [mutate] already did cannot possibly show
  /// the result — the draft does not exist yet. Without this the queue stays
  /// empty until the user thinks to pull down, which reads as the button
  /// having done nothing.
  ///
  /// A push notification also triggers a refresh the moment the draft lands,
  /// and is faster than any of these. This is the fallback for the phone that
  /// refused notification permission, and for the case where the cycle finds
  /// nothing worth writing — where no notification is sent at all, correctly,
  /// and the app should still stop looking busy.
  int _draftWatch = 0;
  Future<void> _watchForDraft(int before) async {
    final watch = ++_draftWatch;
    // Spaced out rather than fixed: a cycle is two LLM calls and finishes
    // anywhere in a wide window, so this checks often early and backs off.
    for (final seconds in const [12, 12, 15, 15, 20, 25, 30]) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration(seconds: seconds));
      // Superseded by a newer run, or signed out in the meantime.
      if (watch != _draftWatch || phase != AuthPhase.signedIn) return;
      await refresh(quiet: true);
      if ((status?.queue.length ?? 0) > before) return;
    }
  }

  /// Run a mutation, surface its error, and re-sync from the server.
  ///
  /// Returns null on success or the error string on failure, so callers can
  /// decide between a snackbar and inline text without re-reading [error].
  ///
  /// Use [mutateAgent] instead for anything that only changes agent settings —
  /// this one pays for a full status refetch, which is the right price for a
  /// mutation that moves posts or slots and far too much for a toggle.
  Future<String?> mutate(Future<void> Function() action) async {
    _refreshRevision++;
    loading = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      await action();
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      // A rejected send can still change the post to failed/unknown. Refresh
      // that result so the screen offers recovery for the actual saved state.
      await refresh(quiet: true);
      loading = false;
      error = e.toString();
      notifyListeners();
      return e.toString();
    }
    await refresh();
    return null;
  }

  /// A settings change that only touches the agent, applied from the response.
  ///
  /// PATCH /api/settings already answers with the updated agent, so re-fetching
  /// the whole dashboard afterwards asked a database on another continent to
  /// rebuild the queue, the history, the rejection log, the slot timeline and
  /// the LLM budget — none of which the change could have altered. Every toggle
  /// cost two sequential round trips at roughly half a second each, with the
  /// entire UI disabled in between. This costs one, and the second is the one
  /// that was pure waste.
  ///
  /// Anything that moves the schedule (timezone, post time) still goes through
  /// [mutate]: the server recomputes every slot's next occurrence, and those
  /// live outside the agent object.
  Future<String?> mutateAgent(Future<dynamic> Function() action) async {
    _refreshRevision++;
    loading = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final json = await action();
      final updated = json is Map<String, dynamic>
          ? json['agent'] as Map<String, dynamic>?
          : null;
      if (updated != null && status != null) {
        _refreshRevision++;
        status = status!.withAgent(Agent.fromJson(updated));
        error = null;
        loading = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return null;
      }
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      loading = false;
      error = e.toString();
      notifyListeners();
      return e.toString();
    }
    // The server answered without an agent — an older build, or a shape we do
    // not recognise. Fall back to the full refetch rather than showing state
    // that might now be wrong.
    await refresh();
    return null;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- actions
  //
  // These all take mutateAgent: PATCH /api/settings returns the updated agent,
  // and nothing else on the dashboard is derived from these fields. setPostTime
  // and setTimezone are the exceptions and stay on mutate — they reschedule
  // every slot, which lives outside the agent object.

  Future<String?> setStyle(StyleConfig style) =>
      mutateAgent(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'style': style.toJson()}));

  Future<String?> applyPreset(String presetId) =>
      mutateAgent(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'preset': presetId}));

  Future<String?> setAutoPublish(bool value) =>
      mutateAgent(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'autoPublish': value}));

  Future<String?> setPaused(bool value) =>
      mutateAgent(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'paused': value}));

  /// How many posts the agent may publish by itself per rolling 24h (1-3).
  Future<String?> setAutoPublishCap(int value) =>
      mutateAgent(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'autoPublishCap': value}));

  /// "HH:MM" in the agent's timezone. Changing it reschedules the next run —
  /// and because nextDailyRun is strictly future, setting today's time after
  /// it has passed moves the run to tomorrow.
  Future<String?> setPostTime(String hhmm) =>
      mutate(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'postTimeLocal': hhmm}));

  Future<String?> setTimezone(String tz) =>
      mutate(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'timezone': tz}));

  /// Toggle a category, applied on screen before the server has answered.
  ///
  /// A chip tap is the most-repeated interaction in the app and it changes one
  /// list on one object, so waiting half a second with every chip disabled to
  /// find out whether it worked is the wrong trade. The new selection is shown
  /// at once and the server's answer overwrites it a moment later; if the
  /// request fails the previous selection is restored and the error surfaces,
  /// so a rejected change can never be left looking accepted.
  ///
  /// Deliberately does NOT set [loading] — that disables every control on the
  /// screen, which is exactly the freeze this is removing.
  Future<String?> setCategories(List<String> categories) async {
    // Nothing blocks a second tap while the first is in flight, so two replies
    // can land out of order and the older one would win. Only the newest
    // request is allowed to write the server's answer back.
    final mySeq = ++_categoriesSeq;
    final previous = status?.agent;
    if (previous != null && status != null) {
      status = status!.withAgent(previous.withCategories(categories));
      error = null;
      notifyListeners();
    }
    try {
      final json = await _api.patch('/api/settings', {
        'categories': categories,
      });
      if (mySeq != _categoriesSeq) {
        return null; // a newer tap already owns the state
      }
      final updated = json is Map<String, dynamic>
          ? json['agent'] as Map<String, dynamic>?
          : null;
      if (updated != null && status != null) {
        // The server is the authority on what was actually stored: it refuses
        // to leave the agent with no categories, and it rewrites the scope line
        // to match. Taking its answer keeps the header honest.
        status = status!.withAgent(Agent.fromJson(updated));
      } else {
        await refresh();
      }
      notifyListeners();
      return null;
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      // Only roll back if nothing newer has been sent — otherwise this would
      // undo a selection the user has since made and the server has accepted.
      if (mySeq == _categoriesSeq && previous != null && status != null) {
        status = status!.withAgent(previous);
      }
      error = e.toString();
      notifyListeners();
      return e.toString();
    }
  }

  int _categoriesSeq = 0;

  /// Attach this phone to the agent, so the server can push to it.
  ///
  /// Called on every launch, not only the first: FCM rotates tokens whenever it
  /// likes and tells no one, so re-registering is the only way the server's
  /// address stays current. The endpoint upserts, which is what makes that
  /// cheap. Failure is deliberately quiet — an app that cannot register for
  /// notifications is still a working control surface, and saying so on the
  /// gate screen would be alarming out of all proportion.
  String? _deviceToken;
  Future<String?> testDeviceNotification() async {
    if (_deviceToken == null) {
      return 'Enable notifications on this device first.';
    }
    return mutate(
      () =>
          _api.post('/api/devices', {'action': 'test', 'token': _deviceToken}),
    );
  }

  Future<bool> registerDevice(String token) async {
    if (phase != AuthPhase.signedIn) return false;
    try {
      final result = await _api.post('/api/devices', {
        'token': token,
        'platform': 'android',
      });
      _deviceToken = token;
      return (result as Map)['configured'] == true;
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[state] could not register for notifications: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Ask the writer for a follow-up to a post that has already gone out, and
  /// carry it to the composer.
  ///
  /// Nothing is saved: the endpoint answers with text and never writes a row,
  /// so this is a suggestion about what to write next rather than a post
  /// created on the author's behalf. Leaving edit mode first matters — a
  /// follow-up is a NEW post, and arriving in a composer still bound to the
  /// original would silently overwrite the thing being followed up.
  Future<String?> followUp(int seq) async {
    loading = true;
    error = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final json = await _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {
        'action': 'followup',
      }, timeout: kWriterTimeout);
      final map = json as Map<String, dynamic>?;
      final text = map?['text'];
      if (text is! String || text.trim().isEmpty) {
        loading = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return 'The writer returned nothing usable.';
      }
      final tags = map?['hashtags'];
      editing = null;
      composeSeed = text;
      composeSeedHashtags = tags is List
          ? tags.whereType<String>().toList()
          : const [];
      composeRequest++; // brings the composer forward
      loading = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return null;
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      loading = false;
      error = e.toString();
      notifyListeners();
      return e.toString();
    }
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------- LinkedIn

  /// Ask the server for LinkedIn's consent URL.
  ///
  /// `?json=1` because the browser-facing route answers with a 302, which this
  /// client must not follow: consent has to happen in the SYSTEM browser, not
  /// inside the app's HTTP stack.
  Future<String?> linkedInConsentUrl() async {
    try {
      final returnUri = await prepareDesktopAuthReturn(
        onReturn: () => refresh(quiet: true),
      );
      final suffix = returnUri == null
          ? ''
          : '&returnUri=${Uri.encodeComponent(returnUri)}';
      final res = await _api.get('/api/linkedin/connect?json=1$suffix');
      final url = (res as Map)['url'];
      return url is String && url.isNotEmpty ? url : null;
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[state] could not get a consent URL: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<String?> disconnectLinkedIn() =>
      mutate(() => _api.post('/api/linkedin/disconnect', const {}));

  /// Writing samples the writer studies before drafting.
  ///
  /// Replaced wholesale rather than appended: the corpus is a set the author
  /// edits, and a merge would make removing a sample impossible. The server
  /// drops anything under 80 characters, so a stray paste cannot become a
  /// "sample" that teaches the model nothing.
  List<String> get corpus => agent?.corpus ?? const [];

  Future<String?> setCorpus(List<String> samples) =>
      mutateAgent(() => _api.patch('/api/settings', {'corpus': samples}));

  Future<String?> addCorpusSample(String text) =>
      setCorpus([...corpus, text.trim()]);

  Future<String?> removeCorpusSample(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= corpus.length) return Future.value(null);
    final next = [...corpus]..removeAt(index);
    return setCorpus(next);
  }

  /// Force a cycle now, ignoring the schedule.
  ///
  /// Session-authenticated, unlike /api/cron/tick which needs the cron secret
  /// the app deliberately does not hold. Returns as soon as the work is
  /// started — the draft appears on a later refresh, 30-60s out.
  Future<String?> runCycleNow() async {
    final before = status?.queue.length ?? 0;
    final error = await mutate(() => _api.post('/api/cycle/run', const {}));
    if (error != null) return error;
    // Deliberately not awaited: the button returns now, and the queue fills in
    // by itself when the writer is done.
    unawaited(_watchForDraft(before));
    return null;
  }

  // PATCH, not POST: /api/posts/[seq] exports PATCH and answers anything else
  // with a 405. Only /api/posts (compose) is a POST.

  /// "I have read this — let it go out at its scheduled time."
  ///
  /// The primary action on a scheduled draft, and deliberately NOT the same
  /// thing as publishing. Before slots existed, approving a draft sent it
  /// immediately; that is the wrong default once a post has a time of its own,
  /// because clearing something at 08:48 should not publish it at 08:48.
  Future<String?> clear(int seq, {Post? reviewed}) => mutate(
    () => _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {
      'action': 'clear',
      if (reviewed != null)
        'reviewed': {
          'text': reviewed.text,
          'hashtags': reviewed.hashtags,
          'media': reviewed.media,
        },
    }),
  );

  /// Withdraw clearance. On a hold-mode slot this is enough to stop the send.
  Future<String?> unclear(int seq) =>
      mutate(() => _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {'action': 'unclear'}));

  /// Send right now, ignoring the schedule. The override, not the default.
  Future<String?> sendNow(int seq, {Post? reviewed}) => mutate(
    () => _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {
      'action': 'publish',
      if (reviewed != null)
        'reviewed': {
          'text': reviewed.text,
          'hashtags': reviewed.hashtags,
          'media': reviewed.media,
        },
    }),
  );

  /// Move a post to a different time, or lift it off the schedule with null.
  Future<String?> reschedule(int seq, DateTime? when) => mutate(
    () => _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {
      'action': 'reschedule',
      'scheduledFor': when?.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
    }),
  );

  /// Take the composer's edit lock so a scheduled send cannot fire mid-edit.
  ///
  /// Failure is swallowed on purpose: the hold is a courtesy, and refusing to
  /// let someone open a draft because a lock call failed would be worse than
  /// the race it prevents. The server expires holds on its own, so the cost of
  /// a missed release is bounded.
  Future<void> holdForEditing(int seq) async {
    try {
      await _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {'action': 'hold'});
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[state] could not hold p$seq for editing: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> releaseEditing(int seq) async {
    try {
      await _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {'action': 'release'});
    } on ApiException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[state] could not release p$seq: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<String?> discard(int seq) =>
      mutate(() => _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {'action': 'discard'}));

  Future<String?> editPost(
    int seq,
    String text,
    List<String> hashtags, {
    List<String>? mediaIds,
  }) => mutate(
    () => _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {
      'action': 'edit',
      'text': text,
      'hashtags': hashtags,
      // Omitted entirely when null: the server treats an absent key as
      // "leave the existing images alone".
      'mediaIds': ?mediaIds,
    }),
  );

  /// Ask the writer for a different treatment of a draft. Returns the variant
  /// text; nothing is saved until the user accepts it with [editPost].
  ///
  /// [variant] cycles the angle the writer is told to take, so pressing the
  /// button repeatedly gives genuinely different options rather than the same
  /// rephrasing each time.
  Future<String> rewriteDraft(int seq, {int variant = 0}) => _readVariant(
    _api.patch('/api/posts/$seq', {
      'action': 'rewrite',
      'variant': variant,
    }, timeout: kWriterTimeout),
  );

  /// Same, for text that has not been saved yet — the composer writing
  /// something new has no seq to reference.
  Future<String> rewriteText(String text, {int variant = 0}) => _readVariant(
    _api.post('/api/compose/rewrite', {
      'text': text,
      'variant': variant,
    }, kWriterTimeout),
  );

  /// Hashtags returned with the last rewrite. The composer snapshots them with
  /// its text, previews both, and applies both only when the user accepts.
  List<String> lastVariantHashtags = const [];

  Future<String> _readVariant(Future<dynamic> call) async {
    final json = await call;
    final map = json as Map<String, dynamic>?;
    final text = map?['text'];
    if (text is! String || text.trim().isEmpty) {
      throw ApiException(
        0,
        'rewrite_failed',
        detail: 'The writer returned nothing usable.',
      );
    }
    final tags = map?['hashtags'];
    lastVariantHashtags = tags is List
        ? tags.whereType<String>().toList()
        : const [];
    return text;
  }

  /// Upload images and return their media ids, in the order given.
  Future<List<String>> uploadImages(List<String> paths) async {
    final ids = <String>[];
    for (final path in paths) {
      ids.add(await _api.uploadImage(path));
    }
    return ids;
  }

  Future<String?> compose({
    required String text,
    required bool polish,
    required bool publishNow,
    String? category,
    List<String> hashtags = const [],
    List<String> mediaIds = const [],
    DateTime? scheduledFor,
    void Function(int seq)? onCreated,
    String? clientRequestId,
  }) => mutate(() async {
    try {
      final result = await _api.post(
        '/api/posts',
        {
          'text': text,
          'polish': polish,
          'publishNow': publishNow,
          'clientRequestId': ?clientRequestId,
          'category': ?category,
          'hashtags': hashtags,
          'mediaIds': mediaIds,
          // Your own post goes on the same timetable as a generated one —
          // the send pass does not care who wrote the text. Scheduling counts
          // as clearing it: you wrote it, so there is nothing left to review.
          'scheduledFor': ?scheduledFor?.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        },
        // Composing with polish on is a model call like any other.
        polish ? kWriterTimeout : null,
      );
      if (result is Map && result['seq'] is num) {
        onCreated?.call((result['seq'] as num).toInt());
      }
    } on ApiException catch (error) {
      if (error.postSeq != null) onCreated?.call(error.postSeq!);
      rethrow;
    }
  });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------ slots

  List<PostSlot> get slots => status?.slots ?? const [];
  SlotLimits get slotLimits => status?.slotLimits ?? SlotLimits.fallback;

  bool get canAddSlot => slots.length < slotLimits.maxSlots;

  Future<String?> addSlot({
    required String localTime,
    int? daysMask,
    int? leadMinutes,
    bool autoPublish = false,
    List<String> categories = const [],
  }) => mutate(
    () => _api.post('/api/slots', {
      'localTime': localTime,
      'daysMask': ?daysMask,
      'leadMinutes': ?leadMinutes,
      'autoPublish': autoPublish,
      'categories': categories,
    }),
  );

  Future<String?> updateSlot(String id, Map<String, dynamic> patch) =>
      mutate(() => _api.patch('/api/slots/$id', patch));

  Future<String?> setSlotTime(String id, String localTime) =>
      updateSlot(id, {'localTime': localTime});

  Future<String?> setSlotDays(String id, int daysMask) =>
      updateSlot(id, {'daysMask': daysMask});

  /// The review window for this slot, in minutes. The server clamps it to its
  /// own floor and ceiling, so an out-of-range value lands at the bound rather
  /// than being rejected.
  Future<String?> setSlotLead(String id, int minutes) =>
      updateSlot(id, {'leadMinutes': minutes});

  /// Whether this slot may send without a human clearing the draft first.
  Future<String?> setSlotAutoPublish(String id, bool value) =>
      updateSlot(id, {'autoPublish': value});

  Future<String?> setSlotEnabled(String id, bool value) =>
      updateSlot(id, {'enabled': value});

  Future<String?> setSlotCategories(String id, List<String> categories) =>
      updateSlot(id, {'categories': categories});

  Future<String?> removeSlot(String id) =>
      mutate(() => _api.delete('/api/slots/$id'));

  /// Preview a candidate voice without saving it. Returns the server payload
  /// rather than storing it — a preview is screen-local by nature.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> previewStyle(StyleConfig style) async {
    final json = await _api.post('/api/style/preview', {
      'style': style.toJson(),
    }, kWriterTimeout);
    return (json as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? const {};
  }
}
````

````text
/// ByLine: a light, readable workspace for Android and Windows.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

/// ByLine light palette. Legacy token names keep every existing screen in sync.
abstract final class C {
  static const ink = Color(0xFFF3F2EF);
  static const ink2 = Color(0xFFFFFFFF);

/// Corner radius.
///
/// Raised from 4/8/14. The tighter set read as an instrument, which was the
/// intent, but combined with a visible border on every surface it also read as
/// tight — a screen of small hard-cornered boxes. Softer corners with fewer
/// borders is the same seriousness without the clench.

  /// TextStyle silently makes it non-const and takes every const widget tree
  /// down with it.
  static const cond = 'PlexSans';

  static const sans = 'PlexSans';

  /// THE CLOCK. Times, counts, scores, ids. Tabular figures, always.
  static const mono = 'PlexMono';

    fontFamily: F.mono,
    fontSize: 12.5,
    height: 1.45,
    color: C.paperFaint,

/// Minimum touch target. Below this a control is a coin toss on a phone.
const double kMinTouch = 48.0;

/// One duration for every state change. Long enough to read as a transition,
/// short enough never to be in the way.
const Duration kStateChange = Duration(milliseconds: 180);

/// Route transitions.
const Duration kRouteChange = Duration(milliseconds: 320);

/// Whether to build motion at all.
///
/// Reduced motion is honoured by NOT creating the timeline, not by shortening
/// it — a 1ms animation still schedules frames and still moves things a user
/// asked not to have moved.
bool motionAllowed(BuildContext context) {
  final media = MediaQuery.maybeOf(context);
  if (media == null) return true;
  return !media.disableAnimations;
}
````

````text
/// The day as a rail, with time as its spine.
///
/// This app is fundamentally about time, so the shape of a day should be
/// legible at a glance rather than reconstructed from a list. Hours down the
/// left edge, events hung off them.
///
/// The state that makes the widget necessary is SILENCE. A slot that read its
/// candidates and turned them all down is the agent working correctly — but
/// rendered as a gap it is indistinguishable from a cron that stopped, and that
/// ambiguity is the fastest way to stop trusting the thing.
///
/// Silence therefore gets a stop on the rail like everything else, and gets no
/// colour: a hollow marker in the faint ink. Correct behaviour must never look
/// like an alarm.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../api/models.dart';
import '../theme.dart';
import 'primitives.dart';

/// How one stop on the rail reads. [Tone] carries the colour; this carries the
/// glyph and whether the marker is filled.
enum RailStop { published, drafted, quiet, broken, pending }

extension RailStopLook on RailStop {
  Tone get tone => switch (this) {
    RailStop.published => Tone.out,
    RailStop.drafted => Tone.desk,
    RailStop.broken => Tone.broken,
    RailStop.quiet => Tone.quiet,
    RailStop.pending => Tone.quiet,
  };

  /// Filled means the slot produced something. Hollow means it did not — which
  /// is readable without reading the label, and is the whole point.
  bool get filled => this == RailStop.published || this == RailStop.drafted;

  IconData get glyph => switch (this) {
    RailStop.published => Icons.check,
    RailStop.drafted => Icons.edit_outlined,
    RailStop.broken => Icons.priority_high,
    RailStop.quiet => Icons.volume_off_outlined,
    RailStop.pending => Icons.schedule,
  };
}

RailStop stopFor(String outcome) => switch (outcome) {
  'published' => RailStop.published,
  'drafted' => RailStop.drafted,
  'silent' => RailStop.quiet,
  'missed' => RailStop.broken,
  'failed' => RailStop.broken,
  _ => RailStop.pending,
};

String labelFor(String outcome) => switch (outcome) {
  'published' => 'Published',
  'drafted' => 'Drafted, waiting on you',
  'silent' => 'Stayed quiet',
  'missed' => 'Missed',
  'failed' => 'Failed to send',
  _ => 'Waiting to run',
};

/// The rail. Give it the day's entries, already in time order.
class DayRail extends StatelessWidget {
  const DayRail({super.key, required this.entries});

  final List<TimelineEntry> entries;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)
        _Stop(entry: entries[i], isLast: i == entries.length - 1),
    ],
  );
}

class _Stop extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Stop({required this.entry, required this.isLast});

  final TimelineEntry entry;
  final bool isLast;

  static const _gutter = 42.0;
  static const _marker = 9.0;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final stop = stopFor(entry.outcome);
    final colour = stop.tone.ink;

    return IntrinsicHeight(
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          // Tabular figures so the column stays a column — times of different
          // digit widths would otherwise wander against the spine.
          SizedBox(
            width: _gutter,
            child: Text(
              entry.localTime,
              textAlign: TextAlign.right,
              style: T.data.copyWith(
                fontSize: 13,
                color: stop.filled ? C.paperDim : C.paperFaint,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: S.x3),

          // The spine, with this stop's marker on it.
          SizedBox(
            width: _marker,
            child: Column(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: _marker,
                  height: _marker,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 5),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: stop.filled ? colour : C.ink,
                    border: Border.all(color: colour, width: 1.5),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                ),
                if (!isLast)
                  Expanded(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 1,
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                      color: C.rule,
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: S.x3),

          Expanded(
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: isLast ? 0 : S.x4),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(stop.glyph, size: 13, color: colour),
                      const SizedBox(width: S.x2),
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          labelFor(entry.outcome),
                          style: T.bodyStrong.copyWith(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            color: colour,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  if (entry.detail != null && entry.detail!.isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2, left: 21),
                      child: Text(entry.detail!, style: T.micro),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
````
