````text
import {mkdirSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join,resolve} from 'node:path';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {liveEnv} from './live-env.mjs';
const env=liveEnv();
const bin=process.env.PG_BIN??'C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin';
const folder=resolve('.byline-local/backups');mkdirSync(folder,{recursive:true});
const file=join(folder,`byline-${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-')}.dump`);
const dump=spawnSync(join(bin,'pg_dump.exe'),['--format=custom','--file',file,'--dbname',env.DATABASE_URL],{windowsHide:true,encoding:'utf8'});
if(dump.status!==0)throw new Error('ByLine backup failed. Check the local database connection.');
const verify=spawnSync(join(bin,'pg_restore.exe'),['--list',file],{windowsHide:true,encoding:'utf8'});
if(verify.status!==0)throw new Error('Backup archive validation failed.');
console.log(`Local ByLine backup saved: ${file}`);
console.log('Contains private account data. Keep it private, together with the matching .env.byline-live encryption key.');

````

## Source: scripts/bench-api.mjs

````text
/**
 * Time the real endpoints, warm, several times.
 *
 * A single reading taken right after a cold start tells you almost nothing —
 * Neon's free tier autosuspends and the first queries after it wakes are slow
 * for reasons that have nothing to do with the code. This signs in once, then
 * samples each endpoint repeatedly so the steady state is visible.
 *
 * Prints timings only. Nothing from .env is echoed.
 *
 *   node scripts/bench-api.mjs [baseUrl]
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const BASE = process.argv[2] ?? "http://localhost:3000";

function envValue(key) {
  if (process.env[key]) return process.env[key];
  try {
    const line = readFileSync(".env", "utf8")
      .split("\n")
      .find((l) => l.startsWith(`${key}=`));
    return line ? line.slice(key.length + 1).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "") : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const password = envValue("APP_PASSWORD");
if (!password) {
  console.error("No APP_PASSWORD found — run from the project root.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const login = await fetch(`${BASE}/api/auth`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ password }),
});
if (!login.ok) {
  console.error(`Sign-in failed (${login.status}). Is the server running at ${BASE}?`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const cookie = (login.headers.get("set-cookie") ?? "").split(";")[0];

const ms = (t) => `${String(Math.round(t)).padStart(5)}ms`;

async function sample(path, runs) {
  const times = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < runs; i++) {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, { headers: { cookie } });
    await res.text();
    times.push(performance.now() - t0);
  }
  const sorted = [...times].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return {
    first: times[0],
    median: sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)],
    best: sorted[0],
  };
}

console.log(`\nEndpoint latency — ${BASE}\n`);

for (const path of ["/api/status", "/api/slots"]) {
  const r = await sample(path, 6);
  console.log(`  ${path}`);
  console.log(`    first  ${ms(r.first)}   <- may still include a wake-up`);
  console.log(`    median ${ms(r.median)}`);
  console.log(`    best   ${ms(r.best)}\n`);
}

console.log(
  `  The median is the number that matters — it is what a screen refresh costs\n` +
    `  once everything is warm. The first reading after a quiet spell includes\n` +
    `  Neon waking from autosuspend, which no amount of code changes here can\n` +
    `  avoid and which does not happen on a server under steady traffic.\n`,
);

````

## Source: scripts/bench-db.mjs

````text
/**
 * Measure what a request actually spends on the database.
 *
 * Exists because "it feels slow" is not something you can fix. This reports
 * round-trip latency, the cost of the schema script, and what a fan-out of
 * independent queries costs at different pool sizes — which is the shape of
 * every read endpoint here.
 *
 * Prints timings only. Nothing from the connection string is echoed.
 *
 *   node scripts/bench-db.mjs
 */
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import pg from "pg";

// Read DATABASE_URL out of .env without printing any of it.
function databaseUrl() {
  if (process.env.DATABASE_URL) return process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  try {
    const line = readFileSync(".env", "utf8")
      .split("\n")
      .find((l) => l.startsWith("DATABASE_URL="));
    return line ? line.slice("DATABASE_URL=".length).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "") : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const url = databaseUrl();
if (!url) {
  console.error("No DATABASE_URL found — set it, or run from the project root.");
  process.exit(1);
}

const ms = (t) => `${Math.round(t)}ms`;
const time = async (fn) => {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  await fn();
  return performance.now() - t0;
};

async function run(poolSize, fanout) {
  const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: url, max: poolSize });
  try {
    // Warm: first connection pays TLS + any Neon wake-up.
    const cold = await time(() => pool.query("SELECT 1"));
    const warm = await time(() => pool.query("SELECT 1"));

    // WARM the pool first. Measuring a fan-out against a cold pool measures
    // TLS handshakes, not queueing — and in the running server the pool is
    // already warm, so that would have been the wrong number entirely.
    await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: poolSize }, () => pool.query("SELECT 1")));

    // The shape every read endpoint has: N independent queries at once.
    const fan = await time(() =>
      Promise.all(Array.from({ length: fanout }, () => pool.query("SELECT 1"))),
    );

    // And the shape it SHOULD have: one round trip carrying everything.
    const single = await time(() =>
      pool.query("SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b, 3 AS c, now() AS d"),
    );

    return { cold, warm, fan, single };
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

console.log("\nDatabase latency\n");

const small = await run(3, 12);
console.log(`  pool max 3   (what it was)`);
console.log(`    first query      ${ms(small.cold)}   <- TLS handshake, plus any Neon wake-up`);
console.log(`    warm query       ${ms(small.warm)}   <- one round trip`);
console.log(`    12 in parallel   ${ms(small.fan)}`);

const big = await run(10, 12);
console.log(`\n  pool max 10  (what it is now)`);
console.log(`    warm query       ${ms(big.warm)}`);
console.log(`    12 in parallel   ${ms(big.fan)}`);

const saved = small.fan - big.fan;
console.log(
  `\n  Fan-out is ${ms(Math.abs(saved))} ${saved > 0 ? "FASTER" : "slower"} with the larger pool.`,
);
console.log(`\n  ONE round trip carrying the same data: ${ms(big.single)}`);
console.log(
  `\n  A read endpoint makes roughly a dozen queries, so the fan-out figure is\n` +
    `  the floor under every screen refresh. The gap between it and a single\n` +
    `  round trip is what the app pays for nothing.\n` +
    `\n` +
    `  Note what dominates: one warm query costs ~${ms(big.warm)}. That is not the\n` +
    `  database being slow, it is the SPEED OF LIGHT between here and wherever\n` +
    `  Neon lives. Deploying the API into the same region as the database turns\n` +
    `  that round trip into single-digit milliseconds and does more for latency\n` +
    `  than any amount of query tuning here can.\n`,
);

````

## Source: scripts/build-check.mjs

````text
/**
 * Verify that a production build compiles, WITHOUT touching `.next`.
 *
 * `next dev` and `next build` both own `.next/`. Running a build while the dev
 * server is live replaces the chunks that server still holds references to, and
 * every subsequent request dies with `Cannot find module './331.js'` or a
 * missing vendor-chunk. It reads like a catastrophic code failure and is purely
 * a clobbered cache — the only cure being to delete `.next` and restart.
 *
 * So this builds into `.next-verify` instead, via the NEXT_DIST_DIR hook in
 * next.config.ts. Use it for "does this still compile"; use `npm run build` for
 * an actual deploy.
 *
 * A node wrapper rather than an inline env var because `VAR=x cmd` is not valid
 * in a Windows npm script, and adding cross-env for one line is a dependency
 * this project does not need.
 */
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";

const result = spawnSync("next", ["build"], {
  stdio: "inherit",
  // Windows resolves `next` to next.cmd, which needs a shell.
  shell: true,
  env: { ...process.env, NEXT_DIST_DIR: ".next-verify" },
});

process.exit(result.status ?? 1);

````

## Source: scripts/build-cloud-android.ps1

````text
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.byline-local/cloud-dart-defines.json')) { throw 'Prepare the cloud build configuration first.' }
$bylineTemp = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path '.byline-local/java-tmp'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bylineTemp | Out-Null
$bylineOldTemp=$env:TEMP; $bylineOldTmp=$env:TMP; $bylineOldJava=$env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
$env:TEMP=$bylineTemp; $env:TMP=$bylineTemp; $env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-Djdk.net.unixdomain.tmpdir=$bylineTemp"
Push-Location -LiteralPath 'mobile'
try {
  flutter build apk --release --dart-define-from-file=../.byline-local/cloud-dart-defines.json
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'ByLine cloud release build failed.' }
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk' -Destination '../.byline-local/byline-cloud-release.apk'
  Write-Output 'Release APK prepared. Nothing was installed on a phone.'
} finally { Pop-Location; $env:TEMP=$bylineOldTemp; $env:TMP=$bylineOldTmp; $env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=$bylineOldJava }

````

def clean(value):
    return (str(value).replace('\u2019', "'").replace('\u2018', "'")
            .replace('\u201c', '"').replace('\u201d', '"').replace('\u2013', '-')
            .replace('\u2014', ' - ').replace('\u00a0', ' ').replace('\u2026', '...')
            .encode('ascii', 'backslashreplace').decode())


def git_files():
    raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=ROOT)
    return sorted({p.decode('utf-8') for p in raw.split(b'\0') if p and (ROOT / p.decode('utf-8')).is_file()})


def purpose(path):
    p = Path(path); stem = p.stem
    if path in DERIVED:
        return {'docs/repository-inventory.json': 'Generated machine-readable file, hash, purpose, symbol and import inventory.',
                'docs/generated-reference.md': 'Generated searchable complete file/reference/source appendix in Markdown.',

                'output/pdf/ByLine-Complete-Project-Handbook.pdf': 'Condensed human-readable handbook with every-file catalogue and linked exhaustive source reference.'}[path]
    exact = {
        'docs/handbook.md': 'Authored architecture, user/developer/operator manual and implementation explanations for the PDF.',
        'docs/README.md': 'Documentation entry point and reproducible PDF generation instructions.',
        'releases/android/README.md': 'Phone download/install/update instructions and release provenance.',

        'DEPLOY.md': 'Original hosted deployment procedure and infrastructure notes.',
        'DESIGN.md': 'Design language, typography, layout and interaction rationale.',
        '.env.example': 'Blank original-backend environment variable template with operator comments.',
        '.gitattributes': 'Preserves PDF/APK binary bytes across Git checkouts and exempts embedded source whitespace in the generated reference.',
        'app/page.tsx': 'Original React operator gate, setup and dashboard UI.',
        'app/layout.tsx': 'Root Next.js HTML/layout and metadata wrapper.',
        'app/globals.css': 'Original web dashboard global styling.',
        'middleware.ts': 'Original Next.js request authentication/gating middleware.',
        'next.config.ts': 'Next.js build/runtime configuration and output directory settings.',
        'next-env.d.ts': 'Next.js generated TypeScript framework declarations reference.',
        'vercel.json': 'Original Vercel deployment/runtime configuration.',
        'cloud/wrangler.jsonc': 'Dedicated Worker account, D1 and Workflow bindings, timer and observability configuration.',
        'cloud/README.md': 'Dedicated cloud ownership, deployment, free-budget limits and recovery guidance.',
        'mobile/lib/main.dart': 'Flutter startup, Firebase/session bootstrap, provider and authenticated/onboarding root routing.',
        'mobile/lib/main_preview.dart': 'Deterministic mock-data visual-preview entry point for UI scenarios.',
        'mobile/lib/api/client.dart': 'Authenticated JSON/multipart transport, secure session/pending flow storage, timeout and reconnect handling.',
        'mobile/lib/api/models.dart': 'Dart JSON response models used by app state and screens.',
        'mobile/lib/state/app_state.dart': 'Observable account/status state, refresh, preparation and cross-screen navigation commands.',
        'mobile/lib/auth_return.dart': 'Desktop loopback sign-in return listener and cancellation.',
        'mobile/lib/android_notifications.dart': 'Android notification platform-channel helpers and payload handling.',
        'mobile/lib/desktop_notifications.dart': 'Desktop notification capability/handling abstraction.',
        'mobile/lib/push.dart': 'Firebase token registration, permission, foreground/background and notification-tap integration.',
        'mobile/lib/theme.dart': 'ByLine Flutter colors, typography, layout tokens and system chrome style.',
        'mobile/android/app/google-services.json': 'Firebase Android client project/app identifiers; not a service-account private key.',
        'mobile/android/app/build.gradle.kts': 'Android package variants, Dart-define routing, Firebase input, SDK defaults and release signing.',
        'mobile/android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/linkdin/linkdin_mobile/MainActivity.kt': 'Android Flutter host and native notification channel/platform integration.',
        'mobile/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml': 'Android permissions, application/activity identity, OAuth intent and notification metadata.',
    }
    if path in exact: return exact[path]
    if path.startswith('app/api/'):
        endpoint=path.removeprefix('app').removesuffix('/route.ts')
        if p.name=='redirect-uri.ts': return 'Resolves and validates the original LinkedIn callback URI for OAuth requests.'
        return 'Next.js App Router HTTP handler for '+endpoint+'. Validates request/authentication, delegates domain operations and returns the endpoint contract.'
    if path.startswith('lib/') and stem in LIB: return LIB[stem]
    if path.startswith('cloud/src/') and stem in CLOUD: return CLOUD[stem]
    if path.startswith('mobile/lib/screens/') and stem in SCREENS: return SCREENS[stem]
    if path.startswith('mobile/lib/widgets/') and stem in WIDGETS: return WIDGETS[stem]
    if '/scripts/' in '/' + path and stem in SCRIPTS: return SCRIPTS[stem]
    if path.startswith('reports/ui-preview/'):
        return f'Historical UI preview of {stem.rsplit("-", 1)[0]} at viewport width {stem.rsplit("-", 1)[-1]} pixels.'
    if path.startswith('reports/'):
        return 'Dated project evidence, plan or verification record: ' + stem.replace('ByLine-', '').replace('-', ' ') + '. Historical claims retain their original date.'
    if path.startswith('cloud/migrations/'):
        return 'D1 schema migration: ' + ('initial complete SQLite tables, ownership keys and indexes.' if '0001' in stem else 'durable jobs, AI reservation triggers and operational indexes.')
    if path.startswith('cloud/test/') or path.startswith('mobile/test/'):
        return ('Cloud Worker/D1 regression suite: ' if path.startswith('cloud/') else 'Flutter widget/transport regression suite: ') + stem.replace('.test', '').replace('_test', '').replace('_', ' ') + '. Exact test titles and assertions appear below.'
    if p.name == 'package.json': return 'npm package identity, direct dependency version ranges and executable task commands for ' + ('the cloud backend.' if path.startswith('cloud/') else 'the original backend.')
    if p.name == 'package-lock.json': return 'Exact npm dependency resolution tree, integrity hashes and platform packages for reproducible installation.'
    if p.name == 'pubspec.yaml': return 'Flutter package metadata, version, Dart constraint, direct plugins, font and asset declarations.'
    if p.name == 'pubspec.lock': return 'Exact resolved Dart/Flutter dependency versions and source checksums.'
    if p.name == 'tsconfig.json': return 'TypeScript compiler settings and included/excluded source scope for this package.'
    if p.name == '.gitignore': return 'Git exclusion rules for generated, private or local-only files in this directory scope.'
    if path.startswith('.github/workflows/'):
        return {'ci.yml': 'GitHub Actions root logic/type/build checks and disposable PostgreSQL integration tests.',
                'ci-mobile.yml': 'Path-filtered GitHub Actions Flutter analysis and tests.',
                'backup.yml': 'Scheduled original PostgreSQL encrypted backup artifact workflow.',
                'watchdog.yml': 'External scheduled original-backend health/reminder watchdog workflow.'}.get(p.name, 'Repository automation workflow.')
    if p.suffix == '.ttf': return 'Bundled ' + stem + ' font asset used by Flutter typography; see pubspec.yaml and theme.dart.'
    if p.name == 'OFL.txt': return 'Bundled font license terms.'
    if 'generated_plugin' in p.name: return 'Flutter-generated Windows native plugin registration/build linkage; regenerated from plugin dependencies.'
    if path.startswith('mobile/windows/'):
        return 'Windows Flutter host ' + {
            '.cpp':'implementation', '.h':'header', '.rc':'resource definition', '.ico':'application icon',
            '.manifest':'executable compatibility manifest', '.txt':'CMake build definition',
        }.get(p.suffix.lower(), 'configuration') + ' for ' + stem.replace('_', ' ') + '.'
    if 'ic_launcher' in p.name: return 'Android launcher icon at the resource density specified by its parent directory.'
    if 'ic_notification' in p.name: return 'Android monochrome notification status-bar icon vector.'
    if 'launch_background' in p.name: return 'Android launch/splash background drawable for this resource variant.'
    if p.name == 'styles.xml': return 'Android startup/normal activity theme for ' + ('dark mode.' if 'night' in path else 'default mode.')
    if p.name == 'AndroidManifest.xml': return 'Android ' + p.parent.name + ' build manifest overlay and permissions.'
    if path.startswith('mobile/android/'):
        return 'Android build/toolchain configuration: ' + p.name + '; controls ' + ('Gradle distribution bootstrap.' if 'wrapper' in path else 'project build and plugin setup.')
    if path.startswith('mobile/web/'):
        return 'Flutter web scaffold ' + ('icon/branding asset.' if p.suffix == '.png' else 'bootstrap document and application metadata.')
    if p.name == '.metadata': return 'Flutter project/platform creation metadata used by migration tooling.'
    if p.name == 'analysis_options.yaml': return 'Dart analyzer and Flutter lint configuration.'
    if p.name == 'README.md': return 'Directory-specific usage, asset provenance or platform instructions.'
    raise ValueError('Add a meaningful purpose for uncatalogued file: ' + path)


def parse_symbols(source):
    names = re.findall(r'^\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:default\s+)?(?:async\s+)?(?:function|class|interface|type|enum|mixin|typedef)\s+([\w$]+)', source, re.M)
    names += re.findall(r'^export\s+(?:const|let)\s+(\w+)', source, re.M)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(names))


def parse_imports(source):
    return sorted(set(re.findall(r'''(?:from\s*|import\s*[(']|require\s*\()\s*['"]([^'"\n]+)['"]''', source)
                      + re.findall(r'''^\s*(?:import|export)\s+['"]([^'"\n]+)['"]''', source, re.M)))


def tests_in(source):
    return re.findall(r'''\b(?:test|testWidgets|group|describe)\s*\(\s*['"]([^'"\n]+)['"]''', source)


def records():
    paths = sorted(set(git_files()) | DERIVED)
    result = []
    for path in paths:
        entry = {'path': path, 'purpose': purpose(path), 'derived': path in DERIVED}
        file = ROOT / path
        if path not in DERIVED and file.exists():
            raw = file.read_bytes()
            entry.update(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
            if file.suffix.lower() not in BINARY:
                source = raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
                entry.update(lines=len(source.splitlines()), lf_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest(), symbols=parse_symbols(source), imports=parse_imports(source), tests=tests_in(source))
        result.append(entry)
    return result


styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
styles.add(ParagraphStyle('BodyText2', fontName='Helvetica', fontSize=9.5, leading=14, spaceAfter=8, splitLongWords=True))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle('Small2', fontName='Helvetica', fontSize=8, leading=11, spaceAfter=5, splitLongWords=True))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle('Code2', fontName='Courier', fontSize=7, leading=9))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle('FileHead', fontName='Helvetica-Bold', fontSize=11, leading=15, textColor=colors.HexColor('#145a65'), spaceBefore=13, spaceAfter=7, keepWithNext=True, splitLongWords=True))
styles['Heading1'].fontName = 'Helvetica-Bold'; styles['Heading1'].fontSize=19; styles['Heading1'].leading=24
styles['Heading1'].textColor=colors.HexColor('#123e46'); styles['Heading1'].spaceAfter=15
styles['Heading2'].fontSize=12; styles['Heading2'].leading=17
STORY=[]; MD=[]; ANCHORS=0


def para(text, small=False):
    STORY.append(Paragraph(html.escape(clean(text)), styles['Small2' if small else 'BodyText2']))


def heading(text, level=1, breakpage=False, toc=True):
    global ANCHORS
    if breakpage: STORY.append(PageBreak())
    ANCHORS += 1
    item=Paragraph(html.escape(clean(text)), styles['Heading1' if level==1 else 'FileHead'])
    item._anchor='section-'+str(ANCHORS); item._title=clean(text); item._level=level; item._toc=toc
    STORY.append(item)


def code(source, numbered=True):
    lines=[]
    for num,line in enumerate(source.splitlines(),1):
        # Display every character, using ASCII escapes for non-ASCII codepoints.
        # Never truncate long source lines; continuation lines retain their association.
        prefix=f'{num:5} | ' if numbered else ''
        text=clean(line.expandtabs(4))
        chunks=textwrap.wrap(text,width=108-len(prefix),replace_whitespace=False,drop_whitespace=False,break_on_hyphens=False) or ['']
        lines.append(prefix+chunks[0])
        lines.extend(('      > ' if numbered else '  ')+chunk for chunk in chunks[1:])
    # Small splittable blocks avoid huge layout objects for long application files.
    for i in range(0,len(lines),70): STORY.append(Preformatted('\n'.join(lines[i:i+70]),styles['Code2']))


def markdown(source):
    buffer=[]; in_code=False; code_lines=[]
    def flush():
        if buffer: para(' '.join(buffer)); buffer.clear()
    for line in source.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('```'):
            flush()
            if in_code: code('\n'.join(code_lines),False); code_lines=[]
            in_code=not in_code; continue
        if in_code: code_lines.append(line); continue
        if line.startswith('# '): continue
        if line.startswith('## '): flush(); heading(line[3:],1,True); continue
        if line.startswith('### '): flush(); heading(line[4:],2,toc=False); continue
        if not line.strip(): flush(); continue
        if re.match(r'^(\d+\.|[-*]) ',line): flush(); para(line); continue
        buffer.append(line.strip())
    flush()


class Handbook(BaseDocTemplate):
    def __init__(self,path):
        super().__init__(str(path),pagesize=A4,rightMargin=47,leftMargin=47,topMargin=49,bottomMargin=43,
                         title='ByLine - Complete Project Handbook',author='ByLine project',pageCompression=1)
        self.addPageTemplates(PageTemplate(id='main',frames=[Frame(self.leftMargin,self.bottomMargin,self.width,self.height,id='body',leftPadding=0,rightPadding=0,topPadding=0,bottomPadding=0)],onPage=self.page))
    def page(self,c,doc):
        c.saveState(); c.setStrokeColor(colors.HexColor('#c9d9d9')); c.line(47, A4[1]-34, A4[0]-47,A4[1]-34)
        c.setFont('Helvetica',8); c.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#53666a'))
        c.drawString(47,A4[1]-27,'BYLINE / COMPLETE PROJECT HANDBOOK')
        c.drawString(47,26,'Source snapshot: '+DATE); c.drawRightString(A4[0]-47,26,str(doc.page)); c.restoreState()
    def afterFlowable(self,flow):
        if hasattr(flow,'_anchor'):
            self.canv.bookmarkPage(flow._anchor)
            self.canv.addOutlineEntry(flow._title,flow._anchor,level=flow._level-1,closed=True)
            if flow._toc and flow._level==1: self.notify('TOCEntry',(0,flow._title,self.page,flow._anchor))


def npm_reference(path):
    lock=json.loads((ROOT/path).read_text('utf-8'))
    for name,item in sorted(lock.get('packages',{}).items()):
        if not name: continue
        deps=item.get('dependencies',{})
        yield f'{name} | version={item.get("version","workspace")} | dev={item.get("dev",False)} | optional={item.get("optional",False)} | license={item.get("license","not recorded")}'
        if item.get('engines'): yield '  engines: '+json.dumps(item['engines'],sort_keys=True)
        if item.get('os') or item.get('cpu'): yield '  platform: '+json.dumps({k:item[k] for k in ['os','cpu'] if k in item})
        if deps: yield '  requires: '+', '.join(k+' '+v for k,v in sorted(deps.items()))
        if item.get('peerDependencies'): yield '  peers: '+json.dumps(item['peerDependencies'],sort_keys=True)
        if item.get('integrity'): yield '  integrity: '+item['integrity']
        if item.get('resolved'): yield '  resolved: '+item['resolved']


def main():

    entries=records()
    INVENTORY.write_text(json.dumps({'snapshot_date':DATE,'policy':'All Git-tracked and non-ignored working files. sha256 hashes workstation bytes; lf_sha256 normalizes CRLF to LF for cross-platform Git comparisons. Derived document artifacts are listed without self-referential hashes.','files':entries},indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    source_entries=[e for e in entries if 'lines' in e and e['path'] not in {'docs/handbook.md'} and not e['path'].endswith('package-lock.json')]
    total_lines=sum(e['lines'] for e in source_entries)
    base=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    STORY.extend([Spacer(1,95),Paragraph('BYLINE',ParagraphStyle('Cover',fontName='Helvetica-Bold',fontSize=44,leading=50,textColor=colors.HexColor('#123e46'))),Spacer(1,22)])
    para('THE COMPLETE PROJECT HANDBOOK')

    heading('Contents',1,True,False)

    STORY.append(toc)
    markdown((ROOT/'docs/handbook.md').read_text('utf-8'))
    heading('26. Release metadata and fresh verification',1,True)
    for path in ['releases/android/release.json','reports/ByLine-release-verification-2026-11-07.md']:

Derived handbook artifacts are listed without recursive content/hashes. Binary assets have metadata instead of source text. The JSON inventory has full SHA-256 values for every non-derived file.')
    MD.append('# ByLine generated complete reference\n\nGenerated from publishable repository files on '+DATE+'.\n')
    MD.append('## Complete file catalogue\n')
    for e in entries:
        heading(e['path'],2,toc=False); para(e['purpose'])
        meta=f'{e.get("bytes","generated")} bytes'
        if 'lines' in e: meta+=f'; {e["lines"]} lines'
        if 'sha256' in e: meta+='; SHA-256 '+e['sha256']
        para(meta,True)
        if e.get('symbols'): para('Declared symbols: '+', '.join(e['symbols']),True)

    heading('28. Direct packages and exact resolved dependencies',1,True)

They are complete package-entry inventories, not third-party implementation source. Flutter exact resolutions are in mobile/pubspec.lock and the companion repository source reference.')
    for path in ['package-lock.json','cloud/package-lock.json']:

    heading('29. Import and configuration-use index',1,True)
    imports=collections.defaultdict(list); variables=collections.defaultdict(set)
    for e in entries:
        for module in e.get('imports',[]): imports[module].append(e['path'])

        for number,line in enumerate((ROOT/e['path']).read_text('utf-8-sig').splitlines(),1):
            names=re.findall(r'process\.env\.([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)|\benv\.([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)|\$env:([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)|fromEnvironment\([\s]*[\'"]([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)',line)
            for group in names:

        # Multiline Dart environment declarations.

    para('This syntactic index covers static imports and literal environment accesses. Dynamically computed names, CLI flags and generated platform bindings are additionally documented by their source/config files. Values are never read from private environment files.')
    for name,locations in sorted(variables.items()):

The thousands of lines of raw application code are available as a separate searchable repository reference, rather than repeated in this PDF.')
    STORY.append(Paragraph('<link href="https://github.com/Don-Gabriel/link_agent/blob/main/docs/generated-reference.md" color="#145a65">Open the complete source reference on GitHub</link>',styles['BodyText2']))
    para('Repository path: docs/generated-reference.md. Download the raw Markdown if GitHub truncates its preview. It contains the full project-owned text listings, historical reports and lockfile resolution details. Individual files remain available at their paths in the repository.')
    for title,description in [
        ('A screen or interaction','Find its mobile/lib/screens or mobile/lib/widgets path in chapter 27, then follow its imports to AppState and ApiClient.'),

        ('A database field or concurrency rule','Use the D1 schema in chapter 30; inspect lib/schema.ts for PostgreSQL and the relevant adapter for transaction behavior.'),
        ('An AI prompt or editorial edge case','Inspect lib/writer-core.ts, lib/judge-core.ts, lib/critique.ts and the deployment-specific AI adapter.'),
        ('A package, configuration key or helper','Use chapters 28-29 for versions and usage locations, then the complete source file for the exact branch.'),

    ]:
        heading(title,2,toc=False);para(description)

Source snippets printed in this PDF use line numbers and wrap long lines; the repository contains the original bytes. Historical comments and reports may describe an earlier implementation.')
    for e in source_entries:

````text
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
````

````text
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')
$bylineTemp = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path '.byline-local/java-tmp'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bylineTemp | Out-Null
# Process-local settings: avoid the packaged-shell/JVM Unix-socket temp-path issue.
$bylineOldTemp = $env:TEMP
$bylineOldTmp = $env:TMP
$bylineOldJavaOptions = $env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
$env:TEMP = $bylineTemp
$env:TMP = $bylineTemp
$env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS = "-Djdk.net.unixdomain.tmpdir=$bylineTemp"
Push-Location -LiteralPath 'mobile'
try {
  flutter build apk --debug --dart-define=BYLINE_API_URL=http://localhost:3100 --dart-define=BYLINE_LOCAL_TEST=true
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Android preview build failed.' }
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk' -Destination '../.byline-local/byline-preview.apk'
} finally {
  Pop-Location
  $env:TEMP = $bylineOldTemp
  $env:TMP = $bylineOldTmp
  $env:JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS = $bylineOldJavaOptions
}
````

````text
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { nativeReturnUri } from '../lib/native-return';
import { nativeCallbackPage } from '../lib/native-callback';
import {nextSlotRun,localClock} from '../lib/schedule';
import {createUserSession,verifySession,sessionIdentity} from '../lib/auth';
import {defaultSetup,firstDelivery,parseSetup,setupStyle} from '../lib/onboarding';
async function main(){
process.env.APP_SECRET='local-unit-test-secret';
const desktop = `http://127.0.0.1:54321/byline-return/${'a'.repeat(43)}`;
assert.equal(nativeReturnUri(desktop),desktop);
for (const bad of [desktop.replace('127.0.0.1','localhost'),desktop.replace(':54321',':80'),desktop.replace(':54321',':99999'),desktop+'?code=secret',desktop+'#fragment',desktop.replace('127.0.0.1','evil.example'),desktop.replace('127.0.0.1','user@127.0.0.1'),desktop.replace('/byline-return/','/other/')]) assert.equal(nativeReturnUri(bad),null);
const page=await nativeCallbackPage(true,desktop).text();
assert.ok(page.includes(`content="1;url=${desktop}"`) && !page.includes('intent://'));
const expired=await nativeCallbackPage(false).text();
assert.ok(expired.includes('could not be completed') && !expired.includes('href="/"'));
const session=await createUserSession('11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111','22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222');
assert.equal(await verifySession(session.value),true);
assert.equal(await verifySession(session.value+'.extra'),false);
assert.equal((await sessionIdentity(session.value))?.userId,'11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111');
const spring=nextSlotRun('America/New_York','09:00',1,new Date('2026-03-07T12:00:00Z'))!;
assert.equal(spring.toISOString(),'2026-03-08T13:00:00.000Z');
const autumn=nextSlotRun('America/New_York','09:00',1,new Date('2026-10-31T12:00:00Z'))!;
assert.equal(autumn.toISOString(),'2026-11-01T14:00:00.000Z');
const repeated=nextSlotRun('America/New_York','01:30',127,new Date('2026-11-01T05:31:00Z'))!;
assert.equal(localClock('America/New_York',repeated).date,'2026-11-02');
const seconds=nextSlotRun('UTC','09:00',127,new Date('2026-09-06T08:20:41Z'))!;
assert.equal(seconds.toISOString(),'2026-09-06T09:00:00.000Z');
const next=firstDelivery({...defaultSetup,timezone:'Asia/Kolkata'},new Date('2026-09-06T01:00:00Z'));
assert.equal(next.toISOString(),'2026-09-07T03:30:00.000Z');
assert.throws(()=>parseSetup({...defaultSetup,topics:['AI','ai','AI']}));
assert.throws(()=>parseSetup({...defaultSetup,timezone:'No/SuchZone'}));
assert.equal(setupStyle(defaultSetup).signature,null);
console.log('ByLine session, input validation, first-delivery and DST checks passed.');
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

````text
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { localEnv } from './local-env.mjs';
import pg from 'pg';
const env=localEnv();const base=`http://127.0.0.1:${env.PORT}`;
// Each run has its own synthetic client so repeated tests do not throttle the phone.
const testClient=`2001:db8:${randomBytes(8).toString('hex').match(/.{4}/g).join(':')}::1`;
let passed=0;
````

````text
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {ALL_CATEGORY_IDS,CATEGORIES,LEGACY_CATEGORY_IDS,categoryBlock,describeCategories,isCategoryId} from '../lib/categories';
import {SUBJECT_GROUPS} from '../lib/category-catalogue';
import {discover,feedsForCategories} from '../lib/discovery';
import {defaultSetup,parseSetup,setupStyle,setupCategories,setupPersona,INDUSTRIES} from '../lib/onboarding';
import {relevanceTotal,PUBLISH_THRESHOLD} from '../lib/judge';
import {styleBlock} from '../lib/style';

async function main() {
  const labels=Object.values(CATEGORIES).map(c=>c.label.toLowerCase());
  assert.ok(ALL_CATEGORY_IDS.length>=1000);
  assert.equal(new Set(labels).size,labels.length,'subjects have distinct labels');
  assert.equal(ALL_CATEGORY_IDS.length,12+SUBJECT_GROUPS.reduce((n,g)=>n+g[2].split('|').length,0),'no colliding IDs');
  assert.ok(ALL_CATEGORY_IDS.every(id=>isCategoryId(id)&&feedsForCategories([id]).length>0));
  for(const id of ['__proto__','constructor','toString','unknown']) assert.equal(isCategoryId(id),false);
  assert.equal(categoryBlock([]),categoryBlock(LEGACY_CATEGORY_IDS));
  assert.equal(describeCategories([]),describeCategories(LEGACY_CATEGORY_IDS));
  const subjects=['energy:solar-energy','music:spatial-audio','health:patient-safety'];
  const config=parseSetup({...defaultSetup,categories:subjects,topics:subjects.map(id=>CATEGORIES[id].label),voice:'analytical',voiceNotes:'Explain the practical implications.',style:{structure:'bullets',minWords:80,maxWords:160,register:'accessible',emoji:'sparing',hook:'plain',cta:'soft',hashtagCount:0,bannedPhrases:['game changer']}});
  assert.deepEqual(setupCategories(config),subjects);
  const persona=setupPersona(config,'Author');
  assert.equal(persona.input.domain,describeCategories(subjects));
  assert.deepEqual(persona.builtFor,subjects);
  const style=setupStyle(config);
  assert.equal(style.structure,'bullets');assert.equal(style.minWords,80);assert.equal(style.maxWords,160);assert.equal(style.hashtagCount,0);
  assert.ok(styleBlock(style).includes('Explain the practical implications.'));
  assert.equal(setupStyle(defaultSetup).signature,null);
  assert.equal(parseSetup({...defaultSetup,voice:undefined}).voice,'professional');
  for(const categories of [[],['__proto__'],[subjects[0],subjects[0]],ALL_CATEGORY_IDS.slice(0,13)]) assert.throws(()=>parseSetup({...defaultSetup,categories}));
  for(const style of [{minWords:200,maxWords:100},{emoji:'always'},{bannedPhrases:['x'.repeat(81)]},{minWords:'80'}]) assert.throws(()=>parseSetup({...defaultSetup,style}));
  for(const industry of INDUSTRIES) assert.ok(industry.categories.every(isCategoryId));
  const great={persona_fit:10,category_fit:10,novelty:10,timeliness:10,non_duplication:10};
  assert.equal(relevanceTotal(great,subjects[0],subjects),10);
  for(const scores of [{...great,category_fit:6},{...great,persona_fit:5}]) assert.ok(relevanceTotal(scores,subjects[0],subjects)<PUBLISH_THRESHOLD,'novelty cannot override poor relevance');
  assert.ok(relevanceTotal(great,'finance',subjects)<PUBLISH_THRESHOLD);
  assert.ok(relevanceTotal(great,'invented',subjects)<PUBLISH_THRESHOLD);
  const realFetch=globalThis.fetch;
  const calls:string[]=[];
  globalThis.fetch=async input=>{
    const url=String(input);calls.push(url);
    return new Response(`<rss><channel><item><title>Solar energy research improves panel recycling</title><link>https://example.org/solar-research</link><description>Researchers tested a new process for recovering materials from retired solar panels in a controlled laboratory study.</description><pubDate>${new Date().toUTCString()}</pubDate></item></channel></rss>`);
  };
  try {
    const discovered=await discover({categories:[subjects[0]]});
    assert.equal(calls.length,1,'only the selected subject is fetched');
    assert.equal(new URL(calls[0]).searchParams.get('q'),'"Solar energy" when:7d');
    assert.equal(discovered[0].categoryHint,subjects[0]);
    assert.ok(discovered[0].summary.includes('solar panels'));
  } finally {globalThis.fetch=realFetch;}
  console.log(`Catalogue verified: ${ALL_CATEGORY_IDS.length} unique subjects, ${SUBJECT_GROUPS.length} specialist groups; discovery, relevance and voice persistence checks passed.`);
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
````

## Source: scripts/check-feeds.mjs

````text
/**
 * Feed reachability check. Run from YOUR network:  npm run check:feeds
 *
 * Several music-tech hosts were unreachable from the environment this project
 * was built in, which could mean the feed is dead or could mean that network
 * blocked the host. Rather than guess, the feed list ships with those marked
 * unverified and this script tells you the truth from where it actually runs.
 *
 * Feed URLs are read straight out of lib/discovery.ts so the two can never
 * drift apart.
 */
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const source = await readFile(join(root, "lib", "discovery.ts"), "utf8");

// Match the { name: "...", url: ... } shape of each FEEDS entry.
//
// The url value is EITHER a quoted literal OR a helper call like
// arxivUrl("cs.SD", 5). It must be matched as one of those two alternatives
// rather than as "everything up to the next comma" — the naive version stops
// at the comma INSIDE the helper's argument list, so every arXiv feed came out
// as an unparseable fragment and got reported as a dead source it never was.
const entries = [
  ...source.matchAll(/name:\s*"([^"]+)",\s*\n?\s*url:\s*("[^"]*"|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\([^)]*\)),/g),
].map((m) => ({
  name: m[1],
  raw: m[2].trim(),
}));

const resolved = entries.map((entry) => {
  if (entry.raw.startsWith('"')) return { ...entry, url: entry.raw.slice(1, -1) };
  // arxivUrl("cs.SD", 5) — reconstruct the query the helper builds.
  const arxiv = /arxivUrl\("([^"]+)",\s*(\d+)\)/.exec(entry.raw);
  if (arxiv) {
    return {
      ...entry,
      url: `https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=cat:${arxiv[1]}&start=0&max_results=${arxiv[2]}&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending`,
    };
  }
  return { ...entry, url: null };
});

console.log(`Checking ${resolved.length} feeds…\n`);
let live = 0;

for (const feed of resolved) {
  if (!feed.url) {
    console.log(`  ?  ${feed.name.padEnd(18)} could not resolve URL from source`);
    continue;
  }
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 15_000);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(feed.url, {
      signal: controller.signal,
      headers: { "User-Agent": "linkedin-creator/1.0 (+feed check)" },
    });
    const body = await res.text();
    const items = (body.match(/<(?:item|entry)[\s>]/g) ?? []).length;
    if (res.ok && items > 0) {
      live++;
      console.log(`  ok ${feed.name.padEnd(18)} ${String(items).padStart(3)} items`);
    } else {
      console.log(`  !! ${feed.name.padEnd(18)} http ${res.status}, ${items} items`);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`  XX ${feed.name.padEnd(18)} ${String(err?.message ?? err)}`);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

console.log(`\n${live}/${resolved.length} feeds returned items.`);
console.log("Anything marked XX or !! can be removed from FEEDS in lib/discovery.ts,");
console.log("or left alone — a dead feed costs one logged warning per cycle and nothing else.");

````

````text
/**
 * Integration tests: every query in the app, executed against a real Postgres.
 *
 * These exist because of a specific, expensive failure. `listDueSlots` shipped
 * with one unqualified column name that Postgres rejects as ambiguous, and the
 * scheduler had never run once — while the entire selftest suite passed. It
 * could not have caught it: scripts/selftest.ts exercises pure logic and never
 * opens a connection, so INVALID SQL THAT IS VALID TYPESCRIPT is invisible to
 * it. Three of the five bugs found on the first live run were of exactly this
 * kind.
 *
 * So this file's job is narrow and it is not "test the business logic" — that
 * is selftest.ts's job and it does it faster. This one exists to make every SQL
 * statement in the codebase actually reach a server and come back. A test here
 * that asserts nothing but runs a query still earns its place.
 *
 * The LLM is never called. Anything that would spend a token is either skipped
 * or fed a pre-made record, because a test suite that needs a model is a test
 * suite that stops running the first time a quota runs out.
 *
 * Run against a THROWAWAY database:
 *   DATABASE_URL=postgres://... npm run test:db
 * Every row it writes is removed on the way out, but it creates and deletes
 * agents, so do not point it at anything you care about.
 */
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { ensureAgent, getAgentSettings, getPrimaryAgent, updateAgentSettings, voiceReferencesFor } from "../lib/agents";
import { getAccountStatus } from "../lib/accounts";
import { ensureSchema, getPool, query } from "../lib/db";
import { listAmbiguousSends, sendsToday } from "../lib/distribute";
import { getTodayCalls } from "../lib/llm";
import { recall } from "../lib/memory";
import { forgetDevice, notify, pushConfigured, registerDevice } from "../lib/push";
import { checkLoginAllowed, clearLoginFailures, recordLoginFailure, MAX_ATTEMPTS } from "../lib/ratelimit";
import { DEAD_AFTER_FAILURES, deadFeeds, recordFeedResult } from "../lib/feedhealth";
import { RETENTION, sweepIfDue } from "../lib/retention";
import {
  claimSlotRun,
  createSlot,
  deleteSlot,
  ensureSlotsMigrated,
  listDueSlots,
  listSlots,
  recordTick,
  schedulerHealth,
  settleSlotRun,
  slotTimeline,
  updateSlot,
  withSlotLock,
} from "../lib/slots";

let failures = 0;
let ran = 0;

function check(label: string, ok: boolean, detail = "") {
  ran++;
  if (ok) {
    console.log(`  ok   ${label}`);
  } else {
    failures++;
    console.error(`  FAIL ${label}${detail ? ` — ${detail}` : ""}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Run a query path and report whether it merely EXECUTED.
 *
 * The point of this suite: an ambiguous column, a stale name, a wrong
 * placeholder count. These throw, and until now nothing made them throw
 * anywhere a human would see before production.
 */
async function runs<T>(label: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | undefined> {
  ran++;
  try {
    const value = await fn();
    console.log(`  ok   ${label}`);
    return value;
  } catch (err) {
    failures++;
    console.error(`  FAIL ${label} — ${String((err as Error)?.message ?? err)}`);
    return undefined;
  }
}

async function main() {
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
    console.error("DATABASE_URL is not set. These tests need a real, throwaway Postgres.");
    process.exit(2);
  }

  // A name nothing else will collide with, so a failed run cannot poison the
  // next one and two runs can share a database.
  const marker = `dbtest-${randomUUID()}`;
  let agentId = "";

  console.log("\nschema");
  {
    check("the schema applies", await ensureSchema());
    // Applied twice on purpose: every statement is IF NOT EXISTS / ADD COLUMN
    // IF NOT EXISTS, and a re-run is what actually happens on every cold start.
    check("the schema is idempotent", await ensureSchema());
  }

  console.log("\nagents");
  {
    const created = await runs("ensureAgent inserts", () =>
      ensureAgent({ name: marker, domain: "emerging tech", categories: ["emerging-tech", "ai-ml"] }),
    );
    agentId = created?.agentId ?? "";
    check("a new agent has an id", agentId.length > 0);

    const again = await runs("ensureAgent is idempotent on the persona hash", () =>
      ensureAgent({ name: marker, domain: "emerging tech", categories: ["emerging-tech", "ai-ml"] }),
    );
    check("the same persona returns the same agent", again?.agentId === agentId, `${again?.agentId} vs ${agentId}`);
    check("and reports it was not created", again?.created === false);

    const settings = await runs("getAgentSettings reads back", () => getAgentSettings(agentId));
    check("the categories round-tripped", settings?.categories.length === 2, JSON.stringify(settings?.categories));

    // The write path the app's most-used control takes.
    const patched = await runs("updateAgentSettings writes categories and the derived scope", () =>
      updateAgentSettings(agentId, { categories: ["compute-silicon"] }),
    );
    check("the category change stuck", patched?.categories.join() === "compute-silicon");
    check("the scope line followed it", patched?.domain === "compute and silicon", patched?.domain);
    check("an empty category list is refused",
      (await updateAgentSettings(agentId, { categories: [] }))?.categories.join() === "compute-silicon");

    await runs("updateAgentSettings writes a style patch", () =>
      updateAgentSettings(agentId, { style: { hashtagCount: 4 }, corpus: ["x ".repeat(60)] }),
    );
    await runs("updateAgentSettings writes the schedule fields", () =>
      updateAgentSettings(agentId, { timezone: "Asia/Kolkata", postTimeLocal: "09:30", autoPublishCap: 2 }),
    );
    await runs("getPrimaryAgent", () => getPrimaryAgent());
    await runs("voiceReferencesFor joins posts", () => {
      const s = getAgentSettings(agentId);
      return s.then((v) => (v ? voiceReferencesFor(v) : Promise.resolve(null)));
    });
  }

  console.log("\nslots — the queries that had never run");
  {
    await runs("ensureSlotsMigrated", () => ensureSlotsMigrated(agentId, "09:30", "Asia/Kolkata", false));

    const made = await runs("createSlot", () =>
      createSlot(agentId, "Asia/Kolkata", { localTime: "09:30", leadMinutes: 30 }),
    );
    const slotId = made && made.ok ? made.slot.id : "";
    check("the slot was created", slotId.length > 0, JSON.stringify(made));

    await runs("listSlots", () => listSlots(agentId));
    await runs("updateSlot", () =>
      updateSlot(agentId, slotId, "Asia/Kolkata", { leadMinutes: 45, enabled: true }),
    );

    // THE regression. listDueSlots joins post_slots to agents, and both carry a
    // categories_json column — an unqualified reference is rejected by Postgres
    // as ambiguous, which is a runtime error no type checker can see.
    const due = await runs("listDueSlots (the ambiguous-column regression)", () => listDueSlots());
    check("listDueSlots returned a list", Array.isArray(due), typeof due);

    await runs("slotTimeline", () => slotTimeline(agentId, 7));
    await runs("schedulerHealth", () => schedulerHealth());
    await runs("recordTick", () => recordTick());

    // The claim/settle pair, including the retry-after-failure behaviour that
    // used to burn a slot for the whole day. Exactly-once for a run that
    // produced something; retryable only for one that failed outright.
    const slot = (await listSlots(agentId)).find((s) => s.id === slotId)!;
    const runDate = "2999-01-01"; // far future, so it cannot collide with a real run
    const fakeDue = {
      slot,
      timezone: "Asia/Kolkata",
      scheduledFor: new Date(Date.now() + 3_600_000),
      runDate,
      missed: false,
    };
    const claimed = await runs("claimSlotRun", () => claimSlotRun(fakeDue));
    check("the first claim succeeds", claimed === true);
    check("the second claim is refused", (await claimSlotRun(fakeDue)) === false);
    await runs("settleSlotRun records a failure", () => settleSlotRun(slotId, runDate, "failed"));
    check("a failed run waits for its retry backoff", (await claimSlotRun(fakeDue)) === false);
    await query("UPDATE slot_runs SET retry_at=now()-interval '1 second' WHERE slot_id=$1 AND run_date=$2",[slotId,runDate]);
    check("a failed run may be retried after backoff", (await claimSlotRun(fakeDue)) === true);
    await runs("settleSlotRun records silence", () => settleSlotRun(slotId, runDate, "silent"));
    check("a settled run is not retried", (await claimSlotRun(fakeDue)) === false);

    // The advisory lock is transaction-scoped so it survives pgbouncer. That is
    // a property of the connection, not of the code, so it needs a real server.
    const locked = await runs("withSlotLock runs the body", () =>
      withSlotLock(slotId, async () => "ran", "busy"),
    );
    check("the lock body ran", locked === "ran");

    await runs("deleteSlot", () => deleteSlot(agentId, slotId));
  }

  console.log("\nposts, budgets and the dashboard fan-out");
  {
    // A published post, so the read paths have something to find rather than
    // returning empty and proving nothing.
    await runs("insert a post", () =>
      query(
        `INSERT INTO posts (agent_id, seq, text, rationale, sources_json, fingerprint, scores_json,
                            cycle_id, status, kind, category, hashtags_json, used_quote, published_at)
         VALUES ($1, 1, $2, 'because', '[]'::jsonb, 'fp — a summary', '{}'::jsonb,
                 1, 'published', 'auto', 'compute-silicon', '["Silicon"]'::jsonb, false, now())`,
        [agentId, "A published post body long enough to be picked up as a voice sample. ".repeat(6)],
      ),
    );

    await runs("sendsToday counts from local midnight", () => sendsToday(agentId, "Asia/Kolkata"));
    await runs("listAmbiguousSends", () => listAmbiguousSends(agentId));
    await runs("getAccountStatus with no connection", () => getAccountStatus(agentId));
    await runs("getTodayCalls", () => getTodayCalls());
    await runs("recall falls back to Postgres fingerprints", () => recall(agentId, "silicon"));
    await runs("insert a rejection", () =>
      query(
        `INSERT INTO rejections (agent_id, cycle_id, title, url, scores_json, reason)
         VALUES ($1, 1, 't', 'https://example.com/x', '{}'::jsonb, 'r')`,
        [agentId],
      ),
    );

    // The exact UNION the status route runs. It is the single most-hit query in
    // the app and the one most likely to break when a column is added.
    await runs("the status route's queue+history UNION", () =>
      query(
        `(SELECT id, seq, text, status, scheduled_for FROM posts
            WHERE agent_id = $1 AND status IN ('draft','approved','failed','unknown','missed')
            ORDER BY scheduled_for ASC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC LIMIT 20)
         UNION ALL
         (SELECT id, seq, text, status, scheduled_for FROM posts
            WHERE agent_id = $1 AND status = 'published'
            ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST, seq DESC LIMIT 20)`,
        [agentId],
      ),
    );

    // The judge's coverage input, added with the category-balance change.
    await runs("recent categories for the coverage tilt", () =>
      query(
        `SELECT category FROM posts WHERE agent_id = $1 AND category IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 12`,
        [agentId],
      ),
    );
  }

  console.log("\nlogin rate limiting");
  {
    const client = `dbtest-${randomUUID()}`;
    const fresh = await runs("checkLoginAllowed on an unseen client", () => checkLoginAllowed(client));
    check("an unseen client is allowed", fresh?.allowed === true);

    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_ATTEMPTS; i++) await recordLoginFailure(client);
    const blocked = await runs("checkLoginAllowed after the limit", () => checkLoginAllowed(client));
    check("the client is blocked at the limit", blocked?.allowed === false, JSON.stringify(blocked));
    check("it reports how long to wait", (blocked?.retryAfterMinutes ?? 0) > 0);

    await runs("clearLoginFailures", () => clearLoginFailures(client));
    check("a correct password forgives the history",
      (await checkLoginAllowed(client))?.allowed === true);
  }

  console.log("\npush notifications");
  {
    const token = `dbtest-token-${randomUUID()}${"x".repeat(40)}`;
    await runs("registerDevice inserts", () => registerDevice(agentId, token, "android"));
    await runs("registerDevice is an upsert", () => registerDevice(agentId, token, "android"));
    check("the device was stored once",
      (await query("SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens WHERE token = $1", [token])).length === 1);

    // Without FCM credentials notify() must be a no-op rather than an error:
    // the app has to work identically for someone who never set push up.
    check("push is not configured in tests", pushConfigured() === false);
    const sent = await runs("notify is a silent no-op with no credentials", () =>
      notify(agentId, { kind: "published", seq: 1 }),
    );
    check("nothing was delivered", sent === 0);

    // The cooldown query is the part with real SQL in it — an interval cast and
    // a count — and it runs on every single notification.
    await runs("the cooldown query executes", () =>
      query(
        `SELECT count(*) AS recent FROM push_log
          WHERE agent_id = $1 AND kind = $2 AND sent_at > now() - ($3 || ' minutes')::interval`,
        [agentId, "scheduler_stalled", "360"],
      ),
    );
    await runs("push_log accepts a row", () =>
      query("INSERT INTO push_log (agent_id, kind) VALUES ($1, $2)", [agentId, "published"]),
    );

    await runs("forgetDevice removes it", () => forgetDevice(token));
    check("the device is gone",
      (await query("SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens WHERE token = $1", [token])).length === 0);
  }

  console.log("\na queued post covers its slot");
  {
    // A slot exists to make sure something is published at that time, not that
    // the AGENT wrote it. The query below is what stops a hand-written post and
    // a generated one competing for the same moment.
    const soon = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
    const covers = async (at: string) =>
      (
        await query<{ seq: number }>(
          `SELECT seq FROM posts
             WHERE agent_id = $1
               AND status IN ('draft', 'approved')
               AND scheduled_for IS NOT NULL
               AND scheduled_for <= $2
               AND scheduled_for > now() - interval '5 minutes'
             ORDER BY scheduled_for LIMIT 1`,
          [agentId, at],
        )
      )[0]?.seq ?? null;

    check("an empty queue covers nothing", (await covers(soon)) === null);

    // An unscheduled draft must NOT count. Otherwise one forgotten draft
    // silences the agent forever, which is far worse than an extra post.
    await runs("insert an unscheduled draft", () =>
      query(
        `INSERT INTO posts (agent_id, seq, text, rationale, sources_json, fingerprint,
                            cycle_id, status, kind, hashtags_json, used_quote)
         VALUES ($1, 90, 'An unscheduled draft body that is long enough to be real.', 'r',
                 '[]'::jsonb, 'fp — x', 1, 'draft', 'custom', '[]'::jsonb, false)`,
        [agentId],
      ),
    );
    check("an unscheduled draft does NOT block generation", (await covers(soon)) === null,
      "one forgotten draft must never silence the agent");

    await runs("insert a post scheduled before the slot", () =>
      query(
        `INSERT INTO posts (agent_id, seq, text, rationale, sources_json, fingerprint,
                            cycle_id, status, kind, hashtags_json, used_quote, scheduled_for)
         VALUES ($1, 91, 'A hand written post already waiting for its time.', 'r',
                 '[]'::jsonb, 'fp — y', 1, 'draft', 'custom', '[]'::jsonb, false,
                 now() + interval '30 minutes')`,
        [agentId],
      ),
    );
    check("a scheduled post DOES cover the slot", (await covers(soon)) === 91);

    // Already published, so it is not competing for anything.
    await query("UPDATE posts SET status = 'published' WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = 91", [agentId]);
    check("a published post no longer covers it", (await covers(soon)) === null);

    // Scheduled for well after this slot: a later slot's business, not this one's.
    await query(
      "UPDATE posts SET status = 'draft', scheduled_for = now() + interval '10 hours' WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq = 91",
      [agentId],
    );
    check("a post scheduled after the slot does not cover it", (await covers(soon)) === null);

    await query("DELETE FROM posts WHERE agent_id = $1 AND seq IN (90, 91)", [agentId]);
  }

  console.log("\nfeed health");
  {
    const feed = `dbtest-feed-${randomUUID()}`;

    await runs("a successful fetch is recorded", () => recordFeedResult(feed, { ok: true, items: 5 }));
    await runs("a failure is recorded", () => recordFeedResult(feed, { ok: false, error: "http 500" }));
    await runs("the upsert increments rather than duplicating", () =>
      recordFeedResult(feed, { ok: false, error: "http 500" }),
    );
    const row = await query<{ fails_in_a_row: number }>(
      "SELECT fails_in_a_row FROM feed_health WHERE name = $1",
      [feed],
    );
    check("failures accumulate", row[0]?.fails_in_a_row === 2, JSON.stringify(row));

    // Two failures is a bad afternoon, not a dead feed. Alerting on that would
    // train the alert away within a month.
    check("a couple of failures is not yet dead",
      !(await deadFeeds()).some((f) => f.name === feed));

    // Fetched fine, parsed nothing — a redesigned site answering 200 with an
    // HTML error page. Exactly as useless as a timeout, and more likely.
    await runs("zero parsed items counts as a failure", () =>
      recordFeedResult(feed, { ok: true, items: 0 }),
    );
    check("the empty response incremented too",
      (await query<{ fails_in_a_row: number }>(
        "SELECT fails_in_a_row FROM feed_health WHERE name = $1", [feed],
      ))[0]?.fails_in_a_row === 3);

    // Past the threshold AND with the last success pushed back, which is what
    // separates a dead feed from one nobody has fetched lately.
    await query(
      `UPDATE feed_health SET fails_in_a_row = $2, last_ok_at = now() - interval '30 days'
        WHERE name = $1`,
      [feed, DEAD_AFTER_FAILURES],
    );
    check("sustained failure IS reported", (await deadFeeds()).some((f) => f.name === feed));

    // A recent success must clear it however bad the run of failures was.
    await runs("one success resets the counter", () => recordFeedResult(feed, { ok: true, items: 3 }));
    check("a recovered feed is no longer dead",
      !(await deadFeeds()).some((f) => f.name === feed));

    await query("DELETE FROM feed_health WHERE name = $1", [feed]);
  }

  console.log("\nretention sweep");
  {
    // Every one of these names a table and a COLUMN, and the column differs per
    // table — slot_runs keys on run_date, llm_calls on day. A wrong guess is
    // valid TypeScript and invalid SQL, which is the entire reason this file
    // exists, so each statement is executed rather than reasoned about.
    for (const { table, column, days } of RETENTION) {
      await runs(`${table}.${column} is a real column and the sweep runs`, () =>
        query(
          `WITH removed AS (
             DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE ${column} < now() - ($1 || ' days')::interval RETURNING 1
           )
           SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM removed`,
          [String(days)],
        ),
      );
    }

    // The marker lives in system_status, not under an agent, so the cleanup at
    // the end of this file does not touch it — and a second run against the
    // same database within the throttle window would find it already claimed.
    // CI gets a fresh Postgres and would never have noticed; a laptop reusing
    // one would fail on the second run and look like a real regression.
    await runs("clear any marker left by an earlier run", () =>
      query("DELETE FROM system_status WHERE key = 'last_sweep'"),
    );

    const first = await runs("sweepIfDue claims the marker and runs", () => sweepIfDue());
    check("the first sweep ran", first?.ran === true, JSON.stringify(first));
    // The throttle is load-bearing: the tick fires every few minutes and this
    // must not delete-scan four tables each time.
    const second = await runs("sweepIfDue is throttled", () => sweepIfDue());
    check("the second sweep did not run", second?.ran === false, JSON.stringify(second));

    // Left as this run found it, so the next one starts from the same place.
    await query("DELETE FROM system_status WHERE key = 'last_sweep'").catch(() => []);
  }

  // ---- cleanup. Ordered by foreign key, deepest first.
  console.log("\ncleanup");
  {
    await runs("remove everything this run created", async () => {
      if (!agentId) return;
      // slot_runs is keyed by slot, not agent, so it goes first and by slot id.
      await query(
        "DELETE FROM slot_runs WHERE slot_id IN (SELECT id FROM post_slots WHERE agent_id = $1)",
        [agentId],
      ).catch(() => []);
      for (const table of ["push_log", "device_tokens", "distributions", "media_assets", "rejections", "posts", "post_slots", "scheduler_state", "linkedin_accounts"]) {
        await query(`DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE agent_id = $1`, [agentId]).catch(() => []);
      }
      await query("DELETE FROM agents WHERE id = $1", [agentId]);
    });
    check("the agent is gone",
      (await query("SELECT 1 FROM agents WHERE id = $1", [agentId])).length === 0);
  }

  await getPool()?.end();

  console.log(
    failures === 0
      ? `\nAll ${ran} database checks passed.`
      : `\n${failures} of ${ran} database checks FAILED.`,
  );
  process.exit(failures === 0 ? 0 : 1);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error("\ndbtest crashed:", err);
  process.exit(1);
});

````

````text
// Local operator access through an existing Firebase CLI login. Never ship to clients.
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import path from 'node:path';
const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);
export async function googleOperatorToken() {
  return (await googleOperatorCredentials()).accessToken;
}
export async function googleOperatorCredentials() {
  const root=process.env.APPDATA?path.join(process.env.APPDATA,'npm/node_modules'):execFileSync('npm',['root','-g'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();
  const auth=require(path.join(root,'firebase-tools/lib/auth.js'));
  const account=auth.getGlobalDefaultAccount();
  if(!account)throw new Error('Sign into the Firebase CLI first.');
  const token=await auth.getAccessToken(account.tokens.refresh_token,account.tokens.scopes??[]);
  return {accessToken:token.access_token,expiresAt:token.expires_at??Date.now()+45*60_000};
}
export async function googleOperatorFetch(url,options={}) {
  const token=await googleOperatorToken();
  return fetch(url,{...options,headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${token}`,'Content-Type':'application/json',...options.headers},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)});
}
````

## Source: scripts/health-test.ts

````text
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { GET } from '../app/api/health/route';

// This process never opens a database connection. Exercise the public route
// with a successful, failing and absent database, including error redaction.
async function main() {
  const state = (globalThis as unknown as {
    __linkdinDb: { pool: unknown };
  }).__linkdinDb;
  process.env.DATABASE_URL = 'postgres://unused.invalid/test';
  state.pool = { query: async () => ({ rows: [{ '?column?': 1 }] }) };
  let response = await GET();
  assert.equal(response.status, 200);
  assert.equal(response.headers.get('Cache-Control'), 'no-store');
  assert.equal((await response.json()).ok, true);

  state.pool = { query: async () => { throw new Error('private-password-and-host'); } };
  response = await GET();
  assert.equal(response.status, 503);
  const failed = await response.text();
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(failed).ok, false);
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(failed).db, 'unavailable');
  assert.equal(failed.includes('private-password-and-host'), false);

  delete process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  response = await GET();
  assert.equal(response.status, 503);
  assert.equal((await response.json()).db, 'unconfigured');
  console.log('Health readiness: healthy, outage redaction and unconfigured checks passed.');
}
main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
````

````text
}
````

## Source: scripts/live-cycle-smoke.ts

````text
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {provisionUser} from '../lib/native-auth';
import {defaultSetup,setupPersona,setupStyle} from '../lib/onboarding';
import {query,getPool} from '../lib/db';
import {runCycleWithLock} from '../lib/cycle';
async function main(){
  const user=await provisionUser('integration-test',randomUUID(),'ByLine integration test');
  const [agent]=await query<{id:string}>('SELECT id FROM agents WHERE owner_id=$1',[user]);
  try {
    await query(`UPDATE agents SET paused=false,categories_json=$2,style_json=$3,persona_json=$4 WHERE id=$1`,[agent.id,JSON.stringify(['emerging-tech','ai-ml','dev-tooling']),JSON.stringify(setupStyle(defaultSetup)),JSON.stringify(setupPersona(defaultSetup,'ByLine integration test'))]);
    const result=await runCycleWithLock(agent.id,true,{reviewDate:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),suppressNotification:true});
    writeFileSync('.byline-local/live-cycle-result.json',JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
    console.log('Real pipeline result:',JSON.stringify({ran:result.ran,drafted:result.drafted,published:result.published,reason:result.skippedReason,models:result.servedBy}));
    if(!result.drafted)process.exitCode=1;
  }finally{
    await query('UPDATE agents SET paused=true,active=false WHERE id=$1',[agent.id]);
    await getPool()?.end();
  }
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error('Pipeline verification failed:',e.message);process.exitCode=1;});

````

````text
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { writeFileSync, renameSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { liveEnv } from './live-env.mjs';
import { googleOperatorCredentials,googleOperatorFetch } from './google-operator.mjs';
const env=liveEnv();
let geminiProject;
function save(file,data){writeFileSync(file+'.tmp',JSON.stringify(data),{mode:0o600});renameSync(file+'.tmp',file);}
async function refreshCredentials() {
  if(!geminiProject){const r=await googleOperatorFetch(`https://apikeys.googleapis.com/v2/keys:lookupKey?keyString=${encodeURIComponent(env.GEMINI_API_KEY)}`);if(!r.ok)throw new Error('Cannot verify the Gemini project.');geminiProject=(await r.json()).parent.split('/')[1];}
  const r=await googleOperatorFetch(`https://cloudbilling.googleapis.com/v1/projects/${geminiProject}/billingInfo`);
  if(!r.ok||(await r.json()).billingEnabled!==false)throw new Error('Zero-budget guard: billing is enabled or could not be verified. AI remains disabled.');
  const credentials=await googleOperatorCredentials();
  save(env.FCM_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE,credentials);
  save(env.BYLINE_ZERO_BUDGET_STATE_FILE,{keyHash:createHash('sha256').update(env.GEMINI_API_KEY).digest('hex'),billingEnabled:false,verifiedUntil:Date.now()+20*60_000});
}
await refreshCredentials();
const server=spawn(process.execPath,['node_modules/next/dist/bin/next','dev','--hostname','127.0.0.1','--port',env.PORT],{env,stdio:'inherit',windowsHide:true});
let ticking=false;
const tick=setInterval(async()=>{if(ticking)return;ticking=true;try{await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${env.PORT}/api/cron/tick`,{headers:{'x-cron-secret':env.CRON_SECRET},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)});}catch{}finally{ticking=false;}},30000);
const refresh=setInterval(()=>refreshCredentials().catch(()=>console.error('Could not refresh free-tier verification. Generation will stop when verification expires.')),10*60_000);
server.on('exit',code=>{clearInterval(tick);clearInterval(refresh);process.exit(code??0);});
process.on('SIGINT',()=>{clearInterval(tick);clearInterval(refresh);server.kill();});
````

````text
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
export function readEnvFile(name) {
  if(!existsSync(name))throw new Error(`Missing ${name}. Run npm run live:setup first.`);
  return Object.fromEntries(readFileSync(name,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(l=>l&&!l.startsWith('#')&&l.includes('=')).map(l=>{const i=l.indexOf('=');return[l.slice(0,i).trim(),l.slice(i+1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g,'')];}));
}
export function liveEnv() {
  const configured=readEnvFile('.env.byline-live');
  if(configured.DATABASE_URL!=='postgresql://byline_local@127.0.0.1:55440/byline_live')throw new Error('Live development requires the separate local ByLine database.');
  return {...process.env,...configured,BYLINE_TEST_MODE:'false',BYLINE_LOCAL_ONLY:'false',NEXT_DIST_DIR:'.next-byline-live',NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED:'1',BREETH_API_KEY:''};
}
````

````text
param([string]$Device, [switch]$Rebuild)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'node_modules/next/package.json')) {
  npm ci
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Backend dependency installation failed.' }
}
npm run local:setup
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Local database setup failed.' }

function Get-PreviewMode {
  try { return Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/native-auth' -TimeoutSec 3 }
  catch { return $null }
}
$mode = Get-PreviewMode
if (-not $mode) {
  $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3100 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($listener) { throw 'Port 3100 is occupied by an unverified server. Check it before starting ByLine Preview.' }
  $server = Start-Process -FilePath (Get-Command node).Source -ArgumentList 'scripts/local-dev.mjs' `
    -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru `
    -RedirectStandardOutput '.byline-local/server.stdout.log' -RedirectStandardError '.byline-local/server.stderr.log'
  Set-Content -LiteralPath '.byline-local/server.pid' -Value $server.Id
  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(60)
  do {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
    $mode = Get-PreviewMode
    if ($server.HasExited) { throw 'ByLine server exited. See .byline-local/server.stderr.log.' }
  } while (-not $mode -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline)
}
if (-not $mode.localTest -or $mode.linkedin -or $mode.google) {
  throw 'The server on port 3100 is not the isolated preview. No APK was installed.'
}
if ($Rebuild -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.byline-local/byline-preview.apk')) {
  & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'build-local-android.ps1')
}
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'install-local-android.ps1') -Device $Device
Write-Output 'ByLine Preview is ready. Keep USB connected and this computer awake. AI drafts and publishing are simulated.'
````

````text
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const bin=process.env.PG_BIN ?? (process.platform==='win32'?'C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin':'');
const exe=n=>join(bin,n+(process.platform==='win32'?'.exe':''));
const root=resolve('.byline-local');const data=join(root,'postgres');
mkdirSync(root,{recursive:true});
function run(n,args){const r=spawnSync(exe(n),args,{encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true,stdio:n==='pg_ctl'?'ignore':'pipe'});if(r.status!==0)throw new Error(`${n} failed: ${r.stderr??r.error}`);}
if(!existsSync(join(data,'PG_VERSION')))run('initdb',['-D',data,'-U','byline_local','-A','trust','--encoding=UTF8','--no-locale']);
if(spawnSync(exe('pg_ctl'),['-D',data,'status'],{windowsHide:true}).status!==0)run('pg_ctl',['-D',data,'-l',join(root,'postgres.log'),'-o','-h 127.0.0.1 -p 55440','-w','start']);
const args=['-h','127.0.0.1','-p','55440','-U','byline_local'];
const check=spawnSync(exe('psql'),[...args,'-d','postgres','-Atc',"SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='byline_local'"],{encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true});
if(check.status!==0)throw new Error('Cannot connect to isolated PostgreSQL.');
if(check.stdout.trim()!=='1')run('createdb',[...args,'byline_local']);
if(!existsSync('.env.byline-local'))writeFileSync('.env.byline-local',[
  '# Generated local-only test settings. Never commit this file.',
  'DATABASE_URL=postgresql://byline_local@127.0.0.1:55440/byline_local',
  `APP_SECRET=${randomBytes(32).toString('hex')}`,`APP_PASSWORD=${randomBytes(24).toString('hex')}`,
  `TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${randomBytes(32).toString('base64')}`,`CRON_SECRET=${randomBytes(24).toString('hex')}`,
  'BYLINE_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3100','PORT=3100',''].join('\n'),{mode:0o600});
console.log('ByLine isolated local database is ready. No provider keys or paid services are used.');
console.log('Next: npm run local:dev. Your existing database and .env files are unchanged.');
````

````text
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {randomBytes, createHash, randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import pg from 'pg';
import {localEnv} from './local-env.mjs';
const env=localEnv(), base=`http://127.0.0.1:${env.PORT}`;
const testClient=`2001:db8:${randomBytes(8).toString('hex').match(/.{4}/g).join(':')}::1`;
const db=new pg.Pool({connectionString:env.DATABASE_URL});
let checks=0;
function check(value,message){assert.ok(value,message);checks++;console.log(`ok ${message}`);}
async function post(body){return fetch(base+'/api/native-auth',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json','x-forwarded-for':testClient},body:JSON.stringify(body)});}
try {
  const mode=await (await fetch(base+'/api/native-auth')).json();
  assert.equal(mode.localTest,true); // never seed flows in live storage
  const verifier=randomBytes(48).toString('base64url');
  const returnUri=`http://127.0.0.1:54321/byline-return/${randomBytes(32).toString('base64url')}`;
  const id=`native-${randomUUID()}`;
  await db.query('INSERT INTO native_auth(id,provider,verifier_hash,redirect_uri,return_uri) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)',[id,'linkedin',createHash('sha256').update(verifier).digest('hex'),base+'/api/linkedin/callback',returnUri]);
  const cancelled=await fetch(base+`/api/linkedin/callback?state=${id}&error=access_denied`,{redirect:'manual'});
  const html=await cancelled.text();
  check(cancelled.status===400&&!cancelled.headers.get('location')&&html.includes(returnUri),'cancelled desktop sign-in retains its app return and avoids the old site');
  check(!html.includes(verifier)&&!html.includes('access_denied'),'browser return contains no verifier or provider payload');
  const wrong=await (await post({action:'poll',id,verifier:randomBytes(48).toString('base64url')})).json();
  check(wrong.pending===true,'wrong verifier cannot consume a completed attempt');
  const failure=await post({action:'poll',id,verifier});
  check(failure.status===400&&(await failure.json()).error==='sign_in_failed','app receives cancellation through the protected polling API');
  const replay=await fetch(base+`/api/linkedin/callback?state=${id}&code=not-a-provider-code`,{redirect:'manual'});
  check(replay.status===400&&!replay.headers.get('location')&&(await replay.text()).includes('Return to ByLine'),'replayed native callback stays on ByLine recovery page');
  for(const path of ['/api/linkedin/callback','/api/native-auth/callback?state=expired']) {
    const r=await fetch(base+path,{redirect:'manual'});
    check(r.status===400&&!r.headers.get('location'),'missing or expired callback does not redirect to the legacy website');
  }
  const invalid=await post({provider:'linkedin',verifier,returnUri:'https://external.example/'});
  check(invalid.status===400&&(await invalid.json()).error==='invalid_return_uri','external return destinations are rejected');
  const state=`app-${randomUUID()}`;
  const agent=(await db.query('SELECT id FROM agents WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1')).rows[0].id;
  await db.query('INSERT INTO oauth_states(state,agent_id,native,return_uri) VALUES($1,$2,true,$3)',[state,agent,returnUri]);
  const reconnect=await fetch(base+`/api/linkedin/callback?state=${state}&error=access_denied`,{redirect:'manual'});
  check(reconnect.status===400&&(await reconnect.text()).includes(returnUri),'LinkedIn reconnection uses the same desktop return on cancellation');
  check((await db.query('SELECT 1 FROM oauth_states WHERE state=$1',[state])).rowCount===0,'cancelled reconnect state is consumed');
  console.log(`${checks} native-return checks passed; no provider exchange or publishing calls.`);
} finally {await db.end();}

````
